adaptedNames.displayName: 加减法应用题 · 10以内的情境
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Solve addition and subtraction word problems within 10 using objects or drawings

adaptedNames.displayName: 加法与减法 · 20以内的数
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Add and subtract one-digit and two-digit numbers to 20, including zero

adaptedNames.displayName: 加减法的策略 · 往前数与往后数
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Use counting on and counting back as strategies for addition and subtraction

adaptedNames.displayName: 熟练使用加减法 · 20以内的事实
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Recall and use addition and subtraction facts to 20 fluently, and derive and use related facts up to 100

adaptedNames.displayName: 加减法口算 · 两位数与一位数
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Add and subtract a two-digit number and ones mentally and using concrete/pictorial representations

adaptedNames.displayName: 加法与减法 · 三位数竖式
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Add and subtract numbers with up to three digits using formal written methods of columnar addition and subtraction

adaptedNames.displayName: 加减法的策略 · 数位与运算规律
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Explain why addition and subtraction strategies work, using place value and the properties of operations

adaptedNames.displayName: 用四舍五入估算 · 估算与逆运算检查
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Estimate the answer to a calculation and use inverse operations to check answers; apply to increasingly large numbers using rounding and inverse reasoning

adaptedNames.displayName: 加减法口算 · 三位数与一位数
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Mentally add and subtract a three-digit number and ones

adaptedNames.displayName: 数轴上的数 · 整数与加减
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Represent whole numbers as lengths on a number line and represent sums and differences within 100 on a number line diagram

adaptedNames.displayName: 加法与减法 · 四位数竖式
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Add and subtract numbers with up to four digits using formal written methods of columnar addition and subtraction

adaptedNames.displayName: 加法与减法 · 多步情境
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Solve addition and subtraction multi-step problems in contexts, deciding which operations and methods to use and why

adaptedNames.displayName: 熟练使用加减法 · 多位数竖式
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Fluently add and subtract whole numbers with more than four digits using the standard columnar algorithm

adaptedNames.displayName: 加减法口算 · 较大数与数位
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Add and subtract numbers mentally with increasingly large numbers, using place-value knowledge and derived facts

adaptedNames.displayName: 加法与减法 · 大数与小数情境
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Solve addition and subtraction multi-step problems in contexts, deciding which operations and methods to use and why, with numbers up to 10,000,000 and decimals

adaptedNames.displayName: 加减法的策略 · 小数的数位与运算
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Add and subtract decimals to hundredths using strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction; relate strategies to written methods and explain reasoning

adaptedNames.displayName: 坐标 · 四象限的点
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Plot and read coordinates in all four quadrants of the Cartesian plane, using positive and negative x- and y-values to describe positions precisely

adaptedNames.displayName: 数轴上的数 · 不等式的解
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Understand inequalities as statements comparing expressions, represent solutions on a number line, and solve simple linear inequalities using the same inverse-operation methods as equations

adaptedNames.displayName: 按2、5、10跳着数
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Count in multiples of 2, 5, and 10 (skip counting)

adaptedNames.displayName: 顺着数与倒着数 · 每次走3
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Count forwards and backwards in steps of 3 from 0

adaptedNames.displayName: 顺着数与倒着数 · 每次走10
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Count forwards and backwards in tens from any number (not just multiples of 10)

adaptedNames.displayName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 简单图表与计数
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Interpret and construct simple pictograms, tally charts, block diagrams, and simple tables

adaptedNames.displayName: 按特征分类 · 分类、计数与排序
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Classify objects into given categories, count the number in each category, and sort the categories by count

adaptedNames.displayName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 收集和图表词语
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Read, write, and use the vocabulary of data collection and display — data, tally, tally chart, frequency, frequency table, survey, pictogram, bar chart, axis/axes, scale, label, category, discrete data, continuous data, line graph, pie chart — and apply these terms when collecting, organising, and presenting data

adaptedNames.displayName: 按特征分类 · 比较各类数量
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Interpret categorical data by asking and answering questions about totals, how many in each category, and how many more or less one category has than another

adaptedNames.displayName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 分类与分组数据的图表
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Construct and interpret frequency tables, bar charts, pie charts, pictograms, and vertical line charts for both categorical and grouped numerical data, choosing appropriate representations for the data type

adaptedNames.displayName: 理解分数 · 数量的一半与等值
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Write simple fractions (e.g. 1/2 of 6 = 3) and recognise the equivalence of 2/4 and 1/2

adaptedNames.displayName: 比较分数大小 · 单位分数与同分母
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Compare and order unit fractions, and fractions with the same denominator

adaptedNames.displayName: 比较分数大小 · 综合分数问题
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Solve problems involving counting in tenths, fractions of quantities, equivalence, fraction addition/subtraction, and fraction comparison

adaptedNames.displayName: 等值分数 · 看图识别
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Recognise and show, using diagrams, equivalent fractions with small denominators

adaptedNames.displayName: 数轴上的分数 · 把分数放上数轴
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Recognise and use fractions as numbers: place unit fractions and non-unit fractions with small denominators on a number line

adaptedNames.displayName: 认识十分之一 · 分成十份
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Count up and down in tenths; recognise that tenths arise from dividing an object into 10 equal parts and from dividing one-digit numbers or quantities by 10

adaptedNames.displayName: 比较分数大小 · 同分子或同分母
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Compare two fractions with the same numerator or the same denominator by reasoning about size; record comparisons with >, =, or < symbols

adaptedNames.displayName: 小数与分数 · 测量与钱的情境
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Solve simple measure and money problems involving fractions and decimals to two decimal places

adaptedNames.displayName: 等值分数 · 细分与合并
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Generate simple equivalent fractions and explain why they are equivalent using visual fraction models

adaptedNames.displayName: 分数的意义 · 整体中的等份
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Understand a fraction 1/b as the quantity formed by 1 part when a whole is partitioned into b equal parts; understand a/b as a parts of size 1/b

adaptedNames.displayName: 分数的意义 · 整数与等值分数
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Express whole numbers as fractions (e.g. 3 = 3/1) and recognise fractions equivalent to whole numbers (e.g. 4/4 = 1, 6/1 = 6)

adaptedNames.displayName: 数轴上的分数 · 一份一份走
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Represent fractions on a number line: partition the interval 0 to 1 into b equal parts to locate 1/b, then mark off a lengths of 1/b from 0 to locate a/b

adaptedNames.displayName: 认识十分之一 · 从十分之一到百分之一
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Count up and down in hundredths; recognise that hundredths arise when dividing an object by 100 or dividing tenths by 10

adaptedNames.displayName: 加减法应用题 · 同分母分数情境
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Solve word problems involving addition and subtraction of fractions with like denominators, using visual models and equations

adaptedNames.displayName: 比较分数大小 · 通分或借助参照
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Compare and order fractions with different numerators and denominators by creating common denominators/numerators or comparing to a benchmark such as 1/2; justify conclusions with visual models

adaptedNames.displayName: 等值分数 · 同倍变化
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Explain why a fraction a/b is equivalent to (n×a)/(n×b) using visual models; use this principle to recognise and generate equivalent fractions, including tenths and hundredths

adaptedNames.displayName: 分数的意义 · 分数乘整数的情境
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Solve word problems involving multiplication of a fraction by a whole number using visual models and equations

adaptedNames.displayName: 分数乘法 · 分数乘整数
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Understand a/b as a multiple of 1/b; multiply proper fractions and mixed numbers by whole numbers, supported by visual models (e.g. 3 × 2/5 = 6/5 = 1 1/5)

adaptedNames.displayName: 认识十分之一 · 从百分之一到千分之一
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Recognise and use thousandths; relate them to tenths, hundredths, and their decimal equivalents (e.g. 1/1000 = 0.001, 35/1000 = 0.035)

adaptedNames.displayName: 理解分数 · 几个相同的小份
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Understand a fraction a/b with a > 1 as a sum of fractions 1/b (e.g. 3/5 = 1/5 + 1/5 + 1/5)

adaptedNames.displayName: 比较分数大小 · 包括大于1的分数
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Compare and order fractions including fractions greater than 1, by converting to common denominators or using benchmarks

adaptedNames.displayName: 小数与分数 · 分数除法与小数百分数
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Associate a fraction with division and calculate decimal fraction equivalents for simple fractions (e.g. 3/8 = 0.375); recall and use equivalences between simple fractions, decimals, and percentages in different contexts

adaptedNames.displayName: 分数的意义 · 分数表示除法
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Interpret a fraction as division of the numerator by the denominator (a/b = a ÷ b); solve word problems involving division of whole numbers leading to fractional or mixed-number answers

adaptedNames.displayName: 分数乘法 · 分数乘分数
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction, including proper fractions by proper fractions; interpret (a/b) × q as a parts of q partitioned into b equal parts; write answers in simplest form

adaptedNames.displayName: 小数与分数 · 有限小数与分数互换
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Work interchangeably with terminating decimals and their corresponding fractions (such as 3.5 and 7/2 or 0.375 and 3/8); convert fluently between the two forms

adaptedNames.displayName: 整数、小数与分数的四则运算
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Use the four operations with formal written methods applied to integers, decimals, proper and improper fractions, and mixed numbers, all both positive and negative

adaptedNames.displayName: 分数乘法 · 求一个量的几分之几
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Interpret fractions and percentages as operators — find a fraction or percentage of an amount by multiplying, understanding that 'of' means multiply (e.g., 3/4 of 200 = 3/4 × 200 = 150)

adaptedNames.displayName: 平面图形 · 认识常见平面图形
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Recognise and name common 2-D shapes (circles, triangles, rectangles including squares)

adaptedNames.displayName: 立体图形 · 认识常见立体图形
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Recognise and name common 3-D shapes (cubes, cuboids, pyramids, spheres, cylinders, cones)

adaptedNames.displayName: 立体图形 · 比较平面与立体
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Analyse and compare 2-D and 3-D shapes using informal language to describe sides, vertices, and other attributes

adaptedNames.displayName: 平面图形 · 边与对称
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Identify and describe properties of 2-D shapes including the number of sides and line symmetry in a vertical line

adaptedNames.displayName: 平面图形 · 画平面图形与建立体图形
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Draw 2-D shapes and make 3-D shapes using modelling materials; recognise 3-D shapes in different orientations and describe them

adaptedNames.displayName: 理解角 · 图形与转动中的角
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Recognise angles as a property of shape or a description of a turn

adaptedNames.displayName: 平面图形 · 寻找对称轴
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Identify lines of symmetry in 2-D shapes presented in different orientations; recognise line-symmetric figures and draw lines of symmetry

adaptedNames.displayName: 坐标 · 连点组成图形
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Plot specified points on a coordinate grid and draw sides to complete a given polygon

adaptedNames.displayName: 网格上的图形变换 · 反射、平移与旋转
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Represent and carry out geometric transformations on squared paper or a coordinate grid: reflections (in horizontal, vertical, and diagonal mirror lines, including the axes), translations (described as a vector or as left/right/up/down moves), and rotations (90° or 180° about a stated centre point); describe each transformation precisely using the correct language; identify which transformation maps one shape onto its image by comparing position, orientation, and size

adaptedNames.displayName: 角的分类 · 锐角与钝角
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Identify acute and obtuse angles; compare and order angles up to two right angles by size

adaptedNames.displayName: 角的分类 · 读懂几何图形的标记
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Use and interpret standard geometric diagram conventions: mark right angles with a small square, equal lengths with single or double tick marks, and equal angles with arc marks; label angles in three-letter notation (∠ABC) and individual angles with a single letter or number; draw diagrams showing angles at a point, angles on a straight line, and angles inside polygons with these conventions; read diagrams with these marks to identify given information and find unknown values

adaptedNames.displayName: 立体图形 · 从平面图认识立体
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Identify 3-D shapes, including cubes and other cuboids, from 2-D representations

adaptedNames.displayName: 测量角 · 量角与画角
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Measure angles in whole-number degrees using a protractor; draw given angles and sketch angles of specified measure

adaptedNames.displayName: 测量角 · 角的加减与未知角
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Recognise angle measure as additive; find unknown angles by adding or subtracting on a diagram using equations with a symbol for the unknown

adaptedNames.displayName: 网格上的图形变换 · 反射与平移后的位置
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Identify, describe, and represent the position of a shape following a reflection or translation using appropriate language; know that the shape has not changed

adaptedNames.displayName: 理解角 · 长方形中的角和长度
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Use the properties of rectangles to deduce related facts and find missing lengths and angles

adaptedNames.displayName: 平面图形 · 按尺寸和角度画图
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Draw 2-D shapes using given dimensions and angles, using a ruler and protractor accurately

adaptedNames.displayName: 立体图形 · 建立体与展开图
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Recognise, describe, and build simple 3-D shapes, including making nets

adaptedNames.displayName: 坐标 · 用负数描述位置
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Describe positions on the full coordinate grid (all four quadrants); use coordinates with negative values

adaptedNames.displayName: 理解角 · 交点、直线与对顶角
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Recognise angles where they meet at a point, are on a straight line, or are vertically opposite; find missing angles using these properties

adaptedNames.displayName: 立体图形 · 面、棱、顶点与截面
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Use the properties of faces, surfaces, edges, and vertices of 3-D shapes (cubes, cuboids, prisms, cylinders, pyramids, cones, and spheres) to solve problems, including visualising cross-sections

adaptedNames.displayName: 理解角 · 用角的关系解决多步问题
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Apply the properties of angles at a point (360°), on a straight line (180°), and vertically opposite angles to find unknown angles in multi-step problems

adaptedNames.displayName: 数轴上的数 · 选择数轴等工具
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Select and use appropriate tools and representations (number lines, hundred squares, rulers, part-whole models) to support problem-solving

adaptedNames.displayName: 图形规律 · 运算、数位与图形结构
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: apply properties of operations, place-value patterns, and relationships between shapes to solve problems efficiently

adaptedNames.displayName: 说明推理的依据 · 跟随推理并找错
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Construct and follow multi-step mathematical arguments; identify errors in reasoning and explain why a method works or does not work

adaptedNames.displayName: 解决多步问题 · 拆分问题与检查
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: With teacher support, make sense of multi-step problems involving larger numbers or mixed operations by breaking them into parts, choosing strategies, and checking answers for reasonableness — children at this stage are developing the habit with guidance; independent strategy evaluation comes later

adaptedNames.displayName: 图形规律 · 三位数、乘除与图形
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: apply place-value patterns to three-digit operations, use multiplication/division relationships, and exploit shape properties to classify

adaptedNames.displayName: 理解分数 · 情境、图形与算式
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, and symbolic equations involving three-digit numbers and fractions, explaining what each part represents

adaptedNames.displayName: 理解分数 · 准确使用词语与符号
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct place-value and fraction vocabulary, specify units in measurement answers, and use notation accurately

adaptedNames.displayName: 用数学表示测量、钱和时间
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Model real-world problems involving measurement, money, and time by choosing appropriate representations and interpreting results in context

adaptedNames.displayName: 数轴上的分数 · 数轴、情境与算式
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, number lines, and symbolic equations involving multiplication, fractions, and decimals, explaining what each representation shows

adaptedNames.displayName: 说明推理的依据 · 呈现推理并评价
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Construct and present multi-step mathematical arguments; critique the reasoning of others and explain clearly why a method works or fails

adaptedNames.displayName: 解决多步问题 · 四则、分数与面积体积
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Make sense of multi-step problems involving four operations, fractions, and area/volume by identifying sub-steps, choosing a strategy, and monitoring progress

adaptedNames.displayName: 乘法口诀与乘法表 · 从已知规律推出新事实
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend patterns in times tables and equivalent fractions, derive unknown facts from known facts efficiently, describe general rules

adaptedNames.displayName: 运算、分数与图形的结构
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: exploit the relationship between fractions, decimals, and percentages; use factor pairs to simplify multiplication; apply angle facts to find unknowns; use properties of regular polygons systematically

adaptedNames.displayName: 数轴上的分数 · 连接小数与百分数
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, number lines, bar models, and symbolic equations involving multi-digit multiplication, fractions, decimals, and percentages, explaining connections between representations

adaptedNames.displayName: 理解分数 · 多步论证与检错
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Construct and present logical mathematical arguments involving multiple steps; critique others' reasoning about fractions, angles, or calculations and clearly explain errors or alternative methods

adaptedNames.displayName: 运算顺序 · 发现运算与图形结构
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: exploit the hierarchy of 2-D shapes to deduce properties; use order of operations and algebraic structure to simplify expressions; connect fraction–decimal–percentage equivalences; use ratio structure to solve proportion problems efficiently

adaptedNames.displayName: 理解分数 · 多种表示之间的联系
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, coordinate grids, algebraic expressions, tables, and symbolic equations involving fractions, ratio, and algebra, explaining connections between representations

adaptedNames.displayName: 测量质量与重量 · 直接比较轻重
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Compare two objects directly by mass or weight and describe the difference using language such as heavy, light, heavier than, lighter than

adaptedNames.displayName: 测量质量与重量 · 用单位测量质量
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Measure and begin to record mass/weight using non-standard and standard units

adaptedNames.displayName: 测量长度 · 比较与排列长度
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Order three objects by length and compare the lengths of two objects indirectly using a third object

adaptedNames.displayName: 测量长度 · 用相同单位首尾相接
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Measure the length of an object using same-size length units laid end to end with no gaps or overlaps

adaptedNames.displayName: 加减法应用题 · 长度情境
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Solve word problems involving lengths within 100, using addition and subtraction with drawings and equations

adaptedNames.displayName: 测量长度 · 选择工具测量
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Measure the length of an object by selecting and using appropriate tools such as rulers, yardsticks, metre sticks, and measuring tapes

adaptedNames.displayName: 测量单位换算 · 长度与时间单位
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Convert between different units of measure (e.g. kilometre to metre, hour to minute, minute to second, year to month, week to day)

adaptedNames.displayName: 测量单位换算 · 常用单位的相对大小
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Know relative sizes of measurement units within one system (km/m/cm/mm, kg/g, l/ml, hr/min/sec); convert between different metric units and express measurements in terms of a smaller unit; record equivalents in conversion tables

adaptedNames.displayName: 数轴上的分数 · 用数轴表示实际问题
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Solve word problems involving distances, time intervals, liquid volumes, masses, and money using the four operations with fractions or decimals; represent with diagrams including number lines

adaptedNames.displayName: 小数的数位与运用 · 用小数换算单位
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Convert among different-sized standard measurement units within a given system (e.g. 5 cm to 0.05 m) using decimal notation to up to three decimal places; convert between smaller and larger units of length, mass, volume, and time

adaptedNames.displayName: 用排列方阵表示乘法 · 用阵列表示乘除
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Use arrays to represent multiplication and division situations

adaptedNames.displayName: 乘法是相同加数的和 · 相同加数与成组
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Understand multiplication as repeated addition and grouping equal sets

adaptedNames.displayName: 乘法是相同加数的和 · 用阵列和事实解决问题
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Solve problems involving multiplication and division using arrays, repeated addition, mental methods, and known facts

adaptedNames.displayName: 乘法口诀与乘法表 · 2、5、10的乘除事实
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Recall and use multiplication and division facts for the 2, 5, and 10 multiplication tables

adaptedNames.displayName: 用排列方阵表示乘法 · 阵列中的相同加数
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Use addition to find the total number of objects arranged in rectangular arrays with up to 5 rows and 5 columns; write an equation to express the total as a sum of equal addends

adaptedNames.displayName: 乘法口诀与乘法表 · 3、4、8的乘除事实
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Recall and use multiplication and division facts for the 3, 4, and 8 multiplication tables

adaptedNames.displayName: 乘除法口算 · 0、1与三个数的乘除
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Use place value, known and derived facts to multiply and divide mentally, including multiplying by 0 and 1, dividing by 1, and multiplying together three numbers

adaptedNames.displayName: 有余数的除法 · 情境中的余数
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Solve multi-step word problems using the four operations with whole numbers, including interpreting remainders in context; represent with equations using a letter for the unknown; check with estimation

adaptedNames.displayName: 因数、倍数与质数 · 因数对与公倍数
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Find all factor pairs for a whole number in the range 1–100; identify common factors and common multiples of two numbers; use these concepts to solve problems

adaptedNames.displayName: 因数、倍数与质数 · 因数、倍数与平方立方
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Solve problems involving multiplication and division using knowledge of factors, multiples, squares, and cubes

adaptedNames.displayName: 乘法竖式 · 竖式与面积模型
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Multiply a whole number of up to four digits by a one-digit number, and multiply two two-digit numbers, using formal written methods including long multiplication; illustrate with area models

adaptedNames.displayName: 乘除法口算 · 利用已知事实和数位
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Multiply and divide numbers mentally drawing upon known facts, including related facts and place-value adjustments

adaptedNames.displayName: 用倍数比较 · 读懂倍数比较
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Interpret a multiplication equation as a comparison (e.g. 35 = 5 × 7 means 35 is 5 times as many as 7); represent verbal statements of multiplicative comparisons as equations

adaptedNames.displayName: 用倍数比较 · 倍数比较的情境问题
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Solve word problems involving multiplicative comparison using drawings and equations with a symbol for the unknown number

adaptedNames.displayName: 图形规律 · 按规则生成图形或数列
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Generate a number or shape pattern that follows a given rule; identify apparent features of the pattern not explicit in the rule and explain informally why they occur

adaptedNames.displayName: 平方数与立方数 · 认识平方与立方
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Recognise and use square numbers and cube numbers, and the notation for squared (²) and cubed (³)

adaptedNames.displayName: 理解分数 · 分数倍与简单速率
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Solve problems involving scaling by simple fractions and problems involving simple rates

adaptedNames.displayName: 有余数的除法 · 两位数除数与余数
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Divide numbers up to 4 digits by a two-digit divisor using formal written long division, interpreting remainders as whole numbers, fractions, or by rounding as appropriate

adaptedNames.displayName: 乘法竖式 · 多位数竖式
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Fluently multiply multi-digit whole numbers (up to 4 digits by 2 digits) using the formal written method of long multiplication

adaptedNames.displayName: 运算顺序 · 四则运算的次序
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Understand and apply the conventional order of operations (PEMDAS/BODMAS) to carry out calculations involving the four operations

adaptedNames.displayName: 因数、倍数与质数 · 质因数与公因数公倍数
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Use the concepts and vocabulary of prime numbers, factors, multiples, common factors, common multiples, highest common factor (HCF), lowest common multiple (LCM), and prime factorisation including product notation and the unique factorisation property

adaptedNames.displayName: 数的读写 · 整数的读写比较
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Read, write, order, and compare whole numbers up to at least 1,000,000 using base-ten numerals, number names, expanded form, and place-value understanding

adaptedNames.displayName: 顺着数与倒着数 · 按10的幂走
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Count forwards and backwards in steps of powers of 10 (10, 100, 1000, 10,000, 100,000) for any given number up to 1,000,000

adaptedNames.displayName: 数的读写 · 小数的读写比较
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Read, write, and compare decimals to thousandths using base-ten numerals, number names, and expanded form; compare using >, =, < based on place-value meaning

adaptedNames.displayName: 小数的数位与运用 · 按精度取近似值
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Round numbers and measures to an appropriate degree of accuracy including to a specified number of decimal places or significant figures

adaptedNames.displayName: 数轴上的分数 · 正负数共用数轴
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Understand and use place value for decimals, measures, and integers of any size; extend the number system to include all positive and negative integers, decimals, and fractions on a single number line

adaptedNames.displayName: 数轴上的分数 · 正负数的顺序与比较
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Order positive and negative integers, decimals, and fractions on a number line; use the symbols =, ≠, <, >, ≤, ≥ to compare values including negative numbers and mixed representations

adaptedNames.displayName: 平方数与立方数 · 整数幂与实数根
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Use integer powers and associated real roots (square, cube, and higher); recognise powers of 2, 3, 4, and 5; distinguish between exact representations of roots and their decimal approximations

adaptedNames.displayName: 用四舍五入估算 · 误差与上下界
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Use approximation through rounding to estimate answers and calculate possible resulting errors expressed using inequality notation a < x ≤ b; understand upper and lower bounds of rounded values

adaptedNames.displayName: 百分数的应用 · 比例与百分数的词语
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Know and use the vocabulary of ratio and proportion — ratio, proportion, percentage, scale, equivalent, unequal, relative size, part-to-part, part-to-whole, and out of — and understand the difference between ratio (comparing parts to parts) and proportion (comparing a part to the whole)

adaptedNames.displayName: 理解分数 · 不等分与分组
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Solve problems involving unequal sharing and grouping using knowledge of fractions and multiples

adaptedNames.displayName: 百分数的应用 · 增减、原值与利息
adaptedNames.sourceGoal: Solve problems involving percentage increase, percentage decrease, finding the original value after a percentage change, and calculating simple interest

edges.fromName: 分数的意义 · 整体中的等份
edges.toName: 理解分数 · 几个相同的小份
edges.fromGoal: Understand a fraction 1/b as the quantity formed by 1 part when a whole is partitioned into b equal parts; understand a/b as a parts of size 1/b
edges.toGoal: Understand a fraction a/b with a > 1 as a sum of fractions 1/b (e.g. 3/5 = 1/5 + 1/5 + 1/5)
edges.sourceReason: Understanding a/b as a parts of size 1/b is prerequisite to understanding a/b as sum of 1/b
edges.chineseReason: 把整体分成相同小份后，几个这样的单位分数可以相加，组成一个分数。

edges.fromGoal: Understand division as sharing equally into groups or as grouping (how many groups of a given size can be made)
edges.toGoal: Recognise odd and even numbers
edges.sourceReason: Odd/even is about whether a number can be divided into 2 equal groups
edges.chineseReason: 把整数个物品两两配对，或平均分成两组，可以观察有没有剩余。

edges.fromGoal: Count in multiples of 2, 5, and 10 (skip counting)
edges.toGoal: Recognise odd and even numbers
edges.sourceReason: Even numbers connect to counting in 2s
edges.chineseReason: 两个一组地数，如果没有剩下，就可以把物品两两配对。

edges.fromName: 因数、倍数与质数 · 因数对与公倍数
edges.toName: 因数、倍数与质数 · 因数、倍数与平方立方
edges.fromGoal: Find all factor pairs for a whole number in the range 1–100; identify common factors and common multiples of two numbers; use these concepts to solve problems
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving multiplication and division using knowledge of factors, multiples, squares, and cubes
edges.sourceReason: Factor/multiple knowledge is prerequisite to solving problems with them
edges.chineseReason: 知道怎样找因数和倍数，可以用这些关系解决乘除问题。

edges.fromName: 平方数与立方数 · 认识平方与立方
edges.toName: 因数、倍数与质数 · 因数、倍数与平方立方
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use square numbers and cube numbers, and the notation for squared (²) and cubed (³)
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving multiplication and division using knowledge of factors, multiples, squares, and cubes
edges.sourceReason: Square/cube number knowledge is prerequisite to solving problems with them
edges.chineseReason: 认识平方数和立方数，可以把它们的性质用于乘除问题。

edges.fromGoal: Read and write numerals from 0 to 20
edges.toGoal: Tell and write the time to the hour and half past the hour on analogue clocks and digital displays (e.g. 3 o'clock = 3:00, half past 7 = 7:30), and draw clock hands to show these times, placing the hour hand halfway between two numbers for half past
edges.sourceReason: Reading a clock requires recognising numerals 1–12
edges.chineseReason: 认出钟面上的1到12，有助于确定时针和分针指向的位置。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise, find, and name a half as one of two equal parts of an object, shape, or quantity
edges.toGoal: Tell and write the time to the hour and half past the hour on analogue clocks and digital displays (e.g. 3 o'clock = 3:00, half past 7 = 7:30), and draw clock hands to show these times, placing the hour hand halfway between two numbers for half past
edges.sourceReason: Understanding 'half past' benefits from the concept of halves
edges.chineseReason: 半小时是一小时的一半，理解一半能帮助看懂钟面上的半时。

edges.fromGoal: Measure and begin to record time in hours, minutes, and seconds
edges.toGoal: Tell and write the time to the hour and half past the hour on analogue clocks and digital displays (e.g. 3 o'clock = 3:00, half past 7 = 7:30), and draw clock hands to show these times, placing the hour hand halfway between two numbers for half past
edges.sourceReason: GB route: Year 1 experience of hours, minutes and seconds as units of time supports reading o'clock and half-past times; soft because this node is GB-only
edges.chineseReason: 理解小时和分钟的单位，能帮助读懂整时和半时。

edges.fromGoal: Count in multiples of 2, 5, and 10 (skip counting)
edges.toGoal: Quantify collections of up to 120 objects by partitioning them into equal groups (twos, fives or tens) and skip counting, explaining why grouping makes counting faster and more reliable
edges.sourceReason: Counting a collection in equal groups uses skip counting
edges.chineseReason: 每组物品一样多时，可以按每组的数量跳着数，得到总数。

edges.fromName: 乘法是相同加数的和 · 相同加数与成组
edges.fromGoal: Understand multiplication as repeated addition and grouping equal sets
edges.toGoal: Quantify collections of up to 120 objects by partitioning them into equal groups (twos, fives or tens) and skip counting, explaining why grouping makes counting faster and more reliable
edges.sourceReason: Seeing equal groups as repeated addition supports quantifying collections
edges.chineseReason: 每组数量相同时，可以把各组数量反复相加，求出总数。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that 10 can be thought of as a bundle of ten ones — called a 'ten'
edges.toGoal: Quantify collections of up to 120 objects by partitioning them into equal groups (twos, fives or tens) and skip counting, explaining why grouping makes counting faster and more reliable
edges.sourceReason: Bundling into tens draws on knowing a ten is ten ones
edges.chineseReason: 把物品十个一捆时，每一捆都代表十个一。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise and name the number of objects in a collection of up to 5 instantly, without counting one by one (subitising), using dot patterns, dice faces, fingers and small groups of objects
edges.toGoal: Quantify collections of up to 120 objects by partitioning them into equal groups (twos, fives or tens) and skip counting, explaining why grouping makes counting faster and more reliable
edges.sourceReason: Recognising small groups instantly speeds up counting collections in groups
edges.chineseReason: 认出小组里有几个物品，可以帮助数清一组一组摆放的总数。

edges.fromGoal: Use common factors to simplify fractions to their simplest form; use common multiples to express fractions with a common denominator
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators (including mixed numbers) by replacing given fractions with equivalent fractions to produce a common denominator
edges.sourceReason: Finding common denominators requires simplification/common multiples skills
edges.chineseReason: 先约分能得到更简洁的等值分数，再寻找共同分母。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise mixed numbers and improper fractions; convert from one form to the other (e.g. 2/5 + 4/5 = 6/5 = 1 1/5)
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators (including mixed numbers) by replacing given fractions with equivalent fractions to produce a common denominator
edges.sourceReason: Mixed number operations benefit from mixed/improper conversion
edges.chineseReason: 带分数和假分数可以表示同一个量；互相转换后，可以选择方便的方式计算。

edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract fractions with denominators that are multiples of the same number by finding a common denominator
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators (including mixed numbers) by replacing given fractions with equivalent fractions to produce a common denominator
edges.sourceReason: Unlike-denominator add/sub extends Y5 add/sub with related denominators
edges.chineseReason: 把不同大小的小份换成共同大小后，可以接着做分数加减。

edges.fromName: 哪些边长能组成三角形
edges.fromGoal: Decide whether given side and angle conditions determine a unique triangle, more than one triangle, or no triangle, and explain why, predicting with a freehand sketch and testing by construction (ruler and protractor, compasses, or dynamic geometry software): three sides give exactly one triangle when each pair of sides adds to more than the third, and none otherwise — if the two shorter sides add to less than the longest, the construction arcs do not meet, and if they add to exactly the longest (e.g. 3, 4 and 7), the arcs touch only on the base line, so the sides lie flat in a straight line rather than forming a triangle; three angles must add to 180° and then fix only the shape, not the size, so many triangles fit (none if the sum is not 180°); two sides with the included angle, or two angles with the included side, give exactly one triangle; and two sides with an angle that is not between them can give two, one or no triangles
edges.toGoal: Know and use the criteria for triangle congruence (SSS, SAS, ASA, RHS), use standard labelling conventions for sides and angles of triangle ABC, and determine whether two triangles are congruent
edges.sourceReason: Congruence criteria are exactly the sets of conditions that determine a unique triangle, and explaining why SSA fails uses the two-triangle case
edges.chineseReason: 判断给定的边和角能否确定唯一三角形，有助于理解哪些条件能判断三角形全等。

edges.fromGoal: Draw and measure line segments and angles accurately, and construct triangles from given conditions using the drawing approaches the standard calls for: ruler and protractor for two sides and the included angle (SAS) or two angles and the included side (ASA); ruler and compasses for three sides (SSS), using intersecting arcs; and dynamic geometry software; check each construction by measuring the remaining sides and angles (to within about 1 mm and 1°). Interpreting scale drawings is covered in Scale drawings and maps; deciding whether conditions give one, many or no triangles is covered in Which triangles are possible
edges.toGoal: Know and use the criteria for triangle congruence (SSS, SAS, ASA, RHS), use standard labelling conventions for sides and angles of triangle ABC, and determine whether two triangles are congruent
edges.sourceReason: Determining congruence requires constructing triangles from given conditions
edges.chineseReason: 按给定边和角画三角形，可以观察这些条件是否确定了相同形状和大小。

edges.fromGoal: Use conventional geometric terms and notation to describe, sketch, and draw points, lines, parallel and perpendicular lines, right angles, regular polygons, and reflectively/rotationally symmetric polygons
edges.toGoal: Know and use the criteria for triangle congruence (SSS, SAS, ASA, RHS), use standard labelling conventions for sides and angles of triangle ABC, and determine whether two triangles are congruent
edges.sourceReason: Triangle congruence criteria require standard labelling conventions
edges.chineseReason: 看懂顶点字母、角和边的标记，有助于准确表达三角形全等的条件。

edges.fromGoal: Write and calculate mathematical statements for multiplication and division using known tables, including two-digit × one-digit, using mental and progressing to formal written methods
edges.toGoal: Multiply two-digit and three-digit numbers by a one-digit number using formal written layout
edges.sourceReason: Formal short multiplication extends Y3 written multiplication
edges.chineseReason: 笔算乘法把熟悉的乘法步骤按数位记录下来。

edges.fromGoal: Recall multiplication and division facts for multiplication tables up to 12 × 12
edges.toGoal: Multiply two-digit and three-digit numbers by a one-digit number using formal written layout
edges.sourceReason: Written multiplication requires fluent table facts
edges.chineseReason: 计算多位数乘法时，可以用到较小数的乘法事实。

edges.toName: 数轴上的数 · 整数与加减
edges.fromGoal: Identify, represent and estimate numbers to 100 using different representations: place a two-digit number on a 0–100 number line marked in tens, represent it with base-ten blocks (tens and ones), drawings, bead strings or hundred squares, and estimate 'about how many' objects in a set before counting to check
edges.toGoal: Represent whole numbers as lengths on a number line and represent sums and differences within 100 on a number line diagram
edges.sourceReason: Number line representation skills support placing numbers as lengths
edges.chineseReason: 数轴上的长度可以表示数，间隔相同的刻度代表相同数量。

edges.toName: 数轴上的数 · 整数与加减
edges.fromGoal: Fluently add and subtract within 100 using strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction
edges.toGoal: Represent whole numbers as lengths on a number line and represent sums and differences within 100 on a number line diagram
edges.sourceReason: Number line representations support addition/subtraction within 100
edges.chineseReason: 在数轴上向前或向后移动，可以表示100以内的加减。

edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving similar shapes where the scale factor is known or can be found
edges.toGoal: Use a scale, given as a ratio (e.g. 1:50), as a statement such as '1 cm represents 2 m', or as a scale factor, to work out actual lengths from a scale drawing or map and drawing lengths from actual lengths; reproduce a scale drawing at a different scale by finding each new drawing length, either through the actual length or from the ratio of the two scales; and solve map, room-plan and design problems with consistent units, converting between mm, cm, m and km before or after scaling. Areas from scale drawings and the area factor are developed in the follow-on topic Area from scale drawings
edges.sourceReason: GB route: Year 6 similar-shape and scale-factor problems are the groundwork for scale drawings; soft because this node is GB-only
edges.chineseReason: 相似图形对应边按同一比例变化，这一关系可用于比例图。

edges.fromGoal: Know and use advanced vocabulary of multiplicative reasoning — direct proportion, inverse proportion, ratio, rate, unit rate, compound unit, scale factor — accurately in problem-solving contexts
edges.toGoal: Use a scale, given as a ratio (e.g. 1:50), as a statement such as '1 cm represents 2 m', or as a scale factor, to work out actual lengths from a scale drawing or map and drawing lengths from actual lengths; reproduce a scale drawing at a different scale by finding each new drawing length, either through the actual length or from the ratio of the two scales; and solve map, room-plan and design problems with consistent units, converting between mm, cm, m and km before or after scaling. Areas from scale drawings and the area factor are developed in the follow-on topic Area from scale drawings
edges.sourceReason: Scale diagrams and maps require 'scale factor' as a precisely defined term
edges.chineseReason: 明确比例尺表示图上长度和实际长度的关系，有助于正确解读比例图。

edges.fromGoal: Represent proportional relationships using double number lines (two parallel number lines aligned at 0) and ratio tables; recognise that equivalent ratios generate straight lines through the origin when graphed
edges.toGoal: Use a scale, given as a ratio (e.g. 1:50), as a statement such as '1 cm represents 2 m', or as a scale factor, to work out actual lengths from a scale drawing or map and drawing lengths from actual lengths; reproduce a scale drawing at a different scale by finding each new drawing length, either through the actual length or from the ratio of the two scales; and solve map, room-plan and design problems with consistent units, converting between mm, cm, m and km before or after scaling. Areas from scale drawings and the area factor are developed in the follow-on topic Area from scale drawings
edges.sourceReason: Scale diagrams use proportional relationships that can be represented on double number lines
edges.chineseReason: 图上长度和实际长度按比例变化，可以放在双数轴上比较。

edges.fromGoal: Draw and measure line segments and angles accurately, and construct triangles from given conditions using the drawing approaches the standard calls for: ruler and protractor for two sides and the included angle (SAS) or two angles and the included side (ASA); ruler and compasses for three sides (SSS), using intersecting arcs; and dynamic geometry software; check each construction by measuring the remaining sides and angles (to within about 1 mm and 1°). Interpreting scale drawings is covered in Scale drawings and maps; deciding whether conditions give one, many or no triangles is covered in Which triangles are possible
edges.toGoal: Use a scale, given as a ratio (e.g. 1:50), as a statement such as '1 cm represents 2 m', or as a scale factor, to work out actual lengths from a scale drawing or map and drawing lengths from actual lengths; reproduce a scale drawing at a different scale by finding each new drawing length, either through the actual length or from the ratio of the two scales; and solve map, room-plan and design problems with consistent units, converting between mm, cm, m and km before or after scaling. Areas from scale drawings and the area factor are developed in the follow-on topic Area from scale drawings
edges.sourceReason: Redrawing a plan at a new scale needs line segments measured and drawn accurately
edges.chineseReason: 按新比例画图时，需要测量并画出相应长度的线段。

edges.fromGoal: Convert freely between related standard units of measurement (time, length, area, volume/capacity, mass) using decimal notation to up to three decimal places where appropriate
edges.toGoal: Use a scale, given as a ratio (e.g. 1:50), as a statement such as '1 cm represents 2 m', or as a scale factor, to work out actual lengths from a scale drawing or map and drawing lengths from actual lengths; reproduce a scale drawing at a different scale by finding each new drawing length, either through the actual length or from the ratio of the two scales; and solve map, room-plan and design problems with consistent units, converting between mm, cm, m and km before or after scaling. Areas from scale drawings and the area factor are developed in the follow-on topic Area from scale drawings
edges.sourceReason: Map and plan problems require converting between mm, cm, m and km to keep units consistent (e.g. 162,500 cm = 1.625 km)
edges.chineseReason: 比较图上和实际长度时，先统一毫米、厘米、米或千米等单位。

edges.fromGoal: Interpret multiplication as scaling (resizing): compare the size of a product to a factor based on the size of the other factor without computing; explain the effect of multiplying by fractions greater than, equal to, or less than 1
edges.toGoal: Use a scale, given as a ratio (e.g. 1:50), as a statement such as '1 cm represents 2 m', or as a scale factor, to work out actual lengths from a scale drawing or map and drawing lengths from actual lengths; reproduce a scale drawing at a different scale by finding each new drawing length, either through the actual length or from the ratio of the two scales; and solve map, room-plan and design problems with consistent units, converting between mm, cm, m and km before or after scaling. Areas from scale drawings and the area factor are developed in the follow-on topic Area from scale drawings
edges.sourceReason: US route: interpreting multiplication as scaling (enlarging or reducing) underpins applying a scale factor; soft because this node is US-only
edges.chineseReason: 图上长度和实际长度按比例放大或缩小，可以用乘法表示。

edges.fromGoal: Use ratio notation to describe the relationship between two or more quantities, simplify ratios to their simplest form, and convert between ratio and fraction representations
edges.toGoal: Use a scale, given as a ratio (e.g. 1:50), as a statement such as '1 cm represents 2 m', or as a scale factor, to work out actual lengths from a scale drawing or map and drawing lengths from actual lengths; reproduce a scale drawing at a different scale by finding each new drawing length, either through the actual length or from the ratio of the two scales; and solve map, room-plan and design problems with consistent units, converting between mm, cm, m and km before or after scaling. Areas from scale drawings and the area factor are developed in the follow-on topic Area from scale drawings
edges.sourceReason: Scales such as 1:50 and 1:25,000 are ratios, and moving between drawing and actual lengths (or between two scales) uses ratio notation and simplification
edges.chineseReason: 比例尺如1∶50是比，可以用它联系图上长度与实际长度。

edges.toName: 用数字工具平均分与分组
edges.fromGoal: Understand division as sharing equally into groups or as grouping (how many groups of a given size can be made)
edges.toGoal: Represent practical equal-sharing and grouping situations with virtual materials (dragging on-screen objects onto plates or into groups) as well as physical objects, using counting or subitising to check each share
edges.sourceReason: Sharing on screen builds on equal sharing with real objects
edges.chineseReason: 在屏幕上模拟平均分时，可以观察每组是否分得一样多。

edges.fromName: 乘法是相同加数的和 · 相同加数与成组
edges.toName: 用数字工具平均分与分组
edges.fromGoal: Understand multiplication as repeated addition and grouping equal sets
edges.toGoal: Represent practical equal-sharing and grouping situations with virtual materials (dragging on-screen objects onto plates or into groups) as well as physical objects, using counting or subitising to check each share
edges.sourceReason: Seeing equal groups as repeated addition supports grouping tasks
edges.chineseReason: 把物品分成相同数量的组，可以用重复相加数出总数。

edges.fromGoal: Count backwards through zero to include negative numbers
edges.toGoal: Interpret negative numbers in context (temperature, sea level, bank balance); count forwards and backwards with positive and negative whole numbers, including through zero
edges.sourceReason: Counting through zero is prerequisite to interpreting negative numbers in context
edges.chineseReason: 从正数经过0继续往下数，可以帮助理解生活中的负数。

edges.fromName: 分数的意义 · 分数表示除法
edges.fromGoal: Interpret a fraction as division of the numerator by the denominator (a/b = a ÷ b); solve word problems involving division of whole numbers leading to fractional or mixed-number answers
edges.toGoal: Interpret and compute division of a whole number by a unit fraction (e.g. 4 ÷ 1/5 = 20); use visual models and the relationship between multiplication and division to explain why the quotient is larger than the dividend
edges.sourceReason: Understanding fraction as division supports reasoning about quotients
edges.chineseReason: 分数可以表示分子除以分母，这有助于理解除法的结果。

edges.fromName: 分数乘法 · 分数乘分数
edges.fromGoal: Multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction, including proper fractions by proper fractions; interpret (a/b) × q as a parts of q partitioned into b equal parts; write answers in simplest form
edges.toGoal: Interpret and compute division of a whole number by a unit fraction (e.g. 4 ÷ 1/5 = 20); use visual models and the relationship between multiplication and division to explain why the quotient is larger than the dividend
edges.sourceReason: Whole ÷ unit-fraction uses inverse relationship with fraction multiplication
edges.chineseReason: 整数除以单位分数，可以反过来检查：商乘这个单位分数是否等于原数。

edges.fromGoal: Interpret and compute division of a unit fraction by a non-zero whole number (e.g. 1/3 ÷ 4 = 1/12); use visual models and the relationship between multiplication and division to explain the result
edges.toGoal: Interpret and compute division of a whole number by a unit fraction (e.g. 4 ÷ 1/5 = 20); use visual models and the relationship between multiplication and division to explain why the quotient is larger than the dividend
edges.sourceReason: Understanding unit-fraction ÷ whole helps contrast with whole ÷ unit-fraction
edges.chineseReason: 比较“把一小份再平均分”和“一个整数里有几份”，可以看清两种除法的不同。

edges.fromGoal: Understand and use standard mathematical formulae; rearrange formulae to change the subject, performing inverse operations to isolate a different variable
edges.toGoal: Apply Pythagoras’ Theorem (a² + b² = c²) to calculate unknown side lengths in right-angled triangles, including in real-world and coordinate-geometry contexts
edges.sourceReason: Rearranging a² + b² = c² to find a shorter side uses formula rearrangement
edges.chineseReason: 要求直角三角形的一条较短边，可以调整勾股定理中的等式。

edges.fromName: 三角形与多边形的内角和
edges.fromGoal: Derive and use the angle sum in a triangle (180°), use it to deduce the angle sum in any polygon ((n−2) × 180°), and calculate interior and exterior angles of regular polygons
edges.toGoal: Apply Pythagoras’ Theorem (a² + b² = c²) to calculate unknown side lengths in right-angled triangles, including in real-world and coordinate-geometry contexts
edges.sourceReason: Pythagoras requires understanding triangle angle sums and properties
edges.chineseReason: 勾股定理适用于直角三角形，先辨认三角形中的角和性质。

edges.toName: 按特征分类 · 比较各类数量
edges.fromGoal: Organise and represent data with up to three categories by counting objects in each category and sorting categories by quantity
edges.toGoal: Interpret categorical data by asking and answering questions about totals, how many in each category, and how many more or less one category has than another
edges.sourceReason: Interpreting data requires having data organised and represented first
edges.chineseReason: 先把数据分类整理，有助于比较各类的数量并回答问题。

edges.fromGoal: Understand and apply the rule that probabilities of all mutually exclusive outcomes sum to one; use this to find the probability of a complementary event (P(not A) = 1 − P(A))
edges.toGoal: Enumerate sets and their unions and intersections systematically using tables, grids, and Venn diagrams to organise and count outcomes
edges.sourceReason: Enumerating sets for probability requires understanding that all outcomes sum to 1
edges.chineseReason: 完整且互不重叠的结果，其概率相加为1；集合和图表可以帮助整理结果。

edges.fromGoal: Count a set of objects to answer 'how many?' for sets up to 20 (arranged in lines, arrays, circles, or scattered)
edges.toGoal: Select and use familiar tools (concrete objects, fingers, ten frames) to help solve a mathematical problem
edges.sourceReason: Counting objects requires choosing appropriate tools (cubes, ten frames)
edges.chineseReason: 数物品时，可以选择积木或十格板等工具帮助组织数量。

edges.fromName: 测量角 · 角的加减与未知角
edges.toName: 理解分数 · 多步论证与检错
edges.fromGoal: Recognise angle measure as additive; find unknown angles by adding or subtracting on a diagram using equations with a symbol for the unknown
edges.toGoal: Construct and present logical mathematical arguments involving multiple steps; critique others' reasoning about fractions, angles, or calculations and clearly explain errors or alternative methods
edges.sourceReason: Unknown angle problems exercise constructing chains of reasoning
edges.chineseReason: 寻找未知角常要连接几步角度关系，这可以练习逐步说明推理。

edges.fromName: 说明推理的依据 · 呈现推理并评价
edges.toName: 理解分数 · 多步论证与检错
edges.fromGoal: Construct and present multi-step mathematical arguments; critique the reasoning of others and explain clearly why a method works or fails
edges.toGoal: Construct and present logical mathematical arguments involving multiple steps; critique others' reasoning about fractions, angles, or calculations and clearly explain errors or alternative methods
edges.sourceReason: Age 8-9 constructing arguments is prerequisite to age 9-10 level
edges.chineseReason: 说明每一步的依据，也可以用来检查分数、角或计算中的多步推理。

edges.fromName: 比较分数大小 · 通分或借助参照
edges.toName: 理解分数 · 多步论证与检错
edges.fromGoal: Compare and order fractions with different numerators and denominators by creating common denominators/numerators or comparing to a benchmark such as 1/2; justify conclusions with visual models
edges.toGoal: Construct and present logical mathematical arguments involving multiple steps; critique others' reasoning about fractions, angles, or calculations and clearly explain errors or alternative methods
edges.sourceReason: Comparing fractions with different denominators requires constructing logical arguments
edges.chineseReason: 比较不同分母的分数时，可以说明通分或借助参照的理由。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: spot calculation patterns, describe rules for sequences, and predict results using known mathematical facts
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend multiplication table patterns, derive unknown facts from known ones, and describe rules for sequences
edges.sourceReason: Age 7-8 repeated reasoning builds on age 6-7
edges.chineseReason: 从反复出现的计算步骤中发现规律，可以继续用到表格和数列中。

edges.fromGoal: Count from 0 in multiples of 4, 8, 50, and 100
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend multiplication table patterns, derive unknown facts from known ones, and describe rules for sequences
edges.sourceReason: Skip counting patterns exercise generalising from repetition
edges.chineseReason: 跳着数时每次按相同规则变化，可以帮助概括表格中的规律。

edges.fromName: 乘法口诀与乘法表 · 3、4、8的乘除事实
edges.fromGoal: Recall and use multiplication and division facts for the 3, 4, and 8 multiplication tables
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend multiplication table patterns, derive unknown facts from known ones, and describe rules for sequences
edges.sourceReason: Multiplication table patterns exercise repeated reasoning
edges.chineseReason: 观察乘法表中重复出现的变化，可以用来推想其他结果。

edges.fromGoal: Apply the area formula (l × w) and perimeter formula (2l + 2w) for rectangles including squares in real-world and mathematical problems; calculate and compare areas using standard units (cm², m²) and estimate areas of irregular shapes
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving similar shapes where the scale factor is known or can be found
edges.sourceReason: Scale factor problems often involve computing scaled lengths/perimeters/areas
edges.chineseReason: 图形按比例放大或缩小时，可以继续比较边长、周长和面积怎样变化。

edges.fromGoal: Represent ratio and proportion problems using bar models (rectangular strips divided into equal parts labelled with quantities) and tape diagrams (segmented strips showing part-to-part and part-to-whole relationships); use these visual models to set up and solve unequal sharing, scaling, and percentage problems — drawing the diagram first, then reading off the answer
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving similar shapes where the scale factor is known or can be found
edges.sourceReason: Scale factor problems for similar shapes can be represented as ratio bar models
edges.chineseReason: 比例条形图可以帮助表示相似图形对应长度的比例。

edges.fromName: 百分数的应用 · 比例与百分数的词语
edges.fromGoal: Know and use the vocabulary of ratio and proportion — ratio, proportion, percentage, scale, equivalent, unequal, relative size, part-to-part, part-to-whole, and out of — and understand the difference between ratio (comparing parts to parts) and proportion (comparing a part to the whole)
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving similar shapes where the scale factor is known or can be found
edges.sourceReason: Similar shapes and scale requires 'scale', 'equivalent', and 'proportion' as defined terms
edges.chineseReason: 理解比例、等值和比例尺等词语，有助于描述相似图形的关系。

edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving the relative sizes of two quantities where missing values can be found by using integer multiplication and division facts
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving similar shapes where the scale factor is known or can be found
edges.sourceReason: Scale factor problems are a specific application of ratio/proportion
edges.chineseReason: 相似图形的对应长度按同一个比例变化，可以用比来解决缩放问题。

edges.fromGoal: Compare and classify geometric shapes based on their properties and sizes; understand that attributes belonging to a category also belong to all subcategories; classify two-dimensional figures in a hierarchy based on properties
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving similar shapes where the scale factor is known or can be found
edges.sourceReason: Similarity requires understanding shape properties — equal angles, proportional sides
edges.chineseReason: 判断图形是否相似，需要比较对应角和对应边的比例。

edges.toName: 小数的数位与运用 · 用小数换算单位
edges.fromGoal: Multiply and divide numbers by 10, 100, and 1000 giving answers up to three decimal places, understanding that digits shift position in the place-value chart
edges.toGoal: Convert among different-sized standard measurement units within a given system (e.g. 5 cm to 0.05 m) using decimal notation to up to three decimal places; convert between smaller and larger units of length, mass, volume, and time
edges.sourceReason: Converting to 3dp requires ×÷ by 10/100/1000 skills
edges.chineseReason: 单位之间相差10、100或1000倍时，可以用乘除这些数完成换算。

edges.fromName: 测量单位换算 · 常用单位的相对大小
edges.toName: 小数的数位与运用 · 用小数换算单位
edges.fromGoal: Know relative sizes of measurement units within one system (km/m/cm/mm, kg/g, l/ml, hr/min/sec); convert between different metric units and express measurements in terms of a smaller unit; record equivalents in conversion tables
edges.toGoal: Convert among different-sized standard measurement units within a given system (e.g. 5 cm to 0.05 m) using decimal notation to up to three decimal places; convert between smaller and larger units of length, mass, volume, and time
edges.sourceReason: Y6 unit conversion with decimals extends Y5 metric conversion
edges.chineseReason: 熟悉测量单位之间的关系后，可以用小数记录不同单位的换算结果。

edges.fromName: 立体图形 · 比较平面与立体
edges.fromGoal: Analyse and compare 2-D and 3-D shapes using informal language to describe sides, vertices, and other attributes
edges.toGoal: Model shapes by building from components (e.g. sticks and clay balls) and by drawing
edges.sourceReason: Modelling shapes by building/drawing requires knowing their attributes (sides, vertices)
edges.chineseReason: 先观察图形的边和顶点等特征，再尝试画出或搭出相应形状。

edges.fromGoal: Measure and begin to record time in hours, minutes, and seconds
edges.toGoal: Know the number of minutes in an hour and the number of hours in a day
edges.sourceReason: Knowing 60 min = 1 hour and 24 hours = 1 day extends from measuring time in hours/minutes/seconds
edges.chineseReason: 理解小时、分钟和秒的测量后，可以进一步比较一天与一小时有多少时间单位。

edges.fromName: 测量单位换算 · 长度与时间单位
edges.fromGoal: Convert between different units of measure (e.g. kilometre to metre, hour to minute, minute to second, year to month, week to day)
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving converting between units of time (hours↔minutes, minutes↔seconds, years↔months, weeks↔days)
edges.sourceReason: Y4 unit conversion feeds into time-specific conversions
edges.chineseReason: 单位换算的想法也可以用在小时、分钟和秒之间。

edges.fromGoal: Solve word problems involving elapsed time by adding and subtracting time intervals in minutes, including using a number line
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving converting between units of time (hours↔minutes, minutes↔seconds, years↔months, weeks↔days)
edges.sourceReason: Elapsed time problems are prerequisite to time conversion problems
edges.chineseReason: 计算经过多久时，可以用分钟表示，并按需要换算时间单位。

edges.toName: 熟练使用加减法 · 20以内的事实
edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract within 20 using strategies such as making ten, decomposing a number leading to ten, and using known facts
edges.toGoal: Recall and use addition and subtraction facts to 20 fluently, and derive and use related facts up to 100
edges.sourceReason: Fluent recall of facts to 20 builds from strategic calculation within 20
edges.chineseReason: 先尝试不同的计算办法，可以逐步熟悉20以内的加减事实。

edges.toName: 熟练使用加减法 · 20以内的事实
edges.fromGoal: Understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones
edges.toGoal: Recall and use addition and subtraction facts to 20 fluently, and derive and use related facts up to 100
edges.sourceReason: Deriving facts to 100 benefits from place value understanding
edges.chineseReason: 利用十位和个位的关系，可以从已知事实推想100以内的加减。

edges.fromGoal: Understand probability as a measure expressed as a number between 0 (impossible) and 1 (certain); place events on the probability scale; express probabilities as fractions, decimals, and percentages
edges.toGoal: Understand that when all possible outcomes of a trial are listed, their probabilities must add up to 1; use this to find the probability of an event NOT happening: P(not A) = 1 − P(A); apply this shortcut to avoid counting all unfavourable outcomes directly
edges.sourceReason: The complement rule P(not A) = 1 − P(A) requires understanding probability as a number that lies between 0 and 1
edges.chineseReason: 概率在0和1之间；一个事件与它的互补事件合起来覆盖全部结果。

edges.fromGoal: Calculate the probability of a simple event with equally likely outcomes using the formula: probability = number of favourable outcomes ÷ total number of possible outcomes; express the result as a fraction in its simplest form; apply to rolling dice, drawing from bags, and other simple chance situations
edges.toGoal: Understand that when all possible outcomes of a trial are listed, their probabilities must add up to 1; use this to find the probability of an event NOT happening: P(not A) = 1 − P(A); apply this shortcut to avoid counting all unfavourable outcomes directly
edges.sourceReason: Using the complement rule is easier once students can calculate basic probabilities and see that favourable + unfavourable outcomes cover all possibilities
edges.chineseReason: 计算事件和非该事件的概率，可以观察两者怎样合成完整的1。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use the inverse relationship between addition and subtraction to check calculations and solve missing-number problems
edges.toGoal: Determine the unknown whole number in an addition or subtraction equation relating three whole numbers
edges.sourceReason: Solving missing-number problems benefits from knowing the inverse relationship
edges.chineseReason: 加法与减法互相对应，可以用逆运算寻找算式里的未知数。

edges.fromGoal: Understand the meaning of the equal sign as 'is the same as' and determine if equations are true or false
edges.toGoal: Determine the unknown whole number in an addition or subtraction equation relating three whole numbers
edges.sourceReason: Finding unknowns in equations requires understanding what = means
edges.chineseReason: 等号表示两边相等，寻找未知数时要保持这种相等关系。

edges.fromGoal: Multiply and divide whole numbers and those involving decimals by 10, 100, and 1000
edges.toGoal: Use estimation and rounding to check the reasonableness of answers when multiplying and dividing decimals (including by multiples of powers of 10), identifying misplaced decimal points
edges.sourceReason: Checking requires multiplying and dividing by multiples of powers of 10
edges.chineseReason: 估算小数运算时，可以借助乘除10、100等数观察数量级。

edges.fromGoal: Solve problems which require answers to be rounded to specified degrees of accuracy
edges.toGoal: Use estimation and rounding to check the reasonableness of answers when multiplying and dividing decimals (including by multiples of powers of 10), identifying misplaced decimal points
edges.sourceReason: Rounding answers supports estimation
edges.chineseReason: 先把小数取接近的数进行估算，可以检查结果是否大致合理。

edges.fromGoal: Multiply one-digit numbers with up to two decimal places by whole numbers (e.g. 3.47 × 6)
edges.toGoal: Use estimation and rounding to check the reasonableness of answers when multiplying and dividing decimals (including by multiples of powers of 10), identifying misplaced decimal points
edges.sourceReason: Checking decimal products requires multiplying decimals
edges.chineseReason: 先理解小数乘整数，再用估算检查乘积的数量级。

edges.fromGoal: Use algebraic methods to solve linear equations in one variable, including equations that require rearrangement, expanding brackets, and collecting terms on both sides; solve equations with rational number coefficients
edges.toGoal: Understand and use standard mathematical formulae; rearrange formulae to change the subject, performing inverse operations to isolate a different variable
edges.sourceReason: Rearranging formulae uses the same inverse-operation techniques as solving equations
edges.chineseReason: 调整公式和解方程都可能用逆运算，把需要的量单独留下。

edges.fromGoal: Substitute numerical values into formulae and expressions including scientific formulae; evaluate expressions by replacing variables with given values and computing the result using correct order of operations
edges.toGoal: Understand and use standard mathematical formulae; rearrange formulae to change the subject, performing inverse operations to isolate a different variable
edges.sourceReason: Rearranging formulae requires fluent substitution to verify results
edges.chineseReason: 调整公式后，可以把数值代回原式，检查调整是否保持相同关系。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use relationships between operations including inverse operations; use these relationships to check answers and simplify calculations
edges.toGoal: Understand and use standard mathematical formulae; rearrange formulae to change the subject, performing inverse operations to isolate a different variable
edges.sourceReason: Rearranging formulae to change the subject is an application of inverse operations to algebraic expressions
edges.chineseReason: 对公式使用逆运算，可以把需要的量单独表示出来。

edges.fromGoal: Express missing number problems algebraically using letters for unknowns; translate word problems into equations
edges.toGoal: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct vocabulary for ratio, proportion, algebra, volume, coordinate geometry, and circle parts; specify units including cm³, m³, and miles/km; use notation for algebraic expressions and order of operations accurately
edges.sourceReason: Distinguishing expression/equation/formula requires algebraic precision
edges.chineseReason: 把问题写成方程时，分清算式、方程和公式，有助于准确交流。

edges.fromGoal: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct vocabulary for primes, factors, multiples, angle types, and polygon regularity; specify units including cm², m³, °; use notation for squares/cubes and percentages accurately
edges.toGoal: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct vocabulary for ratio, proportion, algebra, volume, coordinate geometry, and circle parts; specify units including cm³, m³, and miles/km; use notation for algebraic expressions and order of operations accurately
edges.sourceReason: Y6 precision extends Y5 mathematical vocabulary
edges.chineseReason: 使用准确的数学词语，可以继续帮助表达更复杂的关系。

edges.fromGoal: Illustrate and name parts of circles, including radius, diameter, and circumference; know that the diameter is twice the radius
edges.toGoal: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct vocabulary for ratio, proportion, algebra, volume, coordinate geometry, and circle parts; specify units including cm³, m³, and miles/km; use notation for algebraic expressions and order of operations accurately
edges.sourceReason: Circle vocabulary (radius, diameter, circumference) is key Y6 precision content
edges.chineseReason: 半径、直径和周长等词语能准确描述圆的不同部分。

edges.fromName: 角的分类 · 锐角与钝角
edges.fromGoal: Identify acute and obtuse angles; compare and order angles up to two right angles by size
edges.toGoal: Understand that an angle is a geometric shape formed by two rays sharing a common endpoint (vertex); recognise angles in real-life contexts and 2-D shapes
edges.sourceReason: Angle definition builds on understanding right angles
edges.chineseReason: 比较锐角和钝角时，可以用直角作为参照理解角的大小。

edges.fromGoal: Identify right angles; recognise that two right angles make a half-turn, three make three-quarters, and four make a complete turn
edges.toGoal: Understand that an angle is a geometric shape formed by two rays sharing a common endpoint (vertex); recognise angles in real-life contexts and 2-D shapes
edges.sourceReason: Angle definition builds on classifying acute/obtuse angles
edges.chineseReason: 认识直角和转弯，可以帮助理解角描述了怎样的转动。

edges.fromGoal: Understand and use approximate equivalences between metric units and common imperial units (inches, pounds, pints)
edges.toGoal: Convert between miles and kilometres using the approximate relationship (5 miles ≈ 8 km)
edges.sourceReason: Miles↔km conversion extends Y5 imperial/metric approximation
edges.chineseReason: 英里与千米属于不同单位，可以用近似换算关系进行比较。

edges.fromGoal: Multiply one-digit numbers with up to two decimal places by whole numbers (e.g. 3.47 × 6)
edges.toGoal: Convert between miles and kilometres using the approximate relationship (5 miles ≈ 8 km)
edges.sourceReason: Conversion factor 1.6 involves decimal multiplication
edges.chineseReason: 用约1.6千米对应1英里进行换算时，可以用到小数乘法。

edges.fromGoal: Fluently add and subtract within 100 using strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction
edges.toGoal: Solve word problems involving dollar bills, quarters, dimes, nickels, and pennies, using $ and ¢ symbols appropriately
edges.sourceReason: Money word problems require fluent addition/subtraction within 100
edges.chineseReason: 购物时合计价格和找零，可以用到加减法。

edges.fromGoal: Understand and use standard mathematical formulae; rearrange formulae to change the subject, performing inverse operations to isolate a different variable
edges.toGoal: Plot linear graphs by generating a table of values, reduce a two-variable linear equation to the form y = mx + c, and calculate gradients from two points on a line
edges.sourceReason: Rearranging to y = mx + c form uses formula rearrangement skills
edges.chineseReason: 调整等式，把关系写成y＝mx＋c的形式，可以帮助绘制直线。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise that a linear function produces a straight-line graph, understand the relationship between an equation of the form y = mx + c and its graphical representation, and interpret gradient and y-intercept in context
edges.toGoal: Plot linear graphs by generating a table of values, reduce a two-variable linear equation to the form y = mx + c, and calculate gradients from two points on a line
edges.sourceReason: Plotting linear graphs requires understanding what y = mx + c represents
edges.chineseReason: 理解y＝mx＋c怎样描述两个量的关系，再根据对应数值描点画线。

edges.toName: 数轴上的分数 · 数轴、情境与算式
edges.fromGoal: Use tiling to demonstrate the distributive property: the area of a rectangle with sides a and (b+c) equals a×b + a×c; use area models to represent the distributive property
edges.toGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, number lines, and symbolic equations involving multiplication, fractions, and decimals, explaining what each representation shows
edges.sourceReason: Area models connect multiplication to visual representations
edges.chineseReason: 面积模型可以把乘法计算和图形表示联系起来。

edges.fromName: 理解分数 · 情境、图形与算式
edges.toName: 数轴上的分数 · 数轴、情境与算式
edges.fromGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, and symbolic equations involving three-digit numbers and fractions, explaining what each part represents
edges.toGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, number lines, and symbolic equations involving multiplication, fractions, and decimals, explaining what each representation shows
edges.sourceReason: Age 7-8 quantitative reasoning is prerequisite to age 8-9 level
edges.chineseReason: 练习在情境、图形和算式之间转换，也有助于读懂数轴表示的数量。

edges.toName: 数轴上的分数 · 数轴、情境与算式
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and write decimal equivalents of any number of tenths or hundredths (e.g. 3/10 = 0.3, 27/100 = 0.27)
edges.toGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, number lines, and symbolic equations involving multiplication, fractions, and decimals, explaining what each representation shows
edges.sourceReason: Decimal equivalents exercise fluency between fraction and decimal representations
edges.chineseReason: 同一个量可以写成分数或小数，也可以在数轴上表示。

edges.toName: 求一个数量的几分之几：进阶
edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract fractions with the same denominator, including results greater than one whole (e.g. 5/8 + 6/8 = 11/8)
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving increasingly harder fractions to calculate quantities, including non-unit fractions where the answer is a whole number
edges.sourceReason: Fraction addition supports solving fraction problems
edges.chineseReason: 处理数量中的多个分数部分时，可能需要把同样大小的小份相加。

edges.toName: 求一个数量的几分之几：进阶
edges.fromGoal: Recognise, find, and write fractions of a discrete set of objects: unit fractions and non-unit fractions with small denominators
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving increasingly harder fractions to calculate quantities, including non-unit fractions where the answer is a whole number
edges.sourceReason: Finding fractions of discrete sets is prerequisite to harder fraction-of-quantity problems
edges.chineseReason: 先理解一组物品的几分之一，再看怎样得到几份这样的数量。

edges.fromGoal: Generate measurement data by measuring lengths to the nearest half and quarter inch; display the data on a line plot with a scale marked in whole numbers, halves, and quarters
edges.toGoal: Make a line plot to display measurement data in fractions of a unit (1/2, 1/4, 1/8); solve problems involving addition and subtraction of fractions using line plot data
edges.sourceReason: Line plots with half/quarter inch are prerequisite to 1/8-inch line plots
edges.chineseReason: 用半单位和四分之一单位标记点图后，可以继续观察八分之一单位。

edges.fromGoal: Understand addition and subtraction of fractions as joining and separating parts; decompose a fraction into a sum of fractions with the same denominator in more than one way
edges.toGoal: Make a line plot to display measurement data in fractions of a unit (1/2, 1/4, 1/8); solve problems involving addition and subtraction of fractions using line plot data
edges.sourceReason: Fraction addition/subtraction supports solving problems from line plot data
edges.chineseReason: 点图中记录的测量值如果包含分数，可以通过分数加减比较或合计。

edges.toName: 哪些边长能组成三角形
edges.fromGoal: Find unknown angles in triangles, quadrilaterals, and regular polygons using angle sum properties
edges.toGoal: Decide whether given side and angle conditions determine a unique triangle, more than one triangle, or no triangle, and explain why, predicting with a freehand sketch and testing by construction (ruler and protractor, compasses, or dynamic geometry software): three sides give exactly one triangle when each pair of sides adds to more than the third, and none otherwise — if the two shorter sides add to less than the longest, the construction arcs do not meet, and if they add to exactly the longest (e.g. 3, 4 and 7), the arcs touch only on the base line, so the sides lie flat in a straight line rather than forming a triangle; three angles must add to 180° and then fix only the shape, not the size, so many triangles fit (none if the sum is not 180°); two sides with the included angle, or two angles with the included side, give exactly one triangle; and two sides with an angle that is not between them can give two, one or no triangles
edges.sourceReason: Knowing that a triangle's angles add to 180° explains why three angles must sum to 180°; soft because this GB topic is not in the US route, where the angle sum is used informally until 8.G.5
edges.chineseReason: 三角形的三个内角和是180°；检查给定角度时可以使用这个关系。

edges.toName: 哪些边长能组成三角形
edges.fromGoal: Draw and measure line segments and angles accurately, and construct triangles from given conditions using the drawing approaches the standard calls for: ruler and protractor for two sides and the included angle (SAS) or two angles and the included side (ASA); ruler and compasses for three sides (SSS), using intersecting arcs; and dynamic geometry software; check each construction by measuring the remaining sides and angles (to within about 1 mm and 1°). Interpreting scale drawings is covered in Scale drawings and maps; deciding whether conditions give one, many or no triangles is covered in Which triangles are possible
edges.toGoal: Decide whether given side and angle conditions determine a unique triangle, more than one triangle, or no triangle, and explain why, predicting with a freehand sketch and testing by construction (ruler and protractor, compasses, or dynamic geometry software): three sides give exactly one triangle when each pair of sides adds to more than the third, and none otherwise — if the two shorter sides add to less than the longest, the construction arcs do not meet, and if they add to exactly the longest (e.g. 3, 4 and 7), the arcs touch only on the base line, so the sides lie flat in a straight line rather than forming a triangle; three angles must add to 180° and then fix only the shape, not the size, so many triangles fit (none if the sum is not 180°); two sides with the included angle, or two angles with the included side, give exactly one triangle; and two sides with an angle that is not between them can give two, one or no triangles
edges.sourceReason: Testing whether conditions give one, many or no triangles is done by attempting the SSS, SAS and ASA constructions with ruler, protractor, compasses or software
edges.chineseReason: 按给定边长和角度尝试构造三角形，可以观察能得到一种、多种还是没有三角形。

edges.toName: 哪些边长能组成三角形
edges.fromGoal: Use conventional geometric terms and notation to describe, sketch, and draw points, lines, parallel and perpendicular lines, right angles, regular polygons, and reflectively/rotationally symmetric polygons
