edges.toGoal: Decide whether given side and angle conditions determine a unique triangle, more than one triangle, or no triangle, and explain why, predicting with a freehand sketch and testing by construction (ruler and protractor, compasses, or dynamic geometry software): three sides give exactly one triangle when each pair of sides adds to more than the third, and none otherwise — if the two shorter sides add to less than the longest, the construction arcs do not meet, and if they add to exactly the longest (e.g. 3, 4 and 7), the arcs touch only on the base line, so the sides lie flat in a straight line rather than forming a triangle; three angles must add to 180° and then fix only the shape, not the size, so many triangles fit (none if the sum is not 180°); two sides with the included angle, or two angles with the included side, give exactly one triangle; and two sides with an angle that is not between them can give two, one or no triangles
edges.sourceReason: Conditions are stated with triangle notation (AB, angle A), and explaining 'included' versus 'non-included' angles relies on it
edges.chineseReason: 看懂边和角的标记，有助于说清哪些角在给定边之间。

edges.fromGoal: Know the number of seconds in a minute and the number of days in each month, year, and leap year
edges.toGoal: Compare durations of events and calculate the time taken by particular events or tasks
edges.sourceReason: Knowing time unit relationships supports duration calculations
edges.chineseReason: 知道小时、分钟等单位之间的关系，可以帮助计算经过的时间。

edges.fromGoal: Tell, write and estimate the time to the nearest minute on analogue and digital clocks, using vocabulary such as o'clock, a.m./p.m., morning, afternoon, noon and midnight; record and compare times and durations in seconds, minutes and hours
edges.toGoal: Compare durations of events and calculate the time taken by particular events or tasks
edges.sourceReason: Calculating event durations requires reading time to the minute
edges.chineseReason: 读出事件开始和结束的时刻，可以帮助计算经过多少分钟。

edges.fromName: 分数的意义 · 分数表示除法
edges.toName: 小数与分数 · 分数除法与小数百分数
edges.fromGoal: Interpret a fraction as division of the numerator by the denominator (a/b = a ÷ b); solve word problems involving division of whole numbers leading to fractional or mixed-number answers
edges.toGoal: Associate a fraction with division and calculate decimal fraction equivalents for simple fractions (e.g. 3/8 = 0.375); recall and use equivalences between simple fractions, decimals, and percentages in different contexts
edges.sourceReason: Calculating decimal equivalents requires understanding fraction as division
edges.chineseReason: 把分数看成分子除以分母，可以计算一些分数对应的小数。

edges.toName: 小数与分数 · 分数除法与小数百分数
edges.fromGoal: Solve problems requiring knowledge of percentage and decimal equivalents of 1/2, 1/4, 1/5, 2/5, 4/5 and fractions with denominators that are multiples of 10 or 25
edges.toGoal: Associate a fraction with division and calculate decimal fraction equivalents for simple fractions (e.g. 3/8 = 0.375); recall and use equivalences between simple fractions, decimals, and percentages in different contexts
edges.sourceReason: Extends Y5 percentage/decimal equivalents to broader range of fractions
edges.chineseReason: 认识百分数和小数可以表示同一数量后，可以继续比较它们与分数的对应关系。

edges.toName: 小数与分数 · 分数除法与小数百分数
edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and use decimal and percentage notation correctly — decimal, decimal point, tenths, hundredths, thousandths, percentage, per cent, % symbol, convert, terminating decimal — and understand the relationships between fractions, decimals, and percentages as three ways of expressing the same value
edges.toGoal: Associate a fraction with division and calculate decimal fraction equivalents for simple fractions (e.g. 3/8 = 0.375); recall and use equivalences between simple fractions, decimals, and percentages in different contexts
edges.sourceReason: Recalling equivalences between fractions, decimals, and percentages requires all three sets of vocabulary
edges.chineseReason: 理解分数、小数和百分数的写法，有助于交流它们的等值关系。

edges.toName: 小数与分数 · 分数除法与小数百分数
edges.fromGoal: Understand the per cent symbol (%); know that per cent means ‘number of parts per hundred’; write percentages as a fraction with denominator 100 and as a decimal
edges.toGoal: Associate a fraction with division and calculate decimal fraction equivalents for simple fractions (e.g. 3/8 = 0.375); recall and use equivalences between simple fractions, decimals, and percentages in different contexts
edges.sourceReason: Builds on Y5 understanding of percentages
edges.chineseReason: 百分数表示每一百份中的多少份，可以据此与分数和小数比较。

edges.fromName: 分数乘法 · 分数乘整数
edges.toName: 分数的意义 · 分数表示除法
edges.fromGoal: Understand a/b as a multiple of 1/b; multiply proper fractions and mixed numbers by whole numbers, supported by visual models (e.g. 3 × 2/5 = 6/5 = 1 1/5)
edges.toGoal: Interpret a fraction as division of the numerator by the denominator (a/b = a ÷ b); solve word problems involving division of whole numbers leading to fractional or mixed-number answers
edges.sourceReason: Understanding fraction as division builds on fraction × whole number (inverse reasoning)
edges.chineseReason: 乘法和除法互为逆运算；这些关系可以帮助理解分数表示除法。

edges.fromName: 有余数的除法 · 两位数除数与余数
edges.toName: 分数的意义 · 分数表示除法
edges.fromGoal: Divide numbers up to 4 digits by a two-digit divisor using formal written long division, interpreting remainders as whole numbers, fractions, or by rounding as appropriate
edges.toGoal: Interpret a fraction as division of the numerator by the denominator (a/b = a ÷ b); solve word problems involving division of whole numbers leading to fractional or mixed-number answers
edges.sourceReason: Division leading to fractions connects to long division skills
edges.chineseReason: 整数相除有余数时，结果有时可以用分数表示。

edges.fromGoal: Compare and describe capacity and volume using language such as full, empty, more than, less than, half full
edges.toGoal: Measure and begin to record capacity and volume using non-standard and standard units
edges.sourceReason: Measuring capacity with units requires first being able to compare capacities
edges.chineseReason: 先比较容器能装多少，再用相同单位测量，可以更准确地描述容积。

edges.fromGoal: Tell and write the time to five minutes on analogue clocks, including quarter past and quarter to the hour, write these times in digital form, and draw clock hands to show them
edges.toGoal: Tell and write times to five minutes on analogue and digital clocks with a.m. or p.m. (before or after midday), relating times to daily events and using the words morning, afternoon, evening, noon and midnight. Roman-numeral clock faces and the 24-hour clock are covered in Roman numeral and 24-hour clocks
edges.sourceReason: Extends telling time to include a.m./p.m. and 24-hour notation
edges.chineseReason: 读出钟面上的时间后，还可以用上午、下午或24小时制说明时刻。

edges.fromName: 角的分类 · 读懂几何图形的标记
edges.toName: 测量角 · 量角与画角
edges.fromGoal: Use and interpret standard geometric diagram conventions: mark right angles with a small square, equal lengths with single or double tick marks, and equal angles with arc marks; label angles in three-letter notation (∠ABC) and individual angles with a single letter or number; draw diagrams showing angles at a point, angles on a straight line, and angles inside polygons with these conventions; read diagrams with these marks to identify given information and find unknown values
edges.toGoal: Measure angles in whole-number degrees using a protractor; draw given angles and sketch angles of specified measure
edges.sourceReason: Measuring and drawing angles with a protractor requires knowing how to mark and label angles using standard notation
edges.chineseReason: 看懂顶点和角的标记，可以更清楚地测量、绘制和记录角。

edges.toName: 测量角 · 量角与画角
edges.fromGoal: Name, estimate and compare straight angles, reflex angles and revolutions alongside acute, right and obtuse angles, describing each by its relationship to a right angle (without measuring in degrees)
edges.toGoal: Measure angles in whole-number degrees using a protractor; draw given angles and sketch angles of specified measure
edges.sourceReason: Naming straight and reflex angles supports measuring them in degrees
edges.chineseReason: 认识平角和优角，可以帮助判断量角时需要表示多大的转角。

edges.toName: 测量角 · 量角与画角
edges.fromGoal: Know that angles are measured in degrees, where one degree is 1/360 of a full turn; understand that an angle turning through n one-degree angles has a measure of n degrees
edges.toGoal: Measure angles in whole-number degrees using a protractor; draw given angles and sketch angles of specified measure
edges.sourceReason: Using a protractor requires understanding degree measurement
edges.chineseReason: 角度可以描述转动的大小；量角器用度数记录这种大小。

edges.fromName: 分数与小数的等值关系
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and write decimal equivalents of 1/4, 1/2, and 3/4
edges.toGoal: Solve problems requiring knowledge of percentage and decimal equivalents of 1/2, 1/4, 1/5, 2/5, 4/5 and fractions with denominators that are multiples of 10 or 25
edges.sourceReason: Decimal equivalents of 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 support percentage equivalence problems
edges.chineseReason: 认识四分之一、二分之一等分数对应的小数，可以继续把它们写成百分数。

edges.fromGoal: Understand the per cent symbol (%); know that per cent means ‘number of parts per hundred’; write percentages as a fraction with denominator 100 and as a decimal
edges.toGoal: Solve problems requiring knowledge of percentage and decimal equivalents of 1/2, 1/4, 1/5, 2/5, 4/5 and fractions with denominators that are multiples of 10 or 25
edges.sourceReason: Must understand % concept before solving % problems
edges.chineseReason: 百分数表示每百份中的数量，理解这一点有助于与小数互换。

edges.fromGoal: Use parentheses, brackets, or braces in numerical expressions and evaluate expressions containing these grouping symbols
edges.toGoal: Write simple numerical expressions that record calculations with numbers, and interpret numerical expressions without evaluating them (e.g. recognise that 3 × (18932 + 921) is three times as large as 18932 + 921)
edges.sourceReason: Writing/interpreting expressions requires understanding grouping symbols
edges.chineseReason: 括号表示哪些运算先看作一组，读写算式时需要保留这种关系。

edges.fromGoal: Distinguish a statistical question — one that anticipates variability in the data collected to answer it, so its answer must account for that variability (even when it is reported as a single summary value such as a mean or median) — from a question answered by a single fixed fact; for a statistical question, identify the population (who or what is being asked about), the attribute being investigated, and the variation expected in the answers
edges.toGoal: Distinguish a population from a sample drawn from it; explain why a convenient or biased sample (choosing whoever is easiest to reach, volunteers, or a group linked to the answer) can misrepresent the population; explain that random selection gives every member of the population an equal chance of being chosen, which tends to produce representative samples — while recognising that any single random sample can still, by chance, be unrepresentative
edges.sourceReason: Distinguishing a sample from its population requires first identifying the population and attribute a statistical question is about
edges.chineseReason: 明确统计问题研究的人群或对象，有助于分清总体和从中抽取的样本。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that 'equally likely' means every outcome has exactly the same chance of occurring; identify whether a given situation has equally likely outcomes (a fair coin, a fair die, a spinner with equal sections) or unequally likely outcomes (a bag with more of one colour, a spinner with unequal sections)
edges.toGoal: Distinguish a population from a sample drawn from it; explain why a convenient or biased sample (choosing whoever is easiest to reach, volunteers, or a group linked to the answer) can misrepresent the population; explain that random selection gives every member of the population an equal chance of being chosen, which tends to produce representative samples — while recognising that any single random sample can still, by chance, be unrepresentative
edges.sourceReason: Random selection is defined as giving every member an equal chance of being chosen, which requires understanding equally likely outcomes
edges.chineseReason: 公平随机抽取时，每个成员应有相同机会被选中；这与等可能结果有关。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise the relationship between dollars and cents (100 cents = 1 dollar), read and write amounts in $ and c notation (e.g. $3.45 and 345c), represent the same amount with different combinations of Australian coins and notes, and calculate change in dollars and cents
edges.toGoal: Use estimation and rounding to check and explain the reasonableness of money calculations in dollars and cents, including rounding cash totals to the nearest 5 cents as Australian shops do, and solve practical financial problems
edges.sourceReason: Estimating money totals requires reading and calculating in dollars and cents
edges.chineseReason: 理解元和分的关系，可以帮助读价格并估计购物总价。

edges.fromName: 用四舍五入估算 · 估算与逆运算检查
edges.fromGoal: Estimate the answer to a calculation and use inverse operations to check answers; apply to increasingly large numbers using rounding and inverse reasoning
edges.toGoal: Use estimation and rounding to check and explain the reasonableness of money calculations in dollars and cents, including rounding cash totals to the nearest 5 cents as Australian shops do, and solve practical financial problems
edges.sourceReason: Checking money calculations uses estimation by rounding
edges.chineseReason: 把价格取接近的数再相加，可以估计总价并检查计算。

edges.toName: 数轴上的分数 · 用数轴表示实际问题
edges.fromGoal: Estimate, compare, and calculate different measures including money in pounds and pence
edges.toGoal: Solve word problems involving distances, time intervals, liquid volumes, masses, and money using the four operations with fractions or decimals; represent with diagrams including number lines
edges.sourceReason: Y4 estimate/compare/calculate measures is prerequisite to word problems with fractions/decimals
edges.chineseReason: 先估计和比较测量数量，可以帮助检查分数或小数情境题的结果。

edges.toName: 数轴上的分数 · 用数轴表示实际问题
edges.fromGoal: Use decimal notation for fractions with denominators 10 or 100; read and write decimal numbers as fractions (e.g. 0.62 = 62/100, 0.71 = 71/100)
edges.toGoal: Solve word problems involving distances, time intervals, liquid volumes, masses, and money using the four operations with fractions or decimals; represent with diagrams including number lines
edges.sourceReason: Decimal notation supports measurement problems with decimals
edges.chineseReason: 理解十分位和百分位，可以用小数记录和计算测量结果。

edges.fromName: 测量单位换算 · 常用单位的相对大小
edges.toName: 数轴上的分数 · 用数轴表示实际问题
edges.fromGoal: Know relative sizes of measurement units within one system (km/m/cm/mm, kg/g, l/ml, hr/min/sec); convert between different metric units and express measurements in terms of a smaller unit; record equivalents in conversion tables
edges.toGoal: Solve word problems involving distances, time intervals, liquid volumes, masses, and money using the four operations with fractions or decimals; represent with diagrams including number lines
edges.sourceReason: Unit conversion supports measurement word problems
edges.chineseReason: 解决测量问题时，可能需要先把不同单位换成相同单位。

edges.fromGoal: Tell and write times to five minutes on analogue and digital clocks with a.m. or p.m. (before or after midday), relating times to daily events and using the words morning, afternoon, evening, noon and midnight. Roman-numeral clock faces and the 24-hour clock are covered in Roman numeral and 24-hour clocks
edges.toGoal: Tell and write the time from analogue clocks with Roman-numeral faces (I to XII, including IV, which some clocks show as IIII, and IX), knowing that the minute positions are the same as on a clock with ordinary numbers; and read and write times on 12-hour and 24-hour clocks, knowing that the 24-hour clock runs from 00:00 at midnight to 23:59. Times from 1:00 a.m. to 11:59 a.m. keep the same hour (7:05 a.m. = 07:05); times from 1:00 p.m. to 11:59 p.m. are 12 hours more (3:20 p.m. = 15:20). The 12 o'clock hour is the exception to both: 12:20 p.m., just after noon, stays 12:20, and 12:20 a.m., just after midnight, becomes 00:20. Fluent conversion between 12- and 24-hour times is developed in Year 4
edges.sourceReason: Writing 3:20 p.m. as 15:20 and 07:05 as 7:05 a.m. relies on knowing which times are before and after midday
edges.chineseReason: 上午和下午分别位于中午之前与之后；判断这一点可以帮助转换12小时制和24小时制。

edges.fromGoal: Tell and write the time to five minutes on analogue clocks, including quarter past and quarter to the hour, write these times in digital form, and draw clock hands to show them
edges.toGoal: Tell and write the time from analogue clocks with Roman-numeral faces (I to XII, including IV, which some clocks show as IIII, and IX), knowing that the minute positions are the same as on a clock with ordinary numbers; and read and write times on 12-hour and 24-hour clocks, knowing that the 24-hour clock runs from 00:00 at midnight to 23:59. Times from 1:00 a.m. to 11:59 a.m. keep the same hour (7:05 a.m. = 07:05); times from 1:00 p.m. to 11:59 p.m. are 12 hours more (3:20 p.m. = 15:20). The 12 o'clock hour is the exception to both: 12:20 p.m., just after noon, stays 12:20, and 12:20 a.m., just after midnight, becomes 00:20. Fluent conversion between 12- and 24-hour times is developed in Year 4
edges.sourceReason: Reading a Roman-numeral face uses the same five-minute positions and hand-reading skills as an ordinary clock face
edges.chineseReason: 罗马数字钟面上的数字写法不同，但相邻数字仍表示5分钟。

edges.fromGoal: Know and use advanced vocabulary of multiplicative reasoning — direct proportion, inverse proportion, ratio, rate, unit rate, compound unit, scale factor — accurately in problem-solving contexts
edges.toGoal: Recognise and solve problems involving direct proportion (as one quantity increases, the other increases at a constant rate) and inverse proportion (as one increases, the other decreases), including graphical and algebraic representations
edges.sourceReason: Direct and inverse proportion require 'direct proportion' and 'inverse proportion' as precisely understood contrasting terms
edges.chineseReason: 正比例和反比例描述不同的变化关系，需要分别理解它们的含义。

edges.fromGoal: Represent proportional relationships using double number lines (two parallel number lines aligned at 0) and ratio tables; recognise that equivalent ratios generate straight lines through the origin when graphed
edges.toGoal: Recognise and solve problems involving direct proportion (as one quantity increases, the other increases at a constant rate) and inverse proportion (as one increases, the other decreases), including graphical and algebraic representations
edges.sourceReason: Direct and inverse proportion with graphical representations requires reading and plotting proportion graphs (y = kx through origin)
edges.chineseReason: 正比例图像经过原点，可以通过描点和读图观察两个量的变化。

edges.fromGoal: Divide a given quantity into two parts in a given part:part or part:whole ratio, and express the division as a fraction of the whole
edges.toGoal: Recognise and solve problems involving direct proportion (as one quantity increases, the other increases at a constant rate) and inverse proportion (as one increases, the other decreases), including graphical and algebraic representations
edges.sourceReason: Proportion problems require dividing quantities in given ratios
edges.chineseReason: 按给定的比把数量分配给各部分，可以帮助理解数量之间的比例关系。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise that a linear function produces a straight-line graph, understand the relationship between an equation of the form y = mx + c and its graphical representation, and interpret gradient and y-intercept in context
edges.toGoal: Recognise and solve problems involving direct proportion (as one quantity increases, the other increases at a constant rate) and inverse proportion (as one increases, the other decreases), including graphical and algebraic representations
edges.sourceReason: Graphical representations of proportion connect to linear graphs (y = kx through origin)
edges.chineseReason: 正比例可以写成y＝kx，是经过原点的一次函数图像。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that a multiplicative relationship between two quantities can be expressed as a ratio; use ratio notation; simplify ratios
edges.toGoal: Recognise and solve problems involving direct proportion (as one quantity increases, the other increases at a constant rate) and inverse proportion (as one increases, the other decreases), including graphical and algebraic representations
edges.sourceReason: Direct/inverse proportion requires understanding multiplicative relationships
edges.chineseReason: 比较两个量的倍数关系，可以帮助理解正比例或反比例中的变化。

edges.fromName: 取整十、整百、整千的近似数
edges.fromGoal: Round any number to the nearest 10, 100, or 1000
edges.toGoal: Round any whole number up to 1,000,000 to the nearest 10, 100, 1,000, 10,000, or 100,000 using place-value understanding
edges.sourceReason: Rounding to nearest 10/100/1000 is prerequisite to rounding to any place up to 100,000
edges.chineseReason: 理解取整十、整百和整千的近似数后，可以继续按其他数位取近似值。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise that in a multi-digit whole number, a digit in one place represents ten times what it represents in the place to its right (e.g. 700 ÷ 70 = 10)
edges.toGoal: Round any whole number up to 1,000,000 to the nearest 10, 100, 1,000, 10,000, or 100,000 using place-value understanding
edges.sourceReason: Understanding ×10 relationship supports rounding to higher place values
edges.chineseReason: 相邻数位相差10倍；取近似数时，这有助于看清要保留的数位。

edges.fromName: 加减法的策略 · 小数的数位与运算
edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract decimals to hundredths using strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction; relate strategies to written methods and explain reasoning
edges.toGoal: Recognise volume as additive; find volumes of composite solid figures made of two or more non-overlapping right rectangular prisms
edges.sourceReason: Adding volumes of sub-figures uses decimal addition
edges.chineseReason: 把不重叠的部分体积相加时，如果体积用小数表示，可以用小数加法。

edges.fromGoal: Find the volume of right rectangular prisms by packing with unit cubes and show it equals l × w × h (or base area × height); apply V = l × w × h and V = B × h to solve real-world problems; calculate, estimate, and compare volumes of cubes and cuboids in standard units (cm³, m³); and recognise that the formula applies to cuboids, while an irregular solid built from cubes must be counted or split into cuboids
edges.toGoal: Recognise volume as additive; find volumes of composite solid figures made of two or more non-overlapping right rectangular prisms
edges.sourceReason: Composite volume requires volume formula for individual prisms
edges.chineseReason: 先求各个不重叠长方体的体积，再把它们相加，可以得到组合体的体积。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise rotational symmetry in shapes and designs, state how many times a shape matches itself in a full turn, and create patterns with line and rotational symmetry, including by rotating a motif in dynamic geometry software
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use combinations of translations, reflections and rotations to create tessellations and other geometric patterns, using dynamic geometry software where appropriate
edges.sourceReason: Symmetry supports designing geometric patterns
edges.chineseReason: 观察旋转后是否重合，可以帮助设计具有旋转对称的图案。

edges.fromGoal: Describe and perform translations, reflections and rotations of shapes with dynamic geometry software where appropriate as well as by hand, recognise what changes (position, orientation) and what stays the same (side lengths, angles, shape and size), and identify symmetries in the resulting figures
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use combinations of translations, reflections and rotations to create tessellations and other geometric patterns, using dynamic geometry software where appropriate
edges.sourceReason: Combining transformations into tessellations builds on performing them in geometry software
edges.chineseReason: 在软件中尝试平移、反射和旋转，可以进一步组合图形进行铺砌。

edges.fromName: 网格上的图形变换 · 反射、平移与旋转
edges.fromGoal: Represent and carry out geometric transformations on squared paper or a coordinate grid: reflections (in horizontal, vertical, and diagonal mirror lines, including the axes), translations (described as a vector or as left/right/up/down moves), and rotations (90° or 180° about a stated centre point); describe each transformation precisely using the correct language; identify which transformation maps one shape onto its image by comparing position, orientation, and size
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use combinations of translations, reflections and rotations to create tessellations and other geometric patterns, using dynamic geometry software where appropriate
edges.sourceReason: Tessellations combine translations, reflections and rotations
edges.chineseReason: 平移、反射和旋转图形，可以得到不同的铺砌与重复图案。

edges.fromGoal: Make a line plot to display a data set of measurements in fractions of a unit (1/2, 1/4, 1/8); use operations on fractions to solve problems involving data in line plots (e.g. redistribute total equally)
edges.toGoal: Before summarising a numerical data set, state its context precisely: report the number of observations (n) by counting the values in a list or the dots on a dot plot, or by adding the frequencies in a table or histogram (not by counting rows or bars); describe the attribute investigated (what was measured or counted, and for whom or what), how it was measured (the instrument or method and the precision or rounding used, e.g. measured with a tape to the nearest cm versus self-reported) and its units; and use these details to give every summary value with its units and to judge what the data can show, for example recognising when values bunch at round numbers because of how they were recorded
edges.sourceReason: Generating and plotting measurement data recorded to the nearest 1/8 of a unit gives concrete experience of how the measuring method, precision and units shape a data set
edges.chineseReason: 把测量结果按八分之一单位记录在点图上，可以观察测量精度和单位怎样影响数据。

edges.fromGoal: Distinguish a statistical question — one that anticipates variability in the data collected to answer it, so its answer must account for that variability (even when it is reported as a single summary value such as a mean or median) — from a question answered by a single fixed fact; for a statistical question, identify the population (who or what is being asked about), the attribute being investigated, and the variation expected in the answers
edges.toGoal: Before summarising a numerical data set, state its context precisely: report the number of observations (n) by counting the values in a list or the dots on a dot plot, or by adding the frequencies in a table or histogram (not by counting rows or bars); describe the attribute investigated (what was measured or counted, and for whom or what), how it was measured (the instrument or method and the precision or rounding used, e.g. measured with a tape to the nearest cm versus self-reported) and its units; and use these details to give every summary value with its units and to judge what the data can show, for example recognising when values bunch at round numbers because of how they were recorded
edges.sourceReason: Describing the attribute investigated, and for whom, starts from identifying the population and attribute behind a statistical question
edges.chineseReason: 统计问题先说明研究哪些对象和什么特征，再决定测量什么。

edges.fromGoal: Construct and interpret dot plots for numerical data sets of any kind (counts, scores, times or measurements), extending earlier measurement line plots: draw a number-line scale with equal intervals that runs from at least the minimum to the maximum value, including values nobody recorded so that gaps stay visible; place one dot per observation, stacking repeated values in evenly spaced columns; label the scale with the attribute and its units; and read the plot to find how often a value occurs, the minimum, maximum and most common values, and the total number of observations, recognising that the height of a stack is a count of observations, not a data value
edges.toGoal: Before summarising a numerical data set, state its context precisely: report the number of observations (n) by counting the values in a list or the dots on a dot plot, or by adding the frequencies in a table or histogram (not by counting rows or bars); describe the attribute investigated (what was measured or counted, and for whom or what), how it was measured (the instrument or method and the precision or rounding used, e.g. measured with a tape to the nearest cm versus self-reported) and its units; and use these details to give every summary value with its units and to judge what the data can show, for example recognising when values bunch at round numbers because of how they were recorded
edges.sourceReason: Counting the dots on a dot plot is one of the ways pupils report the number of observations
edges.chineseReason: 点图中每个点代表一条记录时，数点的数量可以得到记录数。

edges.fromName: 用倍数比较 · 读懂倍数比较
edges.toName: 用倍数比较 · 倍数比较的情境问题
edges.fromGoal: Interpret a multiplication equation as a comparison (e.g. 35 = 5 × 7 means 35 is 5 times as many as 7); represent verbal statements of multiplicative comparisons as equations
edges.toGoal: Solve word problems involving multiplicative comparison using drawings and equations with a symbol for the unknown number
edges.sourceReason: Must understand multiplicative comparison concept before solving word problems
edges.chineseReason: 理解“几倍”是在比较两个数量的乘法关系，有助于把情境写成相应算式。

edges.toName: 用倍数比较 · 倍数比较的情境问题
edges.fromGoal: Use multiplication and division within 100 to solve word problems involving equal groups, arrays, and measurement quantities
edges.toGoal: Solve word problems involving multiplicative comparison using drawings and equations with a symbol for the unknown number
edges.sourceReason: Solving M×D word problems within 100 is prerequisite to multiplicative comparison problems
edges.chineseReason: 乘除情境中的分组和数量关系，可以帮助分析倍数比较问题。

edges.fromGoal: Find different combinations of coins that equal the same amount of money
edges.toGoal: Solve simple money problems involving addition and subtraction, including giving change
edges.sourceReason: Solving money problems requires ability to combine coins
edges.chineseReason: 把不同面值的硬币金额相加，可以计算商品总价。

edges.fromName: 拿走与分开：减法的意义
edges.fromGoal: Understand subtraction as taking away or separating from a group to find how many remain
edges.toGoal: Solve simple money problems involving addition and subtraction, including giving change
edges.sourceReason: Giving change involves subtraction
edges.chineseReason: 从付款金额中减去总价，可以得到应找回的钱。

edges.fromGoal: Solve simple money problems involving addition and subtraction, including giving change
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract amounts of money to give change, using both £ and p in practical contexts
edges.sourceReason: Giving change in £ and p extends Y2 simple money problems
edges.chineseReason: 理解钱的加减后，可以进一步处理英镑和便士的找零。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use symbols for pounds (£) and pence (p) and combine amounts to make a particular value
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract amounts of money to give change, using both £ and p in practical contexts
edges.sourceReason: Requires fluency with £ and p symbols
edges.chineseReason: 看懂英镑与便士的符号和写法，有助于读出金额并计算找零。

edges.fromGoal: Compare and order lengths, mass, and capacity and record results using >, <, and =
edges.toGoal: Measure, compare, add, and subtract lengths (m/cm/mm), mass (kg/g), and volume/capacity (l/ml) using standard units
edges.sourceReason: Extends comparing/ordering measures to adding/subtracting them
edges.chineseReason: 比较测量结果后，可以在单位一致时对它们进行加减。

edges.fromGoal: Choose and use appropriate standard units to measure length (m/cm), mass (kg/g), temperature (°C), and capacity (litres/ml) to the nearest appropriate unit
edges.toGoal: Measure, compare, add, and subtract lengths (m/cm/mm), mass (kg/g), and volume/capacity (l/ml) using standard units
edges.sourceReason: Extends Y2 standard unit measurement to include mm and to add/subtract measures
edges.chineseReason: 选择合适的测量单位，能帮助记录长度并比较或计算测量值。

edges.fromGoal: Measure and begin to record time in hours, minutes, and seconds
edges.toGoal: Compare and sequence intervals of time
edges.sourceReason: Sequencing intervals requires understanding time measurement
edges.chineseReason: 用小时、分钟或秒描述时长，有助于把不同时间间隔放在一起排列。

edges.fromGoal: Use comparative language for time: quicker, slower, earlier, later
edges.toGoal: Compare and sequence intervals of time
edges.sourceReason: Comparing and sequencing intervals extends Y1 comparative time language
edges.chineseReason: 先比较时间间隔的长短，再按长短顺序排列。

edges.fromName: 测量长度 · 选择工具测量
edges.fromGoal: Measure the length of an object by selecting and using appropriate tools such as rulers, yardsticks, metre sticks, and measuring tapes
edges.toGoal: Understand that a unit square has one square unit of area and that the area of a plane figure is the number of unit squares that cover it without gaps or overlaps
edges.sourceReason: Length measurement experience supports understanding area as a 2D measurement
edges.chineseReason: 长度是一维测量；认识长度可以帮助理解覆盖平面所需的面积。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise mixed numbers and improper fractions; convert from one form to the other (e.g. 2/5 + 4/5 = 6/5 = 1 1/5)
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract mixed numbers with like denominators, including by converting to improper fractions or using properties of operations
edges.sourceReason: Converting mixed↔improper is needed for adding/subtracting mixed numbers
edges.chineseReason: 带分数可换成假分数来加减，也可以分别处理整数部分和分数部分。

edges.fromGoal: Understand addition and subtraction of fractions as joining and separating parts; decompose a fraction into a sum of fractions with the same denominator in more than one way
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract mixed numbers with like denominators, including by converting to improper fractions or using properties of operations
edges.sourceReason: Fraction decomposition is prerequisite to adding/subtracting mixed numbers
edges.chineseReason: 把带分数拆成整数和分数部分，可以帮助理解带分数的加减。

edges.fromGoal: Read and write number words from one to twenty
edges.toGoal: Read and write numbers to at least 100 in words
edges.sourceReason: Writing number words to 100 extends from writing number words to 20
edges.chineseReason: 来源把较小范围的英文数词和较大范围的英文数词联系起来；这里的活动使用中文数词。

edges.fromGoal: Read and write numerals from 0 to 100
edges.toGoal: Read and write numbers to at least 100 in words
edges.sourceReason: Writing number words to 100 requires reading the corresponding numerals
edges.chineseReason: 认识数字与数词表示同一数量，有助于读写不同形式的数。这里的活动使用中文数词。

edges.fromGoal: Count from 0 in multiples of 4, 8, 50, and 100
edges.toGoal: Count in multiples of 6, 7, 9, 25, and 1000
edges.sourceReason: Counting in 6s/7s/9s/25s/1000s extends counting in 4s/8s/50s/100s
edges.chineseReason: 熟悉按固定数量跳着数后，可以继续尝试每次跳6、7、9等数量。

edges.toName: 把10以内的数分成两部分
edges.fromGoal: Understand addition as combining or putting together two groups to find the total
edges.toGoal: Decompose numbers up to 10 into pairs in more than one way (part-part-whole)
edges.sourceReason: Decomposing numbers into pairs requires understanding addition as combining
edges.chineseReason: 把一个数拆成两部分后，两部分合起来仍是原来的数。

edges.fromName: 测量角 · 量角与画角
edges.toName: 测量角 · 角的加减与未知角
edges.fromGoal: Measure angles in whole-number degrees using a protractor; draw given angles and sketch angles of specified measure
edges.toGoal: Recognise angle measure as additive; find unknown angles by adding or subtracting on a diagram using equations with a symbol for the unknown
edges.sourceReason: Must measure angles before solving unknown angle problems
edges.chineseReason: 量出角的大小，有助于观察相邻角之间的加减关系。

edges.fromName: 角的分类 · 读懂几何图形的标记
edges.toName: 测量角 · 角的加减与未知角
edges.fromGoal: Use and interpret standard geometric diagram conventions: mark right angles with a small square, equal lengths with single or double tick marks, and equal angles with arc marks; label angles in three-letter notation (∠ABC) and individual angles with a single letter or number; draw diagrams showing angles at a point, angles on a straight line, and angles inside polygons with these conventions; read diagrams with these marks to identify given information and find unknown values
edges.toGoal: Recognise angle measure as additive; find unknown angles by adding or subtracting on a diagram using equations with a symbol for the unknown
edges.sourceReason: Finding unknown angles using equations requires reading angle diagrams and interpreting arc marks and notation
edges.chineseReason: 看懂图中角的标记，可以把已知角和未知角的关系写成算式。

edges.toName: 测量角 · 角的加减与未知角
edges.fromGoal: Know that angles at a point sum to 360° (one whole turn), angles on a straight line sum to 180°, and vertically opposite angles are equal; use these facts to find missing angles
edges.toGoal: Recognise angle measure as additive; find unknown angles by adding or subtracting on a diagram using equations with a symbol for the unknown
edges.sourceReason: Must know angle facts (360°, 180°) to solve unknown angle problems
edges.chineseReason: 利用一周角360°或一平角180°等关系，可以求出图中的未知角。

edges.fromName: 乘除法口算 · 0、1与三个数的乘除
edges.toName: 乘除法口算 · 利用已知事实和数位
edges.fromGoal: Use place value, known and derived facts to multiply and divide mentally, including multiplying by 0 and 1, dividing by 1, and multiplying together three numbers
edges.toGoal: Multiply and divide numbers mentally drawing upon known facts, including related facts and place-value adjustments
edges.sourceReason: Y4 mental ×÷ using known/derived facts is prerequisite to extending with larger numbers
edges.chineseReason: 利用已知乘除事实和数位关系，可以处理更大的数。

edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and use the vocabulary of statistical analysis — mean, median, mode, range, frequency, data, sample, average, chart, table, graph, pie chart, scatter graph, correlation — with understanding of what each term describes
edges.toGoal: Describe simple mathematical relationships between two variables using scatter graphs, identify positive, negative, or no correlation, and use a line of best fit to make predictions
edges.sourceReason: Describing correlation and using a scatter graph requires 'correlation', 'scatter graph', and 'line of best fit'
edges.chineseReason: 理解散点图、相关关系和拟合线等词语，有助于描述两个变量的关系。

edges.fromGoal: Plot and read coordinates in all four quadrants of the Cartesian plane, using positive and negative x- and y-values to describe positions precisely
edges.toGoal: Describe simple mathematical relationships between two variables using scatter graphs, identify positive, negative, or no correlation, and use a line of best fit to make predictions
edges.sourceReason: Scatter graphs require confident coordinate plotting in the first quadrant and beyond
edges.chineseReason: 在坐标图中确定每对数的位置，是画散点图的基础。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise that a linear function produces a straight-line graph, understand the relationship between an equation of the form y = mx + c and its graphical representation, and interpret gradient and y-intercept in context
edges.toGoal: Describe simple mathematical relationships between two variables using scatter graphs, identify positive, negative, or no correlation, and use a line of best fit to make predictions
edges.sourceReason: Line of best fit connects to understanding linear relationships from y = mx + c
edges.chineseReason: 拟合直线可以用来描述散点的大致趋势，与一次函数图像有关。

edges.fromGoal: Describe, interpret, and compare observed distributions of a single variable using measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode) and spread (range), including choosing a suitable average and the effect of outliers; comparisons describe the observed data sets themselves and do not yet scale the difference in centres by a measure of variability or generalise from samples to wider populations
edges.toGoal: Describe simple mathematical relationships between two variables using scatter graphs, identify positive, negative, or no correlation, and use a line of best fit to make predictions
edges.sourceReason: Interpreting scatter graphs requires understanding averages and data distributions
edges.chineseReason: 观察平均数和数据分布，有助于描述散点整体的位置与分散。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise Australian coins (5c, 10c, 20c, 50c, $1, $2) and notes ($5, $10, $20, $50, $100), know that a coin's size does not show its value, and solve simple purchase problems within $20 or 20 cents using real coins and virtual money (on-screen coins and notes)
edges.toGoal: Solve practical money transactions with Australian money involving addition, subtraction and equal groups — totals, change and costs of several identical items — and explain the answer in terms of the purchase
edges.sourceReason: Money transactions require recognising Australian coins and notes
edges.chineseReason: 认识不同面值的钱，可以帮助计算购物时的总价和找零。

edges.fromGoal: Add within 100 using strategies based on place value, including adding a two-digit and one-digit number, and a two-digit and a multiple of 10
edges.toGoal: Solve practical money transactions with Australian money involving addition, subtraction and equal groups — totals, change and costs of several identical items — and explain the answer in terms of the purchase
edges.sourceReason: Totals and change use adding within 100
edges.chineseReason: 交易中的总价和找零可以用加减法计算。

edges.fromName: 乘法是相同加数的和 · 用阵列和事实解决问题
edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving multiplication and division using arrays, repeated addition, mental methods, and known facts
edges.toGoal: Solve practical money transactions with Australian money involving addition, subtraction and equal groups — totals, change and costs of several identical items — and explain the answer in terms of the purchase
edges.sourceReason: Costs of several identical items use repeated addition
edges.chineseReason: 几件同价商品的总价，可以用重复加相同价格或乘法求出。

edges.toName: 用数字工具模拟随机事件
edges.fromGoal: Run repeated probability experiments and compare experimental (relative frequency) results with theoretical predictions; understand and demonstrate that as the number of trials increases, the experimental probability tends towards the theoretical probability — and that short runs can give very different results
edges.toGoal: Run chance simulations with an increasing number of trials using digital tools (spreadsheet random functions or online simulators), repeating each run size several times, and explain that relative frequencies tend to stabilise near the expected proportion as the number of trials grows, even though any single longer run need not be closer than a shorter one
edges.sourceReason: Simulations extend comparing experimental and theoretical results
edges.chineseReason: 模拟随机事件得到实验结果，可以与理论概率作比较。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that 10 can be thought of as a bundle of ten ones — called a 'ten'
edges.toGoal: Understand that 100 can be thought of as a bundle of ten tens — called a 'hundred'
edges.sourceReason: 100 as ten tens extends understanding of 10 as ten ones
edges.chineseReason: 十个一组成一个十；十个十组成一百。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones
edges.toGoal: Understand that 100 can be thought of as a bundle of ten tens — called a 'hundred'
edges.sourceReason: Must understand two-digit place value before extending to hundreds
edges.chineseReason: 理解十位和个位怎样组成两位数，可以继续看百位、十位和个位。

edges.toName: 正多边形与不规则多边形
edges.fromGoal: Understand that shapes in different categories may share attributes defining a larger category; classify quadrilaterals (rhombuses, rectangles, squares) and draw examples of quadrilaterals not in those subcategories
edges.toGoal: Distinguish between regular and irregular polygons based on reasoning about equal sides and equal angles
edges.sourceReason: Shape classification supports distinguishing regular from irregular
edges.chineseReason: 给多边形分类时，可以用边和角的特征判断它是否为正多边形。

edges.toName: 正多边形与不规则多边形
edges.fromGoal: Estimate and compare acute, obtuse, and reflex angles in degrees; classify angles by type and order them by size
edges.toGoal: Distinguish between regular and irregular polygons based on reasoning about equal sides and equal angles
edges.sourceReason: Classifying regular/irregular polygons benefits from angle estimation skills
edges.chineseReason: 估计并比较多边形各角的大小，可以帮助判断它是否为正多边形。

edges.toName: 辨析媒体中的统计信息
edges.fromGoal: Distinguish a population from a sample drawn from it; explain why a convenient or biased sample (choosing whoever is easiest to reach, volunteers, or a group linked to the answer) can misrepresent the population; explain that random selection gives every member of the population an equal chance of being chosen, which tends to produce representative samples — while recognising that any single random sample can still, by chance, be unrepresentative
edges.toGoal: Identify statistically informed arguments in traditional and digital media and critique their methods, data representations (e.g. truncated axes, distorted pictographs, selective data) and conclusions
edges.sourceReason: Knowing how samples can mislead supports critiquing media claims
edges.chineseReason: 了解样本如何选取，可以帮助判断媒体中的统计结论是否可靠。

edges.toName: 辨析媒体中的统计信息
edges.fromGoal: Analyse how effectively different displays or visualisations show and compare data distributions, and describe the shape of a distribution and the variation in the data
edges.toGoal: Identify statistically informed arguments in traditional and digital media and critique their methods, data representations (e.g. truncated axes, distorted pictographs, selective data) and conclusions
edges.sourceReason: Critiquing media displays builds on analysing display effectiveness
edges.chineseReason: 比较不同图表怎样呈现同一数据，可以帮助发现媒体图表可能造成的误解。

edges.fromName: 有余数的除法 · 情境中的余数
edges.fromGoal: Solve multi-step word problems using the four operations with whole numbers, including interpreting remainders in context; represent with equations using a letter for the unknown; check with estimation
edges.toGoal: Use parentheses, brackets, or braces in numerical expressions and evaluate expressions containing these grouping symbols
edges.sourceReason: Evaluating grouped expressions formalises multi-step calculation skills from Y5
edges.chineseReason: 多步问题包含一系列运算，括号可以表示其中需要先作为一组的部分。

edges.fromName: 乘法竖式 · 多位数竖式
edges.fromGoal: Fluently multiply multi-digit whole numbers (up to 4 digits by 2 digits) using the formal written method of long multiplication
edges.toGoal: Use parentheses, brackets, or braces in numerical expressions and evaluate expressions containing these grouping symbols
edges.sourceReason: Evaluating expressions requires fluent multiplication
edges.chineseReason: 计算含括号的算式时，可能需要用乘法完成其中的步骤。

edges.fromName: 平面图形 · 边与对称
edges.toName: 理解角 · 图形与转动中的角
edges.fromGoal: Identify and describe properties of 2-D shapes including the number of sides and line symmetry in a vertical line
edges.toGoal: Recognise angles as a property of shape or a description of a turn
edges.sourceReason: Understanding angles as shape properties requires knowing basic shape properties
edges.chineseReason: 观察图形的边与顶点，可以进一步认识边相接形成的角。

edges.toName: 理解角 · 图形与转动中的角
edges.fromGoal: Use mathematical vocabulary to describe position, direction, and movement, including straight lines and distinguishing rotation as a turn in terms of right angles (quarter, half, three-quarter turns, clockwise and anti-clockwise)
edges.toGoal: Recognise angles as a property of shape or a description of a turn
edges.sourceReason: Recognising angles as turns extends Y2 work on quarter/half/three-quarter turns
edges.chineseReason: 转四分之一圈、半圈等移动，可以帮助理解角描述的转动。

edges.fromGoal: Read and write numerals from 0 to 20
edges.toGoal: Read, write, and interpret the symbols +, −, and = in number sentences
edges.sourceReason: Writing number sentences requires reading and writing numerals
edges.chineseReason: 读写数字是读写加减算式中的数量所需的表示方式。

edges.fromGoal: Understand addition as combining or putting together two groups to find the total
edges.toGoal: Read, write, and interpret the symbols +, −, and = in number sentences
edges.sourceReason: Reading/writing the + symbol requires understanding what addition means
edges.chineseReason: 理解把数量合起来的意思，有助于读懂加号表示的运算。

edges.fromName: 拿走与分开：减法的意义
edges.fromGoal: Understand subtraction as taking away or separating from a group to find how many remain
edges.toGoal: Read, write, and interpret the symbols +, −, and = in number sentences
edges.sourceReason: Reading/writing the − symbol requires understanding what subtraction means
edges.chineseReason: 理解拿走或分开的意思，能帮助读懂减号表示的运算。

edges.fromGoal: Find the median, lower quartile and upper quartile of a data set using one explicit convention — order the data, find the median, split the data into a lower and an upper half (leaving out the median itself when there is an odd number of values), and take the median of each half as the lower and upper quartile — while recognising that other textbooks, calculators and software may use slightly different conventions; calculate the interquartile range (IQR = upper quartile − lower quartile) and interpret it as the spread of the middle half of the data; and compare what the range and the IQR reveal, including their different sensitivity to extreme values
edges.toGoal: Construct and interpret a box plot on a numerical scale from a five-number summary (minimum, lower quartile, median, upper quartile, maximum), using the stated convention that the whiskers extend to the minimum and maximum values; interpret the median, quartiles, IQR and range, recognising that each whisker and each half of the box represents roughly a quarter of the data however long or short it is drawn; explain what a box plot does not show (individual values, clusters, gaps, the number of values, or the mean); and compare two distributions using their box plots
edges.sourceReason: A box plot is drawn from the five-number summary, which requires finding the median and quartiles
edges.chineseReason: 箱线图用最小值、四分位数、中位数和最大值组成的五数概括表示数据。

edges.fromGoal: Construct and interpret histograms for continuous or numerical data grouped into equal-width class intervals on a continuous number-line scale, with no gaps between bars; state the interval-boundary convention used (e.g. 140 ≤ h < 150, so a value of exactly 150 belongs to the next interval); read frequencies from bar heights; describe the distribution shown; and explain how a histogram differs from a bar chart of categories. Unequal-width intervals and frequency density are not included.
edges.toGoal: Construct and interpret a box plot on a numerical scale from a five-number summary (minimum, lower quartile, median, upper quartile, maximum), using the stated convention that the whiskers extend to the minimum and maximum values; interpret the median, quartiles, IQR and range, recognising that each whisker and each half of the box represents roughly a quarter of the data however long or short it is drawn; explain what a box plot does not show (individual values, clusters, gaps, the number of values, or the mean); and compare two distributions using their box plots
edges.sourceReason: Comparing a box plot with a histogram of the same data helps show which features of the distribution a box plot cannot reveal
edges.chineseReason: 把同一数据的箱线图与直方图比较，可以看出箱线图没有展示的分布细节。

edges.fromGoal: Describe the distribution of a numerical data set by its centre, spread and overall shape — recognising clusters, gaps, peaks, symmetry or skew (a longer tail on one side) and unusual values — and interpret each feature in the context in which the data were collected, recognising that distributions with similar centres can differ greatly in spread and shape
edges.toGoal: Construct and interpret a box plot on a numerical scale from a five-number summary (minimum, lower quartile, median, upper quartile, maximum), using the stated convention that the whiskers extend to the minimum and maximum values; interpret the median, quartiles, IQR and range, recognising that each whisker and each half of the box represents roughly a quarter of the data however long or short it is drawn; explain what a box plot does not show (individual values, clusters, gaps, the number of values, or the mean); and compare two distributions using their box plots
edges.sourceReason: Explaining what a box plot hides (clusters, gaps, shape) requires being able to describe those features of a distribution
edges.chineseReason: 先认识数据中的聚集、空隙和形状，有助于看出箱线图没有显示哪些细节。

edges.fromGoal: Apply the area formula (l × w) and perimeter formula (2l + 2w) for rectangles including squares in real-world and mathematical problems; calculate and compare areas using standard units (cm², m²) and estimate areas of irregular shapes
edges.toGoal: Model real-world problems involving scaling, unit conversion, area/perimeter, and percentage by selecting appropriate mathematical representations and interpreting results in context
edges.sourceReason: Area/perimeter formula problems exercise real-world modelling
edges.chineseReason: 用面积或周长处理房间等实际问题，就是把实际情境表示成数学问题。

edges.fromName: 用乘法与分数建立模型
edges.fromGoal: Model real-world problems involving multiplication, area, fractions, and unit conversion by choosing appropriate representations and interpreting mathematical results in context
edges.toGoal: Model real-world problems involving scaling, unit conversion, area/perimeter, and percentage by selecting appropriate mathematical representations and interpreting results in context
edges.sourceReason: Age 8-9 modelling is prerequisite to age 9-10 level
edges.chineseReason: 先用乘法或分数表示情境，可以继续练习为其他实际问题选择数学模型。

edges.fromName: 理解分数 · 分数倍与简单速率
edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving scaling by simple fractions and problems involving simple rates
edges.toGoal: Model real-world problems involving scaling, unit conversion, area/perimeter, and percentage by selecting appropriate mathematical representations and interpreting results in context
edges.sourceReason: Scaling problems exercise modelling with appropriate representations
edges.chineseReason: 把分数倍或速率问题写成数学关系，就是一种数学建模。

edges.fromGoal: Compare numbers with the same number of decimal places up to two decimal places
edges.toGoal: Compare two decimals to hundredths (or up to three decimal places) by reasoning about size using place-value understanding; record with >, =, <
edges.sourceReason: Comparing decimals to 2dp (Y4) is prerequisite to comparing to 3dp
edges.chineseReason: 比较小数时，可以从较高数位开始逐位比较，也适用于更多小数位。

edges.fromName: 认识十分之一 · 从百分之一到千分之一
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use thousandths; relate them to tenths, hundredths, and their decimal equivalents (e.g. 1/1000 = 0.001, 35/1000 = 0.035)
edges.toGoal: Compare two decimals to hundredths (or up to three decimal places) by reasoning about size using place-value understanding; record with >, =, <
edges.sourceReason: Thousandths understanding supports comparing decimals to 3dp
edges.chineseReason: 理解千分之一，可以帮助比较精确到千分位的小数。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones
edges.toGoal: Solve number problems and practical problems involving place value of numbers up to 1000
edges.sourceReason: Solving PV problems requires three-digit place-value understanding
edges.chineseReason: 理解百位、十位和个位的数值，有助于解决千以内的数位问题。

edges.fromGoal: Find 10 or 100 more or less than a given number up to 1000
edges.toGoal: Solve number problems and practical problems involving place value of numbers up to 1000
edges.sourceReason: Many PV problems involve finding 10/100 more or less
edges.chineseReason: 知道数位表示的量，有助于判断三位数增加或减少10、100后的变化。

edges.fromGoal: Read and write numerals from 0 to 20
edges.toGoal: Read and write number words from one to twenty
edges.sourceReason: Reading/writing number words requires already knowing the numeral forms
edges.chineseReason: 认识数字和数词可以表示相同数量。来源涉及英文数词；这里的活动使用中文数词。

edges.toName: 理解分数 · 多种表示之间的联系
edges.fromGoal: Interpret and construct pie charts: calculate sector angles from data, draw sectors accurately, and read values from pie charts to solve problems
edges.toGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, coordinate grids, algebraic expressions, tables, and symbolic equations involving fractions, ratio, and algebra, explaining connections between representations
edges.sourceReason: Pie chart/line graph interpretation connects to representation fluency
edges.chineseReason: 扇形图和折线图把数量画成图形，可以练习在图表与数字之间转换。

edges.fromName: 数轴上的分数 · 连接小数与百分数
edges.toName: 理解分数 · 多种表示之间的联系
edges.fromGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, number lines, bar models, and symbolic equations involving multi-digit multiplication, fractions, decimals, and percentages, explaining connections between representations
edges.toGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, coordinate grids, algebraic expressions, tables, and symbolic equations involving fractions, ratio, and algebra, explaining connections between representations
edges.sourceReason: Y6 representation fluency extends Y5 multi-representation skills
edges.chineseReason: 把同一个量写成分数、小数或百分数，有助于比较不同表示。

edges.toName: 理解分数 · 多种表示之间的联系
edges.fromGoal: Generate two numerical patterns using two given rules; identify relationships between corresponding terms; form ordered pairs and graph them on a coordinate plane
edges.toGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, coordinate grids, algebraic expressions, tables, and symbolic equations involving fractions, ratio, and algebra, explaining connections between representations
edges.sourceReason: Coordinating two pattern sequences on a coordinate grid is key Y6 content
edges.chineseReason: 在坐标网格上观察两个数列的变化，可以练习连接规律与图形表示。

edges.toName: 理解分数 · 多种表示之间的联系
edges.fromGoal: Construct and interpret line graphs for continuous data (e.g. temperature over time, plant growth); read intermediate values, identify trends, and solve comparison and difference problems
edges.toGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, coordinate grids, algebraic expressions, tables, and symbolic equations involving fractions, ratio, and algebra, explaining connections between representations
edges.sourceReason: Line graphs are one of the representation types referenced by Y6 representation fluency
edges.chineseReason: 折线图是表示数量关系的一种方式，可以和表格及算式对应起来看。

edges.fromGoal: Represent numbers using objects, pictorial representations, and the number line
edges.toGoal: Identify, represent and estimate numbers to 100 using different representations: place a two-digit number on a 0–100 number line marked in tens, represent it with base-ten blocks (tens and ones), drawings, bead strings or hundred squares, and estimate 'about how many' objects in a set before counting to check
edges.sourceReason: Representing and estimating numbers on a number line builds on Y1 number representations
edges.chineseReason: 用物品或图形表示数量后，可以继续在数轴上表示和估计数。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones
edges.toGoal: Identify, represent and estimate numbers to 100 using different representations: place a two-digit number on a 0–100 number line marked in tens, represent it with base-ten blocks (tens and ones), drawings, bead strings or hundred squares, and estimate 'about how many' objects in a set before counting to check
edges.sourceReason: Representing a two-digit number as tens and ones with blocks or drawings, and placing it between two tens on a number line, requires two-digit place value
edges.chineseReason: 理解两位数由几个十和几个一组成，有助于用积木、图形或数轴表示它。

edges.fromGoal: Solve practical money transactions with Australian money involving addition, subtraction and equal groups — totals, change and costs of several identical items — and explain the answer in terms of the purchase
edges.toGoal: Recognise the relationship between dollars and cents (100 cents = 1 dollar), read and write amounts in $ and c notation (e.g. $3.45 and 345c), represent the same amount with different combinations of Australian coins and notes, and calculate change in dollars and cents
edges.sourceReason: Dollars-and-cents notation and change build on whole-dollar and cents transactions
edges.chineseReason: 理解元与分的写法，可以把交易中的同一金额换成不同单位表示。

edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract within 1000 using concrete models, drawings, and strategies based on place value; understand composing and decomposing tens and hundreds
edges.toGoal: Recognise the relationship between dollars and cents (100 cents = 1 dollar), read and write amounts in $ and c notation (e.g. $3.45 and 345c), represent the same amount with different combinations of Australian coins and notes, and calculate change in dollars and cents
edges.sourceReason: Calculating change uses addition and subtraction with regrouping
edges.chineseReason: 找零需要计算付款与总价的差，可能用到进位或退位。

edges.fromGoal: Use negative numbers in context (temperature, finance, sea level); calculate intervals across zero
edges.toGoal: Understand positive and negative numbers as describing quantities with opposite directions or values; use them in context such as temperature, floors in a building, and bank balances
edges.sourceReason: Negative number arithmetic extends Y6 using negative numbers in context
edges.chineseReason: 温度中的零上和零下提供了情境，可以帮助理解正数与负数。

edges.fromGoal: Find 10 or 100 more or less than a given number up to 1000
edges.toGoal: Find 1000 more or less than a given number
edges.sourceReason: Finding 1000 more/less extends finding 10/100 more/less
edges.chineseReason: 观察多或少10、100的变化后，可以继续比较多或少1000。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise the place value of each digit in a four-digit number (thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones)
edges.toGoal: Find 1000 more or less than a given number
edges.sourceReason: Requires four-digit place-value understanding
edges.chineseReason: 看清千位上的数字表示多少个千，有助于判断多1000或少1000。

edges.fromName: 分数乘法 · 分数乘分数
edges.fromGoal: Multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction, including proper fractions by proper fractions; interpret (a/b) × q as a parts of q partitioned into b equal parts; write answers in simplest form
edges.toGoal: Divide a fraction by a fraction using the 'keep-change-flip' method and visual models; interpret and solve word problems involving division of fractions by fractions
edges.sourceReason: Dividing fractions uses the reciprocal method which builds on fraction multiplication
edges.chineseReason: 分数除法可以通过乘法检查；除以非零分数时也可以乘它的倒数。

edges.fromGoal: Interpret and compute division of a unit fraction by a non-zero whole number (e.g. 1/3 ÷ 4 = 1/12); use visual models and the relationship between multiplication and division to explain the result
edges.toGoal: Divide a fraction by a fraction using the 'keep-change-flip' method and visual models; interpret and solve word problems involving division of fractions by fractions
edges.sourceReason: Dividing fraction by fraction extends Y5 dividing unit fractions by whole numbers
edges.chineseReason: 把单位分数平均分后，可以继续探索分数除以分数的不同情境。

edges.fromName: 数轴上的分数 · 把分数放上数轴
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use fractions as numbers: place unit fractions and non-unit fractions with small denominators on a number line
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract fractions with the same denominator within one whole (e.g. 5/7 + 1/7 = 6/7)
edges.sourceReason: Adding fractions requires understanding fractions as numbers
edges.chineseReason: 把分数看作数轴上的数，可以帮助理解几个分数合起来表示多少。

edges.fromGoal: Understand addition as combining or putting together two groups to find the total
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract fractions with the same denominator within one whole (e.g. 5/7 + 1/7 = 6/7)
edges.sourceReason: Adding fractions extends the concept of addition as combining
edges.chineseReason: 加法表示合起来，同样可以用于合并同样大小的分数份额。

edges.fromName: 用倍数比较 · 倍数比较的情境问题
edges.fromGoal: Solve word problems involving multiplicative comparison using drawings and equations with a symbol for the unknown number
edges.toGoal: Compare two numerical distributions with similar variability shown on a shared scale (e.g. dot plots) in two distinct ways: (1) judge their actual visual overlap directly from the displays — how much of each group's data lies among the other group's values; and (2) separately, find the difference between their centres and express it as a multiple of a clearly named measure of variability of either group, using matching measures (difference in means ÷ MAD, or difference in medians ÷ IQR), interpreting a larger multiple as centres that are further apart relative to the typical spread. Recognise that the same difference in centres means more when the variability is small, and that for similarly shaped, roughly symmetric, single-peaked distributions a larger multiple usually goes with less overlap — but that the ratio alone does not determine overlap: skew, clusters, gaps or outliers can make the visible overlap greater or smaller than the ratio suggests, so overlap is always checked on the display; and this simple ratio is only appropriate when the two variabilities are similar
edges.sourceReason: Describing a gap as 'about twice' a measure of variability draws on multiplicative comparison
edges.chineseReason: 当分散程度不为零时，可以用“相差大约是它的几倍”描述两组中心之间的差。

edges.fromGoal: Construct and interpret a box plot on a numerical scale from a five-number summary (minimum, lower quartile, median, upper quartile, maximum), using the stated convention that the whiskers extend to the minimum and maximum values; interpret the median, quartiles, IQR and range, recognising that each whisker and each half of the box represents roughly a quarter of the data however long or short it is drawn; explain what a box plot does not show (individual values, clusters, gaps, the number of values, or the mean); and compare two distributions using their box plots
edges.toGoal: Compare two numerical distributions with similar variability shown on a shared scale (e.g. dot plots) in two distinct ways: (1) judge their actual visual overlap directly from the displays — how much of each group's data lies among the other group's values; and (2) separately, find the difference between their centres and express it as a multiple of a clearly named measure of variability of either group, using matching measures (difference in means ÷ MAD, or difference in medians ÷ IQR), interpreting a larger multiple as centres that are further apart relative to the typical spread. Recognise that the same difference in centres means more when the variability is small, and that for similarly shaped, roughly symmetric, single-peaked distributions a larger multiple usually goes with less overlap — but that the ratio alone does not determine overlap: skew, clusters, gaps or outliers can make the visible overlap greater or smaller than the ratio suggests, so overlap is always checked on the display; and this simple ratio is only appropriate when the two variabilities are similar
edges.sourceReason: Comparing two box plots on a shared scale gives pupils prior experience of judging overlap between two distributions
edges.chineseReason: 在同一刻度上比较两个箱线图，可以观察概括范围是否重叠；不能由此还原每条数据。

edges.fromGoal: Find the median, lower quartile and upper quartile of a data set using one explicit convention — order the data, find the median, split the data into a lower and an upper half (leaving out the median itself when there is an odd number of values), and take the median of each half as the lower and upper quartile — while recognising that other textbooks, calculators and software may use slightly different conventions; calculate the interquartile range (IQR = upper quartile − lower quartile) and interpret it as the spread of the middle half of the data; and compare what the range and the IQR reveal, including their different sensitivity to extreme values
edges.toGoal: Compare two numerical distributions with similar variability shown on a shared scale (e.g. dot plots) in two distinct ways: (1) judge their actual visual overlap directly from the displays — how much of each group's data lies among the other group's values; and (2) separately, find the difference between their centres and express it as a multiple of a clearly named measure of variability of either group, using matching measures (difference in means ÷ MAD, or difference in medians ÷ IQR), interpreting a larger multiple as centres that are further apart relative to the typical spread. Recognise that the same difference in centres means more when the variability is small, and that for similarly shaped, roughly symmetric, single-peaked distributions a larger multiple usually goes with less overlap — but that the ratio alone does not determine overlap: skew, clusters, gaps or outliers can make the visible overlap greater or smaller than the ratio suggests, so overlap is always checked on the display; and this simple ratio is only appropriate when the two variabilities are similar
edges.sourceReason: The IQR is the matching variability measure when the difference between medians is used instead of means
edges.chineseReason: 用中位数比较中心时，可以用四分位距配合描述分散程度。

edges.fromGoal: Describe the distribution of a numerical data set by its centre, spread and overall shape — recognising clusters, gaps, peaks, symmetry or skew (a longer tail on one side) and unusual values — and interpret each feature in the context in which the data were collected, recognising that distributions with similar centres can differ greatly in spread and shape
edges.toGoal: Compare two numerical distributions with similar variability shown on a shared scale (e.g. dot plots) in two distinct ways: (1) judge their actual visual overlap directly from the displays — how much of each group's data lies among the other group's values; and (2) separately, find the difference between their centres and express it as a multiple of a clearly named measure of variability of either group, using matching measures (difference in means ÷ MAD, or difference in medians ÷ IQR), interpreting a larger multiple as centres that are further apart relative to the typical spread. Recognise that the same difference in centres means more when the variability is small, and that for similarly shaped, roughly symmetric, single-peaked distributions a larger multiple usually goes with less overlap — but that the ratio alone does not determine overlap: skew, clusters, gaps or outliers can make the visible overlap greater or smaller than the ratio suggests, so overlap is always checked on the display; and this simple ratio is only appropriate when the two variabilities are similar
edges.sourceReason: Judging visual overlap requires reading where each distribution is centred and how widely it spreads on a dot plot
edges.chineseReason: 比较两组点图的中心和分散程度，有助于观察两组数据重叠多少。

edges.fromGoal: Calculate the mean absolute deviation (MAD) of a small numerical data set — find the mean, find each value's distance from the mean (a non-negative number: a value equal to the mean has distance 0), then find the mean of those distances; interpret the MAD as the average distance of the values from the mean, stated in the original units of the data (e.g. minutes, cm, points); and use MADs to compare the spread or consistency of two data sets, recognising that a larger MAD means values typically sit further from the mean and that the MAD is 0 only when every value equals the mean
edges.toGoal: Compare two numerical distributions with similar variability shown on a shared scale (e.g. dot plots) in two distinct ways: (1) judge their actual visual overlap directly from the displays — how much of each group's data lies among the other group's values; and (2) separately, find the difference between their centres and express it as a multiple of a clearly named measure of variability of either group, using matching measures (difference in means ÷ MAD, or difference in medians ÷ IQR), interpreting a larger multiple as centres that are further apart relative to the typical spread. Recognise that the same difference in centres means more when the variability is small, and that for similarly shaped, roughly symmetric, single-peaked distributions a larger multiple usually goes with less overlap — but that the ratio alone does not determine overlap: skew, clusters, gaps or outliers can make the visible overlap greater or smaller than the ratio suggests, so overlap is always checked on the display; and this simple ratio is only appropriate when the two variabilities are similar
edges.sourceReason: Expressing the difference in means as a multiple of variability requires calculating and interpreting the MAD
edges.chineseReason: 算出到平均数的平均距离后，可以比较两组平均数之差与这一距离。

edges.fromName: 等值分数 · 细分与合并
edges.toName: 说明推理的依据 · 呈现推理并评价
edges.fromGoal: Generate simple equivalent fractions and explain why they are equivalent using visual fraction models
edges.toGoal: Construct and present multi-step mathematical arguments; critique the reasoning of others and explain clearly why a method works or fails
edges.sourceReason: Generating/explaining equivalent fractions exercises justification skills
edges.chineseReason: 生成等值分数并解释它们相等，可以练习给出理由。

edges.fromName: 比较分数大小 · 同分子或同分母
edges.toName: 说明推理的依据 · 呈现推理并评价
edges.fromGoal: Compare two fractions with the same numerator or the same denominator by reasoning about size; record comparisons with >, =, or < symbols
edges.toGoal: Construct and present multi-step mathematical arguments; critique the reasoning of others and explain clearly why a method works or fails
edges.sourceReason: Fraction comparison requires constructing arguments about relative size
edges.chineseReason: 比较分数大小时，说清相同分子或分母带来的关系，就是在给比较提供理由。

edges.fromName: 说明推理的依据 · 跟随推理并找错
edges.toName: 说明推理的依据 · 呈现推理并评价
edges.fromGoal: Construct and follow multi-step mathematical arguments; identify errors in reasoning and explain why a method works or does not work
edges.toGoal: Construct and present multi-step mathematical arguments; critique the reasoning of others and explain clearly why a method works or fails
edges.sourceReason: Age 7-8 explaining/justifying is prerequisite to age 8-9 level
edges.chineseReason: 跟随推理、找错和评价他人的方法，都需要说清每一步的依据。

edges.toName: 分数乘法 · 分数乘分数
edges.fromGoal: Use common factors to simplify fractions to their simplest form; use common multiples to express fractions with a common denominator
edges.toGoal: Multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction, including proper fractions by proper fractions; interpret (a/b) × q as a parts of q partitioned into b equal parts; write answers in simplest form
edges.sourceReason: Writing products in simplest form requires simplification skills
edges.chineseReason: 算出分数乘积后，可以用约分把结果写成更简洁的等值形式。

edges.fromName: 分数乘法 · 分数乘整数
edges.toName: 分数乘法 · 分数乘分数
edges.fromGoal: Understand a/b as a multiple of 1/b; multiply proper fractions and mixed numbers by whole numbers, supported by visual models (e.g. 3 × 2/5 = 6/5 = 1 1/5)
edges.toGoal: Multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction, including proper fractions by proper fractions; interpret (a/b) × q as a parts of q partitioned into b equal parts; write answers in simplest form
edges.sourceReason: Fraction × fraction extends Y5 fraction × whole number
edges.chineseReason: 理解分数乘整数后，可以继续探索一个量乘以分数表示什么。

edges.toName: 数的读写 · 小数的读写比较
edges.fromGoal: Compare two decimals to hundredths (or up to three decimal places) by reasoning about size using place-value understanding; record with >, =, <
edges.toGoal: Read, write, and compare decimals to thousandths using base-ten numerals, number names, and expanded form; compare using >, =, < based on place-value meaning
edges.sourceReason: Compare decimals to thousandths extends Y5 decimal comparison
edges.chineseReason: 比较小数时，从较高数位开始逐位比较的方法也适用于更多小数位。

edges.toName: 数的读写 · 小数的读写比较
edges.fromGoal: Recognise that in a multi-digit number, a digit in one place represents 10 times as much as in the place to its right and 1/10 of what it represents in the place to its left
edges.toGoal: Read, write, and compare decimals to thousandths using base-ten numerals, number names, and expanded form; compare using >, =, < based on place-value meaning
edges.sourceReason: Place-value understanding supports decimal comparison reasoning
edges.chineseReason: 理解相邻数位相差10倍，可以帮助比较小数中各位数字的值。

edges.fromName: 认识十分之一 · 从百分之一到千分之一
edges.toName: 数的读写 · 小数的读写比较
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use thousandths; relate them to tenths, hundredths, and their decimal equivalents (e.g. 1/1000 = 0.001, 35/1000 = 0.035)
edges.toGoal: Read, write, and compare decimals to thousandths using base-ten numerals, number names, and expanded form; compare using >, =, < based on place-value meaning
edges.sourceReason: Reading/writing decimals to thousandths requires understanding thousandths place
edges.chineseReason: 知道千分位表示多少个千分之一，有助于读写并比较这一数位上的数字。

edges.fromGoal: Record, describe, and analyse the frequency of outcomes from probability experiments to develop an understanding of relative frequency as an estimate of probability
edges.toGoal: Develop a probability model (a list of all the outcomes of a chance process with a probability for each, adding to 1) and use it to find probabilities of events: a uniform model gives every outcome the same probability (e.g. selecting a student at random from a class); a non-uniform model uses probabilities estimated from the observed frequencies of a chance process (e.g. how a tossed paper cup lands); compare a model's probabilities with observed frequencies and, when they disagree, explain whether the difference is plausibly chance variation or a sign that the model does not fit (e.g. a biased die or unequal spinner sections)
edges.sourceReason: A non-uniform model uses relative frequencies from experiments as its probabilities, and judging a model against data compares it with observed frequencies
edges.chineseReason: 用实验中各结果的相对频率建立模型，再比较模型与实际观察的数据。

edges.fromGoal: Understand and apply the rule that probabilities of all mutually exclusive outcomes sum to one; use this to find the probability of a complementary event (P(not A) = 1 − P(A))
edges.toGoal: Develop a probability model (a list of all the outcomes of a chance process with a probability for each, adding to 1) and use it to find probabilities of events: a uniform model gives every outcome the same probability (e.g. selecting a student at random from a class); a non-uniform model uses probabilities estimated from the observed frequencies of a chance process (e.g. how a tossed paper cup lands); compare a model's probabilities with observed frequencies and, when they disagree, explain whether the difference is plausibly chance variation or a sign that the model does not fit (e.g. a biased die or unequal spinner sections)
edges.sourceReason: A probability model must list outcomes whose probabilities add to 1
edges.chineseReason: 完整概率模型中的所有结果应互不重叠，且概率和为1。

edges.fromGoal: Calculate the probability of a simple event with equally likely outcomes using the formula: probability = number of favourable outcomes ÷ total number of possible outcomes; express the result as a fraction in its simplest form; apply to rolling dice, drawing from bags, and other simple chance situations
edges.toGoal: Develop a probability model (a list of all the outcomes of a chance process with a probability for each, adding to 1) and use it to find probabilities of events: a uniform model gives every outcome the same probability (e.g. selecting a student at random from a class); a non-uniform model uses probabilities estimated from the observed frequencies of a chance process (e.g. how a tossed paper cup lands); compare a model's probabilities with observed frequencies and, when they disagree, explain whether the difference is plausibly chance variation or a sign that the model does not fit (e.g. a biased die or unequal spinner sections)
edges.sourceReason: A uniform model applies favourable ÷ total outcomes when every outcome is equally likely
edges.chineseReason: 各结果等可能时，可以用有利结果数除以全部结果数；不等可能时不能只靠结果数量判断概率。

edges.fromGoal: Understand addition as combining or putting together two groups to find the total
edges.toGoal: Find different combinations of coins that equal the same amount of money
edges.sourceReason: Combining coins involves addition
edges.chineseReason: 把每枚硬币的面值相加，可以得到总金额。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use symbols for pounds (£) and pence (p) and combine amounts to make a particular value
