edges.toGoal: Find different combinations of coins that equal the same amount of money
edges.sourceReason: Finding coin combinations requires knowing coin values and symbols
edges.chineseReason: 认出英镑和便士的面值与符号，有助于比较不同硬币组合的金额。

edges.fromGoal: Measure, compare, add, and subtract lengths (m/cm/mm), mass (kg/g), and volume/capacity (l/ml) using standard units
edges.toGoal: Measure and estimate liquid volumes and masses of objects using grams, kilograms, and litres; solve one-step word problems involving mass or volume
edges.sourceReason: Prior experience measuring mass/capacity in standard units feeds into formal measurement with g/kg/l
edges.chineseReason: 用测量单位记录结果的经验，可以用于克、千克、升等单位。

edges.fromGoal: Compare and order the mass and capacity of objects indirectly, using a balance or a third object or container as a go-between, and explain the reasoning
edges.toGoal: Measure and estimate liquid volumes and masses of objects using grams, kilograms, and litres; solve one-step word problems involving mass or volume
edges.sourceReason: Comparing mass and capacity indirectly precedes measuring them with scaled instruments
edges.chineseReason: 比较两个容器能装多少或两个物品的质量后，可以用刻度和单位进一步测量。

edges.fromName: 用更小的单位提高精度
edges.fromGoal: Choose a smaller uniform informal unit when a measurement needs to be more accurate, recognising that a smaller unit gives a larger count, for length, mass and capacity
edges.toGoal: Measure and estimate liquid volumes and masses of objects using grams, kilograms, and litres; solve one-step word problems involving mass or volume
edges.sourceReason: Choosing smaller units for accuracy prepares for reading finer scale markings
edges.chineseReason: 较小单位能给出更细的刻度，帮助记录更精确的测量结果。

edges.toName: 图形规律 · 按规则生成图形或数列
edges.fromGoal: Identify arithmetic patterns (including patterns in the addition table or multiplication table) and explain them using properties of operations
edges.toGoal: Generate a number or shape pattern that follows a given rule; identify apparent features of the pattern not explicit in the rule and explain informally why they occur
edges.sourceReason: Identifying arithmetic patterns feeds into generating and analysing patterns from rules
edges.chineseReason: 观察乘法表中的规律后，可以继续按规则生成并分析数列或图案。

edges.toName: 顺着数与倒着数 · 每次走3
edges.fromGoal: Count in multiples of 2, 5, and 10 (skip counting)
edges.toGoal: Count forwards and backwards in steps of 3 from 0
edges.sourceReason: Skip counting in 3s builds on the concept of skip counting already established in 2s, 5s, and 10s
edges.chineseReason: 按2、5或10跳着数后，可以换成每次增加或减少3。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones
edges.toGoal: Mentally add and subtract a three-digit number and tens
edges.sourceReason: Mental add/sub of tens to three-digit numbers requires three-digit PV
edges.chineseReason: 理解三位数的百位、十位和个位，有助于计算加减整十数。

edges.fromGoal: Find 10 or 100 more or less than a given number up to 1000
edges.toGoal: Mentally add and subtract a three-digit number and tens
edges.sourceReason: Extends finding 10 more/less to adding arbitrary multiples of 10
edges.chineseReason: 先看一个数多10或少10，再看增加或减少几个十。

edges.toName: 乘法口诀与乘法表 · 从已知规律推出新事实
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend multiplication table patterns, derive unknown facts from known ones, and describe rules for sequences
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend patterns in times tables and equivalent fractions, derive unknown facts from known facts efficiently, describe general rules
edges.sourceReason: Age 7-8 repeated reasoning is prerequisite to age 8-9 level
edges.chineseReason: 观察表格里重复的变化，可以帮助从已知乘法事实推想新结果。

edges.toName: 乘法口诀与乘法表 · 从已知规律推出新事实
edges.fromGoal: Understand two fractions as equivalent if they are the same size or the same point on a number line; recognise and show families of common equivalent fractions using diagrams
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend patterns in times tables and equivalent fractions, derive unknown facts from known facts efficiently, describe general rules
edges.sourceReason: Equivalent fraction patterns exercise repeated reasoning
edges.chineseReason: 观察等值分数中反复出现的变化，可以从已知例子尝试概括规律。

edges.toName: 乘法口诀与乘法表 · 从已知规律推出新事实
edges.fromGoal: Multiply side lengths to find areas of rectangles and represent whole-number products as rectangular areas
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend patterns in times tables and equivalent fractions, derive unknown facts from known facts efficiently, describe general rules
edges.sourceReason: Area calculation patterns (doubling side doubles area) exercise generalisation
edges.chineseReason: 长方形一条边不变、另一条边变为2倍时，面积也变为2倍；可以据此观察规律。

edges.toName: 加减法口算 · 两位数与一位数
edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract one-digit and two-digit numbers to 20, including zero
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract a two-digit number and ones mentally and using concrete/pictorial representations
edges.sourceReason: Adding ones to a two-digit number extends Y1 adding within 20
edges.chineseReason: 理解较小数的加减后，可以用相同思路把一位数加到两位数上。

edges.toName: 加减法口算 · 两位数与一位数
edges.fromGoal: Understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract a two-digit number and ones mentally and using concrete/pictorial representations
edges.sourceReason: Adding ones to two-digit numbers requires understanding tens and ones
edges.chineseReason: 看清两位数中的十和一，有助于加减一位数并判断是否需要换位。

edges.fromGoal: Know and use advanced vocabulary of multiplicative reasoning — direct proportion, inverse proportion, ratio, rate, unit rate, compound unit, scale factor — accurately in problem-solving contexts
edges.toGoal: Define percentage as 'number of parts per hundred'; interpret percentages and percentage changes as a fraction or a decimal; express one quantity as a percentage of another; compare quantities using percentages; work with percentages greater than 100%
edges.sourceReason: The conceptual definition of percentage as parts per hundred extends the basic percentage vocabulary to a precise definition
edges.chineseReason: 百分数表示每100份中的多少份，可以写成分母为100的分数。

edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving the calculation of percentages of amounts (e.g. 15% of 360) and the use of percentages for comparison
edges.toGoal: Define percentage as 'number of parts per hundred'; interpret percentages and percentage changes as a fraction or a decimal; express one quantity as a percentage of another; compare quantities using percentages; work with percentages greater than 100%
edges.sourceReason: Percentages as fractions/decimals extends Y6 percentage calculations
edges.chineseReason: 百分数可以改写成分数或小数，帮助比较和计算同一个量。

edges.fromGoal: Fluently add and subtract within 1000 using strategies and algorithms based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction
edges.toGoal: Solve two-step word problems using the four operations; represent problems using equations with a letter standing for the unknown quantity
edges.sourceReason: Fluent within-1000 computation supports solving mixed-operation problems
edges.chineseReason: 两步方程中可能包含多种运算，计算结果时需要用到加减法。

edges.fromName: 取整十、整百、整千的近似数
edges.fromGoal: Round any number to the nearest 10, 100, or 1000
edges.toGoal: Solve two-step word problems using the four operations; represent problems using equations with a letter standing for the unknown quantity
edges.sourceReason: Estimation with rounding supports assessing reasonableness
edges.chineseReason: 先用取近似数估算，可以检查两步问题的答案是否大致合理。

edges.fromGoal: Solve one- and two-step word problems within 100 using addition and subtraction, with unknowns in all positions
edges.toGoal: Solve two-step word problems using the four operations; represent problems using equations with a letter standing for the unknown quantity
edges.sourceReason: Two-step four-ops problems extend one/two-step add/sub problems
edges.chineseReason: 把两步情境中的数量关系写成等式，可以帮助寻找未知数。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that 100 can be thought of as a bundle of ten tens — called a 'hundred'
edges.toGoal: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones
edges.sourceReason: Three-digit place value requires understanding 100 as a unit
edges.chineseReason: 理解一百是十个十，有助于看清三位数中的百位表示多少。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones
edges.toGoal: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones
edges.sourceReason: Three-digit PV extends two-digit PV (tens and ones)
edges.chineseReason: 十位和个位的关系可以继续用于理解百位、十位和个位。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones
edges.toGoal: Compare and order numbers up to 1000 using >, =, and < symbols, based on place-value understanding
edges.sourceReason: Comparing three-digit numbers requires three-digit place value
edges.chineseReason: 比较三位数大小时，可以从百位开始比较各数位表示的量。

edges.fromGoal: Compare and order two-digit numbers using the symbols >, =, and <, based on place value understanding
edges.toGoal: Compare and order numbers up to 1000 using >, =, and < symbols, based on place-value understanding
edges.sourceReason: Comparing to 1000 extends comparing two-digit numbers
edges.chineseReason: 比较较小数的方法可以继续用于排列1000以内的数。

edges.fromGoal: Multiply side lengths to find areas of rectangles and represent whole-number products as rectangular areas
edges.toGoal: Use tiling to demonstrate the distributive property: the area of a rectangle with sides a and (b+c) equals a×b + a×c; use area models to represent the distributive property
edges.sourceReason: Must multiply side lengths for area before using area models for distributive property
edges.chineseReason: 把长方形拆成几块，分别用长乘宽求面积，可以看见分配律。

edges.toName: 乘法与加法结合的问题
edges.fromGoal: Multiply two-digit and three-digit numbers by a one-digit number using formal written layout
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving multiplying and adding, including using the distributive law, integer scaling problems, and harder correspondence problems
edges.sourceReason: Problems require formal written multiplication skills
edges.chineseReason: 解决乘加问题时，可以用笔算乘法求出其中较大的乘积。

edges.toName: 乘法与加法结合的问题
edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving multiplication and division, including scaling problems and correspondence problems where n objects are connected to m objects
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving multiplying and adding, including using the distributive law, integer scaling problems, and harder correspondence problems
edges.sourceReason: Harder problems extend Y3 scaling/correspondence problems
edges.chineseReason: 多步乘除情境中的数量关系，可以帮助分析需要乘法和加法的问题。

edges.toName: 乘法与加法结合的问题
edges.fromGoal: Apply properties of operations (commutative, associative, distributive) as strategies to multiply and divide
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving multiplying and adding, including using the distributive law, integer scaling problems, and harder correspondence problems
edges.sourceReason: Distributive law is explicitly used in problem-solving
edges.chineseReason: 分配律等运算性质可以帮助选择乘加问题的计算方法。

edges.fromName: 分数的意义 · 整体中的等份
edges.toName: 分数的意义 · 整数与等值分数
edges.fromGoal: Understand a fraction 1/b as the quantity formed by 1 part when a whole is partitioned into b equal parts; understand a/b as a parts of size 1/b
edges.toGoal: Express whole numbers as fractions (e.g. 3 = 3/1) and recognise fractions equivalent to whole numbers (e.g. 4/4 = 1, 6/1 = 6)
edges.sourceReason: Must understand a/b notation before expressing whole numbers as fractions
edges.chineseReason: 认识分子和分母的含义，可以帮助理解整数也能写成分数。

edges.fromName: 用排列方阵表示乘法 · 用阵列表示乘除
edges.toName: 用排列方阵表示乘法 · 阵列中的相同加数
edges.fromGoal: Use arrays to represent multiplication and division situations
edges.toGoal: Use addition to find the total number of objects arranged in rectangular arrays with up to 5 rows and 5 columns; write an equation to express the total as a sum of equal addends
edges.sourceReason: Rectangular arrays with repeated addition extends array representation from Y2
edges.chineseReason: 矩形阵列中的每行数量相同，可以用相同加数相加表示总数。

edges.fromName: 乘法是相同加数的和 · 相同加数与成组
edges.toName: 用排列方阵表示乘法 · 阵列中的相同加数
edges.fromGoal: Understand multiplication as repeated addition and grouping equal sets
edges.toGoal: Use addition to find the total number of objects arranged in rectangular arrays with up to 5 rows and 5 columns; write an equation to express the total as a sum of equal addends
edges.sourceReason: Expressing array totals as sums of equal addends requires understanding multiplication as repeated addition
edges.chineseReason: 阵列中每组数量相同，可以用重复加法表示，再与乘法对应。

edges.fromName: 平方数与立方数 · 整数幂与实数根
edges.fromGoal: Use integer powers and associated real roots (square, cube, and higher); recognise powers of 2, 3, 4, and 5; distinguish between exact representations of roots and their decimal approximations
edges.toGoal: Appreciate the infinite nature of the sets of integers, real numbers, and rational numbers; position integers on a number line and distinguish between rational and irrational numbers
edges.sourceReason: Understanding irrational numbers like √2 requires knowledge of square roots
edges.chineseReason: 认识平方根后，可以进一步讨论像√2这样的数属于什么数集。

edges.fromName: 小数与分数 · 有限小数与分数互换
edges.fromGoal: Work interchangeably with terminating decimals and their corresponding fractions (such as 3.5 and 7/2 or 0.375 and 3/8); convert fluently between the two forms
edges.toGoal: Appreciate the infinite nature of the sets of integers, real numbers, and rational numbers; position integers on a number line and distinguish between rational and irrational numbers
edges.sourceReason: Understanding rational vs irrational requires fluency with fraction-decimal conversion
edges.chineseReason: 分数和小数之间的关系可以帮助理解有理数；不能仅凭小数位数无限就断定是无理数。

edges.fromName: 等值分数 · 同倍变化
edges.fromGoal: Explain why a fraction a/b is equivalent to (n×a)/(n×b) using visual models; use this principle to recognise and generate equivalent fractions, including tenths and hundredths
edges.toGoal: Use common factors to simplify fractions to their simplest form; use common multiples to express fractions with a common denominator
edges.sourceReason: Simplifying fractions extends Y5 equivalent fractions concept
edges.chineseReason: 约分是把一个分数换成表示同样大小、写法更简单的分数。

edges.fromName: 因数、倍数与质数 · 因数对与公倍数
edges.fromGoal: Find all factor pairs for a whole number in the range 1–100; identify common factors and common multiples of two numbers; use these concepts to solve problems
edges.toGoal: Use common factors to simplify fractions to their simplest form; use common multiples to express fractions with a common denominator
edges.sourceReason: Using common factors/multiples requires knowledge of common factors and multiples
edges.chineseReason: 寻找分子和分母的共同因数，可以帮助把分数约分。

edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and use fraction notation correctly — fraction, numerator, denominator, unit fraction, non-unit fraction, proper fraction, improper fraction, mixed number, equivalent fraction, simplest form — and understand what each term describes, including the roles of the numerator and denominator in expressing parts of a whole
edges.toGoal: Use common factors to simplify fractions to their simplest form; use common multiples to express fractions with a common denominator
edges.sourceReason: Simplifying fractions to simplest form requires 'simplest form' and 'common factor' vocabulary
edges.chineseReason: 理解“最简形式”和“公因数”的意思，有助于说清怎样约分。

edges.fromGoal: Describe simple mathematical relationships between two variables using scatter graphs, identify positive, negative, or no correlation, and use a line of best fit to make predictions
edges.toGoal: Plot bivariate data on a scatter graph with correctly labelled axes and appropriate scales; describe the correlation (positive, negative, none) and draw an estimated line of best fit where appropriate
edges.sourceReason: Plotting a scatter graph is the representational skill underpinning the conceptual understanding of correlation described in mt_8atyuvPUZc
edges.chineseReason: 散点图用点表示成对数据；观察点的分布可以帮助描述相关关系。

edges.fromName: 小数与分数 · 分数除法与小数百分数
edges.fromGoal: Associate a fraction with division and calculate decimal fraction equivalents for simple fractions (e.g. 3/8 = 0.375); recall and use equivalences between simple fractions, decimals, and percentages in different contexts
edges.toGoal: Interpret and construct pie charts: calculate sector angles from data, draw sectors accurately, and read values from pie charts to solve problems
edges.sourceReason: Understanding fraction-decimal-percentage equivalence deepens pie chart interpretation (e.g. 1/4 = 25% = 90°) but is not strictly required if the child can compute percentages procedurally
edges.chineseReason: 四分之一、25%和90°都可以表示圆的一份；分数、小数和百分数的等值关系有助于读扇形图。

edges.fromName: 测量角 · 量角与画角
edges.fromGoal: Measure angles in whole-number degrees using a protractor; draw given angles and sketch angles of specified measure
edges.toGoal: Interpret and construct pie charts: calculate sector angles from data, draw sectors accurately, and read values from pie charts to solve problems
edges.sourceReason: Drawing accurate pie chart sectors requires protractor skills
edges.chineseReason: 用量角器量出扇形的圆心角，可以更准确地绘制扇形统计图。

edges.fromGoal: Know that angles at a point sum to 360° (one whole turn), angles on a straight line sum to 180°, and vertically opposite angles are equal; use these facts to find missing angles
edges.toGoal: Interpret and construct pie charts: calculate sector angles from data, draw sectors accurately, and read values from pie charts to solve problems
edges.sourceReason: Constructing pie charts requires knowing angles at a point sum to 360°
edges.chineseReason: 一个圆周的角度是360°，扇形图中所有扇形的圆心角合起来也是360°。

edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving the calculation of percentages of amounts (e.g. 15% of 360) and the use of percentages for comparison
edges.toGoal: Interpret and construct pie charts: calculate sector angles from data, draw sectors accurately, and read values from pie charts to solve problems
edges.sourceReason: Calculating pie chart sector angles requires computing percentages of 360; interpreting sectors requires proportional reasoning
edges.chineseReason: 扇形占全部的百分比可以对应360°的一部分，用来求扇形的角度。

edges.fromName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 收集和图表词语
edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and use the vocabulary of data collection and display — data, tally, tally chart, frequency, frequency table, survey, pictogram, bar chart, axis/axes, scale, label, category, discrete data, continuous data, line graph, pie chart — and apply these terms when collecting, organising, and presenting data
edges.toGoal: Interpret and construct pie charts: calculate sector angles from data, draw sectors accurately, and read values from pie charts to solve problems
edges.sourceReason: Constructing pie charts and line graphs requires the display vocabulary
edges.chineseReason: 理解类别、刻度和标签等图表词语，有助于绘制和阅读扇形图。

edges.fromName: 平面图形 · 认识常见平面图形
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and name common 2-D shapes (circles, triangles, rectangles including squares)
edges.toGoal: Distinguish defining attributes of shapes (e.g. triangles are closed and three-sided) from non-defining attributes (e.g. colour, orientation, overall size)
edges.sourceReason: Distinguishing defining vs non-defining attributes requires knowing common 2-D shape names first
edges.chineseReason: 认识常见图形后，可以比较哪些特征决定图形类别，哪些特征可以改变。

edges.fromName: 立体图形 · 比较平面与立体
edges.fromGoal: Analyse and compare 2-D and 3-D shapes using informal language to describe sides, vertices, and other attributes
edges.toGoal: Distinguish defining attributes of shapes (e.g. triangles are closed and three-sided) from non-defining attributes (e.g. colour, orientation, overall size)
edges.sourceReason: Identifying defining attributes builds on informal analysis and comparison of shapes
edges.chineseReason: 比较平面和立体图形的特征，可以帮助区分决定类别的特征。

edges.fromGoal: Choose and use appropriate standard units to measure length (m/cm), mass (kg/g), temperature (°C), and capacity (litres/ml) to the nearest appropriate unit
edges.toGoal: Compare and order lengths, mass, and capacity and record results using >, <, and =
edges.sourceReason: Comparing and ordering measurements with symbols requires being able to measure in standard units
edges.chineseReason: 选用相同单位测量后，可以比较并排列测量结果。

edges.fromGoal: Compare and order two-digit numbers using the symbols >, =, and <, based on place value understanding
edges.toGoal: Compare and order lengths, mass, and capacity and record results using >, <, and =
edges.sourceReason: Using >, <, = for measurements parallels using them for numbers
edges.chineseReason: 大于、小于和等于符号既可以比较数，也可以在单位一致时比较测量结果。

edges.fromGoal: Use subitising to recognise and name the parts of a collection up to 10 and combine them — e.g. seeing 7 on a ten frame as 5 and 2, or a domino as 3 and 3 — connecting part-part-whole thinking to quick recognition
edges.toGoal: Partition one-digit numbers and add and subtract within 20 using virtual materials (on-screen ten frames, counters and number lines) as well as physical materials, applying part-part-whole knowledge to 10 and make-ten strategies
edges.sourceReason: Naming parts within 10 supports partitioning on a ten frame
edges.chineseReason: 理解10以内一个数可以拆成两部分，可以帮助在十格板上表示它。

edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract within 20 using strategies such as making ten, decomposing a number leading to ten, and using known facts
edges.toGoal: Partition one-digit numbers and add and subtract within 20 using virtual materials (on-screen ten frames, counters and number lines) as well as physical materials, applying part-part-whole knowledge to 10 and make-ten strategies
edges.sourceReason: On-screen addition and subtraction within 20 uses the same make-ten strategies
edges.chineseReason: 屏幕上的20以内加减也可以使用凑十等熟悉的办法。

edges.fromName: 用数字工具表示数量故事
edges.fromGoal: Represent practical addition, subtraction and quantity situations within 10 with virtual materials (on-screen counters and ten frames) as well as physical counters, using counting or subitising to find the result
edges.toGoal: Partition one-digit numbers and add and subtract within 20 using virtual materials (on-screen ten frames, counters and number lines) as well as physical materials, applying part-part-whole knowledge to 10 and make-ten strategies
edges.sourceReason: Builds on using on-screen counters and ten frames in Foundation
edges.chineseReason: 在屏幕上用计数物或十格板表示数量故事，可以继续用它们探索加减。

edges.fromGoal: Sequence events in chronological order using language such as before, after, next, first, today, yesterday, tomorrow, morning, afternoon, evening
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use language relating to dates, including days of the week, weeks, months, and years
edges.sourceReason: Understanding days/months/years builds on sequencing events chronologically
edges.chineseReason: 先按先后顺序排列事件，再用日、周、月和年描述较长的时间顺序。

edges.fromName: 把10以内的数分成两部分
edges.fromGoal: Decompose numbers up to 10 into pairs in more than one way (part-part-whole)
edges.toGoal: Use subitising to recognise and name the parts of a collection up to 10 and combine them — e.g. seeing 7 on a ten frame as 5 and 2, or a domino as 3 and 3 — connecting part-part-whole thinking to quick recognition
edges.sourceReason: Partitioning numbers to 10 into pairs supports naming the parts
edges.chineseReason: 把10以内的数分成两部分，可以分别说出这两部分的数量。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise and name the number of objects in a collection of up to 5 instantly, without counting one by one (subitising), using dot patterns, dice faces, fingers and small groups of objects
edges.toGoal: Use subitising to recognise and name the parts of a collection up to 10 and combine them — e.g. seeing 7 on a ten frame as 5 and 2, or a domino as 3 and 3 — connecting part-part-whole thinking to quick recognition
edges.sourceReason: Recognising the parts of a collection quickly requires subitising small groups
edges.chineseReason: 看出小组的数量，可以帮助观察一组物品由哪几部分组成。

edges.fromGoal: Conduct simple probability experiments — flipping a coin, rolling a die, pulling coloured counters from a bag — record results, and compare experimental outcomes with expected theoretical outcomes
edges.toGoal: Run repeated probability experiments and compare experimental (relative frequency) results with theoretical predictions; understand and demonstrate that as the number of trials increases, the experimental probability tends towards the theoretical probability — and that short runs can give very different results
edges.sourceReason: Comparing experimental and theoretical probability requires prior experience conducting simple experiments and recording results
edges.chineseReason: 记录随机实验的结果后，可以把实际频率和理论概率作比较。

edges.fromGoal: Calculate the probability of a simple event with equally likely outcomes using the formula: probability = number of favourable outcomes ÷ total number of possible outcomes; express the result as a fraction in its simplest form; apply to rolling dice, drawing from bags, and other simple chance situations
edges.toGoal: Run repeated probability experiments and compare experimental (relative frequency) results with theoretical predictions; understand and demonstrate that as the number of trials increases, the experimental probability tends towards the theoretical probability — and that short runs can give very different results
edges.sourceReason: Comparing experimental results with theoretical predictions requires being able to calculate the theoretical probability first
edges.chineseReason: 先算出理论概率，再与实验结果比较，观察它们是否相近。

edges.fromName: 测量质量与重量 · 直接比较轻重
edges.fromGoal: Compare two objects directly by mass or weight and describe the difference using language such as heavy, light, heavier than, lighter than
edges.toGoal: Compare and order the mass and capacity of objects indirectly, using a balance or a third object or container as a go-between, and explain the reasoning
edges.sourceReason: Indirect comparison of mass builds on direct comparison with a balance
edges.chineseReason: 直接比较轻重后，可以借助第三个物品或相同单位间接比较质量。

edges.fromGoal: Compare and describe capacity and volume using language such as full, empty, more than, less than, half full
edges.toGoal: Compare and order the mass and capacity of objects indirectly, using a balance or a third object or container as a go-between, and explain the reasoning
edges.sourceReason: Indirect comparison of capacity builds on direct comparison of capacity
edges.chineseReason: 比较两个容器的容量时，可以借助同一个容器进行间接比较。

edges.fromName: 平方数与立方数 · 整数幂与实数根
edges.fromGoal: Use integer powers and associated real roots (square, cube, and higher); recognise powers of 2, 3, 4, and 5; distinguish between exact representations of roots and their decimal approximations
edges.toGoal: Interpret and compare numbers in standard form A × 10ⁿ where 1 ≤ A < 10 and n is an integer; convert between ordinary numbers and standard form
edges.sourceReason: Standard form uses powers of 10 which requires understanding integer powers
edges.chineseReason: 标准形式用10的整数次幂表示数量级，需要理解幂的写法。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that 10 can be thought of as a bundle of ten ones — called a 'ten'
edges.toGoal: Partition and rename two-digit numbers in standard and non-standard ways (e.g. 34 = 3 tens 4 ones = 2 tens 14 ones) using physical and virtual base-ten materials, recognising that the total stays the same
edges.sourceReason: Trading a ten for ten ones requires knowing a ten is ten ones
edges.chineseReason: 一个十等于十个一，所以可以在不改变总量的情况下相互交换。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones
edges.toGoal: Partition and rename two-digit numbers in standard and non-standard ways (e.g. 34 = 3 tens 4 ones = 2 tens 14 ones) using physical and virtual base-ten materials, recognising that the total stays the same
edges.sourceReason: Non-standard partitions extend the standard tens-and-ones partition
edges.chineseReason: 理解几个十和几个一后，可以尝试用不同数量的十和一表示同一个数。

edges.fromName: 因数、倍数与质数 · 因数对与公倍数
edges.toName: 寻找因数的步骤与工具
edges.fromGoal: Find all factor pairs for a whole number in the range 1–100; identify common factors and common multiples of two numbers; use these concepts to solve problems
edges.toGoal: Create and use algorithms with steps and decisions, and digital tools such as spreadsheets, to experiment with factors, multiples and divisibility, and describe the patterns that emerge
edges.sourceReason: Experimenting with factors requires knowing factors and multiples
edges.chineseReason: 知道因数和倍数的含义，有助于检查一个寻找因数的步骤是否有效。

edges.toName: 寻找因数的步骤与工具
edges.fromGoal: Follow and create algorithms with steps and decisions that use addition or multiplication to generate sets of numbers (e.g. repeated doubling or adding a constant until a limit), and identify and describe the patterns produced
edges.toGoal: Create and use algorithms with steps and decisions, and digital tools such as spreadsheets, to experiment with factors, multiples and divisibility, and describe the patterns that emerge
edges.sourceReason: Creating factor algorithms builds on creating number-generating algorithms
edges.chineseReason: 按规则生成一组数的经验，可以帮助编写并检查寻找因数的步骤。

edges.fromName: 按特征分类 · 分类、计数与排序
edges.toName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 简单图表与计数
edges.fromGoal: Classify objects into given categories, count the number in each category, and sort the categories by count
edges.toGoal: Interpret and construct simple pictograms, tally charts, block diagrams, and simple tables
edges.sourceReason: Constructing pictograms and tally charts requires classifying and counting objects first
edges.chineseReason: 先把物品分类并数清数量，再用象形图或计数表记录各类结果。

edges.fromGoal: Conduct simple probability experiments — flipping a coin, rolling a die, pulling coloured counters from a bag — record results, and compare experimental outcomes with expected theoretical outcomes
edges.toGoal: Describe the probability of simple equally-likely outcomes using unit fractions: the probability of rolling a 6 on a fair die is 1/6, flipping heads is 1/2, picking one specific colour from three equally represented colours is 1/3; place these fractional probabilities on a 0-to-1 probability scale
edges.sourceReason: Practical experiment experience provides the intuitive grounding that makes fractional probability representation meaningful
edges.chineseReason: 通过随机实验记录结果，可以为用分数表示概率提供具体情境。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise, find, and write fractions of a discrete set of objects: unit fractions and non-unit fractions with small denominators
edges.toGoal: Describe the probability of simple equally-likely outcomes using unit fractions: the probability of rolling a 6 on a fair die is 1/6, flipping heads is 1/2, picking one specific colour from three equally represented colours is 1/3; place these fractional probabilities on a 0-to-1 probability scale
edges.sourceReason: Expressing probabilities as unit fractions (1/6, 1/2, 1/3) requires prior knowledge of unit fractions from the Fractions domain
edges.chineseReason: 像二分之一或六分之一这样的单位分数，可以用来表示相应概率。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that 'equally likely' means every outcome has exactly the same chance of occurring; identify whether a given situation has equally likely outcomes (a fair coin, a fair die, a spinner with equal sections) or unequally likely outcomes (a bag with more of one colour, a spinner with unequal sections)
edges.toGoal: Describe the probability of simple equally-likely outcomes using unit fractions: the probability of rolling a 6 on a fair die is 1/6, flipping heads is 1/2, picking one specific colour from three equally represented colours is 1/3; place these fractional probabilities on a 0-to-1 probability scale
edges.sourceReason: Using fractions to represent probability only makes sense for equally-likely outcomes, so the equally-likely concept must come first
edges.chineseReason: 各结果等可能时，可用有利结果数与总结果数之比表示概率；不等可能时不能直接这样数。

edges.fromName: 用排列方阵表示乘法 · 用阵列表示乘除
edges.fromGoal: Use arrays to represent multiplication and division situations
edges.toGoal: Understand and apply the commutative property of multiplication and recognise that division is not commutative
edges.sourceReason: Arrays help demonstrate commutativity (rotate the array)
edges.chineseReason: 把矩形阵列旋转后，行列交换，总物品数不变，可以观察乘法交换律。

edges.fromName: 乘法是相同加数的和 · 相同加数与成组
edges.fromGoal: Understand multiplication as repeated addition and grouping equal sets
edges.toGoal: Understand and apply the commutative property of multiplication and recognise that division is not commutative
edges.sourceReason: Commutativity of multiplication requires understanding multiplication
edges.chineseReason: 乘法表示若干相同的组，比较交换两个因数后的结果可以探索交换律。

edges.fromGoal: Round any whole number up to 1,000,000 to the nearest 10, 100, 1,000, 10,000, or 100,000 using place-value understanding
edges.toGoal: Round decimals to any place using place-value understanding; round any whole number to a required degree of accuracy
edges.sourceReason: Rounding to any place extends Y5 rounding
edges.chineseReason: 取近似数时，先确定要保留的数位；这个办法也适用于小数位。

edges.fromName: 数的读写 · 小数的读写比较
edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and compare decimals to thousandths using base-ten numerals, number names, and expanded form; compare using >, =, < based on place-value meaning
edges.toGoal: Round decimals to any place using place-value understanding; round any whole number to a required degree of accuracy
edges.sourceReason: Rounding decimals requires reading/writing decimals to thousandths
edges.chineseReason: 能读出小数的各个数位，有助于明确要把哪一位取近似值。

edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract fractions with the same denominator within one whole (e.g. 5/7 + 1/7 = 6/7)
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract fractions with the same denominator, including results greater than one whole (e.g. 5/8 + 6/8 = 11/8)
edges.sourceReason: Add/sub within one whole is prerequisite to extending beyond one whole
edges.chineseReason: 理解同样大小的小份怎样相加减，也可以用来表示超过一个整体的结果。

edges.fromGoal: Add within 100 using strategies based on place value, including adding a two-digit and one-digit number, and a two-digit and a multiple of 10
edges.toGoal: Fluently add and subtract within 100 using strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction
edges.sourceReason: Fluency within 100 builds on strategy-based adding within 100
edges.chineseReason: 用多种方法计算100以内加法，有助于逐步熟悉这些加减关系。

edges.fromGoal: Fluently add and subtract within 20 using mental strategies; know from memory all sums of two one-digit numbers
edges.toGoal: Fluently add and subtract within 100 using strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction
edges.sourceReason: Fluency within 100 requires fluent single-digit facts
edges.chineseReason: 已知的小数目加减事实，可以帮助计算100以内的加减。

edges.fromName: 加法与减法 · 四位数竖式
edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract numbers with up to four digits using formal written methods of columnar addition and subtraction
edges.toGoal: Solve addition and subtraction two-step problems in contexts, deciding which operations and methods to use and why
edges.sourceReason: Solving four-digit problems requires columnar methods
edges.chineseReason: 解决四位数的加减问题时，可以选择竖式等方法计算。

edges.fromGoal: Solve addition and subtraction problems including missing-number problems, using number facts, place value, and more complex methods
edges.toGoal: Solve addition and subtraction two-step problems in contexts, deciding which operations and methods to use and why
edges.sourceReason: Two-step A+S context problems extend Y3 problem-solving
edges.chineseReason: 先找出每一步的未知数量，再处理需要两步加减的情境。

edges.fromName: 角的分类 · 读懂几何图形的标记
edges.fromGoal: Use and interpret standard geometric diagram conventions: mark right angles with a small square, equal lengths with single or double tick marks, and equal angles with arc marks; label angles in three-letter notation (∠ABC) and individual angles with a single letter or number; draw diagrams showing angles at a point, angles on a straight line, and angles inside polygons with these conventions; read diagrams with these marks to identify given information and find unknown values
edges.toGoal: Find unknown angles in triangles, quadrilaterals, and regular polygons using angle sum properties
edges.sourceReason: Finding unknown angles in polygons requires reading diagrams where known angles are marked with arcs and tick marks
edges.chineseReason: 看懂角弧、相等标记等图形信息，有助于判断已知角与未知角的关系。

edges.fromGoal: Compare and classify geometric shapes based on their properties and sizes; understand that attributes belonging to a category also belong to all subcategories; classify two-dimensional figures in a hierarchy based on properties
edges.toGoal: Find unknown angles in triangles, quadrilaterals, and regular polygons using angle sum properties
edges.sourceReason: Finding angles in polygons requires knowing shape properties
edges.chineseReason: 三角形和多边形的特征有助于判断图中角之间的关系。

edges.fromGoal: Know that angles at a point sum to 360° (one whole turn), angles on a straight line sum to 180°, and vertically opposite angles are equal; use these facts to find missing angles
edges.toGoal: Find unknown angles in triangles, quadrilaterals, and regular polygons using angle sum properties
edges.sourceReason: Finding unknown angles builds on Y5 angle sum facts (180°, 360°)
edges.chineseReason: 利用平角180°或周角360°等关系，可以寻找图中的未知角。

edges.fromName: 寻找二分之一与四分之一
edges.fromGoal: Recognise, find, and name a quarter as one of four equal parts of an object, shape, or quantity
edges.toGoal: Recognise, find, name, and write fractions 1/3, 1/4, 2/4, and 3/4 of a length, shape, set of objects, or quantity
edges.sourceReason: Working with 1/4, 2/4, 3/4 extends from Y1 understanding of quarters
edges.chineseReason: 把整体分成四等份后，可以理解一份、两份或三份占多少。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise, find, and name a half as one of two equal parts of an object, shape, or quantity
edges.toGoal: Recognise, find, name, and write fractions 1/3, 1/4, 2/4, and 3/4 of a length, shape, set of objects, or quantity
edges.sourceReason: Working with fractions extends from Y1 understanding of halves
edges.chineseReason: 二分之一是把整体等分后的一份，可以由此继续观察数量的其他几分之一。

edges.fromGoal: Understand division as sharing equally into groups or as grouping (how many groups of a given size can be made)
edges.toGoal: Recognise, find, name, and write fractions 1/3, 1/4, 2/4, and 3/4 of a length, shape, set of objects, or quantity
edges.sourceReason: Finding fractions of quantities uses equal sharing (division)
edges.chineseReason: 把一组物品平均分成相同份数，可以找到其中的几分之一。

edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and use fraction notation correctly — fraction, numerator, denominator, unit fraction, non-unit fraction, proper fraction, improper fraction, mixed number, equivalent fraction, simplest form — and understand what each term describes, including the roles of the numerator and denominator in expressing parts of a whole
edges.toGoal: Recognise, find, name, and write fractions 1/3, 1/4, 2/4, and 3/4 of a length, shape, set of objects, or quantity
edges.sourceReason: Writing fractions like 1/3 and 3/4 requires knowing numerator and denominator
edges.chineseReason: 知道分子和分母分别表示什么，有助于读写三分之一和四分之三等分数。

edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and use the vocabulary of statistical analysis — mean, median, mode, range, frequency, data, sample, average, chart, table, graph, pie chart, scatter graph, correlation — with understanding of what each term describes
edges.toGoal: Calculate and interpret the mean as an average of a data set
edges.sourceReason: Calculating the mean requires 'mean' and 'average' vocabulary
edges.chineseReason: 理解平均数表示什么，有助于解释计算结果的含义。

edges.fromName: 加减法的策略 · 小数的数位与运算
edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract decimals to hundredths using strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction; relate strategies to written methods and explain reasoning
edges.toGoal: Calculate and interpret the mean as an average of a data set
edges.sourceReason: Calculating mean requires decimal addition
edges.chineseReason: 求平均数时要合计数据；数据有小数时可能需要小数加法。

edges.fromGoal: Use written division methods in cases where the answer has up to two decimal places; divide decimals to hundredths by whole numbers
edges.toGoal: Calculate and interpret the mean as an average of a data set
edges.sourceReason: Calculating mean requires division giving decimal answers
edges.chineseReason: 求平均数要把总量除以数据个数，商有时是小数。

edges.fromGoal: Draw a scaled picture graph and a scaled bar graph to represent a data set; solve one- and two-step comparison, sum, and difference problems using bar charts, pictograms, and tables
edges.toGoal: Interpret and present discrete and continuous data using appropriate graphical methods, including bar charts and time graphs
edges.sourceReason: Scaled bar charts are prerequisite to continuous data and time graphs
edges.chineseReason: 看懂图表的刻度后，可以继续阅读表示时间或连续数量的图表。

edges.fromName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 收集和图表词语
edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and use the vocabulary of data collection and display — data, tally, tally chart, frequency, frequency table, survey, pictogram, bar chart, axis/axes, scale, label, category, discrete data, continuous data, line graph, pie chart — and apply these terms when collecting, organising, and presenting data
edges.toGoal: Interpret and present discrete and continuous data using appropriate graphical methods, including bar charts and time graphs
edges.sourceReason: Distinguishing discrete from continuous data and choosing graphical methods requires these terms
edges.chineseReason: 理解离散、连续、类别和刻度等词语，有助于选择并读懂统计图。

edges.fromGoal: Read and write numerals from 0 to 20
edges.toGoal: Recognise and know the value of different coins and notes
edges.sourceReason: Recognising coin values requires reading numerals (1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50)
edges.chineseReason: 认出硬币上表示数值的数字，能帮助读出它的面值。

edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving converting between units of time (hours↔minutes, minutes↔seconds, years↔months, weeks↔days)
edges.toGoal: Complete, read, and interpret information in tables, including timetables
edges.sourceReason: Time conversion supports interpreting timetables
edges.chineseReason: 读懂以分钟记录的时刻，有助于理解时间表。

edges.fromGoal: Draw a scaled picture graph and a scaled bar graph to represent a data set; solve one- and two-step comparison, sum, and difference problems using bar charts, pictograms, and tables
edges.toGoal: Complete, read, and interpret information in tables, including timetables
edges.sourceReason: Reading scaled charts/tables is prerequisite to interpreting timetables
edges.chineseReason: 读懂表格的行列与标记，可以帮助查找时间表中的信息。

edges.toName: 测量长度 · 用相同单位首尾相接
edges.fromGoal: Measure and begin to record lengths and heights using non-standard and standard units
edges.toGoal: Measure the length of an object using same-size length units laid end to end with no gaps or overlaps
edges.sourceReason: Measuring with iterated units extends Y1 beginning to measure length
edges.chineseReason: 测量长度时，可以用相同长度的单位首尾相接，数出需要多少个。

edges.fromName: 测量长度 · 比较与排列长度
edges.toName: 测量长度 · 用相同单位首尾相接
edges.fromGoal: Order three objects by length and compare the lengths of two objects indirectly using a third object
edges.toGoal: Measure the length of an object using same-size length units laid end to end with no gaps or overlaps
edges.sourceReason: Measuring with units benefits from ability to order and compare lengths
edges.chineseReason: 比较和排列物品长度后，可以用相同单位进一步测量。

edges.fromGoal: Use a scale, given as a ratio (e.g. 1:50), as a statement such as '1 cm represents 2 m', or as a scale factor, to work out actual lengths from a scale drawing or map and drawing lengths from actual lengths; reproduce a scale drawing at a different scale by finding each new drawing length, either through the actual length or from the ratio of the two scales; and solve map, room-plan and design problems with consistent units, converting between mm, cm, m and km before or after scaling. Areas from scale drawings and the area factor are developed in the follow-on topic Area from scale drawings
edges.toGoal: Find actual areas from a scale drawing or map, either by converting each drawing length to an actual length before multiplying or by using the area factor; explain why, when every length is multiplied by a scale factor k, areas are multiplied by k² (both dimensions are scaled), and avoid the mistake of applying the length factor to an area; convert between square units consistently (e.g. 1 m² = 10,000 cm²); and apply this to map, room-plan and design problems such as flooring, turf, paint or land area
edges.sourceReason: Finding actual areas starts from converting drawing lengths to actual lengths with the scale
edges.chineseReason: 先根据比例尺把图上长宽换算成实际长宽，再求实际面积。

edges.fromGoal: Apply the area formula (l × w) and perimeter formula (2l + 2w) for rectangles including squares in real-world and mathematical problems; calculate and compare areas using standard units (cm², m²) and estimate areas of irregular shapes
edges.toGoal: Find actual areas from a scale drawing or map, either by converting each drawing length to an actual length before multiplying or by using the area factor; explain why, when every length is multiplied by a scale factor k, areas are multiplied by k² (both dimensions are scaled), and avoid the mistake of applying the length factor to an area; convert between square units consistently (e.g. 1 m² = 10,000 cm²); and apply this to map, room-plan and design problems such as flooring, turf, paint or land area
edges.sourceReason: Actual and drawn areas of rooms and plots are found as length × width
edges.chineseReason: 求长方形房间或地块的面积时，可以用长乘宽，并留意实际长度与图上长度。

edges.fromGoal: Find the area of polygons such as trapezoids, kites, rhombuses, irregular quadrilaterals and other rectilinear or non-rectilinear polygons by decomposition or composition: decompose the shape into rectangles and triangles and add the parts, or compose it into an enclosing rectangle and subtract the pieces outside; record the dimensions used for each piece, check that the pieces neither overlap nor leave gaps, and apply this to real-world problems such as floor plans, gardens and signs, giving answers in square units. The focus is the decomposition and composition strategy, which works for any polygon whether or not a dedicated formula is known
edges.toGoal: Find actual areas from a scale drawing or map, either by converting each drawing length to an actual length before multiplying or by using the area factor; explain why, when every length is multiplied by a scale factor k, areas are multiplied by k² (both dimensions are scaled), and avoid the mistake of applying the length factor to an area; convert between square units consistently (e.g. 1 m² = 10,000 cm²); and apply this to map, room-plan and design problems such as flooring, turf, paint or land area
edges.sourceReason: Real plans often have L-shaped or other composite regions whose areas are found by splitting
edges.chineseReason: 把不规则平面分成容易计算的部分，可以求出组合区域的面积。

edges.fromGoal: Convert freely between related standard units of measurement (time, length, area, volume/capacity, mass) using decimal notation to up to three decimal places where appropriate
edges.toGoal: Find actual areas from a scale drawing or map, either by converting each drawing length to an actual length before multiplying or by using the area factor; explain why, when every length is multiplied by a scale factor k, areas are multiplied by k² (both dimensions are scaled), and avoid the mistake of applying the length factor to an area; convert between square units consistently (e.g. 1 m² = 10,000 cm²); and apply this to map, room-plan and design problems such as flooring, turf, paint or land area
edges.sourceReason: Answers require converting between square units such as cm² and m² (1 m² = 10,000 cm²)
edges.chineseReason: 换算面积单位时要考虑两个方向的长度；1平方米等于10000平方厘米。

edges.fromName: 数轴上的分数 · 数轴、情境与算式
edges.toName: 数轴上的分数 · 连接小数与百分数
edges.fromGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, number lines, and symbolic equations involving multiplication, fractions, and decimals, explaining what each representation shows
edges.toGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, number lines, bar models, and symbolic equations involving multi-digit multiplication, fractions, decimals, and percentages, explaining connections between representations
edges.sourceReason: Age 8-9 quantitative reasoning is prerequisite to age 9-10 level
edges.chineseReason: 在情境、数轴和算式间转换的经验，可以继续用于小数和百分数。

edges.fromName: 乘法竖式 · 竖式与面积模型
edges.toName: 数轴上的分数 · 连接小数与百分数
edges.fromGoal: Multiply a whole number of up to four digits by a one-digit number, and multiply two two-digit numbers, using formal written methods including long multiplication; illustrate with area models
edges.toGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, number lines, bar models, and symbolic equations involving multi-digit multiplication, fractions, decimals, and percentages, explaining connections between representations
edges.sourceReason: Long multiplication with area models connects situations to visual and symbolic representations
edges.chineseReason: 用面积模型表示乘法，可以练习把情境、图形和算式联系起来。

edges.toName: 数轴上的分数 · 连接小数与百分数
edges.fromGoal: Understand the per cent symbol (%); know that per cent means ‘number of parts per hundred’; write percentages as a fraction with denominator 100 and as a decimal
edges.toGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, number lines, bar models, and symbolic equations involving multi-digit multiplication, fractions, decimals, and percentages, explaining connections between representations
edges.sourceReason: Percentage/fraction/decimal equivalence exercises fluency between representations
edges.chineseReason: 把一个量写成分数、小数和百分数，可以比较不同表示是否等值。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise volume as an attribute of solid figures; understand that a unit cube (side length 1 unit) has 'one cubic unit' of volume and can be used to measure volume; a solid packed with n unit cubes has volume n cubic units
edges.toGoal: Measure and estimate the volume of solids by counting unit cubes: build cuboids from 1 cm³ cubes and count them, count the cubes in models and drawings (including hidden cubes), estimate how many cubes will fill a box and check by filling it, and record volumes in cubic units (cm³, in³, ft³ or improvised units)
edges.sourceReason: Measuring by counting cubes requires understanding unit cube concept
edges.chineseReason: 一个单位立方体表示一个体积单位，数清这些小立方体可以求体积。

edges.toName: 测量单位换算 · 长度与时间单位
edges.fromGoal: Measure, compare, add, and subtract lengths (m/cm/mm), mass (kg/g), and volume/capacity (l/ml) using standard units
edges.toGoal: Convert between different units of measure (e.g. kilometre to metre, hour to minute, minute to second, year to month, week to day)
edges.sourceReason: Measuring in standard units is prerequisite to converting between units
edges.chineseReason: 知道测量所用的单位，有助于把同一测量结果换成另一种单位。

edges.toName: 测量单位换算 · 长度与时间单位
edges.fromGoal: Know the number of seconds in a minute and the number of days in each month, year, and leap year
edges.toGoal: Convert between different units of measure (e.g. kilometre to metre, hour to minute, minute to second, year to month, week to day)
edges.sourceReason: Knowing seconds/minute, days/month etc. is prerequisite to unit conversion problems
edges.chineseReason: 了解秒、分钟、日和月等单位的关系，有助于进行时间单位换算。

edges.fromGoal: Read and write numerals from 0 to 20
edges.toGoal: Name, represent and order numbers from 0 to at least 20 using physical and virtual materials (number cards, on-screen ten frames and number tracks) and numerals
edges.sourceReason: Ordering numbers to 20 needs reading and writing the numerals to 20
edges.chineseReason: 认识并读写20以内的数字，有助于把这些数字按大小排列。

edges.fromGoal: Each successive counting number represents a quantity that is one larger than the previous number
edges.toGoal: Name, represent and order numbers from 0 to at least 20 using physical and virtual materials (number cards, on-screen ten frames and number tracks) and numerals
edges.sourceReason: Knowing each number is one more than the last supports ordering
edges.chineseReason: 每个自然数比前一个多1，这个关系有助于排列数字。

edges.fromGoal: Compare two written numerals between 1 and 10 to determine which is greater or less
edges.toGoal: Name, represent and order numbers from 0 to at least 20 using physical and virtual materials (number cards, on-screen ten frames and number tracks) and numerals
edges.sourceReason: Ordering a set builds on comparing two numerals
edges.chineseReason: 先比较两个数的大小，再把多个数按顺序排列。

edges.toName: 加减法应用题 · 长度情境
edges.fromGoal: Fluently add and subtract within 100 using strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction
edges.toGoal: Solve word problems involving lengths within 100, using addition and subtraction with drawings and equations
edges.sourceReason: Word problems within 100 require fluent addition/subtraction within 100
edges.chineseReason: 计算长度情境中的数量变化，可以用到100以内的加减。

edges.toName: 加减法应用题 · 长度情境
edges.fromGoal: Measure to determine how much longer one object is than another, expressing the length difference in terms of a standard length unit
edges.toGoal: Solve word problems involving lengths within 100, using addition and subtraction with drawings and equations
edges.sourceReason: Length word problems build on comparing measured lengths
edges.chineseReason: 比较测得的长度，有助于理解长度情境中的多与少。

edges.toName: 独立与相互影响的事件
edges.fromGoal: Conduct simple probability experiments — flipping a coin, rolling a die, pulling coloured counters from a bag — record results, and compare experimental outcomes with expected theoretical outcomes
edges.toGoal: Identify whether events in chance experiments and everyday situations are independent (one does not affect the other) or dependent (the first outcome changes the chances of the next)
edges.sourceReason: Chance experiments provide the contexts for independent and dependent events
edges.chineseReason: 从随机实验的具体情境出发，可以观察一次结果是否改变另一次结果的概率。

edges.toName: 独立与相互影响的事件
edges.fromGoal: Compare the likelihood of different events and order them from least to most likely — including situations with unequal outcomes such as a bag with more of one colour than another, or a spinner with sections of different sizes — and explain reasoning using informal language
edges.toGoal: Identify whether events in chance experiments and everyday situations are independent (one does not affect the other) or dependent (the first outcome changes the chances of the next)
edges.sourceReason: Judging dependence requires comparing likelihoods of outcomes
edges.chineseReason: 比较条件变化前后事件的概率，可以帮助判断两个事件是否相互影响。

edges.fromGoal: One-to-one correspondence when counting objects: each object is paired with exactly one number name
edges.toGoal: Cardinality principle: the last number said when counting a set tells how many objects are in the set, regardless of arrangement or order counted
edges.sourceReason: Cardinality principle builds on one-to-one correspondence — you must count correctly to know the last number tells 'how many'
edges.chineseReason: 每个物品恰好数一次时，最后说出的数表示这组物品的总数。

edges.toName: 三角形与四边形的特征
edges.fromGoal: Compare and classify geometric shapes based on their properties and sizes; understand that attributes belonging to a category also belong to all subcategories; classify two-dimensional figures in a hierarchy based on properties
edges.toGoal: Derive and illustrate properties of triangles, quadrilaterals, and circles using appropriate language, including interior angles, diagonals, symmetry, and relationships between side lengths
edges.sourceReason: Extends KS2 shape classification into formal property derivation
edges.chineseReason: 根据边、角等特征给图形分类，可以进一步推断三角形和四边形的性质。

edges.toName: 三角形与四边形的特征
edges.fromGoal: Use conventional geometric terms and notation to describe, sketch, and draw points, lines, parallel and perpendicular lines, right angles, regular polygons, and reflectively/rotationally symmetric polygons
edges.toGoal: Derive and illustrate properties of triangles, quadrilaterals, and circles using appropriate language, including interior angles, diagonals, symmetry, and relationships between side lengths
edges.sourceReason: Deriving shape properties requires fluent geometric vocabulary
edges.chineseReason: 使用准确的边、角和顶点词语，有助于说清图形性质及推理。

edges.fromGoal: Measure and begin to record capacity and volume using non-standard and standard units
edges.toGoal: Choose and use appropriate standard units to measure length (m/cm), mass (kg/g), temperature (°C), and capacity (litres/ml) to the nearest appropriate unit
edges.sourceReason: Using standard units for capacity extends from beginning to measure capacity
edges.chineseReason: 理解容器能装多少后，可以选择合适单位测量容积。

edges.fromGoal: Measure and begin to record lengths and heights using non-standard and standard units
edges.toGoal: Choose and use appropriate standard units to measure length (m/cm), mass (kg/g), temperature (°C), and capacity (litres/ml) to the nearest appropriate unit
edges.sourceReason: Using standard units for length extends from beginning to measure length
edges.chineseReason: 测量长度和高度时，需要选择合适的标准单位。

edges.fromName: 测量质量与重量 · 用单位测量质量
edges.fromGoal: Measure and begin to record mass/weight using non-standard and standard units
edges.toGoal: Choose and use appropriate standard units to measure length (m/cm), mass (kg/g), temperature (°C), and capacity (litres/ml) to the nearest appropriate unit
edges.sourceReason: Using standard units for mass extends from beginning to measure mass
edges.chineseReason: 测量质量时，可以根据物品选择克或千克等单位。

edges.fromName: 认识十分之一 · 分成十份
edges.toName: 认识十分之一 · 从十分之一到百分之一
edges.fromGoal: Count up and down in tenths; recognise that tenths arise from dividing an object into 10 equal parts and from dividing one-digit numbers or quantities by 10
edges.toGoal: Count up and down in hundredths; recognise that hundredths arise when dividing an object by 100 or dividing tenths by 10
edges.sourceReason: Count in tenths is prerequisite to extending to hundredths
edges.chineseReason: 把十分之一再等分成十份，可以得到百分之一。

edges.toName: 分数与小数的等值关系
edges.fromGoal: Understand two fractions as equivalent if they are the same size or the same point on a number line; recognise and show families of common equivalent fractions using diagrams
edges.toGoal: Recognise and write decimal equivalents of 1/4, 1/2, and 3/4
edges.sourceReason: Equivalent fractions understanding supports recognising decimal equivalents of common fractions
edges.chineseReason: 理解不同写法可能表示同一个量，有助于比较常见分数和小数。

edges.toName: 分数与小数的等值关系
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and write decimal equivalents of any number of tenths or hundredths (e.g. 3/10 = 0.3, 27/100 = 0.27)
edges.toGoal: Recognise and write decimal equivalents of 1/4, 1/2, and 3/4
edges.sourceReason: General decimal equivalents prerequisite to specific 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 equivalents
edges.chineseReason: 认识分数与小数的对应关系后，可以比较二分之一等具体分数的小数写法。

edges.toName: 图形规律 · 运算、数位与图形结构
edges.fromGoal: Understand and apply the commutative property of addition: addends can be added in any order
edges.toGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: apply properties of operations, place-value patterns, and relationships between shapes to solve problems efficiently
edges.sourceReason: Deliberately applying commutativity to make addition easier exercises using structure
edges.chineseReason: 交换加数顺序而总和不变，可以用来选择更方便的加法顺序。

edges.toName: 图形规律 · 运算、数位与图形结构
edges.fromGoal: Understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones
edges.toGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: apply properties of operations, place-value patterns, and relationships between shapes to solve problems efficiently
edges.sourceReason: Using place-value structure (tens and ones) to solve problems efficiently
edges.chineseReason: 把两位数拆成几个十和几个一，可以帮助利用数位结构计算。

edges.toName: 图形规律 · 运算、数位与图形结构
edges.fromGoal: Notice simple patterns and structures: spot that changing order doesn't change the total, and recognise how numbers relate to each other
edges.toGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: apply properties of operations, place-value patterns, and relationships between shapes to solve problems efficiently
edges.sourceReason: Age 6-7 using structure deliberately builds on age 5-6 noticing simple patterns and structure
edges.chineseReason: 观察简单规律后，可以继续利用这些结构解决问题。

edges.fromGoal: Understand two fractions as equivalent if they are the same size or the same point on a number line; recognise and show families of common equivalent fractions using diagrams
edges.toGoal: Select and use appropriate tools and representations strategically: choose between mental, written, and diagrammatic methods; use calculators for checking; select fraction models suited to the task
edges.sourceReason: Equivalent fractions require selecting appropriate fraction models
edges.chineseReason: 等值分数可以用分数条或数轴表示；根据要观察的问题选择合适的模型。

edges.fromGoal: Solve word problems involving elapsed time by adding and subtracting time intervals in minutes, including using a number line
edges.toGoal: Select and use appropriate tools and representations strategically: choose between mental, written, and diagrammatic methods; use calculators for checking; select fraction models suited to the task
edges.sourceReason: Elapsed time problems require choosing between number line and mental methods
edges.chineseReason: 计算经过的时间时，可以根据问题选择数轴或其他方法。

edges.fromGoal: Select and use appropriate tools and representations strategically, including choosing between mental methods, jottings, formal algorithms, and calculators for arithmetic with multi-digit numbers, decimals, and fractions
edges.toGoal: Select and use appropriate tools and representations strategically: choose between mental, written, and diagrammatic methods; use calculators for checking; select fraction models suited to the task
edges.sourceReason: Age 7-8 strategic tool use is prerequisite to age 8-9 level
edges.chineseReason: 尝试不同解题策略后，可以比较哪些工具适合当前问题。

edges.fromName: 数轴上的数 · 整数与加减
edges.toName: 理解分数 · 情境、图形与算式
edges.fromGoal: Represent whole numbers as lengths on a number line and represent sums and differences within 100 on a number line diagram
edges.toGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, and symbolic equations involving three-digit numbers and fractions, explaining what each part represents
edges.sourceReason: Number line representations exercise moving between diagrams and equations
edges.chineseReason: 数轴把数量画成位置或长度，可以与表示同一关系的算式相互对应。

edges.toName: 理解分数 · 情境、图形与算式
edges.fromGoal: Move between real-world situations, drawings, and number sentences, explaining how each representation connects to the others (quantitative reasoning)
edges.toGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, and symbolic equations involving three-digit numbers and fractions, explaining what each part represents
edges.sourceReason: Age 7-8 quantitative reasoning builds on age 6-7
edges.chineseReason: 把一个量画成图形、写成数字或算式，可以帮助解释不同表示之间的联系。

edges.fromName: 数轴上的分数 · 把分数放上数轴
edges.toName: 理解分数 · 情境、图形与算式
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use fractions as numbers: place unit fractions and non-unit fractions with small denominators on a number line
edges.toGoal: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, and symbolic equations involving three-digit numbers and fractions, explaining what each part represents
edges.sourceReason: Placing fractions on number lines exercises connecting representations
edges.chineseReason: 把分数放在数轴上，就是把分数符号和位置联系起来。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones
edges.toGoal: Write and calculate mathematical statements for multiplication and division using known tables, including two-digit × one-digit, using mental and progressing to formal written methods
edges.sourceReason: Two-digit × one-digit uses place-value partitioning (e.g. 23 × 4 = 20 × 4 + 3 × 4)
edges.chineseReason: 按数位把23拆成20和3，可以分别乘4再合起来。

edges.fromName: 乘法口诀与乘法表 · 3、4、8的乘除事实
edges.fromGoal: Recall and use multiplication and division facts for the 3, 4, and 8 multiplication tables
edges.toGoal: Write and calculate mathematical statements for multiplication and division using known tables, including two-digit × one-digit, using mental and progressing to formal written methods
edges.sourceReason: Written multiplication/division requires known table facts
edges.chineseReason: 笔算乘除时，可以用已知的乘法表事实处理每一步。

edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and interpret the symbols ×, ÷, and = in multiplication and division number sentences
edges.toGoal: Write and calculate mathematical statements for multiplication and division using known tables, including two-digit × one-digit, using mental and progressing to formal written methods
edges.sourceReason: Writing multiplication/division statements requires fluency with symbols
edges.chineseReason: 认识乘号、除号和等号，有助于读写笔算中的乘除关系。

edges.fromName: 测量长度 · 用相同单位首尾相接
edges.toName: 测量长度 · 选择工具测量
edges.fromGoal: Measure the length of an object using same-size length units laid end to end with no gaps or overlaps
edges.toGoal: Measure the length of an object by selecting and using appropriate tools such as rulers, yardsticks, metre sticks, and measuring tapes
edges.sourceReason: Using standard measurement tools extends measuring with non-standard units
edges.chineseReason: 用相同单位首尾相接测长度的经验，可以帮助理解尺子上的刻度。

edges.toName: 测量长度 · 选择工具测量
edges.fromGoal: Choose and use appropriate standard units to measure length (m/cm), mass (kg/g), temperature (°C), and capacity (litres/ml) to the nearest appropriate unit
edges.toGoal: Measure the length of an object by selecting and using appropriate tools such as rulers, yardsticks, metre sticks, and measuring tapes
edges.sourceReason: Choosing appropriate tools builds on choosing appropriate units
edges.chineseReason: 根据要测的长度选择合适单位，也有助于选择合适的测量工具。

edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators (including mixed numbers) by replacing given fractions with equivalent fractions to produce a common denominator
edges.toGoal: Solve word problems involving addition and subtraction of fractions with unlike denominators, using visual models and benchmark fractions to estimate and assess reasonableness
edges.sourceReason: Word problems require the computational skill of adding/subtracting unlike-denominator fractions
edges.chineseReason: 分数情境题中需要合并不同大小的小份时，可以先通分再相加。

edges.fromName: 加减法应用题 · 同分母分数情境
edges.fromGoal: Solve word problems involving addition and subtraction of fractions with like denominators, using visual models and equations
edges.toGoal: Solve word problems involving addition and subtraction of fractions with unlike denominators, using visual models and benchmark fractions to estimate and assess reasonableness
edges.sourceReason: Extends Y5 fraction word problems to unlike denominators
edges.chineseReason: 理解同分母分数的情境后，可以继续研究不同分母的分数怎样加减。

edges.toName: 用更小的单位提高精度
edges.fromGoal: Measure and begin to record capacity and volume using non-standard and standard units
edges.toGoal: Choose a smaller uniform informal unit when a measurement needs to be more accurate, recognising that a smaller unit gives a larger count, for length, mass and capacity
edges.sourceReason: Applies the idea to capacity measurement
edges.chineseReason: 测量容积时，较小单位可以帮助更细致地记录结果。

edges.fromName: 测量长度 · 用相同单位首尾相接
edges.toName: 用更小的单位提高精度
edges.fromGoal: Measure the length of an object using same-size length units laid end to end with no gaps or overlaps
edges.toGoal: Choose a smaller uniform informal unit when a measurement needs to be more accurate, recognising that a smaller unit gives a larger count, for length, mass and capacity
edges.sourceReason: Choosing a smaller unit requires measuring with uniform informal units
edges.chineseReason: 用相同单位测量长度时，换用更小的单位可以更细致地记录长度。

edges.fromName: 测量质量与重量 · 用单位测量质量
edges.toName: 用更小的单位提高精度
edges.fromGoal: Measure and begin to record mass/weight using non-standard and standard units
edges.toGoal: Choose a smaller uniform informal unit when a measurement needs to be more accurate, recognising that a smaller unit gives a larger count, for length, mass and capacity
edges.sourceReason: Applies the idea to mass measurement
edges.chineseReason: 测量质量时，可以根据需要选择较小单位记录更细的差别。

edges.fromName: 把10以内的数分成两部分
edges.fromGoal: Decompose numbers up to 10 into pairs in more than one way (part-part-whole)
edges.toGoal: Find the number that makes 10 when added to a given number from 1 to 9 (number bonds to 10)
edges.sourceReason: Making 10 is a specific application of decomposing numbers into pairs
edges.chineseReason: 把数分成两部分，可以观察哪些两部分合起来是10。

edges.toName: 等值分数 · 同倍变化
edges.fromGoal: Understand two fractions as equivalent if they are the same size or the same point on a number line; recognise and show families of common equivalent fractions using diagrams
edges.toGoal: Explain why a fraction a/b is equivalent to (n×a)/(n×b) using visual models; use this principle to recognise and generate equivalent fractions, including tenths and hundredths
edges.sourceReason: Understanding equivalence conceptually is prerequisite to explaining algebraically
edges.chineseReason: 先看懂不同分数可以表示同一个位置，再解释它们的分子和分母如何变化。

edges.fromName: 等值分数 · 细分与合并
edges.toName: 等值分数 · 同倍变化
edges.fromGoal: Generate simple equivalent fractions and explain why they are equivalent using visual fraction models
edges.toGoal: Explain why a fraction a/b is equivalent to (n×a)/(n×b) using visual models; use this principle to recognise and generate equivalent fractions, including tenths and hundredths
edges.sourceReason: Generating equivalent fractions with visual models is prerequisite to algebraic explanation of equivalence
edges.chineseReason: 把每一份再等分，能帮助看懂分子、分母为什么同时乘同一个数。

edges.fromName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 简单图表与计数
edges.fromGoal: Interpret and construct simple pictograms, tally charts, block diagrams, and simple tables
edges.toGoal: Acquire categorical and discrete numerical data to address a question of interest by observing, collecting or accessing a data set, and record it using appropriate methods including frequency tables and spreadsheets
edges.sourceReason: Frequency tables build on tally charts
edges.chineseReason: 先用计数标记记录各类结果，再整理成频数表。

edges.fromGoal: Use simple digital tools (graphing apps, tablet tally counters) to acquire and record categorical data from surveys, observations and simple experiments, display it as a list, table, picture or bar graph, and compare category frequencies
edges.toGoal: Acquire categorical and discrete numerical data to address a question of interest by observing, collecting or accessing a data set, and record it using appropriate methods including frequency tables and spreadsheets
edges.sourceReason: Spreadsheet recording builds on early digital data tools
edges.chineseReason: 在屏幕上记录和整理数据的经验，可以用于表格中的数据录入。

edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and interpret the symbols +, −, and = in number sentences
edges.toGoal: Move between real-world situations, drawings, and number sentences, explaining how each representation connects to the others (quantitative reasoning)
edges.sourceReason: Connecting representations to number sentences requires fluency with +, -, = symbols
edges.chineseReason: 图形中的合并与分开可以写成算式，需要理解加号、减号和等号。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use the inverse relationship between addition and subtraction to check calculations and solve missing-number problems
edges.toGoal: Move between real-world situations, drawings, and number sentences, explaining how each representation connects to the others (quantitative reasoning)
edges.sourceReason: Inverse relationship understanding requires moving between addition and subtraction representations
edges.chineseReason: 同一数量关系既可以用加法也可以用减法表达，这能帮助连接不同表示。

edges.fromGoal: Move between a real-world situation and a mathematical representation using concrete objects, drawings, diagrams, tables, number sentences, or bar models
edges.toGoal: Move between real-world situations, drawings, and number sentences, explaining how each representation connects to the others (quantitative reasoning)
edges.sourceReason: Age 6-7 quantitative reasoning builds on age 5-6 concrete-to-representation skills
edges.chineseReason: 先用物品或图画表示生活情境，再尝试用数字和算式表达同一关系。

edges.fromName: 认识十分之一 · 从百分之一到千分之一
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use thousandths; relate them to tenths, hundredths, and their decimal equivalents (e.g. 1/1000 = 0.001, 35/1000 = 0.035)
edges.toGoal: Recognise that in a multi-digit number, a digit in one place represents 10 times as much as in the place to its right and 1/10 of what it represents in the place to its left
edges.sourceReason: Understanding 1/10 of requires familiarity with thousandths
edges.chineseReason: 比较十分之一、百分之一和千分之一，可以观察除以10时数位怎样变化。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise that in a multi-digit whole number, a digit in one place represents ten times what it represents in the place to its right (e.g. 700 ÷ 70 = 10)
edges.toGoal: Recognise that in a multi-digit number, a digit in one place represents 10 times as much as in the place to its right and 1/10 of what it represents in the place to its left
edges.sourceReason: ×10 both directions extends Y5 ×10 relationship
edges.chineseReason: 相邻数位相差10倍；乘10或除以10时可以观察各数字的位值变化。

edges.toName: 网格上的图形变换 · 反射与平移后的位置
edges.fromGoal: Complete a simple symmetric figure with respect to a specific line of symmetry
edges.toGoal: Identify, describe, and represent the position of a shape following a reflection or translation using appropriate language; know that the shape has not changed
edges.sourceReason: Completing symmetric figures supports understanding reflection
edges.chineseReason: 观察图形两侧关于对称轴的位置，可以帮助理解反射。

edges.fromName: 坐标 · 连点组成图形
edges.toName: 网格上的图形变换 · 反射与平移后的位置
edges.fromGoal: Plot specified points on a coordinate grid and draw sides to complete a given polygon
edges.toGoal: Identify, describe, and represent the position of a shape following a reflection or translation using appropriate language; know that the shape has not changed
edges.sourceReason: Performing reflections and translations on a coordinate grid requires the ability to plot specified points
edges.chineseReason: 在坐标网格上准确放点，有助于描述图形反射或平移后的位置。

edges.fromName: 网格上的图形变换 · 反射、平移与旋转
edges.toName: 网格上的图形变换 · 反射与平移后的位置
edges.fromGoal: Represent and carry out geometric transformations on squared paper or a coordinate grid: reflections (in horizontal, vertical, and diagonal mirror lines, including the axes), translations (described as a vector or as left/right/up/down moves), and rotations (90° or 180° about a stated centre point); describe each transformation precisely using the correct language; identify which transformation maps one shape onto its image by comparing position, orientation, and size
edges.toGoal: Identify, describe, and represent the position of a shape following a reflection or translation using appropriate language; know that the shape has not changed
edges.sourceReason: Describing and representing reflections and translations requires the grid-based transformation diagram
edges.chineseReason: 在网格上表示反射和平移，有助于说明变换后图形的位置。

edges.toName: 网格上的图形变换 · 反射与平移后的位置
edges.fromGoal: Describe movements between positions as translations of a given unit to the left/right and up/down
edges.toGoal: Identify, describe, and represent the position of a shape following a reflection or translation using appropriate language; know that the shape has not changed
edges.sourceReason: Y4 translations on a grid is prerequisite to formal reflection and translation
edges.chineseReason: 描述向左、向右、向上或向下移动，可以帮助说明网格上的平移。

edges.fromGoal: Understand subtraction as finding an unknown addend (e.g. 10 − 8 = ? is the same as 8 + ? = 10)
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use the inverse relationship between addition and subtraction to check calculations and solve missing-number problems
edges.sourceReason: Inverse relationship builds on understanding subtraction as unknown-addend
edges.chineseReason: 寻找加法中的未知加数，可以用减法反过来求出它。

edges.fromGoal: Multiply side lengths to find areas of rectangles and represent whole-number products as rectangular areas
edges.toGoal: Apply the area formula (l × w) and perimeter formula (2l + 2w) for rectangles including squares in real-world and mathematical problems; calculate and compare areas using standard units (cm², m²) and estimate areas of irregular shapes
edges.sourceReason: Multiply side lengths for area is prerequisite to applying area formula
edges.chineseReason: 把长和宽相乘得到面积，可以写成长方形面积的计算式。

edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving perimeters of polygons: find perimeter from side lengths, find an unknown side length, and explore rectangles with same perimeter but different areas (or vice versa)
edges.toGoal: Apply the area formula (l × w) and perimeter formula (2l + 2w) for rectangles including squares in real-world and mathematical problems; calculate and compare areas using standard units (cm², m²) and estimate areas of irregular shapes
edges.sourceReason: Y4 perimeter problems are prerequisite to applying perimeter formula
edges.chineseReason: 周长是各边长度的和；长方形的周长公式把这一做法写得更简洁。

edges.toName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 分类与分组数据的图表
edges.fromGoal: Interpret and construct pie charts: calculate sector angles from data, draw sectors accurately, and read values from pie charts to solve problems
edges.toGoal: Construct and interpret frequency tables, bar charts, pie charts, pictograms, and vertical line charts for both categorical and grouped numerical data, choosing appropriate representations for the data type
edges.sourceReason: KS3 chart construction includes pie charts for categorical data, extending KS2 pie chart construction and interpretation (sector angles from data)
edges.chineseReason: 扇形图可以表示各类别占整体的比例，结合数据还能计算各扇形角度。

edges.toName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 分类与分组数据的图表
edges.fromGoal: Interpret and present discrete and continuous data using appropriate graphical methods, including bar charts and time graphs
edges.toGoal: Construct and interpret frequency tables, bar charts, pie charts, pictograms, and vertical line charts for both categorical and grouped numerical data, choosing appropriate representations for the data type
edges.sourceReason: KS3 construction of bar and vertical line (bar) charts for numerical data, and choosing representations for the data type, builds directly on KS2 presentation of discrete and continuous data with appropriate graphs including bar charts
edges.chineseReason: 根据数据类别选择条形图或其他图表，可以帮助呈现和比较数量。

edges.toName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 分类与分组数据的图表
edges.fromGoal: Complete, read, and interpret information in tables, including timetables
edges.toGoal: Construct and interpret frequency tables, bar charts, pie charts, pictograms, and vertical line charts for both categorical and grouped numerical data, choosing appropriate representations for the data type
edges.sourceReason: Frequency tables extend KS2 table interpretation to grouped numerical data
edges.chineseReason: 读懂表格中的数据后，可以按组整理并统计各组频数。

edges.toName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 分类与分组数据的图表
edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and use the vocabulary of statistical analysis — mean, median, mode, range, frequency, data, sample, average, chart, table, graph, pie chart, scatter graph, correlation — with understanding of what each term describes
edges.toGoal: Construct and interpret frequency tables, bar charts, pie charts, pictograms, and vertical line charts for both categorical and grouped numerical data, choosing appropriate representations for the data type
edges.sourceReason: Constructing and interpreting frequency tables and charts draws on frequency and distribution vocabulary
edges.chineseReason: 理解频数和分布等词语，有助于建立和解释统计表与图。

edges.fromName: 百分数的应用 · 增减、原值与利息
edges.toName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 分类与分组数据的图表
edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving percentage increase, percentage decrease, finding the original value after a percentage change, and calculating simple interest
