edges.toGoal: Construct and interpret frequency tables, bar charts, pie charts, pictograms, and vertical line charts for both categorical and grouped numerical data, choosing appropriate representations for the data type
edges.sourceReason: Pie chart construction requires calculating percentages/fractions for angle calculation
edges.chineseReason: 计算类别占整体的百分比，可以帮助求出扇形图中对应的角度。

edges.fromGoal: Write and calculate mathematical statements for multiplication and division using known tables, including two-digit × one-digit, using mental and progressing to formal written methods
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving multiplication and division, including scaling problems and correspondence problems where n objects are connected to m objects
edges.sourceReason: Solving mult/div problems requires computational skills
edges.chineseReason: 多步乘除情境需要先看清每一步的关系，再选择合适的乘除计算。

edges.fromName: 乘法是相同加数的和 · 用阵列和事实解决问题
edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving multiplication and division using arrays, repeated addition, mental methods, and known facts
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving multiplication and division, including scaling problems and correspondence problems where n objects are connected to m objects
edges.sourceReason: Scaling and correspondence problems extend Y2 problem-solving with mult/div
edges.chineseReason: 用分组和阵列解决乘除问题的经验，可以用于分析多步情境。

edges.fromGoal: Multiply side lengths to find areas of rectangles and represent whole-number products as rectangular areas
edges.toGoal: Recognise area as additive; find areas of rectilinear figures by decomposing into non-overlapping rectangles and summing their areas
edges.sourceReason: Must find rectangle areas before decomposing rectilinear figures into rectangles
edges.chineseReason: 把组合图形拆成长方形，分别求面积，再相加可以得到整体面积。

edges.fromName: 等值分数 · 看图识别
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and show, using diagrams, equivalent fractions with small denominators
edges.toGoal: Understand two fractions as equivalent if they are the same size or the same point on a number line; recognise and show families of common equivalent fractions using diagrams
edges.sourceReason: Diagram-based equivalent fractions is prerequisite to formal equivalence understanding
edges.chineseReason: 先从图中辨认相等的分数，再看它们在数轴上处于同一个位置。

edges.fromName: 分数的意义 · 整体中的等份
edges.fromGoal: Understand a fraction 1/b as the quantity formed by 1 part when a whole is partitioned into b equal parts; understand a/b as a parts of size 1/b
edges.toGoal: Understand two fractions as equivalent if they are the same size or the same point on a number line; recognise and show families of common equivalent fractions using diagrams
edges.sourceReason: Must understand unit fractions to reason about equivalence
edges.chineseReason: 理解整体等分后的一小份，可以帮助比较不同分数是否表示相同的量。

edges.fromName: 数轴上的分数 · 一份一份走
edges.fromGoal: Represent fractions on a number line: partition the interval 0 to 1 into b equal parts to locate 1/b, then mark off a lengths of 1/b from 0 to locate a/b
edges.toGoal: Understand two fractions as equivalent if they are the same size or the same point on a number line; recognise and show families of common equivalent fractions using diagrams
edges.sourceReason: Equivalent fractions as the same point on a number line directly uses the fraction number-line representation
edges.chineseReason: 在数轴上按等份走，可以看见不同分数落在同一个位置。

edges.toGoal: Solve word problems that call for adding three whole numbers with a total of 20 or less, representing the problem with objects, a drawing or a three-part bar model and with an equation that uses a symbol for the unknown total (e.g. 4 + 7 + 6 = ☐); choose a convenient order or grouping to add (such as making 10 first) and give the answer in the context of the problem
edges.sourceReason: Extends one-step addition word problems with two numbers, represented with objects, drawings and an equation with an unknown, to three addends
edges.chineseReason: 把故事中的数量用物品、图形或算式表示，可以继续处理三个数的情境。

edges.fromGoal: Add three one-digit numbers using strategies including looking for pairs that make 10
edges.toGoal: Solve word problems that call for adding three whole numbers with a total of 20 or less, representing the problem with objects, a drawing or a three-part bar model and with an equation that uses a symbol for the unknown total (e.g. 4 + 7 + 6 = ☐); choose a convenient order or grouping to add (such as making 10 first) and give the answer in the context of the problem
edges.sourceReason: Solving the problem needs the three addends to be added, using strategies such as making 10 first
edges.chineseReason: 遇到三个加数时，可以选择先凑十等方法，再求总数。

edges.fromGoal: Enumerate sets and their unions and intersections systematically using tables, grids, and Venn diagrams to organise and count outcomes
edges.toGoal: Construct and interpret Venn diagrams with two or three sets to organise and count outcomes; use systematic listing and the product rule for counting to enumerate all possible outcomes of combined events
edges.sourceReason: Constructing Venn diagrams is the representational skill for the set enumeration work in mt_1YwOCMMwD8
edges.chineseReason: 在韦恩图中列出各区域的结果，可以帮助数清集合及其交集。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract within 1000 using concrete models, drawings, and strategies based on place value; understand composing and decomposing tens and hundreds
edges.sourceReason: Three-digit operations require three-digit place-value understanding
edges.chineseReason: 理解百位、十位和个位，有助于计算1000以内的加减。

edges.fromGoal: Partition and rename two-digit numbers in standard and non-standard ways (e.g. 34 = 3 tens 4 ones = 2 tens 14 ones) using physical and virtual base-ten materials, recognising that the total stays the same
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract within 1000 using concrete models, drawings, and strategies based on place value; understand composing and decomposing tens and hundreds
edges.sourceReason: Renaming tens as ones underpins regrouping in addition and subtraction
edges.chineseReason: 一个十可以换成十个一，这种等值交换可以用于加减中的进位和退位。

edges.fromGoal: Fluently add and subtract within 100 using strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract within 1000 using concrete models, drawings, and strategies based on place value; understand composing and decomposing tens and hundreds
edges.sourceReason: Adding/subtracting within 1000 extends within-100 skills
edges.chineseReason: 较小数的加减方法可以继续用于1000以内的数，同时留意数位。

edges.fromGoal: Know the number of minutes in an hour and the number of hours in a day
edges.toGoal: Know the number of seconds in a minute and the number of days in each month, year, and leap year
edges.sourceReason: Extends knowing minutes in an hour to seconds in a minute and days in months
edges.chineseReason: 知道一小时有60分钟后，可以继续比较分钟、秒和日历中的时间单位。

edges.fromGoal: Understand addition as combining or putting together two groups to find the total
edges.toGoal: Understand subtraction as finding an unknown addend (e.g. 10 − 8 = ? is the same as 8 + ? = 10)
edges.sourceReason: Unknown-addend requires understanding both addition and subtraction
edges.chineseReason: 知道两个部分合起来的总数，可以用总数减去已知部分寻找另一部分。

edges.fromName: 拿走与分开：减法的意义
edges.fromGoal: Understand subtraction as taking away or separating from a group to find how many remain
edges.toGoal: Understand subtraction as finding an unknown addend (e.g. 10 − 8 = ? is the same as 8 + ? = 10)
edges.sourceReason: Subtraction as unknown-addend reframes subtraction conceptually
edges.chineseReason: 减法可以看成寻找加法中缺少的一部分，这联系了减法和未知加数。

edges.fromName: 按特征分类 · 比较各类数量
edges.toName: 把数学与生活联系起来
edges.fromGoal: Interpret categorical data by asking and answering questions about totals, how many in each category, and how many more or less one category has than another
edges.toGoal: Represent real-world problems with number sentences, bar models, or diagrams, and interpret the mathematical result back in context
edges.sourceReason: Interpreting data exercises representing real-world situations
edges.chineseReason: 把生活中的记录分类、计数并比较，是把实际情况表示成数学数据。

edges.toName: 把数学与生活联系起来
edges.fromGoal: Determine the unknown whole number in an addition or subtraction equation relating three whole numbers
edges.toGoal: Represent real-world problems with number sentences, bar models, or diagrams, and interpret the mathematical result back in context
edges.sourceReason: Representing unknown-number problems with equations exercises modelling at age 6-7
edges.chineseReason: 用未知数和等式表示生活问题，可以帮助说清需要寻找什么。

edges.toName: 把数学与生活联系起来
edges.fromGoal: Use objects, drawings, or simple number sentences to represent a real-world situation (early mathematical modelling)
edges.toGoal: Represent real-world problems with number sentences, bar models, or diagrams, and interpret the mathematical result back in context
edges.sourceReason: Age 6-7 modelling with bar models/diagrams builds on age 5-6 modelling with objects and pictures
edges.chineseReason: 先用物品表示真实情境，再尝试用图形或条形模型表示同一关系。

edges.toName: 图形规律 · 三位数、乘除与图形
edges.fromGoal: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones
edges.toGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: apply place-value patterns to three-digit operations, use multiplication/division relationships, and exploit shape properties to classify
edges.sourceReason: Three-digit place-value patterns exercise using structure
edges.chineseReason: 观察三位数各数位的规律，可以利用数位结构解决问题。

edges.fromName: 图形规律 · 运算、数位与图形结构
edges.toName: 图形规律 · 三位数、乘除与图形
edges.fromGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: apply properties of operations, place-value patterns, and relationships between shapes to solve problems efficiently
edges.toGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: apply place-value patterns to three-digit operations, use multiplication/division relationships, and exploit shape properties to classify
edges.sourceReason: Age 7-8 using structure builds on age 6-7
edges.chineseReason: 用运算、数位和图形的结构解决问题，可以继续应用到三位数和乘除。

edges.toName: 图形规律 · 三位数、乘除与图形
edges.fromGoal: Identify horizontal and vertical lines and pairs of perpendicular and parallel lines
edges.toGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: apply place-value patterns to three-digit operations, use multiplication/division relationships, and exploit shape properties to classify
edges.sourceReason: Classifying lines by properties exercises structural thinking
edges.chineseReason: 根据线是否平行或垂直进行分类，可以练习按共同特征观察结构。

edges.fromName: 数轴上的分数 · 把分数放上数轴
edges.toName: 等值分数 · 看图识别
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use fractions as numbers: place unit fractions and non-unit fractions with small denominators on a number line
edges.toGoal: Recognise and show, using diagrams, equivalent fractions with small denominators
edges.sourceReason: Number line supports seeing equivalent fractions as the same point
edges.chineseReason: 数轴上表示同一个位置的分数，可以帮助看见它们的量相等。

edges.fromName: 理解分数 · 数量的一半与等值
edges.toName: 等值分数 · 看图识别
edges.fromGoal: Write simple fractions (e.g. 1/2 of 6 = 3) and recognise the equivalence of 2/4 and 1/2
edges.toGoal: Recognise and show, using diagrams, equivalent fractions with small denominators
edges.sourceReason: Extends equivalence of 2/4 and 1/2 to broader equivalent fractions
edges.chineseReason: 从二分之一等于四分之二，继续观察其他表示相同量的分数。

edges.toName: 等值分数 · 看图识别
edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and use fraction notation correctly — fraction, numerator, denominator, unit fraction, non-unit fraction, proper fraction, improper fraction, mixed number, equivalent fraction, simplest form — and understand what each term describes, including the roles of the numerator and denominator in expressing parts of a whole
edges.toGoal: Recognise and show, using diagrams, equivalent fractions with small denominators
edges.sourceReason: Recognising and showing equivalent fractions requires that vocabulary
edges.chineseReason: 认识分数的写法与词语，有助于说清图中相等的分数。

edges.fromGoal: Identify and describe properties of 3-D shapes including the number of edges, vertices, and faces
edges.toGoal: Compare and sort common 2-D and 3-D shapes and everyday objects by their properties
edges.sourceReason: Sorting shapes requires knowing their 3-D properties
edges.chineseReason: 比较立体图形的棱、顶点和面，可以帮助给立体图形分类。

edges.fromName: 平面图形 · 边与对称
edges.fromGoal: Identify and describe properties of 2-D shapes including the number of sides and line symmetry in a vertical line
edges.toGoal: Compare and sort common 2-D and 3-D shapes and everyday objects by their properties
edges.sourceReason: Sorting shapes requires knowing their 2-D properties
edges.chineseReason: 看清平面图形的边和对称等特征，可以帮助给图形分类。

edges.toName: 因数、倍数与质数 · 因数对与公倍数
edges.fromGoal: Recall multiplication and division facts for multiplication tables up to 12 × 12
edges.toGoal: Find all factor pairs for a whole number in the range 1–100; identify common factors and common multiples of two numbers; use these concepts to solve problems
edges.sourceReason: Tables to 12×12 fluency is prerequisite to finding factor pairs up to 100
edges.chineseReason: 已知的乘法事实可以帮助寻找一个数的因数对。

edges.toName: 因数、倍数与质数 · 因数对与公倍数
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use factor pairs and commutativity in mental calculations
edges.toGoal: Find all factor pairs for a whole number in the range 1–100; identify common factors and common multiples of two numbers; use these concepts to solve problems
edges.sourceReason: Recognising factor pairs at Y4 is prerequisite to systematically finding all factor pairs
edges.chineseReason: 交换因数的顺序仍得到同一乘积，可以帮助系统寻找因数对。

edges.fromName: 理解分数 · 不等分与分组
edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving unequal sharing and grouping using knowledge of fractions and multiples
edges.toGoal: Make sense of complex multi-step problems involving ratio, proportion, algebra, negative numbers, and all four operations with fractions and decimals by analysing given and unknown quantities, planning solution strategies, and evaluating reasonableness using estimation and inverse operations
edges.sourceReason: Ratio/proportion problems are key Y6 multi-step contexts
edges.chineseReason: 不等分情境常涉及比和比例，可以拆成几步寻找各部分数量。

edges.fromGoal: Make sense of complex multi-step problems involving large numbers, fractions, decimals, and percentages by analysing what is known and unknown, planning multi-step strategies, and evaluating reasonableness through estimation and inverse operations
edges.toGoal: Make sense of complex multi-step problems involving ratio, proportion, algebra, negative numbers, and all four operations with fractions and decimals by analysing given and unknown quantities, planning solution strategies, and evaluating reasonableness using estimation and inverse operations
edges.sourceReason: Y6 problem-solving extends Y5 multi-step problem analysis
edges.chineseReason: 分析复杂问题时，可以把条件拆开并逐步检查中间结果。

edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, deciding which operations and methods to use and why; solve multi-step problems in contexts
edges.toGoal: Make sense of complex multi-step problems involving ratio, proportion, algebra, negative numbers, and all four operations with fractions and decimals by analysing given and unknown quantities, planning solution strategies, and evaluating reasonableness using estimation and inverse operations
edges.sourceReason: Multi-step problems draw on four-operation problem-solving
edges.chineseReason: 多步问题需要辨认每一步的关系，再选择合适的四则运算。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise and write decimal equivalents of any number of tenths or hundredths (e.g. 3/10 = 0.3, 27/100 = 0.27)
edges.toGoal: Round decimals with one decimal place to the nearest whole number
edges.sourceReason: Must understand decimal notation to round decimals
edges.chineseReason: 看清小数的整数部分和小数位，有助于判断取整时接近哪个整数。

edges.fromName: 按特征分类 · 分类、计数与排序
edges.fromGoal: Classify objects into given categories, count the number in each category, and sort the categories by count
edges.toGoal: Use objects, drawings, or simple number sentences to represent a real-world situation (early mathematical modelling)
edges.sourceReason: Classifying and counting objects into categories is an early modelling activity
edges.chineseReason: 把物品按特征分类并计数，是用数学表示真实情况的一种方式。

edges.fromName: 加减法应用题 · 10以内的情境
edges.fromGoal: Solve addition and subtraction word problems within 10 using objects or drawings
edges.toGoal: Use objects, drawings, or simple number sentences to represent a real-world situation (early mathematical modelling)
edges.sourceReason: Solving word problems with drawings exercises early modelling
edges.chineseReason: 用图画表示故事中的数量和关系，可以帮助把真实问题变成数学问题。

edges.toName: 加法与减法 · 多步情境
edges.fromGoal: Solve addition and subtraction two-step problems in contexts, deciding which operations and methods to use and why
edges.toGoal: Solve addition and subtraction multi-step problems in contexts, deciding which operations and methods to use and why
edges.sourceReason: Two-step A+S problems are prerequisite to multi-step problems with larger numbers
edges.chineseReason: 两步加减问题的分析方法，可以继续用于包含更多步骤的情境。

edges.fromName: 加减法口算 · 较大数与数位
edges.toName: 加法与减法 · 多步情境
edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract numbers mentally with increasingly large numbers, using place-value knowledge and derived facts
edges.toGoal: Solve addition and subtraction multi-step problems in contexts, deciding which operations and methods to use and why
edges.sourceReason: Mental methods support choosing appropriate methods in multi-step problems
edges.chineseReason: 处理多步问题时，可以根据数的特点选择合适的口算或其他方法。

edges.fromName: 熟练使用加减法 · 多位数竖式
edges.toName: 加法与减法 · 多步情境
edges.fromGoal: Fluently add and subtract whole numbers with more than four digits using the standard columnar algorithm
edges.toGoal: Solve addition and subtraction multi-step problems in contexts, deciding which operations and methods to use and why
edges.sourceReason: Must have fluent written method before applying to multi-step contexts
edges.chineseReason: 处理多步问题时，竖式是计算较大数加减的一种可选方法。

edges.toName: 理解分数 · 不等分与分组
edges.fromGoal: Use common factors to simplify fractions to their simplest form; use common multiples to express fractions with a common denominator
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving unequal sharing and grouping using knowledge of fractions and multiples
edges.sourceReason: Understanding fraction of total requires simplification/common denominator skills
edges.chineseReason: 分析不等分和分组时，约分或通分可以帮助比较占总量的份额。

edges.toName: 理解分数 · 不等分与分组
edges.fromGoal: Represent ratio and proportion problems using bar models (rectangular strips divided into equal parts labelled with quantities) and tape diagrams (segmented strips showing part-to-part and part-to-whole relationships); use these visual models to set up and solve unequal sharing, scaling, and percentage problems — drawing the diagram first, then reading off the answer
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving unequal sharing and grouping using knowledge of fractions and multiples
edges.sourceReason: Unequal sharing problems are the canonical use case for tape diagrams — the visual model makes the structure of the problem transparent
edges.chineseReason: 条形图可以把不等分中的各部分及其关系画出来，帮助看清问题结构。

edges.fromName: 百分数的应用 · 比例与百分数的词语
edges.toName: 理解分数 · 不等分与分组
edges.fromGoal: Know and use the vocabulary of ratio and proportion — ratio, proportion, percentage, scale, equivalent, unequal, relative size, part-to-part, part-to-whole, and out of — and understand the difference between ratio (comparing parts to parts) and proportion (comparing a part to the whole)
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving unequal sharing and grouping using knowledge of fractions and multiples
edges.sourceReason: Unequal sharing problems require 'ratio', 'unequal', 'part-to-part', and 'proportion' vocabulary
edges.chineseReason: 理解比、不等分和部分与部分等词语，有助于描述不等分关系。

edges.toName: 理解分数 · 不等分与分组
edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving the relative sizes of two quantities where missing values can be found by using integer multiplication and division facts
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving unequal sharing and grouping using knowledge of fractions and multiples
edges.sourceReason: Unequal sharing is ratio reasoning in context
edges.chineseReason: 不等分问题可以用各部分数量之间的比来表示。

edges.toName: 等值分数 · 细分与合并
edges.fromGoal: Understand two fractions as equivalent if they are the same size or the same point on a number line; recognise and show families of common equivalent fractions using diagrams
edges.toGoal: Generate simple equivalent fractions and explain why they are equivalent using visual fraction models
edges.sourceReason: Must understand equivalence before generating equivalent fractions
edges.chineseReason: 先理解不同写法可以表示相同的量，再通过细分或合并得到新的写法。

edges.fromGoal: Distinguish a population from a sample drawn from it; explain why a convenient or biased sample (choosing whoever is easiest to reach, volunteers, or a group linked to the answer) can misrepresent the population; explain that random selection gives every member of the population an equal chance of being chosen, which tends to produce representative samples — while recognising that any single random sample can still, by chance, be unrepresentative
edges.toGoal: Use data from a random sample to estimate a characteristic of the population, such as a proportion, total count, or mean; present the result as an estimate rather than an exact population measurement; state the assumptions the inference relies on (the sample was randomly drawn from the population being described and is reasonably representative) and explain how the conclusion is limited or invalid when those assumptions fail
edges.sourceReason: Stating the assumptions and limits of an estimate depends on understanding representative versus biased samples
edges.chineseReason: 样本选取是否有偏，会影响用样本估计总体时可以作出的判断。

edges.fromGoal: Calculate and interpret the mean as an average of a data set
edges.toGoal: Use data from a random sample to estimate a characteristic of the population, such as a proportion, total count, or mean; present the result as an estimate rather than an exact population measurement; state the assumptions the inference relies on (the sample was randomly drawn from the population being described and is reasonably representative) and explain how the conclusion is limited or invalid when those assumptions fail
edges.sourceReason: The assessment includes estimating a population mean from a sample mean, which requires calculating and interpreting the mean
edges.chineseReason: 计算并理解样本平均数后，可以用它估计总体平均数，同时说明局限。

edges.fromName: 一个量占另一个量的几分之几
edges.fromGoal: Express one quantity as a fraction of another where the result may be less than 1 or greater than 1, and interpret the meaning in context
edges.toGoal: Use data from a random sample to estimate a characteristic of the population, such as a proportion, total count, or mean; present the result as an estimate rather than an exact population measurement; state the assumptions the inference relies on (the sample was randomly drawn from the population being described and is reasonably representative) and explain how the conclusion is limited or invalid when those assumptions fail
edges.sourceReason: Estimating from a sample proportion requires expressing the sample count as a fraction of the sample and applying it to the population
edges.chineseReason: 先把样本中符合条件的人数写成样本的几分之几，再用这一比例估计总体数量。

edges.fromGoal: Cardinality principle: the last number said when counting a set tells how many objects are in the set, regardless of arrangement or order counted
edges.toGoal: Read and write numerals from 0 to 20
edges.sourceReason: Reading/writing numerals 0–20 requires understanding that numerals represent quantities (cardinality)
edges.chineseReason: 一个数字可以表示一组物品的总数，理解数量有助于读写数字。

edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract within 20 using strategies such as making ten, decomposing a number leading to ten, and using known facts
edges.toGoal: Recognise Australian coins (5c, 10c, 20c, 50c, $1, $2) and notes ($5, $10, $20, $50, $100), know that a coin's size does not show its value, and solve simple purchase problems within $20 or 20 cents using real coins and virtual money (on-screen coins and notes)
edges.sourceReason: Simple purchase problems require adding and subtracting within 20
edges.chineseReason: 购物时合计价格和找零，可以用到20以内的加减。

edges.fromGoal: Divide numbers up to four digits by a one-digit number using short division (and place-value/array strategies); interpret remainders appropriately for the context
edges.toGoal: Divide numbers up to 4 digits by a two-digit number using formal written short division where appropriate, interpreting remainders according to context
edges.sourceReason: Short division by 2-digit extends Y5 short division by 1-digit
edges.chineseReason: 除数从一位数变成两位数时，仍需要逐步判断商与余数。

edges.fromName: 有余数的除法 · 两位数除数与余数
edges.fromGoal: Divide numbers up to 4 digits by a two-digit divisor using formal written long division, interpreting remainders as whole numbers, fractions, or by rounding as appropriate
edges.toGoal: Divide numbers up to 4 digits by a two-digit number using formal written short division where appropriate, interpreting remainders according to context
edges.sourceReason: Choosing short vs long division requires knowing both methods
edges.chineseReason: 比较简式和竖式除法的步骤，可以根据问题选择合适方法。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise the relationship between dollars and cents (100 cents = 1 dollar), read and write amounts in $ and c notation (e.g. $3.45 and 345c), represent the same amount with different combinations of Australian coins and notes, and calculate change in dollars and cents
edges.toGoal: Use a calculator where appropriate to solve and check practical additive and multiplicative money problems in dollars and cents, reading the display as dollars and cents and checking the result with a quick estimate
edges.sourceReason: Reading a calculator display as money requires dollars-and-cents notation
edges.chineseReason: 计算器显示金额时，需要看懂元与分分别对应哪些小数位。

edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract within 1000 using concrete models, drawings, and strategies based on place value; understand composing and decomposing tens and hundreds
edges.toGoal: Use a calculator where appropriate to solve and check practical additive and multiplicative money problems in dollars and cents, reading the display as dollars and cents and checking the result with a quick estimate
edges.sourceReason: Estimating and checking totals uses addition and subtraction within 1000
edges.chineseReason: 先估算金额的和或差，再用计算器结果作比较，可以帮助检查。

edges.fromGoal: Simplify algebraic expressions by collecting like terms — combine terms with the same variable and power (e.g., 3a + 2b + 5a = 8a + 2b) while maintaining equivalence
edges.toGoal: Expand (multiply out) a single term over a bracket using the distributive property, e.g., 3(2x + 5) = 6x + 15; expand expressions involving negative multipliers
edges.sourceReason: Expanding brackets produces terms that then need collecting
edges.chineseReason: 展开括号后可能得到同类项，把它们合并可以使表达式更简洁。

edges.fromName: 图形规律 · 按规则生成图形或数列
edges.fromGoal: Generate a number or shape pattern that follows a given rule; identify apparent features of the pattern not explicit in the rule and explain informally why they occur
edges.toGoal: Generate two numerical patterns using two given rules; identify relationships between corresponding terms; form ordered pairs and graph them on a coordinate plane
edges.sourceReason: Analysing two patterns extends Y5 single-pattern generation
edges.chineseReason: 按规则生成一个数列后，可以比较两组规律及对应项。

edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving the relative sizes of two quantities where missing values can be found by using integer multiplication and division facts
edges.toGoal: Generate two numerical patterns using two given rules; identify relationships between corresponding terms; form ordered pairs and graph them on a coordinate plane
edges.sourceReason: Relationships between corresponding terms connect to proportional reasoning
edges.chineseReason: 比较两组数列中对应项的倍数关系，可以帮助发现它们之间的比例。

edges.fromName: 坐标 · 连点组成图形
edges.fromGoal: Plot specified points on a coordinate grid and draw sides to complete a given polygon
edges.toGoal: Generate two numerical patterns using two given rules; identify relationships between corresponding terms; form ordered pairs and graph them on a coordinate plane
edges.sourceReason: Graphing numerical patterns on a coordinate plane requires coordinate grid plotting
edges.chineseReason: 在坐标网格上放置对应的数对，可以把数列关系画成图像。

edges.fromGoal: Identify, represent and estimate numbers to 100 using different representations: place a two-digit number on a 0–100 number line marked in tens, represent it with base-ten blocks (tens and ones), drawings, bead strings or hundred squares, and estimate 'about how many' objects in a set before counting to check
edges.toGoal: Identify, represent and estimate three-digit numbers using different representations: place a number on a 0–1000 number line marked only in hundreds or unmarked, estimate the value of a marked point, and represent a number with base-ten blocks (hundreds, tens and ones), a place-value chart and a drawing, including numbers with a zero digit and non-standard partitions
edges.sourceReason: Extends number-line placement, base-ten representation and estimation from 0–100 to 0–1000
edges.chineseReason: 数轴、十进制表示和估计数的位置等方法，也可以用于1000以内的数。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones
edges.toGoal: Identify, represent and estimate three-digit numbers using different representations: place a number on a 0–1000 number line marked only in hundreds or unmarked, estimate the value of a marked point, and represent a number with base-ten blocks (hundreds, tens and ones), a place-value chart and a drawing, including numbers with a zero digit and non-standard partitions
edges.sourceReason: Representing three-digit numbers as hundreds, tens and ones (including zero digits and regrouped forms) requires three-digit place value
edges.chineseReason: 理解百位、十位和个位，可以用积木或图形表示三位数，包括某一位为0的情况。

edges.fromGoal: Mentally find 10 more or 10 less than a given two-digit number without counting
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: spot calculation patterns, describe rules for sequences, and predict results using known mathematical facts
edges.sourceReason: Mentally finding 10 more/less uses generalised repeated reasoning about place value
edges.chineseReason: 观察加10或减10时数位的变化，可以从重复计算中总结规律。

edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract within 20 using strategies such as making ten, decomposing a number leading to ten, and using known facts
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: spot calculation patterns, describe rules for sequences, and predict results using known mathematical facts
edges.sourceReason: Deriving facts within 20 from known facts (near doubles, make ten) exercises generalising from patterns
edges.chineseReason: 利用已知加减事实、凑十或接近的双倍数，可以观察并概括计算规律。

edges.fromGoal: Notice when a calculation or pattern repeats and use this to count more efficiently or predict results
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: spot calculation patterns, describe rules for sequences, and predict results using known mathematical facts
edges.sourceReason: Age 6-7 generalising from repeated reasoning builds on age 5-6 noticing repeated patterns
edges.chineseReason: 比较重复出现的计算方法，可以帮助发现更有效的共同做法。

edges.fromGoal: Round any whole number up to 1,000,000 to the nearest 10, 100, 1,000, 10,000, or 100,000 using place-value understanding
edges.toGoal: Use rounding to check answers to calculations and determine appropriate levels of accuracy in context
edges.sourceReason: Must round to any place before using rounding to check large-number calculations
edges.chineseReason: 先把大数取近似值，再计算估计结果，可以检查精确答案的数量级。

edges.fromName: 用四舍五入估算 · 估算与逆运算检查
edges.fromGoal: Estimate the answer to a calculation and use inverse operations to check answers; apply to increasingly large numbers using rounding and inverse reasoning
edges.toGoal: Use rounding to check answers to calculations and determine appropriate levels of accuracy in context
edges.sourceReason: Estimating and inverse checking at Y4 is prerequisite to rounding-based checking with levels of accuracy
edges.chineseReason: 估算和逆运算都可用于检查；取近似值时还要考虑所需精度。

edges.toName: 寻找二分之一与四分之一
edges.fromGoal: Recognise, find, and name a half as one of two equal parts of an object, shape, or quantity
edges.toGoal: Recognise, find, and name a quarter as one of four equal parts of an object, shape, or quantity
edges.sourceReason: Understanding quarters extends from understanding halves — both are equal parts but quarters requires dividing into 4
edges.chineseReason: 一半是两等份中的一份；四分之一是四等份中的一份。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise that in a multi-digit number, a digit in one place represents 10 times as much as in the place to its right and 1/10 of what it represents in the place to its left
edges.toGoal: Read, write, order, and compare numbers up to 10,000,000 and determine the value of each digit
edges.sourceReason: ×10 relationship supports understanding of larger numbers
edges.chineseReason: 相邻数位相差10倍，这一关系也适用于更大的整数。

edges.fromName: 数的读写 · 整数的读写比较
edges.fromGoal: Read, write, order, and compare whole numbers up to at least 1,000,000 using base-ten numerals, number names, expanded form, and place-value understanding
edges.toGoal: Read, write, order, and compare numbers up to 10,000,000 and determine the value of each digit
edges.sourceReason: Numbers to 10M extends Y5 numbers to 1M
edges.chineseReason: 读写较大的数时，仍需要按数位确定各数字表示的值。

edges.toName: 二分之一、四分之一与八分之一
edges.fromGoal: Understand that decomposing a shape into more equal shares creates smaller shares
edges.toGoal: Connect halves, quarters and eighths through repeated halving of shapes, objects and collections, and represent eighths of shapes and objects
edges.sourceReason: Decomposing shapes into more equal shares supports halving again
edges.chineseReason: 把相同的份再平均分，可以得到更多同样大小的小份。

edges.fromName: 图形的二分之一与四分之一
edges.toName: 二分之一、四分之一与八分之一
edges.fromGoal: Partition circles and rectangles into two and four equal shares and describe them using the words halves, fourths, and quarters
edges.toGoal: Connect halves, quarters and eighths through repeated halving of shapes, objects and collections, and represent eighths of shapes and objects
edges.sourceReason: Eighths by repeated halving build on halves and quarters of shapes
edges.chineseReason: 把一个整体先分成两份、再把每份依次平分，可以看到四分之一和八分之一。

edges.toName: 把除法看成求未知因数
edges.fromGoal: Interpret products of whole numbers (e.g. 5 × 7 as the total number of objects in 5 groups of 7)
edges.toGoal: Understand division as an unknown-factor problem (e.g. find 32 ÷ 8 by finding the number that makes 32 when multiplied by 8)
edges.sourceReason: Connecting division to multiplication requires understanding products
edges.chineseReason: 如果已知乘积和一个因数，除法可以用来寻找另一个因数。

edges.toName: 把除法看成求未知因数
edges.fromGoal: Interpret whole-number quotients (e.g. 56 ÷ 8 as the number of objects in each share or the number of equal groups)
edges.toGoal: Understand division as an unknown-factor problem (e.g. find 32 ÷ 8 by finding the number that makes 32 when multiplied by 8)
edges.sourceReason: Seeing division as unknown-factor requires understanding division first
edges.chineseReason: 把除法看成寻找未知因数时，商是需要寻找的那个因数。

edges.fromGoal: Enumerate sets and their unions and intersections systematically using tables, grids, and Venn diagrams to organise and count outcomes
edges.toGoal: Generate theoretical sample spaces for single and combined events using listing, tables, and tree diagrams, and calculate theoretical probabilities as the number of favourable outcomes divided by the total number of equally likely outcomes
edges.sourceReason: Sample spaces for combined events require systematic enumeration skills
edges.chineseReason: 先有序列出各次事件的可能结果，有助于用树状图组织组合结果。

edges.fromName: 分数乘法 · 分数乘分数
edges.fromGoal: Multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction, including proper fractions by proper fractions; interpret (a/b) × q as a parts of q partitioned into b equal parts; write answers in simplest form
edges.toGoal: Generate theoretical sample spaces for single and combined events using listing, tables, and tree diagrams, and calculate theoretical probabilities as the number of favourable outcomes divided by the total number of equally likely outcomes
edges.sourceReason: Calculating probabilities for combined events often requires multiplying fractions
edges.chineseReason: 求连续事件一条路径的概率时，可以把该路径各步的条件概率相乘。

edges.fromGoal: Record, describe, and analyse the frequency of outcomes from probability experiments to develop an understanding of relative frequency as an estimate of probability
edges.toGoal: Generate theoretical sample spaces for single and combined events using listing, tables, and tree diagrams, and calculate theoretical probabilities as the number of favourable outcomes divided by the total number of equally likely outcomes
edges.sourceReason: Theoretical probability builds on experience with experimental probability
edges.chineseReason: 随机实验提供实际结果，可以和树状图算出的理论概率比较。

edges.fromGoal: Use and interpret algebraic notation including: ab for a × b, 3y for y + y + y, a² for a × a, a/b for a ÷ b, coefficients as fractions, and brackets for grouping; read and write algebraic expressions fluently
edges.toGoal: Understand and use the concepts and vocabulary of expressions, equations, inequalities, terms, and factors; distinguish between an expression (no equals sign), an equation (equals sign), and an inequality (inequality sign)
edges.sourceReason: Algebraic vocabulary requires fluency with algebraic notation first
edges.chineseReason: 用字母表示数以后，可以用代数符号写出并描述数量关系。

edges.fromGoal: Understand addition as combining or putting together two groups to find the total
edges.toGoal: Fluently add and subtract within 5
edges.sourceReason: Fluency with addition within 5 requires understanding addition as combining
edges.chineseReason: 理解加法表示合起来，可以帮助计算5以内的加法。

edges.fromName: 拿走与分开：减法的意义
edges.fromGoal: Understand subtraction as taking away or separating from a group to find how many remain
edges.toGoal: Fluently add and subtract within 5
edges.sourceReason: Fluency with subtraction within 5 requires understanding subtraction as taking away
edges.chineseReason: 理解减法可以表示拿走或分开，可以帮助计算5以内的减法。

edges.fromGoal: Generate measurement data by measuring lengths to the nearest whole unit and display the data on a line plot
edges.toGoal: Generate measurement data by measuring lengths to the nearest half and quarter inch; display the data on a line plot with a scale marked in whole numbers, halves, and quarters
edges.sourceReason: Line plot with whole numbers is prerequisite to line plots with fractional units
edges.chineseReason: 用整数单位记录测量值后，可以继续用二分之一或四分之一单位记录。

edges.fromName: 分数的意义 · 整体中的等份
edges.fromGoal: Understand a fraction 1/b as the quantity formed by 1 part when a whole is partitioned into b equal parts; understand a/b as a parts of size 1/b
edges.toGoal: Generate measurement data by measuring lengths to the nearest half and quarter inch; display the data on a line plot with a scale marked in whole numbers, halves, and quarters
edges.sourceReason: Understanding fractions supports measuring to nearest half/quarter inch
edges.chineseReason: 理解一个整体的等份，可以帮助读出半个或四分之一个测量单位。

edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract within 20 using strategies such as making ten, decomposing a number leading to ten, and using known facts
edges.toGoal: Add within 100 using strategies based on place value, including adding a two-digit and one-digit number, and a two-digit and a multiple of 10
edges.sourceReason: Adding within 100 extends within-20 strategies to larger numbers
edges.chineseReason: 较小数的加法方法可以继续用于100以内的数。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones
edges.toGoal: Add within 100 using strategies based on place value, including adding a two-digit and one-digit number, and a two-digit and a multiple of 10
edges.sourceReason: Adding within 100 using PV requires understanding tens and ones
edges.chineseReason: 看清两位数中的几个十和几个一，有助于计算100以内的加法。

edges.toName: 整数、小数与分数的四则运算
edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators (including mixed numbers) by replacing given fractions with equivalent fractions to produce a common denominator
edges.toGoal: Use the four operations with formal written methods applied to integers, decimals, proper and improper fractions, and mixed numbers, all both positive and negative
edges.sourceReason: Four operations with all number types builds on adding/subtracting fractions with unlike denominators
edges.chineseReason: 带分数和假分数也可以参与分数加减；不同大小的小份可以先换成共同大小。

edges.fromName: 分数乘法 · 分数乘分数
edges.toName: 整数、小数与分数的四则运算
edges.fromGoal: Multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction, including proper fractions by proper fractions; interpret (a/b) × q as a parts of q partitioned into b equal parts; write answers in simplest form
edges.toGoal: Use the four operations with formal written methods applied to integers, decimals, proper and improper fractions, and mixed numbers, all both positive and negative
edges.sourceReason: Four operations with all number types builds on multiplying fractions
edges.chineseReason: 假分数或带分数也可以参与乘法，需要保持表示的数量不变。

edges.toName: 整数、小数与分数的四则运算
edges.fromGoal: Interpret and compute division of a unit fraction by a non-zero whole number (e.g. 1/3 ÷ 4 = 1/12); use visual models and the relationship between multiplication and division to explain the result
edges.toGoal: Use the four operations with formal written methods applied to integers, decimals, proper and improper fractions, and mixed numbers, all both positive and negative
edges.sourceReason: Four operations with all number types builds on dividing unit fractions
edges.chineseReason: 单位分数的除法是分数除法的一种情况，可以与其他分数运算比较。

edges.fromGoal: Solve problems requiring knowledge of percentage and decimal equivalents of 1/2, 1/4, 1/5, 2/5, 4/5 and fractions with denominators that are multiples of 10 or 25
edges.toGoal: Make sense of complex multi-step problems involving large numbers, fractions, decimals, and percentages by analysing what is known and unknown, planning multi-step strategies, and evaluating reasonableness through estimation and inverse operations
edges.sourceReason: Percentage problems exercise multi-step reasoning
edges.chineseReason: 百分数情境中可能需要先求变化量，再求变化后的数量。

edges.fromName: 有余数的除法 · 情境中的余数
edges.fromGoal: Solve multi-step word problems using the four operations with whole numbers, including interpreting remainders in context; represent with equations using a letter for the unknown; check with estimation
edges.toGoal: Make sense of complex multi-step problems involving large numbers, fractions, decimals, and percentages by analysing what is known and unknown, planning multi-step strategies, and evaluating reasonableness through estimation and inverse operations
edges.sourceReason: Multi-step word problems exercise problem sense-making at age 9-10
edges.chineseReason: 多步情境里的余数应结合实际意义解释，再决定下一步怎样做。

edges.fromName: 解决多步问题 · 四则、分数与面积体积
edges.fromGoal: Make sense of multi-step problems involving four operations, fractions, and area/volume by identifying sub-steps, choosing a strategy, and monitoring progress
edges.toGoal: Make sense of complex multi-step problems involving large numbers, fractions, decimals, and percentages by analysing what is known and unknown, planning multi-step strategies, and evaluating reasonableness through estimation and inverse operations
edges.sourceReason: Age 8-9 problem sense-making is prerequisite to age 9-10 level
edges.chineseReason: 分析多步问题时，可以拆出中间步骤并检查每一步与原情境的关系。

edges.toName: 用排列方阵表示乘法 · 用阵列表示乘除
edges.fromGoal: Understand division as sharing equally into groups or as grouping (how many groups of a given size can be made)
edges.toGoal: Use arrays to represent multiplication and division situations
edges.sourceReason: Using arrays for division requires understanding division as grouping
edges.chineseReason: 阵列可以表示把物品分成相同组数，也可以表示每组有多少。

edges.fromName: 乘法是相同加数的和 · 相同加数与成组
edges.toName: 用排列方阵表示乘法 · 用阵列表示乘除
edges.fromGoal: Understand multiplication as repeated addition and grouping equal sets
edges.toGoal: Use arrays to represent multiplication and division situations
edges.sourceReason: Using arrays requires understanding what multiplication means
edges.chineseReason: 阵列中的相同行或列可以表示乘法中的相等组。

edges.fromName: 用排列方阵表示乘法 · 阵列中的相同加数
edges.fromGoal: Use addition to find the total number of objects arranged in rectangular arrays with up to 5 rows and 5 columns; write an equation to express the total as a sum of equal addends
edges.toGoal: Interpret products of whole numbers (e.g. 5 × 7 as the total number of objects in 5 groups of 7)
edges.sourceReason: Extends array-based repeated addition to formal multiplication interpretation
edges.chineseReason: 把阵列每行的数量重复相加，可以和乘法算式表示同一总数。

edges.fromName: 乘法是相同加数的和 · 相同加数与成组
edges.fromGoal: Understand multiplication as repeated addition and grouping equal sets
edges.toGoal: Interpret products of whole numbers (e.g. 5 × 7 as the total number of objects in 5 groups of 7)
edges.sourceReason: Interpreting products formalises repeated addition/equal groups from Y1
edges.chineseReason: 乘法可以表示若干相同数量的组，也可以与重复加法对应。

edges.fromName: 乘法竖式 · 多位数竖式
edges.fromGoal: Fluently multiply multi-digit whole numbers (up to 4 digits by 2 digits) using the formal written method of long multiplication
edges.toGoal: Enumerate possibilities of combinations of two variables systematically (e.g. all ways to choose from a set of options)
edges.sourceReason: Systematic enumeration connects to multiplicative reasoning (product of options)
edges.chineseReason: 列出两类选择的组合时，可以用各类选项数相乘核对总数；较大乘积可选择竖式。

edges.fromName: 分数乘法 · 分数乘分数
edges.fromGoal: Multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction, including proper fractions by proper fractions; interpret (a/b) × q as a parts of q partitioned into b equal parts; write answers in simplest form
edges.toGoal: Find the area of a rectangle with fractional side lengths by tiling with unit-fraction squares; show that the area equals the product of the side lengths
edges.sourceReason: Area with fractional sides applies fraction multiplication
edges.chineseReason: 长方形的边长是分数时，面积可以用两条边长相乘求出。

edges.fromGoal: Apply the area formula (l × w) and perimeter formula (2l + 2w) for rectangles including squares in real-world and mathematical problems; calculate and compare areas using standard units (cm², m²) and estimate areas of irregular shapes
edges.toGoal: Find the area of a rectangle with fractional side lengths by tiling with unit-fraction squares; show that the area equals the product of the side lengths
edges.sourceReason: Must know area = l × w before extending to fractional side lengths
edges.chineseReason: 长方形面积仍由长乘宽求出；当边长是分数时，就要用分数相乘。

edges.toName: 平方数与立方数 · 认识平方与立方
edges.fromGoal: Recall multiplication and division facts for multiplication tables up to 12 × 12
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use square numbers and cube numbers, and the notation for squared (²) and cubed (³)
edges.sourceReason: Tables fluency to 12×12 is prerequisite to recognising square numbers
edges.chineseReason: 平方数可以看成一个数乘它自身，可在乘法表中寻找这些乘积。

edges.fromGoal: Find the area of a rectangle by tiling it with unit squares and show that the result equals the product of the side lengths
edges.toGoal: Multiply side lengths to find areas of rectangles and represent whole-number products as rectangular areas
edges.sourceReason: Must see tiling→multiplication connection before computing area via side lengths
edges.chineseReason: 用相同单位方格铺满长方形，可以看到每行格数乘行数得到面积。

edges.fromGoal: Plot linear graphs by generating a table of values, reduce a two-variable linear equation to the form y = mx + c, and calculate gradients from two points on a line
edges.toGoal: Recognise that quadratic functions produce curved (parabolic) graphs, distinguish them from linear graphs, and use plotted quadratic graphs to estimate values and find approximate solutions
edges.sourceReason: Understanding quadratic graphs requires prior experience plotting linear graphs
edges.chineseReason: 描过直线上的点后，可以用类似的坐标方法观察二次函数图像。

edges.fromName: 立体图形 · 面、棱、顶点与截面
edges.fromGoal: Use the properties of faces, surfaces, edges, and vertices of 3-D shapes (cubes, cuboids, prisms, cylinders, pyramids, cones, and spheres) to solve problems, including visualising cross-sections
edges.toGoal: Compare the parallel cross-sections of objects and recognise that slices of a right prism taken parallel to its end (base) faces are all congruent to those faces, while parallel slices of pyramids and cones change in size
edges.sourceReason: Comparing cross-sections requires knowing the properties of 3-D objects
edges.chineseReason: 观察立体图形的面、棱和顶点，有助于判断切开后截面可能是什么形状。

edges.toName: 角的分类 · 锐角与钝角
edges.fromGoal: Identify right angles; recognise that two right angles make a half-turn, three make three-quarters, and four make a complete turn
edges.toGoal: Identify acute and obtuse angles; compare and order angles up to two right angles by size
edges.sourceReason: Identifying right angles and greater/less than right angle is prerequisite to naming acute/obtuse
edges.chineseReason: 把角与直角比较，可以辨认小于直角的锐角和大于直角的钝角。

edges.fromName: 分数乘法 · 分数乘分数
edges.fromGoal: Multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction, including proper fractions by proper fractions; interpret (a/b) × q as a parts of q partitioned into b equal parts; write answers in simplest form
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving the relative sizes of two quantities where missing values can be found by using integer multiplication and division facts
edges.sourceReason: Ratio reasoning connects to fraction multiplication
edges.chineseReason: 用分数表示一个量与另一个量的关系，可以联系比和分数乘法。

edges.fromGoal: Represent ratio and proportion problems using bar models (rectangular strips divided into equal parts labelled with quantities) and tape diagrams (segmented strips showing part-to-part and part-to-whole relationships); use these visual models to set up and solve unequal sharing, scaling, and percentage problems — drawing the diagram first, then reading off the answer
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving the relative sizes of two quantities where missing values can be found by using integer multiplication and division facts
edges.sourceReason: Solving relative-sizes problems is most reliably scaffolded by drawing a bar model to set up the relationship
edges.chineseReason: 把各部分画成条形模型，可以帮助看清比和相对大小。

edges.fromName: 百分数的应用 · 比例与百分数的词语
edges.fromGoal: Know and use the vocabulary of ratio and proportion — ratio, proportion, percentage, scale, equivalent, unequal, relative size, part-to-part, part-to-whole, and out of — and understand the difference between ratio (comparing parts to parts) and proportion (comparing a part to the whole)
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving the relative sizes of two quantities where missing values can be found by using integer multiplication and division facts
edges.sourceReason: Solving relative sizes problems requires 'ratio', 'proportion', and 'relative size' as understood terms
edges.chineseReason: 理解比、比例和相对大小等词语，有助于说清各数量之间的关系。

edges.fromName: 用倍数比较 · 读懂倍数比较
edges.fromGoal: Interpret a multiplication equation as a comparison (e.g. 35 = 5 × 7 means 35 is 5 times as many as 7); represent verbal statements of multiplicative comparisons as equations
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving the relative sizes of two quantities where missing values can be found by using integer multiplication and division facts
edges.sourceReason: Ratio reasoning builds on multiplicative comparison from Y5
edges.chineseReason: 倍数比较说明一个量是另一个量的几倍，可以与比的表示联系起来。

edges.fromGoal: Interpret and present discrete and continuous data using appropriate graphical methods, including bar charts and time graphs
edges.toGoal: Solve comparison, sum, and difference problems using information presented in a line graph
edges.sourceReason: Y4 bar charts and time graphs are prerequisite to line graph problem-solving
edges.chineseReason: 读懂图表中的刻度和数据后，可以从折线图中比较数量变化。

edges.fromGoal: Count a set of objects to answer 'how many?' for sets up to 20 (arranged in lines, arrays, circles, or scattered)
edges.toGoal: Compare two groups of objects to determine which has more, fewer, or whether they are equal, using matching and counting strategies
edges.sourceReason: Counting a set helps when comparing groups, but younger children (GB age 4) can compare using matching without formal counting to 20
edges.chineseReason: 比较两组物品时，可以数数量，也可以一一配对；不一定非要先数出总数。

edges.fromGoal: Apply the area formula (l × w) and perimeter formula (2l + 2w) for rectangles including squares in real-world and mathematical problems; calculate and compare areas using standard units (cm², m²) and estimate areas of irregular shapes
edges.toGoal: Draw polygons in all four quadrants of the coordinate plane from given vertex coordinates; find the length of a horizontal or vertical side from the coordinates of its endpoints (which share an x- or a y-coordinate) by subtracting when both endpoints lie on the same side of the axis, and by adding their distances from the axis (absolute values) when the side crosses it; and use these lengths to find perimeters, areas, missing vertices and distances in real-world and mathematical problems such as maps and plans
edges.sourceReason: The applied problems use side lengths to find rectangle perimeters and areas
edges.chineseReason: 在坐标网格上确定长方形的边长后，可以求它的周长和面积。

edges.fromGoal: Plot and read coordinates in all four quadrants of the Cartesian plane, using positive and negative x- and y-values to describe positions precisely
edges.toGoal: Draw polygons in all four quadrants of the coordinate plane from given vertex coordinates; find the length of a horizontal or vertical side from the coordinates of its endpoints (which share an x- or a y-coordinate) by subtracting when both endpoints lie on the same side of the axis, and by adding their distances from the axis (absolute values) when the side crosses it; and use these lengths to find perimeters, areas, missing vertices and distances in real-world and mathematical problems such as maps and plans
edges.sourceReason: Drawing polygons from vertex coordinates in all four quadrants requires plotting points with negative coordinates
edges.chineseReason: 在四个象限中确定顶点位置后，可以连接对应点组成图形。

edges.fromName: 坐标 · 连点组成图形
edges.fromGoal: Plot specified points on a coordinate grid and draw sides to complete a given polygon
edges.toGoal: Draw polygons in all four quadrants of the coordinate plane from given vertex coordinates; find the length of a horizontal or vertical side from the coordinates of its endpoints (which share an x- or a y-coordinate) by subtracting when both endpoints lie on the same side of the axis, and by adding their distances from the axis (absolute values) when the side crosses it; and use these lengths to find perimeters, areas, missing vertices and distances in real-world and mathematical problems such as maps and plans
edges.sourceReason: Completing polygons from given vertices in the first quadrant is the simpler version of the same task
edges.chineseReason: 在坐标网格中按给定顶点连线，可以得到相应的多边形。

edges.fromGoal: Understand the absolute value of a rational number as its distance from zero on the number line; interpret absolute value as magnitude in real-world contexts; distinguish absolute value comparisons from ordering statements
edges.toGoal: Draw polygons in all four quadrants of the coordinate plane from given vertex coordinates; find the length of a horizontal or vertical side from the coordinates of its endpoints (which share an x- or a y-coordinate) by subtracting when both endpoints lie on the same side of the axis, and by adding their distances from the axis (absolute values) when the side crosses it; and use these lengths to find perimeters, areas, missing vertices and distances in real-world and mathematical problems such as maps and plans
edges.sourceReason: Finding a side length that crosses an axis adds the endpoints' distances from the axis, which are absolute values
edges.chineseReason: 线段跨过坐标轴时，两端到轴的距离相加可以得到这段长度。

edges.fromName: 图形规律 · 按规则生成图形或数列
edges.fromGoal: Generate a number or shape pattern that follows a given rule; identify apparent features of the pattern not explicit in the rule and explain informally why they occur
edges.toGoal: Generate and describe linear number sequences, including those with negative and decimal steps; identify the term-to-term rule
edges.sourceReason: Linear sequences with negative/decimal steps extends Y5 pattern generation
edges.chineseReason: 按固定差生成数列的规则，也可以用于负数或小数的变化。

edges.fromGoal: Use negative numbers in context (temperature, finance, sea level); calculate intervals across zero
edges.toGoal: Generate and describe linear number sequences, including those with negative and decimal steps; identify the term-to-term rule
edges.sourceReason: Sequences crossing zero require negative number understanding
edges.chineseReason: 数列跨过0时，需要理解0两边的正数和负数。

edges.toName: 平方数与立方数 · 整数幂与实数根
edges.fromGoal: Use conventional notation for the priority of operations including brackets, powers, roots, and reciprocals; apply BIDMAS/BODMAS consistently to evaluate complex numerical expressions
edges.toGoal: Use integer powers and associated real roots (square, cube, and higher); recognise powers of 2, 3, 4, and 5; distinguish between exact representations of roots and their decimal approximations
edges.sourceReason: Powers and roots require understanding of order of operations notation
edges.chineseReason: 算式中出现幂或根时，需要看清它们与其他运算的先后关系。

edges.toName: 用数字工具探索千以内的数
edges.fromGoal: Compare and order numbers up to 1000 using >, =, and < symbols, based on place-value understanding
edges.toGoal: Represent and order numbers to at least 1000 using physical base-ten blocks and virtual materials (on-screen base-ten blocks and interactive number lines), connecting each representation to the numeral
edges.sourceReason: Ordering on an interactive number line requires ordering three-digit numbers
edges.chineseReason: 在屏幕数轴上排列三位数时，仍要比较这些数的大小和位置。

edges.toName: 用数字工具探索千以内的数
edges.fromGoal: Identify, represent and estimate three-digit numbers using different representations: place a number on a 0–1000 number line marked only in hundreds or unmarked, estimate the value of a marked point, and represent a number with base-ten blocks (hundreds, tens and ones), a place-value chart and a drawing, including numbers with a zero digit and non-standard partitions
edges.toGoal: Represent and order numbers to at least 1000 using physical base-ten blocks and virtual materials (on-screen base-ten blocks and interactive number lines), connecting each representation to the numeral
edges.sourceReason: On-screen representation to 1000 extends representing numbers to 1000
edges.chineseReason: 屏幕上的模型可以把1000以内的数表示成百、十和一等形式。

edges.toName: 用数字工具探索千以内的数
edges.fromGoal: Recognise, represent and order numbers to at least 120, including 101 to 120, using physical materials (bundled straws, base-ten blocks), virtual materials (on-screen base-ten blocks, digital number charts), numerals, number lines and charts
edges.toGoal: Represent and order numbers to at least 1000 using physical base-ten blocks and virtual materials (on-screen base-ten blocks and interactive number lines), connecting each representation to the numeral
edges.sourceReason: Builds on representing numbers to 120 with physical and virtual materials
edges.chineseReason: 用不同材料表示同一个数的经验，可以继续用于1000以内的数。

edges.fromName: 测量角 · 量角与画角
edges.toName: 平面图形 · 按尺寸和角度画图
edges.fromGoal: Measure angles in whole-number degrees using a protractor; draw given angles and sketch angles of specified measure
edges.toGoal: Draw 2-D shapes using given dimensions and angles, using a ruler and protractor accurately
edges.sourceReason: Drawing shapes with given angles requires protractor skills from Y5
edges.chineseReason: 按给定角度画图形时，可以用量角器确定角的大小。

edges.fromName: 正多边形与不规则多边形
edges.toName: 平面图形 · 按尺寸和角度画图
edges.fromGoal: Distinguish between regular and irregular polygons based on reasoning about equal sides and equal angles
edges.toGoal: Draw 2-D shapes using given dimensions and angles, using a ruler and protractor accurately
edges.sourceReason: Drawing regular/irregular polygons benefits from property knowledge
edges.chineseReason: 观察多边形的边和角，有助于按要求绘制正多边形或不规则多边形。

edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract within 1000 using concrete models, drawings, and strategies based on place value; understand composing and decomposing tens and hundreds
edges.toGoal: Fluently add and subtract within 1000 using strategies and algorithms based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction
edges.sourceReason: Fluency within 1000 builds on strategy-based adding/subtracting within 1000
edges.chineseReason: 理解并尝试多种1000以内的加减方法，可以逐步熟悉计算。

edges.fromName: 加法与减法 · 三位数竖式
edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract numbers with up to three digits using formal written methods of columnar addition and subtraction
edges.toGoal: Fluently add and subtract within 1000 using strategies and algorithms based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction
edges.sourceReason: Fluency requires prior experience with columnar methods for three digits
edges.chineseReason: 三位数竖式按数位记录加减，是处理1000以内计算的一种方法。

edges.toName: 乘法口诀与乘法表 · 2、5、10的乘除事实
edges.fromGoal: Count in multiples of 2, 5, and 10 (skip counting)
edges.toGoal: Recall and use multiplication and division facts for the 2, 5, and 10 multiplication tables
edges.sourceReason: Times tables for 2, 5, 10 build on skip counting in 2s, 5s, 10s
edges.chineseReason: 每次增加2、5或10，可以看出相应乘法表中的数怎样变化。

edges.fromName: 乘法是相同加数的和 · 相同加数与成组
edges.toName: 乘法口诀与乘法表 · 2、5、10的乘除事实
edges.fromGoal: Understand multiplication as repeated addition and grouping equal sets
edges.toGoal: Recall and use multiplication and division facts for the 2, 5, and 10 multiplication tables
edges.sourceReason: Recalling times table facts requires understanding multiplication as repeated addition/grouping
edges.chineseReason: 乘法表中的事实可以对应若干相同的组或重复相加。

edges.fromName: 小数与分数 · 分数除法与小数百分数
edges.toName: 运算顺序 · 发现运算与图形结构
edges.fromGoal: Associate a fraction with division and calculate decimal fraction equivalents for simple fractions (e.g. 3/8 = 0.375); recall and use equivalences between simple fractions, decimals, and percentages in different contexts
edges.toGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: exploit the hierarchy of 2-D shapes to deduce properties; use order of operations and algebraic structure to simplify expressions; connect fraction–decimal–percentage equivalences; use ratio structure to solve proportion problems efficiently
edges.sourceReason: FDP equivalences are key Y6 structural connections
edges.chineseReason: 分数、小数和百分数可以表示同一个量，这是观察数学结构的一种例子。

edges.fromName: 运算、分数与图形的结构
edges.toName: 运算顺序 · 发现运算与图形结构
edges.fromGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: exploit the relationship between fractions, decimals, and percentages; use factor pairs to simplify multiplication; apply angle facts to find unknowns; use properties of regular polygons systematically
edges.toGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: exploit the hierarchy of 2-D shapes to deduce properties; use order of operations and algebraic structure to simplify expressions; connect fraction–decimal–percentage equivalences; use ratio structure to solve proportion problems efficiently
edges.sourceReason: Y6 structural reasoning extends Y5 structure use
edges.chineseReason: 把同一个量写成分数、小数或百分数，可以帮助发现表示之间的联系。

edges.toName: 运算顺序 · 发现运算与图形结构
edges.fromGoal: Compare and classify geometric shapes based on their properties and sizes; understand that attributes belonging to a category also belong to all subcategories; classify two-dimensional figures in a hierarchy based on properties
edges.toGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: exploit the hierarchy of 2-D shapes to deduce properties; use order of operations and algebraic structure to simplify expressions; connect fraction–decimal–percentage equivalences; use ratio structure to solve proportion problems efficiently
edges.sourceReason: Shape hierarchy exploits structural relationships
edges.chineseReason: 图形类别之间的包含关系，可以通过比较边、角等结构来理解。

edges.fromName: 分数乘法 · 分数乘整数
edges.toName: 分数的意义 · 分数乘整数的情境
edges.fromGoal: Understand a/b as a multiple of 1/b; multiply proper fractions and mixed numbers by whole numbers, supported by visual models (e.g. 3 × 2/5 = 6/5 = 1 1/5)
edges.toGoal: Solve word problems involving multiplication of a fraction by a whole number using visual models and equations
edges.sourceReason: Must multiply fraction by whole number before solving word problems
edges.chineseReason: 在情境中求一个分数的几倍时，可以用分数乘整数表示。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the multiples of 10 (10, 20, 30 … 90) represent one to nine tens and 0 ones
edges.toGoal: Subtract multiples of 10 (10–90) from multiples of 10 using place value strategies
edges.sourceReason: Subtracting multiples of 10 requires understanding decade numbers as tens
edges.chineseReason: 整十数可以看成若干个十，减去整十数时可以观察十的数量怎样变化。

edges.fromName: 拿走与分开：减法的意义
edges.fromGoal: Understand subtraction as taking away or separating from a group to find how many remain
edges.toGoal: Subtract multiples of 10 (10–90) from multiples of 10 using place value strategies
edges.sourceReason: Subtracting multiples of 10 requires understanding subtraction
edges.chineseReason: 减去整十数仍可表示拿走或比较数量之间的差。

edges.fromName: 因数、倍数与质数 · 因数对与公倍数
edges.toName: 运算、分数与图形的结构
edges.fromGoal: Find all factor pairs for a whole number in the range 1–100; identify common factors and common multiples of two numbers; use these concepts to solve problems
edges.toGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: exploit the relationship between fractions, decimals, and percentages; use factor pairs to simplify multiplication; apply angle facts to find unknowns; use properties of regular polygons systematically
edges.sourceReason: Factor pairs as structural tool for simplifying multiplication
edges.chineseReason: 把乘积拆成合适的因数对，可以帮助发现并利用计算结构。

edges.toName: 运算、分数与图形的结构
edges.fromGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: exploit place-value patterns for ×10/×100, use the distributive property to break apart multiplications, apply fraction equivalence to compare and compute, use shape properties to classify quadrilaterals
edges.toGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: exploit the relationship between fractions, decimals, and percentages; use factor pairs to simplify multiplication; apply angle facts to find unknowns; use properties of regular polygons systematically
edges.sourceReason: Age 8-9 using structure is prerequisite to age 9-10 level
edges.chineseReason: 数位、分配律和等值表示等结构，都可以帮助选择合适的计算方法。

edges.toName: 运算、分数与图形的结构
edges.fromGoal: Know that angles at a point sum to 360° (one whole turn), angles on a straight line sum to 180°, and vertically opposite angles are equal; use these facts to find missing angles
edges.toGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: exploit the relationship between fractions, decimals, and percentages; use factor pairs to simplify multiplication; apply angle facts to find unknowns; use properties of regular polygons systematically
edges.sourceReason: Angle facts (360°, 180°) are structural tools for finding unknowns
edges.chineseReason: 利用平角和周角关系寻找未知角，是利用图形结构解决问题的例子。

edges.fromGoal: Solve comparison, sum, and difference problems using information presented in a line graph
edges.toGoal: Construct and interpret line graphs for continuous data (e.g. temperature over time, plant growth); read intermediate values, identify trends, and solve comparison and difference problems
edges.sourceReason: Y6 line graph construction and interpretation directly extends Y5 line graph problem-solving
edges.chineseReason: 根据折线图回答问题的经验，可以帮助检查自己绘制的图是否清楚。

edges.fromName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 收集和图表词语
edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and use the vocabulary of data collection and display — data, tally, tally chart, frequency, frequency table, survey, pictogram, bar chart, axis/axes, scale, label, category, discrete data, continuous data, line graph, pie chart — and apply these terms when collecting, organising, and presenting data
edges.toGoal: Construct and interpret line graphs for continuous data (e.g. temperature over time, plant growth); read intermediate values, identify trends, and solve comparison and difference problems
edges.sourceReason: Constructing and interpreting line graphs requires vocabulary: axis, scale, continuous data, line graph
edges.chineseReason: 理解坐标轴、刻度和连续数据等词语，有助于绘制和阅读折线图。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise that in a multi-digit number, a digit in one place represents 10 times as much as in the place to its right and 1/10 of what it represents in the place to its left
edges.toGoal: Explain patterns in zeros when multiplying by powers of 10 and in decimal-point placement when multiplying/dividing by a power of 10; use whole-number exponents to denote powers of 10 (e.g. 10³ = 1000)
edges.sourceReason: Exponent notation for powers of 10 builds on ×10 relationship
edges.chineseReason: 10的幂表示反复乘10，可以与数位之间的10倍关系联系起来。

edges.fromGoal: Multiply and divide whole numbers and those involving decimals by 10, 100, and 1000
edges.toGoal: Explain patterns in zeros when multiplying by powers of 10 and in decimal-point placement when multiplying/dividing by a power of 10; use whole-number exponents to denote powers of 10 (e.g. 10³ = 1000)
edges.sourceReason: Patterns in zeros when ×÷ by powers of 10 builds on fluent ×÷ by 10/100/1000
edges.chineseReason: 乘除10、100和1000可以帮助观察按10的幂变化时数位的规律。

edges.fromGoal: Count in multiples of 2, 5, and 10 (skip counting)
edges.toGoal: Determine whether a group of objects (up to 20) has an odd or even number of members
edges.sourceReason: Odd/even requires counting by 2s (skip counting)
edges.chineseReason: 两个一组地数，可以观察数量是否恰好分成两两一组。

edges.fromGoal: Understand addition as combining or putting together two groups to find the total
edges.toGoal: Determine whether a group of objects (up to 20) has an odd or even number of members
edges.sourceReason: Writing even numbers as sum of two equal addends uses addition concept
edges.chineseReason: 一个偶数可以分成两个相等的整数部分，也可以写成两个相同加数的和。

edges.fromName: 比较分数大小 · 单位分数与同分母
edges.toName: 比较分数大小 · 同分子或同分母
edges.fromGoal: Compare and order unit fractions, and fractions with the same denominator
edges.toGoal: Compare two fractions with the same numerator or the same denominator by reasoning about size; record comparisons with >, =, or < symbols
edges.sourceReason: Same-denominator comparison experience is prerequisite to same-numerator comparison
edges.chineseReason: 比较相同分母的分数后，可以再观察分子相同时分母变化怎样影响大小。

edges.fromName: 分数的意义 · 整体中的等份
edges.toName: 比较分数大小 · 同分子或同分母
edges.fromGoal: Understand a fraction 1/b as the quantity formed by 1 part when a whole is partitioned into b equal parts; understand a/b as a parts of size 1/b
edges.toGoal: Compare two fractions with the same numerator or the same denominator by reasoning about size; record comparisons with >, =, or < symbols
edges.sourceReason: Must understand unit fraction size reasoning for same-numerator comparison
edges.chineseReason: 对同一个整体，等分得越多，每一份越小；这有助于比较相同分子的分数。

edges.fromGoal: Tell and write the time to the hour and half past the hour on analogue clocks and digital displays (e.g. 3 o'clock = 3:00, half past 7 = 7:30), and draw clock hands to show these times, placing the hour hand halfway between two numbers for half past
edges.toGoal: Tell and write the time to five minutes on analogue clocks, including quarter past and quarter to the hour, write these times in digital form, and draw clock hands to show them
edges.sourceReason: Telling time to 5 minutes extends from telling time to the hour and half past
edges.chineseReason: 读懂整时和半时后，可以继续看分钟指针走过的5分钟间隔。

edges.fromGoal: Count in multiples of 2, 5, and 10 (skip counting)
edges.toGoal: Tell and write the time to five minutes on analogue clocks, including quarter past and quarter to the hour, write these times in digital form, and draw clock hands to show them
edges.sourceReason: Reading 5-minute intervals benefits from skip counting in 5s
edges.chineseReason: 钟面上相邻数字之间有5分钟，可以按5跳着数分钟。

edges.fromName: 理解角 · 用角的关系解决多步问题
edges.fromGoal: Apply the properties of angles at a point (360°), on a straight line (180°), and vertically opposite angles to find unknown angles in multi-step problems
edges.toGoal: Understand and use the relationship between parallel lines cut by a transversal: corresponding angles, alternate interior angles, and co-interior (same-side interior) angles; use these to find unknown angles
edges.sourceReason: Parallel line angles build on basic angle properties at points and lines
edges.chineseReason: 利用直线上的角和交点处的角等关系，可以进一步研究平行线中的角。

edges.fromName: 平面图形 · 寻找对称轴
edges.fromGoal: Identify lines of symmetry in 2-D shapes presented in different orientations; recognise line-symmetric figures and draw lines of symmetry
edges.toGoal: Complete a simple symmetric figure with respect to a specific line of symmetry
edges.sourceReason: Must identify lines of symmetry before completing symmetric figures
edges.chineseReason: 找出图形的对称轴，可以帮助确定缺少的另一半应该画在哪里。

edges.fromName: 网格上的图形变换 · 反射、平移与旋转
edges.fromGoal: Represent and carry out geometric transformations on squared paper or a coordinate grid: reflections (in horizontal, vertical, and diagonal mirror lines, including the axes), translations (described as a vector or as left/right/up/down moves), and rotations (90° or 180° about a stated centre point); describe each transformation precisely using the correct language; identify which transformation maps one shape onto its image by comparing position, orientation, and size
edges.toGoal: Complete a simple symmetric figure with respect to a specific line of symmetry
edges.sourceReason: Completing a symmetric figure requires performing a reflection on a grid accurately
edges.chineseReason: 在网格上反射图形，可以检查图形两侧是否关于对称轴对应。

edges.fromGoal: Use algebraic methods to solve linear equations in one variable, including equations that require rearrangement, expanding brackets, and collecting terms on both sides; solve equations with rational number coefficients
edges.toGoal: Find the nth-term expression for an arithmetic sequence by identifying the common difference and the zero-term, and use it to determine any term in the sequence or test whether a given number belongs to the sequence
edges.sourceReason: Testing whether a number is in a sequence requires solving a linear equation
edges.chineseReason: 把一个数代入数列的规则并寻找对应的项数，可以用到解方程。

edges.fromGoal: Generate terms of a sequence from a term-to-term rule (e.g., 'add 3 each time') or a position-to-term rule (e.g., '2n + 1'), and identify whether a sequence is arithmetic, geometric, or neither
edges.toGoal: Find the nth-term expression for an arithmetic sequence by identifying the common difference and the zero-term, and use it to determine any term in the sequence or test whether a given number belongs to the sequence
edges.sourceReason: Finding nth term requires experience generating and classifying sequences first
edges.chineseReason: 先按规则生成数列，有助于观察项数与每一项之间的关系。

edges.fromName: 平面图形 · 边与对称
edges.toName: 平面图形 · 寻找对称轴
edges.fromGoal: Identify and describe properties of 2-D shapes including the number of sides and line symmetry in a vertical line
edges.toGoal: Identify lines of symmetry in 2-D shapes presented in different orientations; recognise line-symmetric figures and draw lines of symmetry
edges.sourceReason: Vertical line symmetry in Y2 is prerequisite to finding symmetry lines in multiple orientations
edges.chineseReason: 找过竖直方向的对称轴后，可以转动图形，继续寻找其他方向的对称轴。

edges.fromName: 网格上的图形变换 · 反射、平移与旋转
edges.toName: 平面图形 · 寻找对称轴
edges.fromGoal: Represent and carry out geometric transformations on squared paper or a coordinate grid: reflections (in horizontal, vertical, and diagonal mirror lines, including the axes), translations (described as a vector or as left/right/up/down moves), and rotations (90° or 180° about a stated centre point); describe each transformation precisely using the correct language; identify which transformation maps one shape onto its image by comparing position, orientation, and size
edges.toGoal: Identify lines of symmetry in 2-D shapes presented in different orientations; recognise line-symmetric figures and draw lines of symmetry
edges.sourceReason: Identifying lines of symmetry requires the ability to draw and interpret reflection on a grid
edges.chineseReason: 在网格上比较反射前后的图形，可以帮助寻找对称轴。

edges.fromGoal: Understand division as sharing equally into groups or as grouping (how many groups of a given size can be made)
edges.toGoal: Recognise, find, and name a half as one of two equal parts of an object, shape, or quantity
edges.sourceReason: Finding a half requires equal sharing into 2 groups — a division concept
edges.chineseReason: 把一个整体平均分成两份，每份都是这个整体的一半。

edges.fromName: 坐标 · 连点组成图形
edges.fromGoal: Plot specified points on a coordinate grid and draw sides to complete a given polygon
edges.toGoal: Plot and read coordinates in all four quadrants of the Cartesian plane, using positive and negative x- and y-values to describe positions precisely
edges.sourceReason: GB route: plotting points and completing polygons in the first quadrant (Year 4) is the groundwork that four-quadrant plotting extends; soft because this node is GB-only and US learners get the same groundwork from 5.G.2
edges.chineseReason: 先在一个象限中按坐标放点，再把同样的坐标方法扩展到其他象限。

edges.fromName: 坐标 · 用负数描述位置
edges.fromGoal: Describe positions on the full coordinate grid (all four quadrants); use coordinates with negative values
edges.toGoal: Plot and read coordinates in all four quadrants of the Cartesian plane, using positive and negative x- and y-values to describe positions precisely
edges.sourceReason: GB route: Year 6 introduces all four quadrants, which KS3 revisits and consolidates; soft because this node is GB-only
edges.chineseReason: 用正负数表示位置，可以帮助读写四个象限中的坐标。

edges.fromGoal: Plot and read ordered pairs in the first quadrant of the coordinate plane; represent real-world and mathematical problems by graphing points and interpreting coordinate values in context
edges.toGoal: Plot and read coordinates in all four quadrants of the Cartesian plane, using positive and negative x- and y-values to describe positions precisely
edges.sourceReason: US route: plotting and reading ordered pairs in the first quadrant (5.G.2) is the groundwork that four-quadrant plotting extends; soft because this node is US-only
edges.chineseReason: 理解第一象限中的有序数对后，可以继续观察四个象限中的点。

edges.fromName: 数轴上的分数 · 正负数的顺序与比较
edges.fromGoal: Order positive and negative integers, decimals, and fractions on a number line; use the symbols =, ≠, <, >, ≤, ≥ to compare values including negative numbers and mixed representations
edges.toGoal: Plot and read coordinates in all four quadrants of the Cartesian plane, using positive and negative x- and y-values to describe positions precisely
edges.sourceReason: Plotting coordinates in all four quadrants requires understanding positive and negative values on both axes
edges.chineseReason: 四象限坐标的横轴和纵轴都包含正数与负数，需要按对应顺序确定位置。

edges.toName: 理解分数 · 准确使用词语与符号
edges.fromGoal: Measure, compare, add, and subtract lengths (m/cm/mm), mass (kg/g), and volume/capacity (l/ml) using standard units
edges.toGoal: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct place-value and fraction vocabulary, specify units in measurement answers, and use notation accurately
edges.sourceReason: Specifying units in measurement exercises precision
edges.chineseReason: 记录测量结果时说明单位，是准确交流数学信息的一部分。

edges.toName: 理解分数 · 准确使用词语与符号
edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract fractions with the same denominator within one whole (e.g. 5/7 + 1/7 = 6/7)
