edges.toGoal: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct place-value and fraction vocabulary, specify units in measurement answers, and use notation accurately
edges.sourceReason: Fraction notation exercises precise communication
edges.chineseReason: 准确书写分数的分子、分母和符号，可以让别人明白表示的数量。

edges.toName: 理解分数 · 准确使用词语与符号
edges.fromGoal: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct vocabulary, specify units, and use symbols accurately
edges.toGoal: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct place-value and fraction vocabulary, specify units in measurement answers, and use notation accurately
edges.sourceReason: Age 7-8 precision builds on age 6-7
edges.chineseReason: 清楚使用数学词语和符号，可以帮助准确说明分数与测量结果。

edges.fromName: 图形的二分之一与四分之一
edges.fromGoal: Partition circles and rectangles into two and four equal shares and describe them using the words halves, fourths, and quarters
edges.toGoal: Understand that decomposing a shape into more equal shares creates smaller shares
edges.sourceReason: Comparing share sizes requires experience partitioning into halves and quarters
edges.chineseReason: 把图形平分成两份或四份后，可以继续比较分得更细时每份的大小。

edges.toName: 数轴上的数 · 不等式的解
edges.fromGoal: Use algebraic methods to solve linear equations in one variable, including equations that require rearrangement, expanding brackets, and collecting terms on both sides; solve equations with rational number coefficients
edges.toGoal: Understand inequalities as statements comparing expressions, represent solutions on a number line, and solve simple linear inequalities using the same inverse-operation methods as equations
edges.sourceReason: Solving inequalities uses the same inverse-operation methods as solving equations
edges.chineseReason: 解不等式也会用到逆运算；两边乘或除负数时，要改变不等号方向。

edges.fromName: 数轴上的分数 · 正负数的顺序与比较
edges.toName: 数轴上的数 · 不等式的解
edges.fromGoal: Order positive and negative integers, decimals, and fractions on a number line; use the symbols =, ≠, <, >, ≤, ≥ to compare values including negative numbers and mixed representations
edges.toGoal: Understand inequalities as statements comparing expressions, represent solutions on a number line, and solve simple linear inequalities using the same inverse-operation methods as equations
edges.sourceReason: Representing inequality solutions on a number line requires ordering integers, decimals, and fractions together
edges.chineseReason: 在同一条数轴上排列正负整数、小数和分数，有助于表示不等式的解。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise area as additive; find areas of rectilinear figures by decomposing into non-overlapping rectangles and summing their areas
edges.toGoal: Find the area of polygons such as trapezoids, kites, rhombuses, irregular quadrilaterals and other rectilinear or non-rectilinear polygons by decomposition or composition: decompose the shape into rectangles and triangles and add the parts, or compose it into an enclosing rectangle and subtract the pieces outside; record the dimensions used for each piece, check that the pieces neither overlap nor leave gaps, and apply this to real-world problems such as floor plans, gardens and signs, giving answers in square units. The focus is the decomposition and composition strategy, which works for any polygon whether or not a dedicated formula is known
edges.sourceReason: Decomposing rectilinear figures into rectangles and adding their areas is the first experience of area as additive
edges.chineseReason: 把组合图形拆成不重叠的长方形，分别求面积后相加，可以得到整体面积。

edges.fromName: 三角形与平行四边形面积
edges.fromGoal: Find the area of parallelograms and triangles by relating them to rectangles: rearrange a parallelogram (cut off a triangle and move it) into a rectangle with the same base and perpendicular height; see a right triangle as half of a rectangle and any triangle as half of a parallelogram (or as two right triangles); use the resulting formulae A = b × h for parallelograms and A = ½ × b × h for triangles, always using the perpendicular height rather than a slanted side, including when the height falls outside an obtuse triangle; and recognise when an area formula can be used (rectangles, parallelograms, triangles) and when another method is needed, such as counting or estimating squares for an irregular shape
edges.toGoal: Find the area of polygons such as trapezoids, kites, rhombuses, irregular quadrilaterals and other rectilinear or non-rectilinear polygons by decomposition or composition: decompose the shape into rectangles and triangles and add the parts, or compose it into an enclosing rectangle and subtract the pieces outside; record the dimensions used for each piece, check that the pieces neither overlap nor leave gaps, and apply this to real-world problems such as floor plans, gardens and signs, giving answers in square units. The focus is the decomposition and composition strategy, which works for any polygon whether or not a dedicated formula is known
edges.sourceReason: Decomposed or subtracted pieces are mostly triangles and parallelograms, so their areas must be found first
edges.chineseReason: 把图形拆成三角形或平行四边形后，可以分别计算各部分面积。

edges.toName: 坐标 · 连点组成图形
edges.fromGoal: Describe positions on a 2-D grid as coordinates in the first quadrant
edges.toGoal: Plot specified points on a coordinate grid and draw sides to complete a given polygon
edges.sourceReason: Must read/understand coordinates before plotting points
edges.chineseReason: 读懂坐标中横纵两个数的顺序，有助于在网格上放置对应的点。

edges.toName: 坐标 · 连点组成图形
edges.fromGoal: Understand that shapes in different categories may share attributes defining a larger category; classify quadrilaterals (rhombuses, rectangles, squares) and draw examples of quadrilaterals not in those subcategories
edges.toGoal: Plot specified points on a coordinate grid and draw sides to complete a given polygon
edges.sourceReason: Shape classification supports completing polygons on grid
edges.chineseReason: 观察多边形的边和顶点，有助于在网格上连接或补全图形。

edges.fromGoal: Mentally find 10 more or 10 less than a given two-digit number without counting
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract a two-digit number and tens mentally and using concrete/pictorial representations
edges.sourceReason: Adding/subtracting tens builds on mentally finding 10 more or less
edges.chineseReason: 理解一个数多10或少10，可以继续计算多或少几个十。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract a two-digit number and tens mentally and using concrete/pictorial representations
edges.sourceReason: Adding/subtracting tens requires place value understanding
edges.chineseReason: 整十数的加减会改变十的数量；需要结合个位是否换位来判断结果。

edges.fromGoal: Write simple numerical expressions that record calculations with numbers, and interpret numerical expressions without evaluating them (e.g. recognise that 3 × (18932 + 921) is three times as large as 18932 + 921)
edges.toGoal: Express missing number problems algebraically using letters for unknowns; translate word problems into equations
edges.sourceReason: Writing algebraic expressions extends writing/interpreting numerical expressions
edges.chineseReason: 把数量关系写成算式后，可以进一步用字母表示未知数并写成方程。

edges.fromName: 运算顺序 · 四则运算的次序
edges.fromGoal: Understand and apply the conventional order of operations (PEMDAS/BODMAS) to carry out calculations involving the four operations
edges.toGoal: Express missing number problems algebraically using letters for unknowns; translate word problems into equations
edges.sourceReason: Solving equations uses order-of-operations understanding
edges.chineseReason: 解方程或检查结果时，要看清算式里各运算的先后顺序。

edges.fromName: 分数的意义 · 整体中的等份
edges.fromGoal: Understand a fraction 1/b as the quantity formed by 1 part when a whole is partitioned into b equal parts; understand a/b as a parts of size 1/b
edges.toGoal: Partition shapes into parts with equal areas and express the area of each part as a unit fraction of the whole
edges.sourceReason: Must understand unit fractions to express area parts as 1/b
edges.chineseReason: 把整体分成相等小份后，可以用单位分数表示其中一份的面积。

edges.fromGoal: Partition circles and rectangles into two, three, or four equal shares; describe shares as halves, thirds, and fourths; recognise that equal shares of identical wholes need not have the same shape
edges.toGoal: Partition shapes into parts with equal areas and express the area of each part as a unit fraction of the whole
edges.sourceReason: Prior partitioning experience feeds into area-fraction work
edges.chineseReason: 把图形平均分成相同大小的份，可以用分数描述其中的一部分。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise and write decimal equivalents of any number of tenths or hundredths (e.g. 3/10 = 0.3, 27/100 = 0.27)
edges.toGoal: Compare numbers with the same number of decimal places up to two decimal places
edges.sourceReason: Must understand decimal notation to compare decimals
edges.chineseReason: 理解小数各数位的值，可以帮助比较两位小数的大小。

edges.fromName: 小数与分数 · 分数除法与小数百分数
edges.toName: 百分数的应用 · 增减、原值与利息
edges.fromGoal: Associate a fraction with division and calculate decimal fraction equivalents for simple fractions (e.g. 3/8 = 0.375); recall and use equivalences between simple fractions, decimals, and percentages in different contexts
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving percentage increase, percentage decrease, finding the original value after a percentage change, and calculating simple interest
edges.sourceReason: Using decimal multipliers for percentage change requires fraction-decimal fluency
edges.chineseReason: 百分数可以写成分数或小数，用来计算增加或减少后的数量。

edges.toName: 百分数的应用 · 增减、原值与利息
edges.fromGoal: Know and use advanced vocabulary of multiplicative reasoning — direct proportion, inverse proportion, ratio, rate, unit rate, compound unit, scale factor — accurately in problem-solving contexts
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving percentage increase, percentage decrease, finding the original value after a percentage change, and calculating simple interest
edges.sourceReason: Percentage increase/decrease problems use 'rate', 'proportion', and 'multiplicative relationship' vocabulary
edges.chineseReason: 理解百分率、比例和倍数变化，有助于分析百分数增减问题。

edges.toName: 百分数的应用 · 增减、原值与利息
edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving the calculation of percentages of amounts (e.g. 15% of 360) and the use of percentages for comparison
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving percentage increase, percentage decrease, finding the original value after a percentage change, and calculating simple interest
edges.sourceReason: Percentage increase/decrease extends KS2 percentage calculations
edges.chineseReason: 知道怎样求一个数量的百分之几，可以继续处理增加或减少的情境。

edges.toName: 比较分数大小 · 单位分数与同分母
edges.fromGoal: Understand that decomposing a shape into more equal shares creates smaller shares
edges.toGoal: Compare and order unit fractions, and fractions with the same denominator
edges.sourceReason: More shares = smaller helps understand why 1/5 < 1/3
edges.chineseReason: 对同一个整体，平均分成的份数越多，每份越小；例如五分之一小于三分之一。

edges.fromName: 数轴上的分数 · 把分数放上数轴
edges.toName: 比较分数大小 · 单位分数与同分母
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use fractions as numbers: place unit fractions and non-unit fractions with small denominators on a number line
edges.toGoal: Compare and order unit fractions, and fractions with the same denominator
edges.sourceReason: Comparing fractions requires understanding them as numbers on a line
edges.chineseReason: 把分数放在同一条数轴上，可以比较它们的位置和大小。

edges.fromName: 分数的意义 · 分数表示除法
edges.fromGoal: Interpret a fraction as division of the numerator by the denominator (a/b = a ÷ b); solve word problems involving division of whole numbers leading to fractional or mixed-number answers
edges.toGoal: Interpret and compute division of a unit fraction by a non-zero whole number (e.g. 1/3 ÷ 4 = 1/12); use visual models and the relationship between multiplication and division to explain the result
edges.sourceReason: Understanding fraction as division supports interpreting 1/3 ÷ 4
edges.chineseReason: 把三分之一再平均分成4份，可以理解三分之一除以4。

edges.fromName: 分数乘法 · 分数乘分数
edges.fromGoal: Multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction, including proper fractions by proper fractions; interpret (a/b) × q as a parts of q partitioned into b equal parts; write answers in simplest form
edges.toGoal: Interpret and compute division of a unit fraction by a non-zero whole number (e.g. 1/3 ÷ 4 = 1/12); use visual models and the relationship between multiplication and division to explain the result
edges.sourceReason: Unit-fraction ÷ whole uses inverse relationship with fraction multiplication
edges.chineseReason: 把单位分数平均分后，可以用乘法反过来检查商是否正确。

edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators (including mixed numbers) by replacing given fractions with equivalent fractions to produce a common denominator
edges.toGoal: Make a line plot to display a data set of measurements in fractions of a unit (1/2, 1/4, 1/8); use operations on fractions to solve problems involving data in line plots (e.g. redistribute total equally)
edges.sourceReason: Solving problems with fraction data requires unlike-denominator addition
edges.chineseReason: 点图中的数据如果是不同分母的分数，合计时可以先通分。

edges.fromGoal: Make a line plot to display measurement data in fractions of a unit (1/2, 1/4, 1/8); solve problems involving addition and subtraction of fractions using line plot data
edges.toGoal: Make a line plot to display a data set of measurements in fractions of a unit (1/2, 1/4, 1/8); use operations on fractions to solve problems involving data in line plots (e.g. redistribute total equally)
edges.sourceReason: Line plots with fractions extends Y5 line plot with fraction data
edges.chineseReason: 在点图上记录分数测量值时，需要按刻度把每条数据放在对应位置。

edges.fromGoal: Round decimals with one decimal place to the nearest whole number
edges.toGoal: Round decimals with two decimal places to the nearest whole number and to one decimal place
edges.sourceReason: Rounding 1dp to whole (Y4) is prerequisite to rounding 2dp to whole or 1dp
edges.chineseReason: 取小数近似值时，先确定保留到整数位还是十分位，再看下一位。

edges.fromGoal: Compare durations of events and calculate the time taken by particular events or tasks
edges.toGoal: Solve word problems involving elapsed time by adding and subtracting time intervals in minutes, including using a number line
edges.sourceReason: GB route: Year 3 calculating the time taken by events feeds into elapsed-time problem solving; soft because this node is GB-only (both countries keep the hard nearest-minute prerequisite)
edges.chineseReason: 比较两个时刻之间的间隔，可以帮助分析经过了多久。

edges.fromGoal: Tell, write and estimate the time to the nearest minute on analogue and digital clocks, using vocabulary such as o'clock, a.m./p.m., morning, afternoon, noon and midnight; record and compare times and durations in seconds, minutes and hours
edges.toGoal: Solve word problems involving elapsed time by adding and subtracting time intervals in minutes, including using a number line
edges.sourceReason: Must read time to nearest minute before solving elapsed time problems
edges.chineseReason: 读出开始和结束时刻的分钟数，有助于计算经过的时间。

edges.fromGoal: Find the area of a rectangle with fractional side lengths by tiling with unit-fraction squares; show that the area equals the product of the side lengths
edges.toGoal: Find the volume of a right rectangular prism with fractional edge lengths by packing it with cubes whose edge is a suitable unit fraction of a unit (e.g. 1/2 or 1/4), working out the volume of one such cube (a cube with 1/2-unit edges has volume 1/8 cubic unit), counting the cubes and multiplying; show that this gives the same result as multiplying the edge lengths; and apply V = l × w × h and V = B × h with fractional or mixed-number edge lengths in real-world and mathematical problems
edges.sourceReason: Tiling a rectangle with unit-fraction squares and multiplying fractional side lengths is the two-dimensional version of packing with unit-fraction cubes
edges.chineseReason: 用相同的小块铺满面积或填满体积，可以观察分数边长的乘积怎样表示大小。

edges.fromGoal: Find the volume of right rectangular prisms by packing with unit cubes and show it equals l × w × h (or base area × height); apply V = l × w × h and V = B × h to solve real-world problems; calculate, estimate, and compare volumes of cubes and cuboids in standard units (cm³, m³); and recognise that the formula applies to cuboids, while an irregular solid built from cubes must be counted or split into cuboids
edges.toGoal: Find the volume of a right rectangular prism with fractional edge lengths by packing it with cubes whose edge is a suitable unit fraction of a unit (e.g. 1/2 or 1/4), working out the volume of one such cube (a cube with 1/2-unit edges has volume 1/8 cubic unit), counting the cubes and multiplying; show that this gives the same result as multiplying the edge lengths; and apply V = l × w × h and V = B × h with fractional or mixed-number edge lengths in real-world and mathematical problems
edges.sourceReason: Extends whole-number cube packing and V = l × w × h to fractional edge lengths
edges.chineseReason: 长方体体积可以用长乘宽再乘高；边长是分数时仍可使用这一关系。

edges.fromGoal: Substitute numerical values into formulae and expressions including scientific formulae; evaluate expressions by replacing variables with given values and computing the result using correct order of operations
edges.toGoal: Find the volume of a right rectangular prism with fractional edge lengths by packing it with cubes whose edge is a suitable unit fraction of a unit (e.g. 1/2 or 1/4), working out the volume of one such cube (a cube with 1/2-unit edges has volume 1/8 cubic unit), counting the cubes and multiplying; show that this gives the same result as multiplying the edge lengths; and apply V = l × w × h and V = B × h with fractional or mixed-number edge lengths in real-world and mathematical problems
edges.sourceReason: Applying V = l × w × h with fractional values is substitution into a formula
edges.chineseReason: 把分数边长代入长方体体积公式，可以计算对应的体积。

edges.fromGoal: Round decimals to any place using place-value understanding; round any whole number to a required degree of accuracy
edges.toGoal: Use estimation to check answers to calculations and determine, in the context of a problem, an appropriate degree of accuracy
edges.sourceReason: Determining appropriate accuracy requires rounding skills
edges.chineseReason: 取近似数时，需要先判断保留多少位才能满足所需精度。

edges.fromGoal: Use rounding to check answers to calculations and determine appropriate levels of accuracy in context
edges.toGoal: Use estimation to check answers to calculations and determine, in the context of a problem, an appropriate degree of accuracy
edges.sourceReason: Y6 estimation extends Y5 use-rounding-to-check-answers
edges.chineseReason: 用近似数估算结果，可以检查精确计算是否大致合理，但不能保证误差界限。

edges.fromGoal: Represent addition and subtraction using objects, drawings, and mental images
edges.toGoal: Move between a real-world situation and a mathematical representation using concrete objects, drawings, diagrams, tables, number sentences, or bar models
edges.sourceReason: Representing addition/subtraction with objects and drawings is the core exercise of early quantitative reasoning
edges.chineseReason: 把生活中的数量用物品、图形或加减算式表示，是用数学描述情境。

edges.fromName: 加减法应用题 · 10以内的情境
edges.fromGoal: Solve addition and subtraction word problems within 10 using objects or drawings
edges.toGoal: Move between a real-world situation and a mathematical representation using concrete objects, drawings, diagrams, tables, number sentences, or bar models
edges.sourceReason: Solving word problems within 10 with objects requires translating between situation and representation
edges.chineseReason: 用物品或画图表示故事里的数量，有助于把情境转成加减关系。

edges.fromGoal: Understand division as sharing equally into groups or as grouping (how many groups of a given size can be made)
edges.toGoal: Interpret whole-number quotients (e.g. 56 ÷ 8 as the number of objects in each share or the number of equal groups)
edges.sourceReason: Interpreting quotients formalises equal sharing/grouping from Y1
edges.chineseReason: 平均分和分组是理解除法商的两种情境：每份多少，或能分成几份。

edges.fromName: 加减法应用题 · 长度情境
edges.toName: 用数学表示测量、钱和时间
edges.fromGoal: Solve word problems involving lengths within 100, using addition and subtraction with drawings and equations
edges.toGoal: Model real-world problems involving measurement, money, and time by choosing appropriate representations and interpreting results in context
edges.sourceReason: Length word problems exercise real-world modelling
edges.chineseReason: 用图形和加减表示长度问题，是把测量情境转成数学关系的例子。

edges.fromName: 把数学与生活联系起来
edges.toName: 用数学表示测量、钱和时间
edges.fromGoal: Represent real-world problems with number sentences, bar models, or diagrams, and interpret the mathematical result back in context
edges.toGoal: Model real-world problems involving measurement, money, and time by choosing appropriate representations and interpreting results in context
edges.sourceReason: Age 7-8 modelling builds on age 6-7
edges.chineseReason: 把生活问题画成图或写成算式后，还要把结果放回原情境理解。

edges.toName: 用数学表示测量、钱和时间
edges.fromGoal: Generate measurement data by measuring lengths to the nearest whole unit and display the data on a line plot
edges.toGoal: Model real-world problems involving measurement, money, and time by choosing appropriate representations and interpreting results in context
edges.sourceReason: Line plots from measurement data exercise modelling
edges.chineseReason: 测量长度并用点图记录数据，是把实际测量表示成数学图表的例子。

edges.fromGoal: Use a calculator where appropriate to solve and check practical additive and multiplicative money problems in dollars and cents, reading the display as dollars and cents and checking the result with a quick estimate
edges.toGoal: Use a calculator efficiently and appropriately to solve multi-step addition, subtraction, multiplication and division problems, deciding when a calculator is the best tool and checking the result with an estimate
edges.sourceReason: Year 3 calculator checks for money precede efficient Year 4 calculator use
edges.chineseReason: 用屏幕上的计算操作处理金额后，可以继续比较计算工具适合哪些多步问题。

edges.fromName: 加法与减法 · 四位数竖式
edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract numbers with up to four digits using formal written methods of columnar addition and subtraction
edges.toGoal: Use a calculator efficiently and appropriately to solve multi-step addition, subtraction, multiplication and division problems, deciding when a calculator is the best tool and checking the result with an estimate
edges.sourceReason: Using a calculator well requires understanding the operations it performs
edges.chineseReason: 理解加减乘除各自表示什么，有助于检查计算工具输入的运算是否符合问题。

edges.fromName: 用四舍五入估算 · 估算与逆运算检查
edges.fromGoal: Estimate the answer to a calculation and use inverse operations to check answers; apply to increasingly large numbers using rounding and inverse reasoning
edges.toGoal: Use a calculator efficiently and appropriately to solve multi-step addition, subtraction, multiplication and division problems, deciding when a calculator is the best tool and checking the result with an estimate
edges.sourceReason: Checking calculator results uses estimation by rounding
edges.chineseReason: 先估算数量级，可以帮助检查计算工具显示的结果是否大致合理。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones
edges.toGoal: Multiply one-digit whole numbers by multiples of 10 in the range 10–90 using strategies based on place value and properties of operations
edges.sourceReason: Place-value understanding supports reasoning about tens
edges.chineseReason: 理解数位表示的量，有助于把整十数看成若干个十来计算。

edges.fromGoal: Fluently multiply and divide within 100 using strategies such as the relationship between multiplication and division
edges.toGoal: Multiply one-digit whole numbers by multiples of 10 in the range 10–90 using strategies based on place value and properties of operations
edges.sourceReason: Multiplying by multiples of 10 requires single-digit fluency
edges.chineseReason: 乘整十数时，可以利用相关乘法事实，再结合十的单位。

edges.fromName: 图形规律 · 三位数、乘除与图形
edges.fromGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: apply place-value patterns to three-digit operations, use multiplication/division relationships, and exploit shape properties to classify
edges.toGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: exploit place-value patterns for ×10/×100, use the distributive property to break apart multiplications, apply fraction equivalence to compare and compute, use shape properties to classify quadrilaterals
edges.sourceReason: Age 7-8 using structure is prerequisite to age 8-9 level
edges.chineseReason: 数位、乘除关系和图形分类都是利用数学结构解决问题的例子。

edges.fromGoal: Find the effect of dividing a one- or two-digit number by 10 and 100, identifying the value of the digits as ones, tenths, and hundredths
edges.toGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: exploit place-value patterns for ×10/×100, use the distributive property to break apart multiplications, apply fraction equivalence to compare and compute, use shape properties to classify quadrilaterals
edges.sourceReason: Dividing by 10/100 exercises place-value structural patterns
edges.chineseReason: 比较除以10和100时数位的变化，可以观察十进制结构。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that shapes in different categories may share attributes defining a larger category; classify quadrilaterals (rhombuses, rectangles, squares) and draw examples of quadrilaterals not in those subcategories
edges.toGoal: Look for and use mathematical structure: exploit place-value patterns for ×10/×100, use the distributive property to break apart multiplications, apply fraction equivalence to compare and compute, use shape properties to classify quadrilaterals
edges.sourceReason: Quadrilateral classification exercises using structure (shape hierarchy)
edges.chineseReason: 根据共同特征把四边形分类，可以看见图形类别之间的包含关系。

edges.fromGoal: Estimate the capacity of containers in litres and millilitres by comparing them with known measures (e.g. a 1-litre bottle) and check by filling with water; distinguish a container's capacity (how much it can hold) from the volume of liquid in it. Estimating the volume of solids with 1 cm³ cubes is covered in Counting Unit Cubes
edges.toGoal: Recognise volume as an attribute of solid figures; understand that a unit cube (side length 1 unit) has 'one cubic unit' of volume and can be used to measure volume; a solid packed with n unit cubes has volume n cubic units
edges.sourceReason: GB route: estimating how much containers hold gives experience of volume as an amount of space; soft because this node is GB-only
edges.chineseReason: 估计容器能装多少，有助于理解体积与所占空间的联系。

edges.fromGoal: Measure areas by counting unit squares (square cm, square m, square in, square ft)
edges.toGoal: Recognise volume as an attribute of solid figures; understand that a unit cube (side length 1 unit) has 'one cubic unit' of volume and can be used to measure volume; a solid packed with n unit cubes has volume n cubic units
edges.sourceReason: Measuring volume with unit cubes extends measuring area by counting unit squares, and the evidence contrasts volume with area
edges.chineseReason: 面积可以数单位正方形，体积可以数单位立方体；二者测量的空间不同。

edges.fromName: 测量角 · 量角与画角
edges.fromGoal: Measure angles in whole-number degrees using a protractor; draw given angles and sketch angles of specified measure
edges.toGoal: Select and use tools and representations strategically: choose between mental methods, formal written methods, protractors, fraction strips, and diagrams based on the demands of the problem
edges.sourceReason: Protractor use exercises strategic tool selection
edges.chineseReason: 需要表示或测量角时，可以考虑使用量角器等工具。

edges.fromGoal: Select and use appropriate tools and representations strategically: choose between mental, written, and diagrammatic methods; use calculators for checking; select fraction models suited to the task
edges.toGoal: Select and use tools and representations strategically: choose between mental methods, formal written methods, protractors, fraction strips, and diagrams based on the demands of the problem
edges.sourceReason: Age 8-9 strategic tool use is prerequisite to age 9-10 level
edges.chineseReason: 比较数学工具的用途，可以帮助选择适合当前问题的表示方式。

edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract fractions with denominators that are multiples of the same number by finding a common denominator
edges.toGoal: Select and use tools and representations strategically: choose between mental methods, formal written methods, protractors, fraction strips, and diagrams based on the demands of the problem
edges.sourceReason: Choosing common-denominator approach requires strategic method selection
edges.chineseReason: 面对分数加减，可以判断是否要先通分，再选择合适的表示方式。

edges.fromName: 按特征分类 · 比较各类数量
edges.fromGoal: Interpret categorical data by asking and answering questions about totals, how many in each category, and how many more or less one category has than another
edges.toGoal: Distinguish a statistical question — one that anticipates variability in the data collected to answer it, so its answer must account for that variability (even when it is reported as a single summary value such as a mean or median) — from a question answered by a single fixed fact; for a statistical question, identify the population (who or what is being asked about), the attribute being investigated, and the variation expected in the answers
edges.sourceReason: Experience asking and answering questions about collected categorical data gives the concrete basis for recognising which questions need data that varies
edges.chineseReason: 比较已经收集的类别数据，可以帮助提出需要收集变化数据才能回答的问题。

edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and use the vocabulary of statistical analysis — mean, median, mode, range, frequency, data, sample, average, chart, table, graph, pie chart, scatter graph, correlation — with understanding of what each term describes
edges.toGoal: Distinguish a statistical question — one that anticipates variability in the data collected to answer it, so its answer must account for that variability (even when it is reported as a single summary value such as a mean or median) — from a question answered by a single fixed fact; for a statistical question, identify the population (who or what is being asked about), the attribute being investigated, and the variation expected in the answers
edges.sourceReason: Terms such as data, sample and average help pupils describe the population, attribute and expected variation
edges.chineseReason: 理解数据、样本和平均数等词语，有助于说明统计问题研究的对象和特征。

edges.toName: 从重复推理中概括规律
edges.fromGoal: Find unknown angles in triangles, quadrilaterals, and regular polygons using angle sum properties
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: describe algebraic rules for nth terms, use properties of operations to simplify, and verify generalisations with specific cases
edges.sourceReason: Generalising polygon angle sums exemplifies repeated reasoning
edges.chineseReason: 观察把多边形分成三角形的做法，可以帮助探索内角和的规律。

edges.toName: 从重复推理中概括规律
edges.fromGoal: Generate and describe linear number sequences, including those with negative and decimal steps; identify the term-to-term rule
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: describe algebraic rules for nth terms, use properties of operations to simplify, and verify generalisations with specific cases
edges.sourceReason: Linear sequences are key Y6 generalisation context
edges.chineseReason: 等差数列中相邻两项的差相同，可以用这一重复关系概括并预测数列。

edges.toName: 从重复推理中概括规律
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend patterns in equivalent fractions and percentage conversions, derive unknown facts from known facts, describe general rules for sequences and predict terms
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: describe algebraic rules for nth terms, use properties of operations to simplify, and verify generalisations with specific cases
edges.sourceReason: Y6 generalisation extends Y5 repeated reasoning
edges.chineseReason: 从等值分数的重复变化中概括规律，可以继续练习用一般表达式描述规律。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones
edges.toGoal: Find 10 or 100 more or less than a given number up to 1000
edges.sourceReason: Requires three-digit place value to understand which digit changes
edges.chineseReason: 理解百位、十位和个位的值，有助于判断多或少10、100后的变化。

edges.fromGoal: Mentally find 10 more or 10 less than a given two-digit number without counting
edges.toGoal: Find 10 or 100 more or less than a given number up to 1000
edges.sourceReason: Finding 10/100 more/less within 1000 extends finding 10 more/less of two-digit numbers
edges.chineseReason: 理解多或少10后，可以继续比较多或少100对数位的影响。

edges.fromGoal: Count in multiples of 2, 5, and 10 (skip counting)
edges.toGoal: Count from 0 in multiples of 4, 8, 50, and 100
edges.sourceReason: Counting in 4s and 8s extends prior skip counting in 2s, 5s, 10s
edges.chineseReason: 已经尝试过按固定数量跳数后，可以继续尝试每次跳4或8。

edges.toName: 三角形与多边形的内角和
edges.fromGoal: Find unknown angles in triangles, quadrilaterals, and regular polygons using angle sum properties
edges.toGoal: Derive and use the angle sum in a triangle (180°), use it to deduce the angle sum in any polygon ((n−2) × 180°), and calculate interior and exterior angles of regular polygons
edges.sourceReason: Extends KS2 angle sums in triangles and quadrilaterals to general polygons
edges.chineseReason: 把简单多边形分成三角形，可以用三角形内角和帮助探索多边形内角和。

edges.toName: 三角形与多边形的内角和
edges.fromGoal: Use and interpret algebraic notation including: ab for a × b, 3y for y + y + y, a² for a × a, a/b for a ÷ b, coefficients as fractions, and brackets for grouping; read and write algebraic expressions fluently
edges.toGoal: Derive and use the angle sum in a triangle (180°), use it to deduce the angle sum in any polygon ((n−2) × 180°), and calculate interior and exterior angles of regular polygons
edges.sourceReason: Expressing angle sum as (n-2)×180 requires algebraic notation for the general formula
edges.chineseReason: 用n表示简单多边形的边数，可以把内角和写成(n−2)×180°。

edges.fromName: 理解角 · 用角的关系解决多步问题
edges.toName: 三角形与多边形的内角和
edges.fromGoal: Apply the properties of angles at a point (360°), on a straight line (180°), and vertically opposite angles to find unknown angles in multi-step problems
edges.toGoal: Derive and use the angle sum in a triangle (180°), use it to deduce the angle sum in any polygon ((n−2) × 180°), and calculate interior and exterior angles of regular polygons
edges.sourceReason: Polygon angle sums require fluency with basic angle properties
edges.chineseReason: 利用直线、交点和三角形等角的关系，可以帮助推导多边形的内角和。

edges.toName: 分数乘法 · 求一个量的几分之几
edges.fromGoal: Define percentage as 'number of parts per hundred'; interpret percentages and percentage changes as a fraction or a decimal; express one quantity as a percentage of another; compare quantities using percentages; work with percentages greater than 100%
edges.toGoal: Interpret fractions and percentages as operators — find a fraction or percentage of an amount by multiplying, understanding that 'of' means multiply (e.g., 3/4 of 200 = 3/4 × 200 = 150)
edges.sourceReason: Fractions/percentages as operators requires understanding percentages as fractions/decimals
edges.chineseReason: 百分数可以写成分数，再用分数乘法求一个量的百分之几。

edges.fromName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 简单图表与计数
edges.fromGoal: Interpret and construct simple pictograms, tally charts, block diagrams, and simple tables
edges.toGoal: Conduct simple probability experiments — flipping a coin, rolling a die, pulling coloured counters from a bag — record results, and compare experimental outcomes with expected theoretical outcomes
edges.sourceReason: Recording probability experiment results in tally charts uses the data-recording skills taught in Data & Statistics
edges.chineseReason: 用计数标记记录随机实验各结果的次数，可以帮助比较结果。

edges.fromGoal: Use probability language to describe and compare the likelihood of everyday events using words such as certain, likely, even chance, unlikely, impossible
edges.toGoal: Conduct simple probability experiments — flipping a coin, rolling a die, pulling coloured counters from a bag — record results, and compare experimental outcomes with expected theoretical outcomes
edges.sourceReason: Conducting probability experiments and describing results requires knowing the language used to describe likelihood
edges.chineseReason: 描述结果可能性时，可以用不可能、可能和一定等词语表达。

edges.fromName: 理解分数 · 多步论证与检错
edges.fromGoal: Construct and present logical mathematical arguments involving multiple steps; critique others' reasoning about fractions, angles, or calculations and clearly explain errors or alternative methods
edges.toGoal: Construct and present logical mathematical arguments involving multiple steps and formal reasoning; critique others' reasoning about fractions, algebra, ratio, or geometry and clearly explain errors or alternative approaches
edges.sourceReason: Y6 formal reasoning extends Y5 multi-step argument construction
edges.chineseReason: 构建数学论证时，可以连接多步理由并检查每一步是否成立。

edges.fromGoal: Find unknown angles in triangles, quadrilaterals, and regular polygons using angle sum properties
edges.toGoal: Construct and present logical mathematical arguments involving multiple steps and formal reasoning; critique others' reasoning about fractions, algebra, ratio, or geometry and clearly explain errors or alternative approaches
edges.sourceReason: Angle-based proofs draw on angle sum knowledge
edges.chineseReason: 利用三角形的角度关系，可以为图形结论提供推理依据。

edges.fromGoal: Interpret multiplication as scaling (resizing): compare the size of a product to a factor based on the size of the other factor without computing; explain the effect of multiplying by fractions greater than, equal to, or less than 1
edges.toGoal: Construct and present logical mathematical arguments involving multiple steps and formal reasoning; critique others' reasoning about fractions, algebra, ratio, or geometry and clearly explain errors or alternative approaches
edges.sourceReason: Disproving 'multiplication always makes bigger' uses scaling concept
edges.chineseReason: 一个正数乘以小于1的正数会缩小；这样的例子可以检验“乘法总使数变大”的说法。

edges.fromGoal: Use mathematical vocabulary to describe position, direction, and movement, including straight lines and distinguishing rotation as a turn in terms of right angles (quarter, half, three-quarter turns, clockwise and anti-clockwise)
edges.toGoal: Describe positions on a 2-D grid as coordinates in the first quadrant
edges.sourceReason: Position/direction vocabulary supports understanding coordinate grid
edges.chineseReason: 左右、上下等位置词语，有助于理解第一象限中坐标轴指向的方向。

edges.fromName: 图形规律 · 按规则生成图形或数列
edges.fromGoal: Generate a number or shape pattern that follows a given rule; identify apparent features of the pattern not explicit in the rule and explain informally why they occur
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend patterns in equivalent fractions and percentage conversions, derive unknown facts from known facts, describe general rules for sequences and predict terms
edges.sourceReason: Generating patterns from rules exercises repeated reasoning and generalisation
edges.chineseReason: 根据规则生成图形或数列，可以练习观察重复变化并概括规律。

edges.fromName: 乘法口诀与乘法表 · 从已知规律推出新事实
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend patterns in times tables and equivalent fractions, derive unknown facts from known facts efficiently, describe general rules
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend patterns in equivalent fractions and percentage conversions, derive unknown facts from known facts, describe general rules for sequences and predict terms
edges.sourceReason: Age 8-9 repeated reasoning is prerequisite to age 9-10 level
edges.chineseReason: 观察乘法表和等值分数的重复变化，可以帮助概括百分数和分数之间的规律。

edges.fromName: 等值分数 · 同倍变化
edges.fromGoal: Explain why a fraction a/b is equivalent to (n×a)/(n×b) using visual models; use this principle to recognise and generate equivalent fractions, including tenths and hundredths
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend patterns in equivalent fractions and percentage conversions, derive unknown facts from known facts, describe general rules for sequences and predict terms
edges.sourceReason: Equivalent fraction patterns exercise generalisation
edges.chineseReason: 观察等值分数中重复出现的变化，可以练习概括规律。

edges.fromName: 测量角 · 量角与画角
edges.fromGoal: Measure angles in whole-number degrees using a protractor; draw given angles and sketch angles of specified measure
edges.toGoal: Draw and measure line segments and angles accurately, and construct triangles from given conditions using the drawing approaches the standard calls for: ruler and protractor for two sides and the included angle (SAS) or two angles and the included side (ASA); ruler and compasses for three sides (SSS), using intersecting arcs; and dynamic geometry software; check each construction by measuring the remaining sides and angles (to within about 1 mm and 1°). Interpreting scale drawings is covered in Scale drawings and maps; deciding whether conditions give one, many or no triangles is covered in Which triangles are possible
edges.sourceReason: KS3 drawing/measuring extends KS2 protractor and ruler skills
edges.chineseReason: 用尺子和量角器确定边长与角度，可以帮助按给定条件画三角形。

edges.fromName: 平面图形 · 按尺寸和角度画图
edges.fromGoal: Draw 2-D shapes using given dimensions and angles, using a ruler and protractor accurately
edges.toGoal: Draw and measure line segments and angles accurately, and construct triangles from given conditions using the drawing approaches the standard calls for: ruler and protractor for two sides and the included angle (SAS) or two angles and the included side (ASA); ruler and compasses for three sides (SSS), using intersecting arcs; and dynamic geometry software; check each construction by measuring the remaining sides and angles (to within about 1 mm and 1°). Interpreting scale drawings is covered in Scale drawings and maps; deciding whether conditions give one, many or no triangles is covered in Which triangles are possible
edges.sourceReason: GB route: Year 6 drawing of 2-D shapes with given dimensions and angles is the groundwork for KS3 accurate drawing; soft because this node is GB-only (both countries keep the hard ruler-and-protractor prerequisite)
edges.chineseReason: 按给定边长和角度绘制平面图形的经验，可以用于更准确地构造三角形。

edges.fromName: 数的读写 · 小数的读写比较
edges.toName: 加减法的策略 · 小数的数位与运算
edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and compare decimals to thousandths using base-ten numerals, number names, and expanded form; compare using >, =, < based on place-value meaning
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract decimals to hundredths using strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction; relate strategies to written methods and explain reasoning
edges.sourceReason: Adding/subtracting decimals requires reading and comparing decimals to thousandths
edges.chineseReason: 先读清小数各数位，再按位对应进行加减。

edges.toName: 加减法的策略 · 小数的数位与运算
edges.fromGoal: Recognise that in a multi-digit number, a digit in one place represents 10 times as much as in the place to its right and 1/10 of what it represents in the place to its left
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract decimals to hundredths using strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction; relate strategies to written methods and explain reasoning
edges.sourceReason: Place-value understanding of ×10/÷10 supports decimal regrouping
edges.chineseReason: 相邻数位相差10倍，这有助于理解小数加减中的换位。

edges.fromName: 熟练使用加减法 · 多位数竖式
edges.toName: 加减法的策略 · 小数的数位与运算
edges.fromGoal: Fluently add and subtract whole numbers with more than four digits using the standard columnar algorithm
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract decimals to hundredths using strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction; relate strategies to written methods and explain reasoning
edges.sourceReason: Decimal addition/subtraction builds on fluent whole-number columnar algorithm
edges.chineseReason: 整数竖式按数位对齐，小数加减也要把相同数位对齐。

edges.toName: 运算顺序 · 四则运算的次序
edges.fromGoal: Use parentheses, brackets, or braces in numerical expressions and evaluate expressions containing these grouping symbols
edges.toGoal: Understand and apply the conventional order of operations (PEMDAS/BODMAS) to carry out calculations involving the four operations
edges.sourceReason: The full BODMAS/PEMDAS convention extends understanding of grouping symbols to all operations
edges.chineseReason: 括号表示分组；完整的运算顺序还规定其他运算怎样先后进行。

edges.fromName: 测量长度 · 选择工具测量
edges.fromGoal: Measure the length of an object by selecting and using appropriate tools such as rulers, yardsticks, metre sticks, and measuring tapes
edges.toGoal: Measure the length of an object using two different length units and describe how the measurements relate to the size of the unit chosen
edges.sourceReason: Must be able to measure with tools before comparing measurements in different units
edges.chineseReason: 用工具测量同一长度后，可以比较用不同单位记录的结果。

edges.fromGoal: Make a line plot to display a data set of measurements in fractions of a unit (1/2, 1/4, 1/8); use operations on fractions to solve problems involving data in line plots (e.g. redistribute total equally)
edges.toGoal: Construct and interpret dot plots for numerical data sets of any kind (counts, scores, times or measurements), extending earlier measurement line plots: draw a number-line scale with equal intervals that runs from at least the minimum to the maximum value, including values nobody recorded so that gaps stay visible; place one dot per observation, stacking repeated values in evenly spaced columns; label the scale with the attribute and its units; and read the plot to find how often a value occurs, the minimum, maximum and most common values, and the total number of observations, recognising that the height of a stack is a count of observations, not a data value
edges.sourceReason: Recent experience of line plots on fractional scales (halves, quarters, eighths) supports choosing an equal-interval scale for any numerical data
edges.chineseReason: 在分数刻度上放点时，刻度间隔应相等；其他数值点图也遵循这一原则。

edges.fromGoal: Generate measurement data by measuring lengths to the nearest whole unit and display the data on a line plot
edges.toGoal: Construct and interpret dot plots for numerical data sets of any kind (counts, scores, times or measurements), extending earlier measurement line plots: draw a number-line scale with equal intervals that runs from at least the minimum to the maximum value, including values nobody recorded so that gaps stay visible; place one dot per observation, stacking repeated values in evenly spaced columns; label the scale with the attribute and its units; and read the plot to find how often a value occurs, the minimum, maximum and most common values, and the total number of observations, recognising that the height of a stack is a count of observations, not a data value
edges.sourceReason: A dot plot is the same display as a line plot: one mark per observation above a number-line scale, with repeated values stacked; Grade 2 line plots first teach this construction
edges.chineseReason: 点图中每个点表示一条记录，相同数值的点可以叠放在同一刻度上。

edges.fromGoal: Write simple numerical expressions that record calculations with numbers, and interpret numerical expressions without evaluating them (e.g. recognise that 3 × (18932 + 921) is three times as large as 18932 + 921)
edges.toGoal: Use simple formulae expressed in words or symbols to calculate values (e.g. perimeter = 2 × (length + width))
edges.sourceReason: Interpreting formulae connects to interpreting numerical expressions
edges.chineseReason: 公式和数值算式都用符号表示数量关系，读懂算式有助于解释公式。

edges.fromName: 运算顺序 · 四则运算的次序
edges.fromGoal: Understand and apply the conventional order of operations (PEMDAS/BODMAS) to carry out calculations involving the four operations
edges.toGoal: Use simple formulae expressed in words or symbols to calculate values (e.g. perimeter = 2 × (length + width))
edges.sourceReason: Substituting into formulae requires understanding order of operations
edges.chineseReason: 把数代入公式后，按约定的运算顺序计算结果。

edges.fromGoal: Measure areas by counting unit squares (square cm, square m, square in, square ft)
edges.toGoal: Find the area of a rectangle by tiling it with unit squares and show that the result equals the product of the side lengths
edges.sourceReason: Counting unit squares is prerequisite to connecting tiling to multiplication
edges.chineseReason: 用相同的单位方格铺满图形，数方格可以求出面积。

edges.toName: 数的读写 · 整数的读写比较
edges.fromGoal: Order and compare numbers beyond 1000
edges.toGoal: Read, write, order, and compare whole numbers up to at least 1,000,000 using base-ten numerals, number names, expanded form, and place-value understanding
edges.sourceReason: Comparing beyond 1000 is prerequisite to comparing up to 1,000,000
edges.chineseReason: 比较大数时，可以从较高数位开始比较各位表示的量。

edges.toName: 数的读写 · 整数的读写比较
edges.fromGoal: Recognise that in a multi-digit whole number, a digit in one place represents ten times what it represents in the place to its right (e.g. 700 ÷ 70 = 10)
edges.toGoal: Read, write, order, and compare whole numbers up to at least 1,000,000 using base-ten numerals, number names, expanded form, and place-value understanding
edges.sourceReason: Understanding ×10 place-value relationship supports reading/writing larger numbers
edges.chineseReason: 相邻数位相差10倍，有助于读写和理解更大的整数。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones
edges.toGoal: Recognise the place value of each digit in a four-digit number (thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones)
edges.sourceReason: Four-digit place value extends three-digit place value
edges.chineseReason: 理解百位、十位和个位后，可以继续观察千位表示的量。

edges.fromGoal: Tell and write the time to the hour and half past the hour on analogue clocks and digital displays (e.g. 3 o'clock = 3:00, half past 7 = 7:30), and draw clock hands to show these times, placing the hour hand halfway between two numbers for half past
edges.toGoal: Identify common uses of halves, quarters and eighths in relation to events and time, such as half-time in a game, half an hour, a quarter of an hour, and an activity split into eight equal time parts
edges.sourceReason: Half past on a clock connects to half an hour
edges.chineseReason: 钟面上的半时表示经过半小时，可以与一小时的一半联系起来。

edges.fromName: 二分之一、四分之一与八分之一
edges.fromGoal: Connect halves, quarters and eighths through repeated halving of shapes, objects and collections, and represent eighths of shapes and objects
edges.toGoal: Identify common uses of halves, quarters and eighths in relation to events and time, such as half-time in a game, half an hour, a quarter of an hour, and an activity split into eight equal time parts
edges.sourceReason: Splitting an activity into eighths requires knowing eighths from repeated halving of shapes and objects
edges.chineseReason: 把一段时间平均分成八份，可以用八分之一描述其中一份。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise, find, and name a half as one of two equal parts of an object, shape, or quantity
edges.toGoal: Identify common uses of halves, quarters and eighths in relation to events and time, such as half-time in a game, half an hour, a quarter of an hour, and an activity split into eight equal time parts
edges.sourceReason: Halves of events require understanding a half as one of two equal parts
edges.chineseReason: 把一个事件的时间分成相等的两段，可以说其中一段是一半。

edges.fromGoal: Plot and read coordinates in all four quadrants of the Cartesian plane, using positive and negative x- and y-values to describe positions precisely
edges.toGoal: Identify properties of translations, rotations, and reflections; describe and perform these transformations on given figures, and understand that the image is congruent to the original
edges.sourceReason: Transformations on coordinate grids require confident four-quadrant coordinate work
edges.chineseReason: 在四个象限中确定坐标点，有助于描述图形变换前后的位置。

edges.fromGoal: Draw and translate simple shapes on the coordinate plane; reflect shapes in the axes
edges.toGoal: Identify properties of translations, rotations, and reflections; describe and perform these transformations on given figures, and understand that the image is congruent to the original
edges.sourceReason: KS3 transformations extend KS2 translation and reflection on coordinate plane
edges.chineseReason: 平移和反射的规律，也可以用坐标描述各点的位置变化。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise, find, name, and write fractions 1/3, 1/4, 2/4, and 3/4 of a length, shape, set of objects, or quantity
edges.toGoal: Recognise, find, and write fractions of a discrete set of objects: unit fractions and non-unit fractions with small denominators
edges.sourceReason: Finding fractions of discrete sets extends finding fractions of shapes/quantities
edges.chineseReason: 理解一组数量的几分之一，可以帮助认识单位分数。

edges.fromName: 二分之一、四分之一与八分之一
edges.fromGoal: Connect halves, quarters and eighths through repeated halving of shapes, objects and collections, and represent eighths of shapes and objects
edges.toGoal: Recognise, find, and write fractions of a discrete set of objects: unit fractions and non-unit fractions with small denominators
edges.sourceReason: Halves, quarters and eighths by repeated halving lead into unit fractions
edges.chineseReason: 二分之一、四分之一和八分之一都是整体等分后的一份。

edges.fromGoal: Understand division as sharing equally into groups or as grouping (how many groups of a given size can be made)
edges.toGoal: Recognise, find, and write fractions of a discrete set of objects: unit fractions and non-unit fractions with small denominators
edges.sourceReason: Finding 1/4 of 12 objects connects to division as sharing equally
edges.chineseReason: 把12个物品平均分成4份，每份3个，也就是12的四分之一。

edges.fromName: 测量单位换算 · 长度与时间单位
edges.toName: 用乘法与分数建立模型
edges.fromGoal: Convert between different units of measure (e.g. kilometre to metre, hour to minute, minute to second, year to month, week to day)
edges.toGoal: Model real-world problems involving multiplication, area, fractions, and unit conversion by choosing appropriate representations and interpreting mathematical results in context
edges.sourceReason: Unit conversion exercises modelling with appropriate representations
edges.chineseReason: 在实际测量问题中换算单位，是把生活数量表示成数学关系的一种方式。

edges.toName: 用乘法与分数建立模型
edges.fromGoal: Multiply side lengths to find areas of rectangles and represent whole-number products as rectangular areas
edges.toGoal: Model real-world problems involving multiplication, area, fractions, and unit conversion by choosing appropriate representations and interpreting mathematical results in context
edges.sourceReason: Area of rectangles exercises modelling real-world with multiplication
edges.chineseReason: 用长乘宽求长方形面积，可以把实际空间转成乘法模型。

edges.fromName: 用数学表示测量、钱和时间
edges.toName: 用乘法与分数建立模型
edges.fromGoal: Model real-world problems involving measurement, money, and time by choosing appropriate representations and interpreting results in context
edges.toGoal: Model real-world problems involving multiplication, area, fractions, and unit conversion by choosing appropriate representations and interpreting mathematical results in context
edges.sourceReason: Age 7-8 modelling is prerequisite to age 8-9 level
edges.chineseReason: 把测量、钱或时间的问题表示成数量关系，可以继续用乘法或分数建立模型。

edges.fromGoal: Count in multiples of 6, 7, 9, 25, and 1000
edges.toGoal: Recall multiplication and division facts for multiplication tables up to 12 × 12
edges.sourceReason: Counting in 6s/7s/9s supports learning those table facts
edges.chineseReason: 按6、7或9跳着数，可以观察对应乘法表中乘积的变化。

edges.fromName: 乘法口诀与乘法表 · 3、4、8的乘除事实
edges.fromGoal: Recall and use multiplication and division facts for the 3, 4, and 8 multiplication tables
edges.toGoal: Recall multiplication and division facts for multiplication tables up to 12 × 12
edges.sourceReason: All tables to 12×12 extends knowledge of 3/4/8 tables
edges.chineseReason: 已知的3、4、8乘法事实，可以和其他乘法表事实联系起来。

edges.fromGoal: Compare two objects directly by length or height and describe the difference using language such as long, short, tall, longer, shorter, taller, double, half
edges.toGoal: Measure and begin to record lengths and heights using non-standard and standard units
edges.sourceReason: Measuring length with units requires first being able to compare lengths directly
edges.chineseReason: 先直接比较长度，再用单位测量可以更精确地记录差别。

edges.fromGoal: Apply Pythagoras’ Theorem (a² + b² = c²) to calculate unknown side lengths in right-angled triangles, including in real-world and coordinate-geometry contexts
edges.toGoal: Use the trigonometric ratios sin, cos, and tan in right-angled triangles to find unknown sides and angles, including setting up the correct ratio for a given problem
edges.sourceReason: Trigonometry extends Pythagoras by introducing angle-side relationships
edges.chineseReason: 勾股定理联系直角三角形的三条边；三角函数进一步联系角与边的比。

edges.fromGoal: Understand and use standard mathematical formulae; rearrange formulae to change the subject, performing inverse operations to isolate a different variable
edges.toGoal: Use the trigonometric ratios sin, cos, and tan in right-angled triangles to find unknown sides and angles, including setting up the correct ratio for a given problem
edges.sourceReason: Using trig ratios to find unknowns requires formula rearrangement
edges.chineseReason: 用三角比求未知边或角时，可能需要调整公式并代入已知量。

edges.fromGoal: Describe the distribution of a numerical data set by its centre, spread and overall shape — recognising clusters, gaps, peaks, symmetry or skew (a longer tail on one side) and unusual values — and interpret each feature in the context in which the data were collected, recognising that distributions with similar centres can differ greatly in spread and shape
edges.toGoal: Find the median, lower quartile and upper quartile of a data set using one explicit convention — order the data, find the median, split the data into a lower and an upper half (leaving out the median itself when there is an odd number of values), and take the median of each half as the lower and upper quartile — while recognising that other textbooks, calculators and software may use slightly different conventions; calculate the interquartile range (IQR = upper quartile − lower quartile) and interpret it as the spread of the middle half of the data; and compare what the range and the IQR reveal, including their different sensitivity to extreme values
edges.sourceReason: Recognising skew, long tails and unusual values helps pupils judge when the IQR is the better summary of spread
edges.chineseReason: 观察偏斜、长尾和异常值，可以帮助判断是否用四分位距描述分散程度。

edges.fromGoal: Describe, interpret, and compare observed distributions of a single variable using measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode) and spread (range), including choosing a suitable average and the effect of outliers; comparisons describe the observed data sets themselves and do not yet scale the difference in centres by a measure of variability or generalise from samples to wider populations
edges.toGoal: Find the median, lower quartile and upper quartile of a data set using one explicit convention — order the data, find the median, split the data into a lower and an upper half (leaving out the median itself when there is an odd number of values), and take the median of each half as the lower and upper quartile — while recognising that other textbooks, calculators and software may use slightly different conventions; calculate the interquartile range (IQR = upper quartile − lower quartile) and interpret it as the spread of the middle half of the data; and compare what the range and the IQR reveal, including their different sensitivity to extreme values
edges.sourceReason: Quartiles are medians of each half and the topic compares IQR with range and outliers, all of which are taught in this topic
edges.chineseReason: 四分位数把排序后的数据分成部分；四分位距可与极差一起描述分散。

edges.fromName: 认识十分之一 · 从十分之一到百分之一
edges.fromGoal: Count up and down in hundredths; recognise that hundredths arise when dividing an object by 100 or dividing tenths by 10
edges.toGoal: Find the effect of dividing a one- or two-digit number by 10 and 100, identifying the value of the digits as ones, tenths, and hundredths
edges.sourceReason: Must understand hundredths to identify digit values when dividing by 10/100
edges.chineseReason: 理解十分之一和百分之一，有助于观察除以10或100后各数字的位值。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise and write decimal equivalents of any number of tenths or hundredths (e.g. 3/10 = 0.3, 27/100 = 0.27)
edges.toGoal: Find the effect of dividing a one- or two-digit number by 10 and 100, identifying the value of the digits as ones, tenths, and hundredths
edges.sourceReason: Must know decimal notation to express results of dividing by 10/100
edges.chineseReason: 用小数记录除以10或100的结果，需要看清小数点和各数位。

edges.toName: 认识十分之一 · 从百分之一到千分之一
edges.fromGoal: Use decimal notation for fractions with denominators 10 or 100; read and write decimal numbers as fractions (e.g. 0.62 = 62/100, 0.71 = 71/100)
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use thousandths; relate them to tenths, hundredths, and their decimal equivalents (e.g. 1/1000 = 0.001, 35/1000 = 0.035)
edges.sourceReason: Decimal notation for 10ths/100ths is prerequisite to extending to thousandths
edges.chineseReason: 理解十分位和百分位后，可以继续看千分位表示多少个千分之一。

edges.toName: 理解角 · 长方形中的角和长度
edges.fromGoal: Apply the area formula (l × w) and perimeter formula (2l + 2w) for rectangles including squares in real-world and mathematical problems; calculate and compare areas using standard units (cm², m²) and estimate areas of irregular shapes
edges.toGoal: Use the properties of rectangles to deduce related facts and find missing lengths and angles
edges.sourceReason: Rectangle area/perimeter formulas support finding missing lengths
edges.chineseReason: 知道长方形的面积或周长和部分边长时，可以反过来寻找未知边长。

edges.toName: 理解角 · 长方形中的角和长度
edges.fromGoal: Understand that shapes in different categories may share attributes defining a larger category; classify quadrilaterals (rhombuses, rectangles, squares) and draw examples of quadrilaterals not in those subcategories
edges.toGoal: Use the properties of rectangles to deduce related facts and find missing lengths and angles
edges.sourceReason: Quadrilateral classification supports reasoning about rectangle properties
edges.chineseReason: 长方形属于四边形，可以利用它的边和角的特征推断未知长度或角。

edges.fromGoal: Expand (multiply out) a single term over a bracket using the distributive property, e.g., 3(2x + 5) = 6x + 15; expand expressions involving negative multipliers
edges.toGoal: Expand products of two or more binomials, e.g., (x + 3)(x - 2) = x² + x - 6, using the grid method or FOIL; simplify the result by collecting like terms
edges.sourceReason: Expanding double brackets extends single-bracket expansion using FOIL/grid method
edges.chineseReason: 展开两个括号的乘积时，可以把一个括号中的每项分别乘另一个括号中的每项。

edges.fromGoal: Simplify algebraic expressions by collecting like terms — combine terms with the same variable and power (e.g., 3a + 2b + 5a = 8a + 2b) while maintaining equivalence
edges.toGoal: Expand products of two or more binomials, e.g., (x + 3)(x - 2) = x² + x - 6, using the grid method or FOIL; simplify the result by collecting like terms
edges.sourceReason: Expanding double brackets requires collecting like terms to simplify the result
edges.chineseReason: 展开两个括号后可能出现同类项，合并它们可以化简结果。

edges.fromGoal: Show and tell how a mathematical answer was found using objects, drawings, and spoken words
edges.toGoal: With teacher prompting, explain and justify mathematical reasoning using drawings, number sentences, or words
edges.sourceReason: Age 6-7 explaining with diagrams/logic builds on age 5-6 showing and telling with objects
edges.chineseReason: 先展示做法，再用图形或语言说明每一步为什么成立。

edges.fromGoal: Understand the meaning of the equal sign as 'is the same as' and determine if equations are true or false
edges.toGoal: With teacher prompting, explain and justify mathematical reasoning using drawings, number sentences, or words
edges.sourceReason: Determining whether equations are true/false exercises evaluating and justifying
edges.chineseReason: 判断等式是否成立时，可以解释两边为什么相等或不相等。

edges.fromGoal: Understand and apply the commutative property of addition: addends can be added in any order
edges.toGoal: With teacher prompting, explain and justify mathematical reasoning using drawings, number sentences, or words
edges.sourceReason: Justifying why a+b=b+a exercises logical mathematical argument
edges.chineseReason: 说明交换加数顺序为什么不改变总和，是数学推理的例子。

edges.fromGoal: Recall number bonds (addition and related subtraction facts) within 20
edges.toGoal: Use place value understanding and number facts to solve problems
edges.sourceReason: Using number facts to solve problems benefits from known addition/subtraction facts
edges.chineseReason: 利用已知的数的分合，可以帮助解决新的加减问题。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones
edges.toGoal: Use place value understanding and number facts to solve problems
edges.sourceReason: Using PV to solve problems requires understanding tens and ones
edges.chineseReason: 看清一个两位数由几个十和几个一组成，有助于利用数位计算。

edges.fromGoal: Understand and use standard mathematical formulae; rearrange formulae to change the subject, performing inverse operations to isolate a different variable
edges.toGoal: Use compound units such as speed (distance ÷ time), unit pricing (cost ÷ quantity), and density (mass ÷ volume); solve problems involving compound units
edges.sourceReason: Rearranging compound unit formulae (speed = distance/time) uses formula rearrangement skills
edges.chineseReason: 知道速度、距离和时间的公式后，可以调整等式求其中的未知量。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise and solve problems involving direct proportion (as one quantity increases, the other increases at a constant rate) and inverse proportion (as one increases, the other decreases), including graphical and algebraic representations
edges.toGoal: Use compound units such as speed (distance ÷ time), unit pricing (cost ÷ quantity), and density (mass ÷ volume); solve problems involving compound units
edges.sourceReason: Speed, density, and unit pricing are applications of direct/inverse proportion
edges.chineseReason: 速度、密度和单价等可用两个量的比值表示；固定其他条件时可以研究比例变化。

edges.fromGoal: Know and use advanced vocabulary of multiplicative reasoning — direct proportion, inverse proportion, ratio, rate, unit rate, compound unit, scale factor — accurately in problem-solving contexts
edges.toGoal: Use compound units such as speed (distance ÷ time), unit pricing (cost ÷ quantity), and density (mass ÷ volume); solve problems involving compound units
edges.sourceReason: Compound units (speed, density) require 'compound unit', 'rate', 'speed', and 'density' as named and defined vocabulary
edges.chineseReason: 理解复合单位、速率、速度和密度等词语，有助于解释量的比值。

edges.fromGoal: Represent proportional relationships using double number lines (two parallel number lines aligned at 0) and ratio tables; recognise that equivalent ratios generate straight lines through the origin when graphed
edges.toGoal: Use compound units such as speed (distance ÷ time), unit pricing (cost ÷ quantity), and density (mass ÷ volume); solve problems involving compound units
edges.sourceReason: Compound units like speed and density involve proportional relationships visible on proportion graphs
edges.chineseReason: 速度等复合单位涉及两个量的关系，在条件合适时可以用图像观察变化。

edges.fromGoal: Convert freely between related standard units of measurement (time, length, area, volume/capacity, mass) using decimal notation to up to three decimal places where appropriate
edges.toGoal: Use compound units such as speed (distance ÷ time), unit pricing (cost ÷ quantity), and density (mass ÷ volume); solve problems involving compound units
edges.sourceReason: Compound units require confident unit conversion (e.g. km/h to m/s)
edges.chineseReason: 换算千米每小时与米每秒时，需要分别处理长度单位和时间单位。

edges.fromGoal: Distinguish a population from a sample drawn from it; explain why a convenient or biased sample (choosing whoever is easiest to reach, volunteers, or a group linked to the answer) can misrepresent the population; explain that random selection gives every member of the population an equal chance of being chosen, which tends to produce representative samples — while recognising that any single random sample can still, by chance, be unrepresentative
edges.toGoal: Use measures of centre and variability calculated from random samples of two populations to make informal comparative inferences about those populations (e.g. whether words in a Grade 7 science book are generally longer than words in a Grade 4 science book): check that each sample was randomly drawn from the population it is meant to describe and is reasonably representative; weigh the difference between the sample centres against the variability within the samples and against how much centres vary from one random sample to another; and state qualified conclusions ('generally', 'on average', 'probably') rather than claiming every member of one population exceeds every member of the other — recognising that a small difference between two samples may be due to chance alone
edges.sourceReason: Qualifying a population comparison requires checking that each sample is random and representative of its population
edges.chineseReason: 检查样本怎样抽取、是否可能有偏，有助于判断总体比较的依据有多可靠。

edges.fromGoal: Compare two numerical distributions with similar variability shown on a shared scale (e.g. dot plots) in two distinct ways: (1) judge their actual visual overlap directly from the displays — how much of each group's data lies among the other group's values; and (2) separately, find the difference between their centres and express it as a multiple of a clearly named measure of variability of either group, using matching measures (difference in means ÷ MAD, or difference in medians ÷ IQR), interpreting a larger multiple as centres that are further apart relative to the typical spread. Recognise that the same difference in centres means more when the variability is small, and that for similarly shaped, roughly symmetric, single-peaked distributions a larger multiple usually goes with less overlap — but that the ratio alone does not determine overlap: skew, clusters, gaps or outliers can make the visible overlap greater or smaller than the ratio suggests, so overlap is always checked on the display; and this simple ratio is only appropriate when the two variabilities are similar
edges.toGoal: Use measures of centre and variability calculated from random samples of two populations to make informal comparative inferences about those populations (e.g. whether words in a Grade 7 science book are generally longer than words in a Grade 4 science book): check that each sample was randomly drawn from the population it is meant to describe and is reasonably representative; weigh the difference between the sample centres against the variability within the samples and against how much centres vary from one random sample to another; and state qualified conclusions ('generally', 'on average', 'probably') rather than claiming every member of one population exceeds every member of the other — recognising that a small difference between two samples may be due to chance alone
edges.sourceReason: Weighing the difference between sample centres against the variability within the samples applies the centre-versus-spread comparison to sample data
edges.chineseReason: 比较样本中心之差时，同时看各样本的分散程度，有助于判断差异的大小。

edges.fromGoal: Generate or compare several random samples of the same size from the same population (by drawing physically — returning and remixing the items before each new sample — from a list, or by simulation), observe that their estimates differ by chance, and use the spread of those estimates to judge how uncertain a single estimate or prediction is — distinguishing chance variation between random samples from the consistent error caused by a biased sampling method, and distinguishing variation between sample estimates from the variation among individual observations within a sample
edges.toGoal: Use measures of centre and variability calculated from random samples of two populations to make informal comparative inferences about those populations (e.g. whether words in a Grade 7 science book are generally longer than words in a Grade 4 science book): check that each sample was randomly drawn from the population it is meant to describe and is reasonably representative; weigh the difference between the sample centres against the variability within the samples and against how much centres vary from one random sample to another; and state qualified conclusions ('generally', 'on average', 'probably') rather than claiming every member of one population exceeds every member of the other — recognising that a small difference between two samples may be due to chance alone
edges.sourceReason: Deciding whether a difference between samples could be due to chance requires knowing how much sample centres vary from one random sample to another
edges.chineseReason: 观察不同随机样本的结果怎样变化，可以帮助判断样本间差异可能有多常见。

edges.toName: 数轴上的分数 · 把分数放上数轴
edges.fromGoal: Recognise, find, name, and write fractions 1/3, 1/4, 2/4, and 3/4 of a length, shape, set of objects, or quantity
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use fractions as numbers: place unit fractions and non-unit fractions with small denominators on a number line
edges.sourceReason: Placing fractions on number line requires knowing what fractions are
edges.chineseReason: 理解分数表示相等的份，有助于在数轴上确定分数的位置。

edges.fromName: 认识十分之一 · 分成十份
edges.toName: 数轴上的分数 · 把分数放上数轴
edges.fromGoal: Count up and down in tenths; recognise that tenths arise from dividing an object into 10 equal parts and from dividing one-digit numbers or quantities by 10
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use fractions as numbers: place unit fractions and non-unit fractions with small denominators on a number line
edges.sourceReason: Counting in tenths supports placing fractions on a number line
edges.chineseReason: 在数轴上每次走十分之一，可以把这些分数放到对应位置。

edges.fromGoal: Each successive counting number represents a quantity that is one larger than the previous number
edges.toGoal: Mentally find 10 more or 10 less than a given two-digit number without counting
edges.sourceReason: 10 more/less generalises the concept of one more/one less to tens
edges.chineseReason: 从一个数多1或少1，继续观察多10或少10会怎样变化。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones
edges.toGoal: Mentally find 10 more or 10 less than a given two-digit number without counting
edges.sourceReason: Mentally finding 10 more/less requires understanding that the tens digit changes
edges.chineseReason: 加减10会改变十的数量，遇到换位时也可能影响更高数位。

edges.fromGoal: Express missing number problems algebraically using letters for unknowns; translate word problems into equations
edges.toGoal: Use and interpret algebraic notation including: ab for a × b, 3y for y + y + y, a² for a × a, a/b for a ÷ b, coefficients as fractions, and brackets for grouping; read and write algebraic expressions fluently
edges.sourceReason: Algebraic notation builds on KS2 expressing missing-number problems algebraically
edges.chineseReason: 用字母表示问题中的未知数，可以把数量关系写成方程。

edges.fromGoal: Use simple formulae expressed in words or symbols to calculate values (e.g. perimeter = 2 × (length + width))
edges.toGoal: Use and interpret algebraic notation including: ab for a × b, 3y for y + y + y, a² for a × a, a/b for a ÷ b, coefficients as fractions, and brackets for grouping; read and write algebraic expressions fluently
edges.sourceReason: Using letters in expressions extends KS2 simple formulae work
edges.chineseReason: 公式中的字母可以代表变化的量，理解这一点有助于读写代数式。

edges.toName: 在引导下开展统计调查
edges.fromGoal: Acquire categorical and discrete numerical data to address a question of interest by observing, collecting or accessing a data set, and record it using appropriate methods including frequency tables and spreadsheets
edges.toGoal: Carry out a guided statistical investigation for a question of interest: collect categorical or discrete numerical data, represent it in a suitable display and interpret the results in terms of the question
edges.sourceReason: An investigation requires collecting and recording data for a question
edges.chineseReason: 统计调查先围绕问题收集并记录数据，再根据数据回答。

edges.toName: 在引导下开展统计调查
edges.fromGoal: Draw a scaled picture graph and a scaled bar graph to represent a data set; solve one- and two-step comparison, sum, and difference problems using bar charts, pictograms, and tables
edges.toGoal: Carry out a guided statistical investigation for a question of interest: collect categorical or discrete numerical data, represent it in a suitable display and interpret the results in terms of the question
edges.sourceReason: An investigation requires representing data in a scaled display
edges.chineseReason: 用适当刻度的图表呈现调查数据，可以帮助观察并比较结果。

edges.fromGoal: Understand and apply the commutative property of multiplication and recognise that division is not commutative
edges.toGoal: Apply properties of operations (commutative, associative, distributive) as strategies to multiply and divide
edges.sourceReason: Applying all three properties extends Y2 commutativity understanding
edges.chineseReason: 交换律是一种运算性质，可以与结合律和分配律一起比较。

edges.fromGoal: Interpret products of whole numbers (e.g. 5 × 7 as the total number of objects in 5 groups of 7)
edges.toGoal: Apply properties of operations (commutative, associative, distributive) as strategies to multiply and divide
edges.sourceReason: Using properties requires understanding what multiplication means
edges.chineseReason: 理解乘法中的数量关系，有助于解释乘法相关的运算性质。

edges.fromName: 角的分类 · 锐角与钝角
edges.fromGoal: Identify acute and obtuse angles; compare and order angles up to two right angles by size
edges.toGoal: Name, estimate and compare straight angles, reflex angles and revolutions alongside acute, right and obtuse angles, describing each by its relationship to a right angle (without measuring in degrees)
edges.sourceReason: Straight and reflex angles extend acute, right and obtuse angle names
edges.chineseReason: 认识锐角和钝角后，可以继续比较平角、优角和周角。

edges.fromGoal: Identify right angles; recognise that two right angles make a half-turn, three make three-quarters, and four make a complete turn
edges.toGoal: Name, estimate and compare straight angles, reflex angles and revolutions alongside acute, right and obtuse angles, describing each by its relationship to a right angle (without measuring in degrees)
edges.sourceReason: Relating angles to right angles and full turns requires understanding turns
edges.chineseReason: 角可以表示转动；半圈对应平角，整圈对应周角。

edges.fromGoal: Identify, represent and estimate three-digit numbers using different representations: place a number on a 0–1000 number line marked only in hundreds or unmarked, estimate the value of a marked point, and represent a number with base-ten blocks (hundreds, tens and ones), a place-value chart and a drawing, including numbers with a zero digit and non-standard partitions
edges.toGoal: Identify, represent, and estimate numbers up to 10,000 using different representations
edges.sourceReason: Representing numbers to 10,000 extends representing three-digit numbers to 1000
edges.chineseReason: 表示较大的数时，仍可以用不同数量的千、百、十和一来表达。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise the place value of each digit in a four-digit number (thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones)
edges.toGoal: Identify, represent, and estimate numbers up to 10,000 using different representations
edges.sourceReason: Representing four-digit numbers requires knowing their place value
edges.chineseReason: 理解千位、百位、十位和个位，有助于表示四位数。

edges.fromName: 正多边形与不规则多边形
edges.fromGoal: Distinguish between regular and irregular polygons based on reasoning about equal sides and equal angles
edges.toGoal: Compare and classify geometric shapes based on their properties and sizes; understand that attributes belonging to a category also belong to all subcategories; classify two-dimensional figures in a hierarchy based on properties
edges.sourceReason: Hierarchy includes regular/irregular distinction from Y5
edges.chineseReason: 给多边形分类时，可以比较它们的边和角是否都相等。

edges.fromName: 按边的特征给图形分类
edges.fromGoal: Classify two-dimensional figures based on the presence or absence of parallel or perpendicular lines, or angles of a specified size; recognise right triangles as a category
