edges.fromGoal: Calculate the mean absolute deviation (MAD) of a small numerical data set — find the mean, find each value's distance from the mean (a non-negative number: a value equal to the mean has distance 0), then find the mean of those distances; interpret the MAD as the average distance of the values from the mean, stated in the original units of the data (e.g. minutes, cm, points); and use MADs to compare the spread or consistency of two data sets, recognising that a larger MAD means values typically sit further from the mean and that the MAD is 0 only when every value equals the mean
edges.toGoal: Write a complete summary of a numerical data set in relation to its context, bringing together: the number of observations; the attribute, how it was measured and its units; a measure of centre with a matching measure of variability, each with units, chosen between median with IQR and mean with MAD; the overall pattern and any striking deviations, interpreted in context; and a justification of that choice by the shape of the distribution and the context (e.g. median and IQR for skewed data or data with extreme values, mean and MAD for roughly symmetric data without extreme values)
edges.sourceReason: The summary requires choosing between mean with MAD and median with IQR and justifying the choice by shape, so learners must be able to calculate and interpret the MAD
edges.chineseReason: 平均数与到平均数的平均距离可以一起描述中心和分散，也要结合分布形状判断是否合适。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use language relating to dates, including days of the week, weeks, months, and years
edges.toGoal: Read a calendar to identify today's date and the day of the week for a given date, and determine the number of days between two events
edges.sourceReason: Reading a calendar requires knowing days, weeks and months
edges.chineseReason: 日历用日、周和月组织日期；理解这些时间单位有助于读日历。

edges.fromGoal: Know the number of seconds in a minute and the number of days in each month, year, and leap year
edges.toGoal: Read a calendar to identify today's date and the day of the week for a given date, and determine the number of days between two events
edges.sourceReason: Days in each month help count days between dates
edges.chineseReason: 知道各月的天数，可以帮助计算两个日期之间经过多少天。

edges.fromGoal: Name, represent and order numbers from 0 to at least 20 using physical and virtual materials (number cards, on-screen ten frames and number tracks) and numerals
edges.toGoal: Compare and order two-digit numbers using the symbols >, =, and <, based on place value understanding
edges.sourceReason: Ordering numbers to 20 precedes comparing and ordering numbers to 120
edges.chineseReason: 比较并排列较小的数后，可以继续用相同方法排列更大的数。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones
edges.toGoal: Compare and order two-digit numbers using the symbols >, =, and <, based on place value understanding
edges.sourceReason: Comparing two-digit numbers using PV requires understanding tens and ones
edges.chineseReason: 比较两位数时，先看十位表示的量，再按需要比较个位。

edges.fromGoal: Compare two written numerals between 1 and 10 to determine which is greater or less
edges.toGoal: Compare and order two-digit numbers using the symbols >, =, and <, based on place value understanding
edges.sourceReason: Comparing two-digit numbers extends from comparing single-digit written numerals
edges.chineseReason: 比较一位数的经验，可以继续用于比较两位数。

edges.fromGoal: Identify right angles; recognise that two right angles make a half-turn, three make three-quarters, and four make a complete turn
edges.toGoal: Identify horizontal and vertical lines and pairs of perpendicular and parallel lines
edges.sourceReason: Perpendicular lines require understanding right angles
edges.chineseReason: 两条直线相交成直角时，这两条直线互相垂直。

edges.fromGoal: Describe the position of objects using terms such as above, below, beside, in front of, behind, next to
edges.toGoal: Identify horizontal and vertical lines and pairs of perpendicular and parallel lines
edges.sourceReason: Horizontal/vertical builds on positional vocabulary
edges.chineseReason: 水平和竖直等词语可以描述直线的位置方向。

edges.toName: 用倍数比较 · 读懂倍数比较
edges.fromGoal: Interpret products of whole numbers (e.g. 5 × 7 as the total number of objects in 5 groups of 7)
edges.toGoal: Interpret a multiplication equation as a comparison (e.g. 35 = 5 × 7 means 35 is 5 times as many as 7); represent verbal statements of multiplicative comparisons as equations
edges.sourceReason: Interpreting products is prerequisite to interpreting multiplication as comparison
edges.chineseReason: 乘法不仅可以表示相同的组，也可以表示一个数量是另一个的几倍。

edges.fromName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 简单图表与计数
edges.toName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 收集和图表词语
edges.fromGoal: Interpret and construct simple pictograms, tally charts, block diagrams, and simple tables
edges.toGoal: Read, write, and use the vocabulary of data collection and display — data, tally, tally chart, frequency, frequency table, survey, pictogram, bar chart, axis/axes, scale, label, category, discrete data, continuous data, line graph, pie chart — and apply these terms when collecting, organising, and presenting data
edges.sourceReason: Using tally, frequency and pictogram vocabulary when describing how data is recorded and displayed requires first having read and made simple pictograms and tally charts
edges.chineseReason: 读写简单象形图和计数表后，可以用频数、类别等词语说明记录方式。

edges.toName: 小数的数位与运用 · 按精度取近似值
edges.fromGoal: Round decimals to any place using place-value understanding; round any whole number to a required degree of accuracy
edges.toGoal: Round numbers and measures to an appropriate degree of accuracy including to a specified number of decimal places or significant figures
edges.sourceReason: Rounding to dp/sf extends Y6 rounding to any place
edges.chineseReason: 取小数近似值时，可以按指定小数位或有效数字确定保留的精度。

edges.fromGoal: Use probability language to describe and compare the likelihood of everyday events using words such as certain, likely, even chance, unlikely, impossible
edges.toGoal: Compare the likelihood of different events and order them from least to most likely — including situations with unequal outcomes such as a bag with more of one colour than another, or a spinner with sections of different sizes — and explain reasoning using informal language
edges.sourceReason: Comparing and ordering likelihoods requires first knowing the vocabulary of likelihood (certain, likely, unlikely, impossible)
edges.chineseReason: 理解不可能、可能和一定等词语，有助于比较事件的可能性大小。

edges.toName: 数轴上的分数 · 正负数的顺序与比较
edges.fromGoal: Understand positive and negative numbers as describing quantities with opposite directions or values; use them in context such as temperature, floors in a building, and bank balances
edges.toGoal: Order positive and negative integers, decimals, and fractions on a number line; use the symbols =, ≠, <, >, ≤, ≥ to compare values including negative numbers and mixed representations
edges.sourceReason: Ordering all number types (integers, decimals, fractions) on a number line extends the negative-number number-line representation
edges.chineseReason: 在数轴上表示正负数后，可以继续比较整数、小数和分数的位置。

edges.fromName: 数轴上的分数 · 正负数共用数轴
edges.toName: 数轴上的分数 · 正负数的顺序与比较
edges.fromGoal: Understand and use place value for decimals, measures, and integers of any size; extend the number system to include all positive and negative integers, decimals, and fractions on a single number line
edges.toGoal: Order positive and negative integers, decimals, and fractions on a number line; use the symbols =, ≠, <, >, ≤, ≥ to compare values including negative numbers and mixed representations
edges.sourceReason: Ordering all number types requires understanding place value across the full system
edges.chineseReason: 把不同形式的数放在同一条数轴上，可以比较正负数、分数和小数。

edges.toName: 数轴上的分数 · 正负数的顺序与比较
edges.fromGoal: Use negative numbers in context (temperature, finance, sea level); calculate intervals across zero
edges.toGoal: Order positive and negative integers, decimals, and fractions on a number line; use the symbols =, ≠, <, >, ≤, ≥ to compare values including negative numbers and mixed representations
edges.sourceReason: Ordering with inequality symbols extends Y6 work with negative numbers in context
edges.chineseReason: 温度中的零上和零下提供了比较正负数大小的具体例子。

edges.fromGoal: Expand (multiply out) a single term over a bracket using the distributive property, e.g., 3(2x + 5) = 6x + 15; expand expressions involving negative multipliers
edges.toGoal: Factorise algebraic expressions by taking out common factors — identify the highest common factor of all terms and write the expression as a product, e.g., 6x + 9 = 3(2x + 3)
edges.sourceReason: Factorising is the reverse of expanding — students need expanding fluency first
edges.chineseReason: 展开括号和提取公因式是相反方向的变形，可以用展开检查因式分解。

edges.fromGoal: Understand addition as combining or putting together two groups to find the total
edges.toGoal: Notice simple patterns and structures: spot that changing order doesn't change the total, and recognise how numbers relate to each other
edges.sourceReason: Noticing commutativity of addition exercises spotting structural patterns
edges.chineseReason: 观察两个加数交换顺序后总和不变，可以发现加法中的规律。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the teen numbers (11–19) are composed of ten ones and some further ones (early place value)
edges.toGoal: Notice simple patterns and structures: spot that changing order doesn't change the total, and recognise how numbers relate to each other
edges.sourceReason: Recognising teen numbers as 'ten and some more' exercises noticing structure
edges.chineseReason: 十几可以看成一个十和几个一，这体现了数的组成结构。

edges.fromName: 物体有哪些可测量的量
edges.fromGoal: Describe and identify measurable attributes of objects such as length, height, weight, and capacity; use comparative language (longer, shorter, heavier, lighter, more, less)
edges.toGoal: Compare two objects directly by length or height and describe the difference using language such as long, short, tall, longer, shorter, taller, double, half
edges.sourceReason: Comparing lengths/heights requires first identifying length as a measurable attribute
edges.chineseReason: 先确定比较的是长度或高度，再判断两个物体的这一特征谁大谁小。

edges.fromGoal: Tell and write times to five minutes on analogue and digital clocks with a.m. or p.m. (before or after midday), relating times to daily events and using the words morning, afternoon, evening, noon and midnight. Roman-numeral clock faces and the 24-hour clock are covered in Roman numeral and 24-hour clocks
edges.toGoal: Tell, write and estimate the time to the nearest minute on analogue and digital clocks, using vocabulary such as o'clock, a.m./p.m., morning, afternoon, noon and midnight; record and compare times and durations in seconds, minutes and hours
edges.sourceReason: Tell time to 5 minutes is prerequisite to telling time to nearest minute
edges.chineseReason: 区分上午和下午后，可以更完整地说明读出的具体时刻。

edges.fromGoal: Compare and sequence intervals of time
edges.toGoal: Tell, write and estimate the time to the nearest minute on analogue and digital clocks, using vocabulary such as o'clock, a.m./p.m., morning, afternoon, noon and midnight; record and compare times and durations in seconds, minutes and hours
edges.sourceReason: GB route: Year 2 comparing and sequencing intervals of time is the groundwork for recording and comparing durations in seconds, minutes and hours; soft because this node is GB-only
edges.chineseReason: 比较时间间隔的经验，可以继续用于记录和比较分钟、秒等时长。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise, read and show quarter past and quarter to the hour on an analog clock, linking each to a quarter turn of the minute hand
edges.toGoal: Tell, write and estimate the time to the nearest minute on analogue and digital clocks, using vocabulary such as o'clock, a.m./p.m., morning, afternoon, noon and midnight; record and compare times and durations in seconds, minutes and hours
edges.sourceReason: Reading quarter hours supports reading time to the nearest minute
edges.chineseReason: 钟面上的一刻是15分钟，可作为读出更精确分钟数的参照。

edges.fromName: 平面图形 · 认识常见平面图形
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and name common 2-D shapes (circles, triangles, rectangles including squares)
edges.toGoal: Identify 2-D shapes on the surface of 3-D shapes (e.g. a circle on a cylinder, a triangle on a pyramid)
edges.sourceReason: Must recognise 2-D shapes to identify them on 3-D surfaces
edges.chineseReason: 认识圆、长方形等平面图形，有助于辨认立体物体表面的形状。

edges.fromGoal: Distinguish two-dimensional (flat) shapes from three-dimensional (solid) shapes
edges.toGoal: Identify 2-D shapes on the surface of 3-D shapes (e.g. a circle on a cylinder, a triangle on a pyramid)
edges.sourceReason: Must understand the distinction between 2-D and 3-D to recognise 2-D shapes on 3-D surfaces
edges.chineseReason: 立体物体有空间体积；它的某些平面可以呈现平面图形。

edges.fromName: 立体图形 · 认识常见立体图形
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and name common 3-D shapes (cubes, cuboids, pyramids, spheres, cylinders, cones)
edges.toGoal: Identify 2-D shapes on the surface of 3-D shapes (e.g. a circle on a cylinder, a triangle on a pyramid)
edges.sourceReason: Must recognise 3-D shapes to examine their surfaces
edges.chineseReason: 认识立体图形后，可以观察它有哪些面以及各个面的形状。

edges.fromGoal: Describe positions on a 2-D grid as coordinates in the first quadrant
edges.toGoal: Describe movements between positions as translations of a given unit to the left/right and up/down
edges.sourceReason: Must understand coordinates before describing translations between positions
edges.chineseReason: 用坐标描述移动前后的位置，可以帮助说明移动方向和距离。

edges.fromName: 网格上的图形变换 · 反射、平移与旋转
edges.fromGoal: Represent and carry out geometric transformations on squared paper or a coordinate grid: reflections (in horizontal, vertical, and diagonal mirror lines, including the axes), translations (described as a vector or as left/right/up/down moves), and rotations (90° or 180° about a stated centre point); describe each transformation precisely using the correct language; identify which transformation maps one shape onto its image by comparing position, orientation, and size
edges.toGoal: Describe movements between positions as translations of a given unit to the left/right and up/down
edges.sourceReason: Describing translations on a grid requires the grid-based transformation diagram representation
edges.chineseReason: 在网格上比较图形平移前后的对应点，可以描述向哪个方向移动了多少。

edges.fromName: 加减法口算 · 两位数与一位数
edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract a two-digit number and ones mentally and using concrete/pictorial representations
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract two two-digit numbers using concrete objects, pictorial representations, and mental methods
edges.sourceReason: Adding two two-digit numbers requires ability to add ones to a two-digit number
edges.chineseReason: 两位数加两位数时，可以按十和一拆开，利用已有加法关系计算。

edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract a two-digit number and tens mentally and using concrete/pictorial representations
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract two two-digit numbers using concrete objects, pictorial representations, and mental methods
edges.sourceReason: Adding two two-digit numbers requires ability to add tens to a two-digit number
edges.chineseReason: 两位数加两位数时，可以先加整十数，再处理个位。

edges.fromName: 用排列方阵表示乘法 · 阵列中的相同加数
edges.fromGoal: Use addition to find the total number of objects arranged in rectangular arrays with up to 5 rows and 5 columns; write an equation to express the total as a sum of equal addends
edges.toGoal: Partition a rectangle into rows and columns of same-size squares and count to find the total number of them
edges.sourceReason: Partitioning rectangles into unit squares builds on understanding rectangular arrays
edges.chineseReason: 长方形中的行和列形成矩形阵列，可以用相同单位方格表示。

edges.fromName: 等值分数 · 同倍变化
edges.fromGoal: Explain why a fraction a/b is equivalent to (n×a)/(n×b) using visual models; use this principle to recognise and generate equivalent fractions, including tenths and hundredths
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract fractions with denominators that are multiples of the same number by finding a common denominator
edges.sourceReason: Must generate equivalent fractions to find common denominators
edges.chineseReason: 换成等值分数可以得到共同分母，方便把同样大小的小份相加或相减。

edges.fromGoal: Understand addition and subtraction of fractions as joining and separating parts; decompose a fraction into a sum of fractions with the same denominator in more than one way
edges.toGoal: Add and subtract fractions with denominators that are multiples of the same number by finding a common denominator
edges.sourceReason: Same-denom add/sub is prerequisite to related-denom add/sub
edges.chineseReason: 先理解同样大小的小份怎样相加减，再看不同小份怎样换成共同大小。

edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract one-digit and two-digit numbers to 20, including zero
edges.toGoal: Solve one-step word problems involving addition and subtraction to 20, including missing-number problems
edges.sourceReason: Word problems to 20 require the procedural ability to add/subtract to 20
edges.chineseReason: 把生活故事中的数量关系写成算式后，可以用相应的加减方法计算。

edges.fromName: 加减法应用题 · 10以内的情境
edges.fromGoal: Solve addition and subtraction word problems within 10 using objects or drawings
edges.toGoal: Solve one-step word problems involving addition and subtraction to 20, including missing-number problems
edges.sourceReason: Word problems to 20 extend from word problems within 10 — same problem structures at a higher range
edges.chineseReason: 较小数情境中的合并或分开关系，也可以用于分析20以内的故事问题。

edges.fromGoal: Read and write numbers to at least 100 in words
edges.toGoal: Read and write numbers to 1000 in numerals, number names, and expanded form
edges.sourceReason: Reading/writing to 1000 extends reading/writing to 100
edges.chineseReason: 数字和数词可以表示同一数量。来源涉及英文数词；这里的活动使用中文数词。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones
edges.toGoal: Read and write numbers to 1000 in numerals, number names, and expanded form
edges.sourceReason: Expanded form requires understanding hundreds, tens, ones
edges.chineseReason: 理解百位、十位和个位，有助于读写和展开1000以内的数。

edges.fromName: 理解分数 · 几个相同的小份
edges.fromGoal: Understand a fraction a/b with a > 1 as a sum of fractions 1/b (e.g. 3/5 = 1/5 + 1/5 + 1/5)
edges.toGoal: Understand addition and subtraction of fractions as joining and separating parts; decompose a fraction into a sum of fractions with the same denominator in more than one way
edges.sourceReason: Fraction as sum of unit fractions is prerequisite to decomposing and adding/subtracting
edges.chineseReason: 几个相同单位分数可以相加，也可以拆开来表示同一个分数。

edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract fractions with the same denominator, including results greater than one whole (e.g. 5/8 + 6/8 = 11/8)
edges.toGoal: Understand addition and subtraction of fractions as joining and separating parts; decompose a fraction into a sum of fractions with the same denominator in more than one way
edges.sourceReason: Y4 add/sub fractions same denom is prerequisite to decomposition and joining/separating
edges.chineseReason: 同分母分数表示同样大小的小份，可以通过合并或分开这些份来理解加减。

edges.fromGoal: Organise and represent data with up to three categories by counting objects in each category and sorting categories by quantity
edges.toGoal: Draw a picture graph and a bar graph (with single-unit scale) to represent a data set with up to four categories; solve put-together, take-apart, and compare problems using information presented in a bar graph
edges.sourceReason: Drawing picture/bar graphs extends organising and representing data
edges.chineseReason: 把数据分类并数清数量后，可以用象形图或条形图表示各类结果。

edges.fromGoal: Use and interpret algebraic notation including: ab for a × b, 3y for y + y + y, a² for a × a, a/b for a ÷ b, coefficients as fractions, and brackets for grouping; read and write algebraic expressions fluently
edges.toGoal: Substitute numerical values into formulae and expressions including scientific formulae; evaluate expressions by replacing variables with given values and computing the result using correct order of operations
edges.sourceReason: Substitution requires understanding algebraic notation
edges.chineseReason: 公式中的字母代表数；代入时把对应数值放到相应字母的位置。

edges.fromGoal: Express a fraction with denominator 10 as an equivalent fraction with denominator 100 and use this to add fractions with denominators 10 and 100 (e.g. 3/10 + 4/100 = 34/100)
edges.toGoal: Use decimal notation for fractions with denominators 10 or 100; read and write decimal numbers as fractions (e.g. 0.62 = 62/100, 0.71 = 71/100)
edges.sourceReason: 10ths as 100ths supports using decimal notation for both
edges.chineseReason: 一个十分之一等于十个百分之一，也可以用小数位表示这两种分法。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise and write decimal equivalents of any number of tenths or hundredths (e.g. 3/10 = 0.3, 27/100 = 0.27)
edges.toGoal: Use decimal notation for fractions with denominators 10 or 100; read and write decimal numbers as fractions (e.g. 0.62 = 62/100, 0.71 = 71/100)
edges.sourceReason: Y4 decimal equivalents of 10ths/100ths is prerequisite to formal decimal notation for fractions
edges.chineseReason: 十分之一和百分之一可以写成相应的小数，并对应十分位和百分位。

edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and use decimal and percentage notation correctly — decimal, decimal point, tenths, hundredths, thousandths, percentage, per cent, % symbol, convert, terminating decimal — and understand the relationships between fractions, decimals, and percentages as three ways of expressing the same value
edges.toGoal: Use decimal notation for fractions with denominators 10 or 100; read and write decimal numbers as fractions (e.g. 0.62 = 62/100, 0.71 = 71/100)
edges.sourceReason: Using decimal notation for fractions requires decimal, tenths, and hundredths vocabulary
edges.chineseReason: 理解小数点和各小数位的名称，有助于读写分数对应的小数。

edges.toName: 平面图形 · 画平面图形与建立体图形
edges.fromGoal: Identify and describe properties of 3-D shapes including the number of edges, vertices, and faces
edges.toGoal: Draw 2-D shapes and make 3-D shapes using modelling materials; recognise 3-D shapes in different orientations and describe them
edges.sourceReason: Making/describing 3-D shapes requires knowing their properties (edges, vertices, faces)
edges.chineseReason: 知道立体图形的面、棱和顶点等特征，可以帮助描述或在屏幕上搭建它。

edges.fromName: 平面图形 · 边与对称
edges.toName: 平面图形 · 画平面图形与建立体图形
edges.fromGoal: Identify and describe properties of 2-D shapes including the number of sides and line symmetry in a vertical line
edges.toGoal: Draw 2-D shapes and make 3-D shapes using modelling materials; recognise 3-D shapes in different orientations and describe them
edges.sourceReason: Drawing 2-D shapes requires knowing their properties
edges.chineseReason: 画平面图形时，可以用边的数量等特征检查画出的形状。

edges.fromName: 分数乘法 · 分数乘分数
edges.fromGoal: Multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction, including proper fractions by proper fractions; interpret (a/b) × q as a parts of q partitioned into b equal parts; write answers in simplest form
edges.toGoal: Interpret multiplication as scaling (resizing): compare the size of a product to a factor based on the size of the other factor without computing; explain the effect of multiplying by fractions greater than, equal to, or less than 1
edges.sourceReason: Understanding scaling requires knowing how fraction multiplication works
edges.chineseReason: 把一个量乘以分数，可以观察它按这个分数放大或缩小。

edges.fromName: 等值分数 · 同倍变化
edges.fromGoal: Explain why a fraction a/b is equivalent to (n×a)/(n×b) using visual models; use this principle to recognise and generate equivalent fractions, including tenths and hundredths
edges.toGoal: Interpret multiplication as scaling (resizing): compare the size of a product to a factor based on the size of the other factor without computing; explain the effect of multiplying by fractions greater than, equal to, or less than 1
edges.sourceReason: Relating n/n × a/b to equivalence connects to equivalent fractions
edges.chineseReason: 分子和分母同乘一个非零数，相当于把分数乘以等于1的数，量保持不变。

edges.fromGoal: Find the area of a rectangle with fractional side lengths by tiling with unit-fraction squares; show that the area equals the product of the side lengths
edges.toGoal: Interpret multiplication as scaling (resizing): compare the size of a product to a factor based on the size of the other factor without computing; explain the effect of multiplying by fractions greater than, equal to, or less than 1
edges.sourceReason: Interpreting fraction multiplication as scaling is enriched by the prior area-model experience of tiling fractional rectangles, which makes the resizing effect concrete
edges.chineseReason: 用分数边长拼出长方形，可以看见分数乘法怎样改变面积。

edges.fromName: 一个量占另一个量的几分之几
edges.fromGoal: Express one quantity as a fraction of another where the result may be less than 1 or greater than 1, and interpret the meaning in context
edges.toGoal: Understand probability as a measure on a scale from 0 (impossible) to 1 (certain); use the language of probability including likely, unlikely, certain, and impossible
edges.sourceReason: Probability as a fraction requires expressing one quantity as a fraction of another
edges.chineseReason: 一个量占另一个量的几分之几，可以用分数表示相应比例。

edges.fromGoal: Calculate the probability of a simple event with equally likely outcomes using the formula: probability = number of favourable outcomes ÷ total number of possible outcomes; express the result as a fraction in its simplest form; apply to rolling dice, drawing from bags, and other simple chance situations
edges.toGoal: Understand probability as a measure on a scale from 0 (impossible) to 1 (certain); use the language of probability including likely, unlikely, certain, and impossible
edges.sourceReason: The formal KS3 treatment of probability as a 0-1 scale with fairness and equally-likely outcomes formalises what was practised in the age-10-11 calculation node
edges.chineseReason: 概率可以用0到1之间的数表示；等可能情况下可用有利结果数与总数的比计算。

edges.fromName: 加减法口算 · 较大数与数位
edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract numbers mentally with increasingly large numbers, using place-value knowledge and derived facts
edges.toGoal: Perform mental calculations including with mixed operations and large numbers, using strategies such as partitioning, compensation, and derived facts
edges.sourceReason: Mental calculations with mixed ops/large numbers extends Y5 mental A+S
edges.chineseReason: 根据数位和已知事实选择合适口算方法，可以用于更大数和多种运算。

edges.fromName: 乘法竖式 · 多位数竖式
edges.fromGoal: Fluently multiply multi-digit whole numbers (up to 4 digits by 2 digits) using the formal written method of long multiplication
edges.toGoal: Perform mental calculations including with mixed operations and large numbers, using strategies such as partitioning, compensation, and derived facts
edges.sourceReason: Mental strategies build on understanding of formal multiplication
edges.chineseReason: 理解多位数乘法的分解方式，可以帮助构思口算策略。

edges.fromGoal: Identify and describe properties of 3-D shapes including the number of edges, vertices, and faces
edges.toGoal: Identify, draw, and interpret nets of common 3-D shapes — cubes, cuboids, triangular prisms, and square-based pyramids — by predicting which 3-D shape a given flat arrangement of faces will fold into, checking whether a net will close completely, and sketching a net from a description or 3-D model; understand the relationship between the number of faces and the structure of the net
edges.sourceReason: Predicting which net folds into a shape and checking that its faces, edges and vertices match requires knowing how many faces, edges and vertices common 3-D shapes have
edges.chineseReason: 比较展开图中面的数量和连接方式，可以判断它是否能折成目标立体。

edges.fromName: 平面图形 · 画平面图形与建立体图形
edges.fromGoal: Draw 2-D shapes and make 3-D shapes using modelling materials; recognise 3-D shapes in different orientations and describe them
edges.toGoal: Identify, draw, and interpret nets of common 3-D shapes — cubes, cuboids, triangular prisms, and square-based pyramids — by predicting which 3-D shape a given flat arrangement of faces will fold into, checking whether a net will close completely, and sketching a net from a description or 3-D model; understand the relationship between the number of faces and the structure of the net
edges.sourceReason: Having built 3-D shapes from modelling materials and recognised them in different orientations helps learners visualise how a flat net folds into a solid
edges.chineseReason: 观察立体与平面展开图的对应关系，可以帮助想象展开图折合后的形状。

edges.fromName: 运算顺序 · 四则运算的次序
edges.fromGoal: Understand and apply the conventional order of operations (PEMDAS/BODMAS) to carry out calculations involving the four operations
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use relationships between operations including inverse operations; use these relationships to check answers and simplify calculations
edges.sourceReason: Understanding order of operations (BODMAS) is required before studying how operations undo each other via inverse relationships
edges.chineseReason: 在含多步运算的算式中，需要结合运算顺序思考怎样逐步用逆运算还原。

edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, deciding which operations and methods to use and why; solve multi-step problems in contexts
edges.toGoal: Recognise and use relationships between operations including inverse operations; use these relationships to check answers and simplify calculations
edges.sourceReason: Fluency with all four operations in context is required before formalising inverse relationships between them
edges.chineseReason: 分析实际问题中的运算关系，可以帮助理解加减、乘除等逆运算。

edges.fromName: 小数的数位与运用 · 按精度取近似值
edges.toName: 用四舍五入估算 · 误差与上下界
edges.fromGoal: Round numbers and measures to an appropriate degree of accuracy including to a specified number of decimal places or significant figures
edges.toGoal: Use approximation through rounding to estimate answers and calculate possible resulting errors expressed using inequality notation a < x ≤ b; understand upper and lower bounds of rounded values
edges.sourceReason: Error intervals require understanding rounding to specified accuracy
edges.chineseReason: 按指定精度取近似值后，可以研究哪些原数会得到同一结果。

edges.fromGoal: Count within 1000, including skip-counting by 5s, 10s, and 100s
edges.toGoal: Count backwards through zero to include negative numbers
edges.sourceReason: Counting backwards through zero extends counting backwards within 1000
edges.chineseReason: 从正整数往回数并跨过0，可以继续认识负数。

edges.fromName: 顺着数与倒着数 · 每次走3
edges.fromGoal: Count forwards and backwards in steps of 3 from 0
edges.toGoal: Recognise, describe and create additive patterns that increase or decrease by a constant amount using numbers, shapes and objects, state the rule, and find missing elements
edges.sourceReason: Describing additive patterns builds on counting forwards and backwards in steps
edges.chineseReason: 每次增加或减少相同数量地数，可以帮助描述数列的增长规律。

edges.fromGoal: Identify and describe the repeating unit (core) of a repeating pattern made with numbers, symbols, shapes or objects, and use it to continue, create and compare patterns
edges.toGoal: Recognise, describe and create additive patterns that increase or decrease by a constant amount using numbers, shapes and objects, state the rule, and find missing elements
edges.sourceReason: Identifying the unit of repeat in repeating patterns prepares for describing the rule of growing patterns
edges.chineseReason: 辨认重复图案的单元后，可以比较增长规律每一步新增的部分；两种规则不一定相同。

edges.fromGoal: Apply properties of operations (commutative, associative, distributive) as strategies to multiply and divide
edges.toGoal: Identify arithmetic patterns (including patterns in the addition table or multiplication table) and explain them using properties of operations
edges.sourceReason: Explaining patterns uses properties of operations
edges.chineseReason: 运算的交换、结合等性质，可以帮助解释乘法表中的一些规律。

edges.fromGoal: Fluently multiply and divide within 100 using strategies such as the relationship between multiplication and division
edges.toGoal: Identify arithmetic patterns (including patterns in the addition table or multiplication table) and explain them using properties of operations
edges.sourceReason: Spotting patterns in tables requires knowing the facts
edges.chineseReason: 比较乘法表中的已知结果，可以观察每行或每列怎样变化。

edges.fromGoal: Plot and read coordinates in all four quadrants of the Cartesian plane, using positive and negative x- and y-values to describe positions precisely
edges.toGoal: Recognise that a linear function produces a straight-line graph, understand the relationship between an equation of the form y = mx + c and its graphical representation, and interpret gradient and y-intercept in context
edges.sourceReason: Understanding linear graphs requires confident coordinate plotting
edges.chineseReason: 一次函数图像由坐标点组成，需要理解点的横坐标和纵坐标。

edges.fromGoal: Substitute numerical values into formulae and expressions including scientific formulae; evaluate expressions by replacing variables with given values and computing the result using correct order of operations
edges.toGoal: Recognise that a linear function produces a straight-line graph, understand the relationship between an equation of the form y = mx + c and its graphical representation, and interpret gradient and y-intercept in context
edges.sourceReason: Interpreting y = mx + c requires substitution to generate coordinate pairs
edges.chineseReason: 把不同的x值代入y＝mx＋c，可以得到描图所需的数对。

edges.fromGoal: Model situations or procedures by translating them into algebraic expressions or formulae and by using graphs; move between word problems, algebraic representations, tables, and graphical representations
edges.toGoal: Recognise that a linear function produces a straight-line graph, understand the relationship between an equation of the form y = mx + c and its graphical representation, and interpret gradient and y-intercept in context
edges.sourceReason: Recognising the relationship between y=mx+c and its graph requires moving fluently between algebraic and graphical representations
edges.chineseReason: 比较y＝mx＋c的表达式和图像，可以观察系数与直线之间的关系。

edges.fromName: 求一个数量的几分之几：进阶
edges.toName: 小数与分数 · 测量与钱的情境
edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving increasingly harder fractions to calculate quantities, including non-unit fractions where the answer is a whole number
edges.toGoal: Solve simple measure and money problems involving fractions and decimals to two decimal places
edges.sourceReason: Fraction-of-quantity skills support measure/money problems
edges.chineseReason: 求一个数量的几分之几，可以用于测量和钱的情境。

edges.toName: 小数与分数 · 测量与钱的情境
edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract fractions with the same denominator, including results greater than one whole (e.g. 5/8 + 6/8 = 11/8)
edges.toGoal: Solve simple measure and money problems involving fractions and decimals to two decimal places
edges.sourceReason: Fraction addition/subtraction supports measure/money problem-solving
edges.chineseReason: 测量或钱的情境中若要合并同样大小的分数份，可以用分数加减。

edges.toName: 小数与分数 · 测量与钱的情境
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and write decimal equivalents of any number of tenths or hundredths (e.g. 3/10 = 0.3, 27/100 = 0.27)
edges.toGoal: Solve simple measure and money problems involving fractions and decimals to two decimal places
edges.sourceReason: Must understand decimal notation for measure/money problems
edges.chineseReason: 小数可以记录测量值和金额，需要理解各数位表示的量。

edges.fromGoal: Find the number that makes 10 when added to a given number from 1 to 9 (number bonds to 10)
edges.toGoal: Fluently add and subtract within 10
edges.sourceReason: Fluency within 10 requires knowing number bonds to 10
edges.chineseReason: 理解10以内数的分合，可以帮助找到相应的加减关系。

edges.fromGoal: Fluently add and subtract within 5
edges.toGoal: Fluently add and subtract within 10
edges.sourceReason: Fluency within 10 extends from fluency within 5
edges.chineseReason: 较小数的已知加减事实，可以帮助拆分10以内的其他计算。

edges.fromGoal: Measure, compare, add, and subtract lengths (m/cm/mm), mass (kg/g), and volume/capacity (l/ml) using standard units
edges.toGoal: Measure the perimeter of simple 2-D shapes
edges.sourceReason: Measuring perimeter requires measuring lengths and adding them
edges.chineseReason: 周长是外边界各段长度的和，需要测量或求出各段长度。

edges.fromName: 平面图形 · 边与对称
edges.fromGoal: Identify and describe properties of 2-D shapes including the number of sides and line symmetry in a vertical line
edges.toGoal: Measure the perimeter of simple 2-D shapes
edges.sourceReason: Perimeter of 2-D shapes requires knowing shape properties (number of sides)
edges.chineseReason: 看清图形有哪几条边，再把各边长度合起来，就能求出周长。

edges.fromGoal: Tell and write the time from analogue clocks with Roman-numeral faces (I to XII, including IV, which some clocks show as IIII, and IX), knowing that the minute positions are the same as on a clock with ordinary numbers; and read and write times on 12-hour and 24-hour clocks, knowing that the 24-hour clock runs from 00:00 at midnight to 23:59. Times from 1:00 a.m. to 11:59 a.m. keep the same hour (7:05 a.m. = 07:05); times from 1:00 p.m. to 11:59 p.m. are 12 hours more (3:20 p.m. = 15:20). The 12 o'clock hour is the exception to both: 12:20 p.m., just after noon, stays 12:20, and 12:20 a.m., just after midnight, becomes 00:20. Fluent conversion between 12- and 24-hour times is developed in Year 4
edges.toGoal: Read, write, and convert time between analogue and digital 12-hour and 24-hour clocks
edges.sourceReason: Year 4 conversion between analogue and digital 12- and 24-hour clocks builds on Year 3 reading of 12- and 24-hour times
edges.chineseReason: 读懂12小时制和24小时制的时刻后，可以继续在钟面和数字时刻之间转换。

edges.fromName: 用排列方阵表示乘法 · 用阵列表示乘除
edges.toName: 乘法是相同加数的和 · 用阵列和事实解决问题
edges.fromGoal: Use arrays to represent multiplication and division situations
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving multiplication and division using arrays, repeated addition, mental methods, and known facts
edges.sourceReason: Arrays are a key representation for solving multiplication/division problems
edges.chineseReason: 矩形阵列可以把乘除问题中的行、列和总数画出来。

edges.fromName: 乘法口诀与乘法表 · 2、5、10的乘除事实
edges.toName: 乘法是相同加数的和 · 用阵列和事实解决问题
edges.fromGoal: Recall and use multiplication and division facts for the 2, 5, and 10 multiplication tables
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving multiplication and division using arrays, repeated addition, mental methods, and known facts
edges.sourceReason: Solving multiplication/division problems requires knowing the table facts
edges.chineseReason: 已知的乘除事实可以帮助检验阵列或分组中的数量。

edges.fromGoal: Cardinality principle: the last number said when counting a set tells how many objects are in the set, regardless of arrangement or order counted
edges.toGoal: Make sense of a problem by identifying what is being asked, choosing concrete objects or pictures to represent the situation, and explaining a pathway to the solution
edges.sourceReason: Problem sense-making at 5-6 requires cardinality understanding to make sense of 'how many' problems
edges.chineseReason: 理解数字表示一组物品的数量，有助于看懂问题问的“一共有多少”。

edges.fromGoal: Understand addition as combining or putting together two groups to find the total
edges.toGoal: Make sense of a problem by identifying what is being asked, choosing concrete objects or pictures to represent the situation, and explaining a pathway to the solution
edges.sourceReason: Making sense of addition problems requires understanding addition as combining
edges.chineseReason: 理解把数量合起来的情境，有助于辨认故事中的加法关系。

edges.fromGoal: Multiply and divide whole numbers and those involving decimals by 10, 100, and 1000
edges.toGoal: Multiply and divide numbers by 10, 100, and 1000 giving answers up to three decimal places, understanding that digits shift position in the place-value chart
edges.chineseReason: 乘除10、100和1000时，可以观察各数字的位值怎样变化。

edges.fromGoal: Identify the value of each digit in numbers given to three decimal places (e.g. in 4.378, the 7 represents 7 hundredths)
edges.toGoal: Multiply and divide numbers by 10, 100, and 1000 giving answers up to three decimal places, understanding that digits shift position in the place-value chart
edges.sourceReason: Understanding digit shifting requires knowing what each decimal place represents
edges.chineseReason: 知道各个小数位表示的量，可以帮助解释乘除10等数后的位值变化。

edges.fromName: 乘法口诀与乘法表 · 2、5、10的乘除事实
edges.toName: 乘法口诀与乘法表 · 3、4、8的乘除事实
edges.fromGoal: Recall and use multiplication and division facts for the 2, 5, and 10 multiplication tables
edges.toGoal: Recall and use multiplication and division facts for the 3, 4, and 8 multiplication tables
edges.sourceReason: 3, 4, 8 times tables build on known 2, 5, 10 tables
edges.chineseReason: 已知的乘除事实可以帮助从相关规律推想3、4和8的乘法表。

edges.toName: 乘法口诀与乘法表 · 3、4、8的乘除事实
edges.fromGoal: Count from 0 in multiples of 4, 8, 50, and 100
edges.toGoal: Recall and use multiplication and division facts for the 3, 4, and 8 multiplication tables
edges.sourceReason: Counting in 4s and 8s supports learning those table facts
edges.chineseReason: 按4或8跳着数，可以观察对应乘法表中乘积的变化。

edges.toName: 有余数的除法 · 两位数除数与余数
edges.fromGoal: Divide numbers up to four digits by a one-digit number using short division (and place-value/array strategies); interpret remainders appropriately for the context
edges.toGoal: Divide numbers up to 4 digits by a two-digit divisor using formal written long division, interpreting remainders as whole numbers, fractions, or by rounding as appropriate
edges.sourceReason: Long division by 2-digit extends Y5 short division by 1-digit
edges.chineseReason: 逐位除法的步骤可以继续用于除数是两位数的情况。

edges.fromName: 乘法竖式 · 多位数竖式
edges.toName: 有余数的除法 · 两位数除数与余数
edges.fromGoal: Fluently multiply multi-digit whole numbers (up to 4 digits by 2 digits) using the formal written method of long multiplication
edges.toGoal: Divide numbers up to 4 digits by a two-digit divisor using formal written long division, interpreting remainders as whole numbers, fractions, or by rounding as appropriate
edges.sourceReason: Checking division with multiplication requires fluent multiplication
edges.chineseReason: 除法有余数时，可以用商乘除数再加余数，检查是否等于被除数。

edges.fromGoal: Multiply side lengths to find areas of rectangles and represent whole-number products as rectangular areas
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving perimeters of polygons: find perimeter from side lengths, find an unknown side length, and explore rectangles with same perimeter but different areas (or vice versa)
edges.sourceReason: Area of rectangles supports exploring same-perimeter-different-area relationships
edges.chineseReason: 求出不同长方形的面积和周长，可以观察周长相同不一定面积相同。

edges.fromGoal: Measure the perimeter of simple 2-D shapes
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving perimeters of polygons: find perimeter from side lengths, find an unknown side length, and explore rectangles with same perimeter but different areas (or vice versa)
edges.sourceReason: Measuring perimeter of simple shapes is prerequisite to perimeter problem solving
edges.chineseReason: 周长是外边界各边长度的和，可以通过测量或计算求出。

edges.fromName: 正多边形与不规则多边形
edges.fromGoal: Distinguish between regular and irregular polygons based on reasoning about equal sides and equal angles
edges.toGoal: Use conventional geometric terms and notation to describe, sketch, and draw points, lines, parallel and perpendicular lines, right angles, regular polygons, and reflectively/rotationally symmetric polygons
edges.sourceReason: GB route: the Year 5 distinction between regular and irregular polygons supports describing regular polygons; soft because this node is GB-only (both countries keep the hard shape-classification prerequisite)
edges.chineseReason: 描述正多边形时，需要准确说明边和角相等的特征。

edges.fromGoal: Compare and classify geometric shapes based on their properties and sizes; understand that attributes belonging to a category also belong to all subcategories; classify two-dimensional figures in a hierarchy based on properties
edges.toGoal: Use conventional geometric terms and notation to describe, sketch, and draw points, lines, parallel and perpendicular lines, right angles, regular polygons, and reflectively/rotationally symmetric polygons
edges.sourceReason: KS3 geometric notation builds on KS2 shape classification and property language
edges.chineseReason: 根据边、角等特征分类时，可以用几何符号和草图准确表达关系。

edges.fromName: 平面图形 · 画平面图形与建立体图形
edges.toName: 立体图形 · 从平面图认识立体
edges.fromGoal: Draw 2-D shapes and make 3-D shapes using modelling materials; recognise 3-D shapes in different orientations and describe them
edges.toGoal: Identify 3-D shapes, including cubes and other cuboids, from 2-D representations
edges.sourceReason: Y3 drawing 2D and making 3D shapes is prerequisite to identifying 3D from 2D representations
edges.chineseReason: 在屏幕上观察并搭建立体图形，有助于从不同方向的平面表示认识它。

edges.toName: 立体图形 · 从平面图认识立体
edges.fromGoal: Identify, draw, and interpret nets of common 3-D shapes — cubes, cuboids, triangular prisms, and square-based pyramids — by predicting which 3-D shape a given flat arrangement of faces will fold into, checking whether a net will close completely, and sketching a net from a description or 3-D model; understand the relationship between the number of faces and the structure of the net
edges.toGoal: Identify 3-D shapes, including cubes and other cuboids, from 2-D representations
edges.sourceReason: Identifying 3-D shapes from 2-D representations requires understanding the relationship between a net and its solid
edges.chineseReason: 展开图中的各个面与对应立体的表面相连，可以帮助辨认立体。

edges.fromName: 把除法看成求未知因数
edges.fromGoal: Understand division as an unknown-factor problem (e.g. find 32 ÷ 8 by finding the number that makes 32 when multiplied by 8)
edges.toGoal: Fluently multiply and divide within 100 using strategies such as the relationship between multiplication and division
edges.sourceReason: Using mult/div relationship as strategy supports fluency
edges.chineseReason: 把除法看成寻找未知因数，可以利用已知乘法事实推算商。

edges.fromName: 乘法口诀与乘法表 · 2、5、10的乘除事实
edges.fromGoal: Recall and use multiplication and division facts for the 2, 5, and 10 multiplication tables
edges.toGoal: Fluently multiply and divide within 100 using strategies such as the relationship between multiplication and division
edges.sourceReason: Fluency within 100 builds on knowing 2/5/10 tables
edges.chineseReason: 已知的2、5、10乘除事实可以与其他乘除事实联系起来。

edges.fromName: 乘法口诀与乘法表 · 3、4、8的乘除事实
edges.fromGoal: Recall and use multiplication and division facts for the 3, 4, and 8 multiplication tables
edges.toGoal: Fluently multiply and divide within 100 using strategies such as the relationship between multiplication and division
edges.sourceReason: Fluency within 100 builds on knowing 3/4/8 tables
edges.chineseReason: 已知的3、4、8乘除事实可以帮助推想相关乘除结果。

edges.fromGoal: Rote count forwards and backwards from 0 to 100, beginning from 0, 1, or any given number, by ones
edges.toGoal: Order and arrange combinations of mathematical objects in patterns and sequences
edges.sourceReason: Number sequence experience supports recognising patterns and sequences
edges.chineseReason: 观察数字按顺序变化，可以帮助发现数列中的规律。

edges.fromGoal: Count in multiples of 2, 5, and 10 (skip counting)
edges.toGoal: Order and arrange combinations of mathematical objects in patterns and sequences
edges.sourceReason: Skip counting patterns support general pattern recognition
edges.chineseReason: 跳着数会出现有规则变化的数列，可以用来观察排列规律。

edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract two two-digit numbers using concrete objects, pictorial representations, and mental methods
edges.toGoal: Solve addition and subtraction problems using mental and written methods, including problems involving numbers, quantities, and measures
edges.sourceReason: Solving real problems with mental/written methods requires the procedural skill of adding/subtracting two-digit numbers
edges.chineseReason: 分析实际问题后，可以选择口算、竖式或其他方法完成两位数加减。

edges.fromGoal: Solve one-step word problems involving addition and subtraction to 20, including missing-number problems
edges.toGoal: Solve addition and subtraction problems using mental and written methods, including problems involving numbers, quantities, and measures
edges.sourceReason: Problem-solving in context extends from Y1 word problems
edges.chineseReason: 把故事中的数量关系写成算式后，可以选择合适方法计算并解释结果。

edges.fromName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 简单图表与计数
edges.fromGoal: Interpret and construct simple pictograms, tally charts, block diagrams, and simple tables
edges.toGoal: Use simple digital tools (graphing apps, tablet tally counters) to acquire and record categorical data from surveys, observations and simple experiments, display it as a list, table, picture or bar graph, and compare category frequencies
edges.sourceReason: Digital displays build on pictograms and tally charts
edges.chineseReason: 象形图和计数表记录各类数量，也可以用屏幕上的图表呈现。

edges.fromGoal: Organise and represent data with up to three categories by counting objects in each category and sorting categories by quantity
edges.toGoal: Use simple digital tools (graphing apps, tablet tally counters) to acquire and record categorical data from surveys, observations and simple experiments, display it as a list, table, picture or bar graph, and compare category frequencies
edges.sourceReason: Recording data digitally requires sorting data into categories
edges.chineseReason: 先把数据按类别整理，再用屏幕表格记录和展示各类结果。

edges.fromName: 运算顺序 · 四则运算的次序
edges.fromGoal: Understand and apply the conventional order of operations (PEMDAS/BODMAS) to carry out calculations involving the four operations
edges.toGoal: Use conventional notation for the priority of operations including brackets, powers, roots, and reciprocals; apply BIDMAS/BODMAS consistently to evaluate complex numerical expressions
edges.sourceReason: Order of operations with powers/roots extends Y6 BODMAS understanding
edges.chineseReason: 已有的四则运算顺序可以扩展到含幂或根的算式。

edges.fromGoal: Use data from a random sample to estimate a characteristic of the population, such as a proportion, total count, or mean; present the result as an estimate rather than an exact population measurement; state the assumptions the inference relies on (the sample was randomly drawn from the population being described and is reasonably representative) and explain how the conclusion is limited or invalid when those assumptions fail
edges.toGoal: Generate or compare several random samples of the same size from the same population (by drawing physically — returning and remixing the items before each new sample — from a list, or by simulation), observe that their estimates differ by chance, and use the spread of those estimates to judge how uncertain a single estimate or prediction is — distinguishing chance variation between random samples from the consistent error caused by a biased sampling method, and distinguishing variation between sample estimates from the variation among individual observations within a sample
edges.sourceReason: Comparing estimates from several samples presupposes being able to produce an estimate from a single sample
edges.chineseReason: 多次从总体抽样并分别计算估计后，可以比较不同样本估计的波动。

edges.fromGoal: Describe the distribution of a numerical data set by its centre, spread and overall shape — recognising clusters, gaps, peaks, symmetry or skew (a longer tail on one side) and unusual values — and interpret each feature in the context in which the data were collected, recognising that distributions with similar centres can differ greatly in spread and shape
edges.toGoal: Generate or compare several random samples of the same size from the same population (by drawing physically — returning and remixing the items before each new sample — from a list, or by simulation), observe that their estimates differ by chance, and use the spread of those estimates to judge how uncertain a single estimate or prediction is — distinguishing chance variation between random samples from the consistent error caused by a biased sampling method, and distinguishing variation between sample estimates from the variation among individual observations within a sample
edges.sourceReason: Describing the spread of individual observations in a distribution supports contrasting it with the smaller spread of sample estimates
edges.chineseReason: 分别观察单个数据和多次样本估计的分散程度，可以比较这两种分布。

edges.fromGoal: Record, describe, and analyse the frequency of outcomes from probability experiments to develop an understanding of relative frequency as an estimate of probability
edges.toGoal: Generate or compare several random samples of the same size from the same population (by drawing physically — returning and remixing the items before each new sample — from a list, or by simulation), observe that their estimates differ by chance, and use the spread of those estimates to judge how uncertain a single estimate or prediction is — distinguishing chance variation between random samples from the consistent error caused by a biased sampling method, and distinguishing variation between sample estimates from the variation among individual observations within a sample
edges.sourceReason: Seeing relative frequencies vary between runs of a probability experiment is a close analogue of chance variation between random samples
edges.chineseReason: 不同次随机实验的频率可能变化，这与随机样本估计之间的波动相似。

edges.fromGoal: Describe, interpret, and compare observed distributions of a single variable using measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode) and spread (range), including choosing a suitable average and the effect of outliers; comparisons describe the observed data sets themselves and do not yet scale the difference in centres by a measure of variability or generalise from samples to wider populations
edges.toGoal: Generate or compare several random samples of the same size from the same population (by drawing physically — returning and remixing the items before each new sample — from a list, or by simulation), observe that their estimates differ by chance, and use the spread of those estimates to judge how uncertain a single estimate or prediction is — distinguishing chance variation between random samples from the consistent error caused by a biased sampling method, and distinguishing variation between sample estimates from the variation among individual observations within a sample
edges.sourceReason: Using the range to describe spread helps pupils summarise how much the sample estimates vary
edges.chineseReason: 极差可以概括一组结果从最小到最大相差多少，也可用于描述样本估计的变化范围。

edges.fromGoal: Read and write numerals from 0 to 20
edges.toGoal: Read and write numerals from 0 to 100
edges.sourceReason: Reading/writing numerals to 100 extends from reading/writing numerals to 20
edges.chineseReason: 读写较小数的数位方法，可以继续用于100以内的数。

edges.fromGoal: Rote count forwards and backwards from 0 to 100, beginning from 0, 1, or any given number, by ones
edges.toGoal: Read and write numerals from 0 to 100
edges.sourceReason: Reading/writing numerals to 100 requires fluent rote counting to 100
edges.chineseReason: 把数词顺序与对应数字联系起来，有助于读写100以内的数。

edges.fromName: 寻找二分之一与四分之一
edges.toName: 图形的二分之一与四分之一
edges.fromGoal: Recognise, find, and name a quarter as one of four equal parts of an object, shape, or quantity
edges.toGoal: Partition circles and rectangles into two and four equal shares and describe them using the words halves, fourths, and quarters
edges.sourceReason: Partitioning into fourths/quarters extends from Y1 understanding of quarters
edges.chineseReason: 理解一个整体的四分之一后，可以在图形中寻找相应的等份。

edges.toName: 图形的二分之一与四分之一
edges.fromGoal: Recognise, find, and name a half as one of two equal parts of an object, shape, or quantity
edges.toGoal: Partition circles and rectangles into two and four equal shares and describe them using the words halves, fourths, and quarters
edges.sourceReason: Partitioning shapes into halves extends from Y1 understanding of halves
edges.chineseReason: 把图形分成相等的两份，可以用一半描述其中一份。

edges.toName: 一个量占另一个量的几分之几
edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators (including mixed numbers) by replacing given fractions with equivalent fractions to produce a common denominator
edges.toGoal: Express one quantity as a fraction of another where the result may be less than 1 or greater than 1, and interpret the meaning in context
edges.sourceReason: Adding/subtracting fractions with unlike denominators is needed when comparing fractional parts
edges.chineseReason: 比较或合计不同分母的分数部分时，可以先把它们换成相同大小的份。

edges.fromName: 小数与分数 · 分数除法与小数百分数
edges.toName: 一个量占另一个量的几分之几
edges.fromGoal: Associate a fraction with division and calculate decimal fraction equivalents for simple fractions (e.g. 3/8 = 0.375); recall and use equivalences between simple fractions, decimals, and percentages in different contexts
edges.toGoal: Express one quantity as a fraction of another where the result may be less than 1 or greater than 1, and interpret the meaning in context
edges.sourceReason: Expressing one quantity as a fraction of another requires fluent fraction-decimal equivalence
edges.chineseReason: 比较两个量时，所得分数有时也可以写成等值小数。

edges.toName: 一个量占另一个量的几分之几
edges.fromGoal: Know and use advanced vocabulary of multiplicative reasoning — direct proportion, inverse proportion, ratio, rate, unit rate, compound unit, scale factor — accurately in problem-solving contexts
edges.toGoal: Express one quantity as a fraction of another where the result may be less than 1 or greater than 1, and interpret the meaning in context
edges.sourceReason: Expressing one quantity as a fraction of another uses 'proportion' and 'multiplicative relationship' vocabulary
edges.chineseReason: 部分与整体、比例和倍数关系等词语，可以帮助说明一个量占另一个量的几分之几。

edges.fromName: 正多边形与不规则多边形
edges.fromGoal: Distinguish between regular and irregular polygons based on reasoning about equal sides and equal angles
edges.toGoal: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct vocabulary for primes, factors, multiples, angle types, and polygon regularity; specify units including cm², m³, °; use notation for squares/cubes and percentages accurately
edges.sourceReason: Regular/irregular polygon vocabulary exercises geometric precision
edges.chineseReason: 使用正多边形和不规则多边形等词语，可以更准确地描述图形。

edges.fromName: 平方数与立方数 · 认识平方与立方
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and use square numbers and cube numbers, and the notation for squared (²) and cubed (³)
edges.toGoal: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct vocabulary for primes, factors, multiples, angle types, and polygon regularity; specify units including cm², m³, °; use notation for squares/cubes and percentages accurately
edges.sourceReason: Square/cube notation exercises precision in mathematical communication
edges.chineseReason: 使用平方和立方的符号，可以准确表达数乘自身的次数。

edges.fromGoal: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct fraction/decimal vocabulary, name angle types accurately, specify units in measurement and money, and use notation (=, <, >, ÷, ×) correctly
edges.toGoal: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct vocabulary for primes, factors, multiples, angle types, and polygon regularity; specify units including cm², m³, °; use notation for squares/cubes and percentages accurately
edges.sourceReason: Age 8-9 precision is prerequisite to age 9-10 level
edges.chineseReason: 准确使用数学词语和符号，有助于清楚表达推理。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that when all possible outcomes of a trial are listed, their probabilities must add up to 1; use this to find the probability of an event NOT happening: P(not A) = 1 − P(A); apply this shortcut to avoid counting all unfavourable outcomes directly
edges.toGoal: Understand and apply the rule that probabilities of all mutually exclusive outcomes sum to one; use this to find the probability of a complementary event (P(not A) = 1 − P(A))
edges.sourceReason: The formal mutually-exclusive outcomes rule extends the simpler complement rule introduced at age 10-11
edges.chineseReason: 一个事件和它的互补事件互不重叠且覆盖所有结果，因此两者概率和为1。

edges.fromGoal: Understand probability as a measure on a scale from 0 (impossible) to 1 (certain); use the language of probability including likely, unlikely, certain, and impossible
edges.toGoal: Understand and apply the rule that probabilities of all mutually exclusive outcomes sum to one; use this to find the probability of a complementary event (P(not A) = 1 − P(A))
edges.sourceReason: Probabilities summing to 1 builds directly on understanding the probability scale
edges.chineseReason: 概率尺度从0到1；事件与互补事件的概率合起来是1。

edges.fromName: 因数、倍数与质数 · 因数对与公倍数
edges.toName: 因数、倍数与质数 · 质因数与公因数公倍数
edges.fromGoal: Find all factor pairs for a whole number in the range 1–100; identify common factors and common multiples of two numbers; use these concepts to solve problems
edges.toGoal: Use the concepts and vocabulary of prime numbers, factors, multiples, common factors, common multiples, highest common factor (HCF), lowest common multiple (LCM), and prime factorisation including product notation and the unique factorisation property
edges.sourceReason: HCF/LCM/prime factorisation extends Y5-6 factor pairs and common factors/multiples
edges.chineseReason: 因数对和公因数公倍数的经验，可以继续用于质因数分解和最大公因数等问题。

edges.fromName: 平面图形 · 认识常见平面图形
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and name common 2-D shapes (circles, triangles, rectangles including squares)
edges.toGoal: Compose simple shapes to form larger shapes (e.g. two triangles make a rectangle)
edges.sourceReason: Composing shapes requires recognising the component shapes
edges.chineseReason: 认识简单图形的形状，有助于选择它们拼成新的图形。

edges.fromName: 立体图形 · 比较平面与立体
edges.fromGoal: Analyse and compare 2-D and 3-D shapes using informal language to describe sides, vertices, and other attributes
edges.toGoal: Compose simple shapes to form larger shapes (e.g. two triangles make a rectangle)
edges.sourceReason: Composing shapes benefits from understanding shape attributes to know how pieces fit together
edges.chineseReason: 观察图形的边和外形，可以帮助判断各部分怎样拼接。

edges.fromName: 乘法竖式 · 竖式与面积模型
edges.toName: 乘法竖式 · 多位数竖式
edges.fromGoal: Multiply a whole number of up to four digits by a one-digit number, and multiply two two-digit numbers, using formal written methods including long multiplication; illustrate with area models
edges.toGoal: Fluently multiply multi-digit whole numbers (up to 4 digits by 2 digits) using the formal written method of long multiplication
edges.sourceReason: Long multiplication 4×2 extends Y5 multiplication up to 4×1 and 2×2
edges.chineseReason: 多位数乘法仍可按数位拆出部分乘积，再把它们相加。

edges.fromGoal: Cardinality principle: the last number said when counting a set tells how many objects are in the set, regardless of arrangement or order counted
edges.toGoal: Understand that the teen numbers (11–19) are composed of ten ones and some further ones (early place value)
edges.sourceReason: Understanding tens-and-ones composition requires cardinality — knowing numbers represent quantities
edges.chineseReason: 数字表示一组物品的数量；十几可以看成一个十和若干个一。

edges.fromGoal: Read and write numerals from 0 to 20
edges.toGoal: Understand that the teen numbers (11–19) are composed of ten ones and some further ones (early place value)
edges.sourceReason: Composing/decomposing teen numbers requires reading and writing those numerals
edges.chineseReason: 认识十几的数字写法后，可以用一个十和几个一表示相同数量。

edges.fromGoal: Round any whole number up to 1,000,000 to the nearest 10, 100, 1,000, 10,000, or 100,000 using place-value understanding
edges.toGoal: Solve number and practical problems involving reading, writing, ordering, comparing, and rounding whole numbers up to 1,000,000
edges.sourceReason: Must round numbers before solving problems involving rounding
edges.chineseReason: 解决大数问题时，可以根据所需精度取近似值。

edges.fromName: 数的读写 · 整数的读写比较
edges.fromGoal: Read, write, order, and compare whole numbers up to at least 1,000,000 using base-ten numerals, number names, expanded form, and place-value understanding
edges.toGoal: Solve number and practical problems involving reading, writing, ordering, comparing, and rounding whole numbers up to 1,000,000
edges.sourceReason: Must read/write/compare numbers before solving problems with them
edges.chineseReason: 读写并比较大数，有助于理解题目中的数量。

edges.fromGoal: Round decimals to any place using place-value understanding; round any whole number to a required degree of accuracy
edges.toGoal: Solve number and practical problems involving reading, writing, ordering, comparing, rounding, and negative numbers up to 10,000,000
edges.sourceReason: Solving number problems involves rounding
edges.chineseReason: 大数问题有时需要按要求取近似数，并说明保留的精度。

edges.fromGoal: Read, write, order, and compare numbers up to 10,000,000 and determine the value of each digit
edges.toGoal: Solve number and practical problems involving reading, writing, ordering, comparing, rounding, and negative numbers up to 10,000,000
edges.sourceReason: Number problems to 10M requires reading/comparing to 10M
edges.chineseReason: 读写并比较千万以内的数，有助于理解题目中的数量关系。

edges.fromGoal: Use negative numbers in context (temperature, finance, sea level); calculate intervals across zero
edges.toGoal: Solve number and practical problems involving reading, writing, ordering, comparing, rounding, and negative numbers up to 10,000,000
edges.sourceReason: Negative number problems may appear in context
edges.chineseReason: 温度中的负数提供了一个实际情境，可以和大数及其他数的表示一起比较。

edges.toName: 按特征分类 · 分类、计数与排序
edges.fromGoal: Compare two groups of objects to determine which has more, fewer, or whether they are equal, using matching and counting strategies
edges.toGoal: Classify objects into given categories, count the number in each category, and sort the categories by count
edges.sourceReason: Sorting categories by count benefits from ability to compare quantities
edges.chineseReason: 比较各类数量多少，可以帮助按数量排列分类结果。

edges.toName: 按特征分类 · 分类、计数与排序
edges.fromGoal: Count a set of objects to answer 'how many?' for sets up to 20 (arranged in lines, arrays, circles, or scattered)
edges.toGoal: Classify objects into given categories, count the number in each category, and sort the categories by count
edges.sourceReason: Counting objects in each category requires being able to count sets of objects
edges.chineseReason: 先把物品分类，再数每一类有多少，可以得到各类数量。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones
edges.toGoal: Mentally add and subtract a three-digit number and hundreds
edges.sourceReason: Mental add/sub of hundreds requires three-digit PV
edges.chineseReason: 看清三位数的百位、十位和个位，有助于加减整百数。

edges.fromGoal: Find 10 or 100 more or less than a given number up to 1000
edges.toGoal: Mentally add and subtract a three-digit number and hundreds
edges.sourceReason: Extends finding 100 more/less to adding arbitrary multiples of 100
edges.chineseReason: 理解多或少100后，可以继续计算多或少几个百。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that decomposing a shape into more equal shares creates smaller shares
edges.toGoal: Partition circles and rectangles into two, three, or four equal shares; describe shares as halves, thirds, and fourths; recognise that equal shares of identical wholes need not have the same shape
edges.sourceReason: Understanding equal shares of different shapes requires concept of more shares = smaller
edges.chineseReason: 对同一个整体，分成的等份越多，每一份越小；需要先确认各份相等。

edges.fromName: 图形的二分之一与四分之一
edges.fromGoal: Partition circles and rectangles into two and four equal shares and describe them using the words halves, fourths, and quarters
edges.toGoal: Partition circles and rectangles into two, three, or four equal shares; describe shares as halves, thirds, and fourths; recognise that equal shares of identical wholes need not have the same shape
edges.sourceReason: Extends partitioning from halves/fourths to include thirds
edges.chineseReason: 把图形分成两等份或四等份后，可以继续尝试其他等分方式。

edges.fromGoal: Compare the likelihood of different events and order them from least to most likely — including situations with unequal outcomes such as a bag with more of one colour than another, or a spinner with sections of different sizes — and explain reasoning using informal language
edges.toGoal: Understand that 'equally likely' means every outcome has exactly the same chance of occurring; identify whether a given situation has equally likely outcomes (a fair coin, a fair die, a spinner with equal sections) or unequally likely outcomes (a bag with more of one colour, a spinner with unequal sections)
edges.sourceReason: Understanding what 'equally likely' means is a specific case of comparing likelihoods that requires the general comparison skill first
edges.chineseReason: 比较事件可能性后，可以判断两个事件的机会是否相同。

edges.fromGoal: Calculate and interpret the mean as an average of a data set
edges.toGoal: Describe, interpret, and compare observed distributions of a single variable using measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode) and spread (range), including choosing a suitable average and the effect of outliers; comparisons describe the observed data sets themselves and do not yet scale the difference in centres by a measure of variability or generalise from samples to wider populations
edges.sourceReason: KS3 averages and spread extend KS2 mean calculation to include median, mode, and range
edges.chineseReason: 平均数、中位数和众数描述中心；极差描述最大值与最小值之间的距离。

edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and use the vocabulary of statistical analysis — mean, median, mode, range, frequency, data, sample, average, chart, table, graph, pie chart, scatter graph, correlation — with understanding of what each term describes
edges.toGoal: Describe, interpret, and compare observed distributions of a single variable using measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode) and spread (range), including choosing a suitable average and the effect of outliers; comparisons describe the observed data sets themselves and do not yet scale the difference in centres by a measure of variability or generalise from samples to wider populations
edges.sourceReason: Describing distributions using mean, median, mode, and range requires all these statistical terms
edges.chineseReason: 理解平均数、中位数、众数和极差等词语，有助于描述数据。

edges.fromName: 平面图形 · 边与对称
edges.fromGoal: Identify and describe properties of 2-D shapes including the number of sides and line symmetry in a vertical line
edges.toGoal: Understand that shapes in different categories may share attributes defining a larger category; classify quadrilaterals (rhombuses, rectangles, squares) and draw examples of quadrilaterals not in those subcategories
edges.sourceReason: Identifying 2D shape properties is prerequisite to classifying by shared attributes
edges.chineseReason: 比较边和角等共同特征，可以帮助给四边形分类。

edges.fromName: 按特征辨认和绘制图形
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and draw shapes having specified attributes (e.g. a given number of angles or equal faces); identify triangles, quadrilaterals, pentagons, hexagons, and cubes
edges.toGoal: Understand that shapes in different categories may share attributes defining a larger category; classify quadrilaterals (rhombuses, rectangles, squares) and draw examples of quadrilaterals not in those subcategories
edges.sourceReason: Recognising shapes by attributes is prerequisite to quadrilateral hierarchy classification
edges.chineseReason: 根据边和角等特征辨认图形，可以继续比较四边形之间的包含关系。

edges.fromName: 加法与减法 · 三位数竖式
edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract numbers with up to three digits using formal written methods of columnar addition and subtraction
edges.toGoal: Solve addition and subtraction problems including missing-number problems, using number facts, place value, and more complex methods
edges.sourceReason: Formal written methods support solving more complex problems
edges.chineseReason: 求未知数的多步问题可能需要较大数计算，可以按需要选择竖式。

edges.fromGoal: Solve one- and two-step word problems within 100 using addition and subtraction, with unknowns in all positions
edges.toGoal: Solve addition and subtraction problems including missing-number problems, using number facts, place value, and more complex methods
edges.sourceReason: Complex missing-number problems extend simpler word problems
edges.chineseReason: 把情境拆成步骤并寻找中间未知量，可以用于更复杂的问题。

edges.fromGoal: Rote count forwards and backwards from 0 to 100, beginning from 0, 1, or any given number, by ones
edges.toGoal: Count to 120 starting at any number less than 120; read and write numerals to 120
edges.sourceReason: Counting to 120 extends fluent rote counting to 100
edges.chineseReason: 按顺序数到100的经验，可以继续用于100之后的数。

edges.fromGoal: Read and write numerals from 0 to 100
edges.toGoal: Count to 120 starting at any number less than 120; read and write numerals to 120
edges.sourceReason: Counting and reading/writing to 120 extends from reading/writing numerals to 100
edges.chineseReason: 读写和排列100以内的数后，可以继续表示120以内的数。

edges.fromName: 测量长度 · 选择工具测量
edges.fromGoal: Measure the length of an object by selecting and using appropriate tools such as rulers, yardsticks, metre sticks, and measuring tapes
edges.toGoal: Measure to determine how much longer one object is than another, expressing the length difference in terms of a standard length unit
edges.sourceReason: Comparing measured lengths requires ability to measure with tools
edges.chineseReason: 用相同单位测出长度后，可以比较各个测量结果。

edges.fromName: 测量长度 · 比较与排列长度
edges.fromGoal: Order three objects by length and compare the lengths of two objects indirectly using a third object
edges.toGoal: Measure to determine how much longer one object is than another, expressing the length difference in terms of a standard length unit
edges.sourceReason: Extends ordering/comparing by length to expressing differences in standard units
edges.chineseReason: 按同一单位测出长度后，可以用这些数值比较或表示差多少。

edges.fromGoal: Know and use advanced vocabulary of multiplicative reasoning — direct proportion, inverse proportion, ratio, rate, unit rate, compound unit, scale factor — accurately in problem-solving contexts
edges.toGoal: Use ratio notation to describe the relationship between two or more quantities, simplify ratios to their simplest form, and convert between ratio and fraction representations
edges.sourceReason: Ratio notation (a:b) requires 'ratio', 'simplify', and 'equivalent' as defined terms
edges.chineseReason: 理解比和等值比的含义，有助于读写a∶b这样的表示。

edges.fromName: 因数、倍数与质数 · 因数对与公倍数
edges.fromGoal: Find all factor pairs for a whole number in the range 1–100; identify common factors and common multiples of two numbers; use these concepts to solve problems
edges.toGoal: Use ratio notation to describe the relationship between two or more quantities, simplify ratios to their simplest form, and convert between ratio and fraction representations
edges.sourceReason: Simplifying ratios requires finding common factors — extends KS2 factor pairs and common factors
edges.chineseReason: 比的两项同时除以非零的共同因数，可以得到等值的简化比。

edges.fromName: 理解分数 · 不等分与分组
edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving unequal sharing and grouping using knowledge of fractions and multiples
edges.toGoal: Use ratio notation to describe the relationship between two or more quantities, simplify ratios to their simplest form, and convert between ratio and fraction representations
edges.sourceReason: Ratio notation and simplification extends KS2 unequal sharing and grouping with ratios
edges.chineseReason: 不等分中的各部分可以用比表示，等值比有助于比较分配关系。

edges.fromGoal: Represent proportional relationships using double number lines (two parallel number lines aligned at 0) and ratio tables; recognise that equivalent ratios generate straight lines through the origin when graphed
edges.toGoal: Use ratio notation to describe the relationship between two or more quantities, simplify ratios to their simplest form, and convert between ratio and fraction representations
edges.sourceReason: Ratio notation and simplification is complemented by double number line representations
edges.chineseReason: 双数轴可以对应两组按相同比例变化的数，帮助看见等值比。

edges.fromName: 把除法看成求未知因数
edges.fromGoal: Understand division as an unknown-factor problem (e.g. find 32 ÷ 8 by finding the number that makes 32 when multiplied by 8)
edges.toGoal: Determine the unknown whole number in a multiplication or division equation relating three whole numbers (e.g. 8 × ? = 48, ? × 6 = 42)
edges.sourceReason: Finding unknown factors requires seeing division as unknown-factor problems
edges.chineseReason: 已知乘积和一个因数时，可以用除法寻找另一个未知因数。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that a unit square has one square unit of area and that the area of a plane figure is the number of unit squares that cover it without gaps or overlaps
edges.toGoal: Measure areas by counting unit squares (square cm, square m, square in, square ft)
edges.sourceReason: Must understand unit squares and area concept before measuring by counting
edges.chineseReason: 用相同的单位正方形铺满平面，可以通过数方格测量面积。

edges.fromName: 因数、倍数与质数 · 因数对与公倍数
edges.fromGoal: Find all factor pairs for a whole number in the range 1–100; identify common factors and common multiples of two numbers; use these concepts to solve problems
edges.toGoal: Know and use the vocabulary of prime numbers, prime factors, and composite numbers; establish whether a number up to 100 is prime; recall prime numbers up to 19
edges.sourceReason: Must find factor pairs before reasoning about which numbers have exactly 2 factors (primes)
edges.chineseReason: 寻找一个数的因数对，可以帮助判断它是否恰好有两个正因数。

edges.toName: 用数字工具表示数量故事
edges.fromGoal: Represent addition and subtraction using objects, drawings, and mental images
edges.toGoal: Represent practical addition, subtraction and quantity situations within 10 with virtual materials (on-screen counters and ten frames) as well as physical counters, using counting or subitising to find the result
edges.sourceReason: Showing number stories on screen builds on representing addition and subtraction with objects
edges.chineseReason: 用物品或图画表示合并、拿走的数量，也可以在屏幕上表示同样的故事。

edges.toName: 用数字工具表示数量故事
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and name the number of objects in a collection of up to 5 instantly, without counting one by one (subitising), using dot patterns, dice faces, fingers and small groups of objects
edges.toGoal: Represent practical addition, subtraction and quantity situations within 10 with virtual materials (on-screen counters and ten frames) as well as physical counters, using counting or subitising to find the result
edges.sourceReason: Subitising small groups on a ten frame speeds up finding totals
edges.chineseReason: 观察十格板中的小组数量，可以帮助把各部分合起来求总数。

edges.fromName: 在引导下开展统计调查
edges.fromGoal: Carry out a guided statistical investigation for a question of interest: collect categorical or discrete numerical data, represent it in a suitable display and interpret the results in terms of the question
edges.toGoal: Conduct a statistical investigation by collecting data through survey responses and other methods, recording and displaying the data with digital tools, and interpreting and communicating the results
edges.sourceReason: An independent investigation builds on guided investigations
edges.chineseReason: 围绕问题规划对象和记录步骤，可以用于构思完整调查；这里的调查数据是模拟的。

edges.fromGoal: Use digital tools (online survey forms, spreadsheets, data-logging apps) to acquire categorical and discrete numerical data that address a question of interest, and display it as a column graph or other visualisation
edges.toGoal: Conduct a statistical investigation by collecting data through survey responses and other methods, recording and displaying the data with digital tools, and interpreting and communicating the results
edges.sourceReason: The investigation records and displays data with digital tools
edges.chineseReason: 屏幕上可以记录并整理模拟调查数据，观察结果如何呈现。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise, find, and name a half as one of two equal parts of an object, shape, or quantity
edges.toGoal: Describe movement and direction, including whole, half, quarter, and three-quarter turns
edges.sourceReason: Understanding half and quarter turns benefits from the concept of halves and quarters
edges.chineseReason: 转半圈和转四分之一圈，都可以与整圈的相等部分联系起来。

edges.fromGoal: Describe the position of objects using terms such as above, below, beside, in front of, behind, next to
edges.toGoal: Describe movement and direction, including whole, half, quarter, and three-quarter turns
edges.sourceReason: Describing movement and turns builds on positional language
edges.chineseReason: 用左右、前后等位置词语，可以帮助描述转向和移动。

edges.fromGoal: Use a scale, given as a ratio (e.g. 1:50), as a statement such as '1 cm represents 2 m', or as a scale factor, to work out actual lengths from a scale drawing or map and drawing lengths from actual lengths; reproduce a scale drawing at a different scale by finding each new drawing length, either through the actual length or from the ratio of the two scales; and solve map, room-plan and design problems with consistent units, converting between mm, cm, m and km before or after scaling. Areas from scale drawings and the area factor are developed in the follow-on topic Area from scale drawings
