edges.toGoal: Understand similarity as a relationship where one shape is an enlargement of another; construct similar shapes by enlargement with a given scale factor and centre, with and without coordinate grids
edges.sourceReason: Enlarging by a scale factor from a centre and finding scale factors between similar shapes extend using scale factors to reproduce drawings at a new size
edges.chineseReason: 比例图使用放大或缩小的关系；相似图形也有对应长度的固定比例。

edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving similar shapes where the scale factor is known or can be found
edges.toGoal: Understand similarity as a relationship where one shape is an enlargement of another; construct similar shapes by enlargement with a given scale factor and centre, with and without coordinate grids
edges.sourceReason: GB route: Year 6 similar-shape problems introduce finding and using scale factors; soft because this node is GB-only
edges.chineseReason: 相似图形对应边按同一个比例变化，可以用缩放倍数描述。

edges.fromGoal: Identify properties of translations, rotations, and reflections; describe and perform these transformations on given figures, and understand that the image is congruent to the original
edges.toGoal: Understand similarity as a relationship where one shape is an enlargement of another; construct similar shapes by enlargement with a given scale factor and centre, with and without coordinate grids
edges.sourceReason: Similarity and enlargement build on understanding rigid transformations first
edges.chineseReason: 平移、旋转或反射与等比缩放都可用于研究图形之间的相似关系。

edges.fromGoal: Use ratio notation to describe the relationship between two or more quantities, simplify ratios to their simplest form, and convert between ratio and fraction representations
edges.toGoal: Understand similarity as a relationship where one shape is an enlargement of another; construct similar shapes by enlargement with a given scale factor and centre, with and without coordinate grids
edges.sourceReason: Similar shapes have sides in a constant ratio — connects to ratio notation
edges.chineseReason: 相似图形的对应边长度具有相同的比，可以用比的写法描述。

edges.fromGoal: Express missing number problems algebraically using letters for unknowns; translate word problems into equations
edges.toGoal: Find pairs of numbers that satisfy an equation with two unknowns (e.g. find pairs (a, b) where a + b = 10 or 2a + b = 15)
edges.sourceReason: Finding pairs satisfying equations requires algebraic expression skills
edges.chineseReason: 含两个未知数的等式可以用字母表示，并寻找满足关系的数对。

edges.fromName: 平面图形 · 认识常见平面图形
edges.toName: 立体图形 · 比较平面与立体
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and name common 2-D shapes (circles, triangles, rectangles including squares)
edges.toGoal: Analyse and compare 2-D and 3-D shapes using informal language to describe sides, vertices, and other attributes
edges.sourceReason: Analysing and comparing shapes requires being able to name them first
edges.chineseReason: 认识常见平面图形后，可以与立体图形比较边、面和形状。

edges.fromName: 立体图形 · 认识常见立体图形
edges.toName: 立体图形 · 比较平面与立体
edges.fromGoal: Recognise and name common 3-D shapes (cubes, cuboids, pyramids, spheres, cylinders, cones)
edges.toGoal: Analyse and compare 2-D and 3-D shapes using informal language to describe sides, vertices, and other attributes
edges.sourceReason: Analysing 3-D shapes requires recognising and naming them
edges.chineseReason: 认识常见立体图形后，可以与平面图形比较它们的特征。

edges.toName: 加减法应用题 · 10以内的情境
edges.fromGoal: Represent addition and subtraction using objects, drawings, and mental images
edges.toGoal: Solve addition and subtraction word problems within 10 using objects or drawings
edges.sourceReason: Solving word problems within 10 requires ability to represent the operations with objects/drawings
edges.chineseReason: 用物品或图画表示故事中的合并与拿走，可以帮助分析10以内的加减。

edges.fromGoal: Know and use advanced vocabulary of multiplicative reasoning — direct proportion, inverse proportion, ratio, rate, unit rate, compound unit, scale factor — accurately in problem-solving contexts
edges.toGoal: Understand that a multiplicative relationship between two quantities can be expressed as a ratio; use ratio notation; simplify ratios
edges.sourceReason: Multiplicative relationships require 'multiplicative relationship', 'direct proportion', and 'rate' vocabulary
edges.chineseReason: 理解倍数关系、正比例和速率等词语，有助于描述两个量怎样一起变化。

edges.fromGoal: Represent proportional relationships using double number lines (two parallel number lines aligned at 0) and ratio tables; recognise that equivalent ratios generate straight lines through the origin when graphed
edges.toGoal: Understand that a multiplicative relationship between two quantities can be expressed as a ratio; use ratio notation; simplify ratios
edges.sourceReason: Understanding multiplicative relationships as ratios or fractions is reinforced by the double number line and proportion graph
edges.chineseReason: 双数轴或比例图像可以帮助观察两个量之间的倍数关系。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise that a linear function produces a straight-line graph, understand the relationship between an equation of the form y = mx + c and its graphical representation, and interpret gradient and y-intercept in context
edges.toGoal: Understand that a multiplicative relationship between two quantities can be expressed as a ratio; use ratio notation; simplify ratios
edges.sourceReason: Connecting ratios to linear functions links to understanding y = mx + c from algebra
edges.chineseReason: 正比例关系可以写成y＝kx，是经过原点的特殊直线关系。

edges.fromName: 一个量占另一个量的几分之几
edges.fromGoal: Express one quantity as a fraction of another where the result may be less than 1 or greater than 1, and interpret the meaning in context
edges.toGoal: Understand that a multiplicative relationship between two quantities can be expressed as a ratio; use ratio notation; simplify ratios
edges.sourceReason: Connecting ratios to fractions requires expressing quantities as fractions of each other
edges.chineseReason: 一个量占另一个量的几分之几，可以与它们的比联系起来。

edges.fromGoal: Use ratio notation to describe the relationship between two or more quantities, simplify ratios to their simplest form, and convert between ratio and fraction representations
edges.toGoal: Understand that a multiplicative relationship between two quantities can be expressed as a ratio; use ratio notation; simplify ratios
edges.sourceReason: Understanding multiplicative relationships requires fluent ratio notation
edges.chineseReason: 读写比并比较等值比，可以帮助描述两个量的倍数关系。

edges.fromName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 简单图表与计数
edges.fromGoal: Interpret and construct simple pictograms, tally charts, block diagrams, and simple tables
edges.toGoal: Organise and represent data with up to three categories by counting objects in each category and sorting categories by quantity
edges.sourceReason: Data representation formats (pictograms, tally charts) support organising data
edges.chineseReason: 计数表和象形图可以用来整理并呈现各类别的数据。

edges.fromGoal: Cardinality principle: the last number said when counting a set tells how many objects are in the set, regardless of arrangement or order counted
edges.toGoal: Organise and represent data with up to three categories by counting objects in each category and sorting categories by quantity
edges.sourceReason: Counting data in categories requires understanding cardinality
edges.chineseReason: 数出各类别分别有多少条记录，可以得到每类的数量。

edges.fromName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 收集和图表词语
edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and use the vocabulary of data collection and display — data, tally, tally chart, frequency, frequency table, survey, pictogram, bar chart, axis/axes, scale, label, category, discrete data, continuous data, line graph, pie chart — and apply these terms when collecting, organising, and presenting data
edges.toGoal: Organise and represent data with up to three categories by counting objects in each category and sorting categories by quantity
edges.sourceReason: Organising and representing data requires data, tally, frequency, and category vocabulary
edges.chineseReason: 理解类别、计数和频数等词语，有助于整理数据。

edges.fromName: 按特征分类 · 分类、计数与排序
edges.fromGoal: Classify objects into given categories, count the number in each category, and sort the categories by count
edges.toGoal: Organise and represent data with up to three categories by counting objects in each category and sorting categories by quantity
edges.sourceReason: Organising data in categories builds on classifying and counting objects in categories
edges.chineseReason: 把物品按特征分类并计数，可以用于组织各类别的数据。

edges.fromGoal: Cardinality principle: the last number said when counting a set tells how many objects are in the set, regardless of arrangement or order counted
edges.toGoal: Count a set of objects to answer 'how many?' for sets up to 20 (arranged in lines, arrays, circles, or scattered)
edges.sourceReason: Answering 'how many?' requires the cardinality principle
edges.chineseReason: 数字表示一组物品的总数，可以回答“一共有多少”。

edges.fromGoal: One-to-one correspondence when counting objects: each object is paired with exactly one number name
edges.toGoal: Count a set of objects to answer 'how many?' for sets up to 20 (arranged in lines, arrays, circles, or scattered)
edges.sourceReason: Counting objects to answer 'how many?' requires one-to-one correspondence
edges.chineseReason: 每件物品恰好对应一个数词，可以帮助数清20以内的物品。

edges.toName: 为生活问题建立数学模型
edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving similar shapes where the scale factor is known or can be found
edges.toGoal: Model real-world problems involving ratio, scale, volume, unit conversion, and proportional reasoning with appropriate tools, diagrams, or equations
edges.sourceReason: Scale factor problems are key Y6 modelling contexts
edges.chineseReason: 比例尺把图上长度和实际长度联系起来，是用数学表示生活问题的一种方式。

edges.toName: 为生活问题建立数学模型
edges.fromGoal: Model real-world problems involving scaling, unit conversion, area/perimeter, and percentage by selecting appropriate mathematical representations and interpreting results in context
edges.toGoal: Model real-world problems involving ratio, scale, volume, unit conversion, and proportional reasoning with appropriate tools, diagrams, or equations
edges.sourceReason: Y6 modelling extends Y5 real-world problem modelling
edges.chineseReason: 把实际情境转成数量关系，再结合情境解释结果，就是数学建模。

edges.toName: 为生活问题建立数学模型
edges.fromGoal: Find the volume of right rectangular prisms by packing with unit cubes and show it equals l × w × h (or base area × height); apply V = l × w × h and V = B × h to solve real-world problems; calculate, estimate, and compare volumes of cubes and cuboids in standard units (cm³, m³); and recognise that the formula applies to cuboids, while an irregular solid built from cubes must be counted or split into cuboids
edges.toGoal: Model real-world problems involving ratio, scale, volume, unit conversion, and proportional reasoning with appropriate tools, diagrams, or equations
edges.sourceReason: Volume formula application is key Y6 modelling context
edges.chineseReason: 用长、宽、高和体积的关系描述实际容器，是数学建模的一种例子。

edges.fromGoal: Compare two groups of objects to determine which has more, fewer, or whether they are equal, using matching and counting strategies
edges.toGoal: Compare two written numerals between 1 and 10 to determine which is greater or less
edges.sourceReason: Comparing written numerals is the symbolic form of comparing quantities — conceptual comparison helps but isn't strictly required
edges.chineseReason: 比较两组数量的多少，可以与比较表示它们的数字大小联系起来。

edges.fromGoal: Acquire categorical and discrete numerical data to address a question of interest by observing, collecting or accessing a data set, and record it using appropriate methods including frequency tables and spreadsheets
edges.toGoal: Use digital tools (online survey forms, spreadsheets, data-logging apps) to acquire categorical and discrete numerical data that address a question of interest, and display it as a column graph or other visualisation
edges.sourceReason: Collecting data digitally builds on collecting data for a question
edges.chineseReason: 围绕一个问题收集数据后，可以用屏幕工具记录和整理。

edges.fromGoal: Use simple digital tools (graphing apps, tablet tally counters) to acquire and record categorical data from surveys, observations and simple experiments, display it as a list, table, picture or bar graph, and compare category frequencies
edges.toGoal: Use digital tools (online survey forms, spreadsheets, data-logging apps) to acquire categorical and discrete numerical data that address a question of interest, and display it as a column graph or other visualisation
edges.sourceReason: Builds on early digital data tools
edges.chineseReason: 屏幕上的表格或图形可以帮助记录、整理和查看模拟数据。

edges.fromGoal: Fluently add and subtract within 100 using strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction
edges.toGoal: Solve one- and two-step word problems within 100 using addition and subtraction, with unknowns in all positions
edges.sourceReason: Solving word problems within 100 requires fluent computation within 100
edges.chineseReason: 分析两步故事中的数量关系后，可以选择合适的加减方法计算。

edges.fromGoal: Solve one-step word problems involving addition and subtraction to 20, including missing-number problems
edges.toGoal: Solve one- and two-step word problems within 100 using addition and subtraction, with unknowns in all positions
edges.sourceReason: Word problems within 100 extend word problems within 20
edges.chineseReason: 先把故事中的数量关系写成算式，再处理需要两个步骤的问题。

edges.fromGoal: Name, estimate and compare straight angles, reflex angles and revolutions alongside acute, right and obtuse angles, describing each by its relationship to a right angle (without measuring in degrees)
edges.toGoal: Estimate and compare acute, obtuse, and reflex angles in degrees; classify angles by type and order them by size
edges.sourceReason: Comparing angles to right and straight angles supports estimating in degrees
edges.chineseReason: 把一个角与直角、平角等参照比较，可以帮助估计它的度数。

edges.fromGoal: Know that angles are measured in degrees, where one degree is 1/360 of a full turn; understand that an angle turning through n one-degree angles has a measure of n degrees
edges.toGoal: Estimate and compare acute, obtuse, and reflex angles in degrees; classify angles by type and order them by size
edges.sourceReason: Estimating/comparing angles requires understanding the degree system
edges.chineseReason: 理解度数描述转动的大小后，可以估计和比较角。

edges.fromName: 象形统计图与计数表 · 简单图表与计数
edges.fromGoal: Interpret and construct simple pictograms, tally charts, block diagrams, and simple tables
edges.toGoal: Compare different graphical representations of the same data (tally chart, picture graph, bar graph, list) and identify and describe the features each shows in response to questions
edges.sourceReason: Comparing displays requires making tally charts and pictograms
edges.chineseReason: 先读懂图表怎样记录数量，再比较两幅图呈现的信息。

edges.fromGoal: Draw a picture graph and a bar graph (with single-unit scale) to represent a data set with up to four categories; solve put-together, take-apart, and compare problems using information presented in a bar graph
edges.toGoal: Compare different graphical representations of the same data (tally chart, picture graph, bar graph, list) and identify and describe the features each shows in response to questions
edges.sourceReason: Comparing displays requires making picture and bar graphs
edges.chineseReason: 比较象形图和条形图，可以观察同一数据的不同呈现方式。

edges.fromName: 加法与减法 · 四位数竖式
edges.toName: 熟练使用加减法 · 多位数竖式
edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract numbers with up to four digits using formal written methods of columnar addition and subtraction
edges.toGoal: Fluently add and subtract whole numbers with more than four digits using the standard columnar algorithm
edges.sourceReason: Columnar add/sub with 4 digits is prerequisite to >4 digits
edges.chineseReason: 按数位计算的竖式方法可以继续用于更多位数的加减。

edges.fromGoal: Plot linear graphs by generating a table of values, reduce a two-variable linear equation to the form y = mx + c, and calculate gradients from two points on a line
edges.toGoal: Use graphs of linear and quadratic functions to estimate output values for given inputs, find approximate solutions to equations, and interpret graphical information in real-world contexts
edges.sourceReason: Reading approximate values from graphs requires graph-plotting experience
edges.chineseReason: 从直线图像读取刻度时，可以估计不在标记上的数值。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise that quadratic functions produce curved (parabolic) graphs, distinguish them from linear graphs, and use plotted quadratic graphs to estimate values and find approximate solutions
edges.toGoal: Use graphs of linear and quadratic functions to estimate output values for given inputs, find approximate solutions to equations, and interpret graphical information in real-world contexts
edges.sourceReason: Estimating from quadratic graphs requires understanding how curves behave
edges.chineseReason: 从曲线图像读取数值时，可以结合坐标刻度估计答案。

edges.fromGoal: Generate and describe linear number sequences, including those with negative and decimal steps; identify the term-to-term rule
edges.toGoal: Generate terms of a sequence from a term-to-term rule (e.g., 'add 3 each time') or a position-to-term rule (e.g., '2n + 1'), and identify whether a sequence is arithmetic, geometric, or neither
edges.sourceReason: KS3 sequence generation extends KS2 linear number sequences
edges.chineseReason: 按固定差生成数列后，可以继续用规则描述任意位置的项。

edges.fromGoal: Substitute numerical values into formulae and expressions including scientific formulae; evaluate expressions by replacing variables with given values and computing the result using correct order of operations
edges.toGoal: Generate terms of a sequence from a term-to-term rule (e.g., 'add 3 each time') or a position-to-term rule (e.g., '2n + 1'), and identify whether a sequence is arithmetic, geometric, or neither
edges.sourceReason: Position-to-term rules require substituting the position number into a formula
edges.chineseReason: 把项的位置代入数列规则，可以得到该位置对应的数。

edges.toName: 认识十分之一 · 分成十份
edges.fromGoal: Recognise, find, name, and write fractions 1/3, 1/4, 2/4, and 3/4 of a length, shape, set of objects, or quantity
edges.toGoal: Count up and down in tenths; recognise that tenths arise from dividing an object into 10 equal parts and from dividing one-digit numbers or quantities by 10
edges.sourceReason: Tenths extend fraction understanding from halves, thirds, quarters
edges.chineseReason: 理解整体等分后的一份，可以继续观察分成十份时的十分之一。

edges.toName: 认识十分之一 · 分成十份
edges.fromGoal: Count in multiples of 2, 5, and 10 (skip counting)
edges.toGoal: Count up and down in tenths; recognise that tenths arise from dividing an object into 10 equal parts and from dividing one-digit numbers or quantities by 10
edges.sourceReason: Skip counting supports counting in tenths
edges.chineseReason: 每次增加相同数量的办法，也可以用于每次数十分之一。

edges.fromGoal: Use and interpret algebraic notation including: ab for a × b, 3y for y + y + y, a² for a × a, a/b for a ÷ b, coefficients as fractions, and brackets for grouping; read and write algebraic expressions fluently
edges.toGoal: Model situations or procedures by translating them into algebraic expressions or formulae and by using graphs; move between word problems, algebraic representations, tables, and graphical representations
edges.sourceReason: Translating real-world situations into algebra requires notation fluency
edges.chineseReason: 用字母表示变化的数，可以把生活中的数量关系写成代数式。

edges.fromGoal: Use algebraic methods to solve linear equations in one variable, including equations that require rearrangement, expanding brackets, and collecting terms on both sides; solve equations with rational number coefficients
edges.toGoal: Model situations or procedures by translating them into algebraic expressions or formulae and by using graphs; move between word problems, algebraic representations, tables, and graphical representations
edges.sourceReason: Modelling with algebra requires setting up and solving equations
edges.chineseReason: 把情境关系写成方程并求解，可以帮助用代数表示和解决问题。

edges.fromName: 测量质量与重量 · 直接比较轻重
edges.toName: 测量质量与重量 · 用单位测量质量
edges.fromGoal: Compare two objects directly by mass or weight and describe the difference using language such as heavy, light, heavier than, lighter than
edges.toGoal: Measure and begin to record mass/weight using non-standard and standard units
edges.sourceReason: Measuring mass with units requires first being able to compare masses directly
edges.chineseReason: 直接比较轻重后，可以用相同单位测量并记录质量。

edges.fromGoal: Interpret products of whole numbers (e.g. 5 × 7 as the total number of objects in 5 groups of 7)
edges.toGoal: Use multiplication and division within 100 to solve word problems involving equal groups, arrays, and measurement quantities
edges.sourceReason: Word problems require understanding what products mean
edges.chineseReason: 乘法可以表示相同的组或倍数关系，可用来分析情境中的乘积。

edges.fromGoal: Interpret whole-number quotients (e.g. 56 ÷ 8 as the number of objects in each share or the number of equal groups)
edges.toGoal: Use multiplication and division within 100 to solve word problems involving equal groups, arrays, and measurement quantities
edges.sourceReason: Word problems require understanding what quotients mean
edges.chineseReason: 除法可以表示平均分享或分组，可用来分析情境中的商。

edges.fromGoal: Calculate and interpret the mean as an average of a data set
edges.toGoal: Calculate the mean absolute deviation (MAD) of a small numerical data set — find the mean, find each value's distance from the mean (a non-negative number: a value equal to the mean has distance 0), then find the mean of those distances; interpret the MAD as the average distance of the values from the mean, stated in the original units of the data (e.g. minutes, cm, points); and use MADs to compare the spread or consistency of two data sets, recognising that a larger MAD means values typically sit further from the mean and that the MAD is 0 only when every value equals the mean
edges.sourceReason: Every MAD calculation starts by finding the mean and ends by averaging the distances, so calculating and interpreting the mean is essential
edges.chineseReason: 先算出平均数，再求每个数据到平均数的距离并取平均，得到平均距离。

edges.fromGoal: Describe the distribution of a numerical data set by its centre, spread and overall shape — recognising clusters, gaps, peaks, symmetry or skew (a longer tail on one side) and unusual values — and interpret each feature in the context in which the data were collected, recognising that distributions with similar centres can differ greatly in spread and shape
edges.toGoal: Calculate the mean absolute deviation (MAD) of a small numerical data set — find the mean, find each value's distance from the mean (a non-negative number: a value equal to the mean has distance 0), then find the mean of those distances; interpret the MAD as the average distance of the values from the mean, stated in the original units of the data (e.g. minutes, cm, points); and use MADs to compare the spread or consistency of two data sets, recognising that a larger MAD means values typically sit further from the mean and that the MAD is 0 only when every value equals the mean
edges.sourceReason: Seeing spread as a feature of a distribution helps pupils interpret what a larger or smaller MAD says about the data
edges.chineseReason: 平均距离描述数据离平均数有多远，可以用来比较数据的分散程度。

edges.fromGoal: Understand the absolute value of a rational number as its distance from zero on the number line; interpret absolute value as magnitude in real-world contexts; distinguish absolute value comparisons from ordering statements
edges.toGoal: Calculate the mean absolute deviation (MAD) of a small numerical data set — find the mean, find each value's distance from the mean (a non-negative number: a value equal to the mean has distance 0), then find the mean of those distances; interpret the MAD as the average distance of the values from the mean, stated in the original units of the data (e.g. minutes, cm, points); and use MADs to compare the spread or consistency of two data sets, recognising that a larger MAD means values typically sit further from the mean and that the MAD is 0 only when every value equals the mean
edges.sourceReason: Understanding absolute value as a distance on the number line supports treating each deviation from the mean as a positive distance
edges.chineseReason: 绝对值可以表示到平均数的距离；距离为0的记录也要计入平均。

edges.fromGoal: Describe, interpret, and compare observed distributions of a single variable using measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode) and spread (range), including choosing a suitable average and the effect of outliers; comparisons describe the observed data sets themselves and do not yet scale the difference in centres by a measure of variability or generalise from samples to wider populations
edges.toGoal: Calculate the mean absolute deviation (MAD) of a small numerical data set — find the mean, find each value's distance from the mean (a non-negative number: a value equal to the mean has distance 0), then find the mean of those distances; interpret the MAD as the average distance of the values from the mean, stated in the original units of the data (e.g. minutes, cm, points); and use MADs to compare the spread or consistency of two data sets, recognising that a larger MAD means values typically sit further from the mean and that the MAD is 0 only when every value equals the mean
edges.sourceReason: Using MAD to compare spread builds on knowing that a single number (first the range) can summarise how much values vary, and on comparing two data sets by centre and spread
edges.chineseReason: 极差和平均距离都可以概括数据的分散程度，但它们使用的信息不同。

edges.fromGoal: Count in multiples of 2, 5, and 10 (skip counting)
edges.toGoal: Understand that the multiples of 10 (10, 20, 30 … 90) represent one to nine tens and 0 ones
edges.sourceReason: Skip counting in tens supports recognising decade numbers
edges.chineseReason: 从0开始每次增加10，会依次遇到10的倍数。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that 10 can be thought of as a bundle of ten ones — called a 'ten'
edges.toGoal: Understand that the multiples of 10 (10, 20, 30 … 90) represent one to nine tens and 0 ones
edges.sourceReason: Understanding decade numbers as 'some tens and 0 ones' requires the concept of a ten
edges.chineseReason: 整十数由若干个十组成，个位为0。

edges.fromGoal: Select and use tools and representations strategically: choose between mental methods, formal written methods, protractors, fraction strips, and diagrams based on the demands of the problem
edges.toGoal: Select and use tools and representations strategically: choose between mental methods, formal written methods, algebraic approaches, coordinate grids, and technology based on the demands of the problem
edges.sourceReason: Y6 strategic tool use extends Y5 tool selection
edges.chineseReason: 比较不同表示方式能说明什么，可以帮助选择适合问题的数学工具。

edges.fromGoal: Plot and read ordered pairs in the first quadrant of the coordinate plane; represent real-world and mathematical problems by graphing points and interpreting coordinate values in context
edges.toGoal: Select and use tools and representations strategically: choose between mental methods, formal written methods, algebraic approaches, coordinate grids, and technology based on the demands of the problem
edges.sourceReason: Coordinate grids are a new tool for verification
edges.chineseReason: 坐标网格可以用来放点并检查位置关系，是一种数学工具。

edges.fromName: 有余数的除法 · 两位数除数与余数
edges.fromGoal: Divide numbers up to 4 digits by a two-digit divisor using formal written long division, interpreting remainders as whole numbers, fractions, or by rounding as appropriate
edges.toGoal: Select and use tools and representations strategically: choose between mental methods, formal written methods, algebraic approaches, coordinate grids, and technology based on the demands of the problem
edges.sourceReason: Choosing long vs short division exemplifies Y6 strategic tool use
edges.chineseReason: 比较简式和竖式除法的步骤，可以练习为问题选择合适工具或方法。

edges.fromGoal: Order and arrange combinations of mathematical objects in patterns and sequences
edges.toGoal: Identify and describe the repeating unit (core) of a repeating pattern made with numbers, symbols, shapes or objects, and use it to continue, create and compare patterns
edges.sourceReason: Identifying the repeating unit requires copying and continuing repeating patterns
edges.chineseReason: 观察图案怎样重复，可以找出反复出现的部分。

edges.fromName: 物体有哪些可测量的量
edges.fromGoal: Describe and identify measurable attributes of objects such as length, height, weight, and capacity; use comparative language (longer, shorter, heavier, lighter, more, less)
edges.toGoal: Compare and describe capacity and volume using language such as full, empty, more than, less than, half full
edges.sourceReason: Comparing capacity requires understanding capacity as a measurable attribute
edges.chineseReason: 容积描述容器能装多少，可以选择两个容器比较这一量。

edges.fromName: 测量单位换算 · 长度与时间单位
edges.toName: 测量单位换算 · 常用单位的相对大小
edges.fromGoal: Convert between different units of measure (e.g. kilometre to metre, hour to minute, minute to second, year to month, week to day)
edges.toGoal: Know relative sizes of measurement units within one system (km/m/cm/mm, kg/g, l/ml, hr/min/sec); convert between different metric units and express measurements in terms of a smaller unit; record equivalents in conversion tables
edges.sourceReason: Y4 unit conversion is prerequisite to systematic metric conversions with tables
edges.chineseReason: 根据长度和时间等单位之间的关系，可以用换算表系统记录等值数量。

edges.toName: 测量单位换算 · 常用单位的相对大小
edges.fromGoal: Multiply and divide whole numbers and those involving decimals by 10, 100, and 1000
edges.toGoal: Know relative sizes of measurement units within one system (km/m/cm/mm, kg/g, l/ml, hr/min/sec); convert between different metric units and express measurements in terms of a smaller unit; record equivalents in conversion tables
edges.sourceReason: ×÷ by 10/100/1000 supports metric unit conversions
edges.chineseReason: 公制单位之间常有10、100或1000倍关系，可以用乘除进行换算。

edges.toName: 加减法应用题 · 同分母分数情境
edges.fromGoal: Add and subtract mixed numbers with like denominators, including by converting to improper fractions or using properties of operations
edges.toGoal: Solve word problems involving addition and subtraction of fractions with like denominators, using visual models and equations
edges.sourceReason: Must add/sub mixed numbers before solving word problems with them
edges.chineseReason: 同样大小的分数份可以相加减，也可结合整数部分处理带分数情境。

edges.fromGoal: Use decimal notation for fractions with denominators 10 or 100; read and write decimal numbers as fractions (e.g. 0.62 = 62/100, 0.71 = 71/100)
edges.toGoal: Understand the per cent symbol (%); know that per cent means ‘number of parts per hundred’; write percentages as a fraction with denominator 100 and as a decimal
edges.sourceReason: Decimal notation for fractions is prerequisite to understanding % as parts per 100
edges.chineseReason: 百分数表示每100份中的多少份，可与百分之一及分母为100的分数联系。

edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and use decimal and percentage notation correctly — decimal, decimal point, tenths, hundredths, thousandths, percentage, per cent, % symbol, convert, terminating decimal — and understand the relationships between fractions, decimals, and percentages as three ways of expressing the same value
edges.toGoal: Understand the per cent symbol (%); know that per cent means ‘number of parts per hundred’; write percentages as a fraction with denominator 100 and as a decimal
edges.sourceReason: Understanding the % symbol and 'per cent means parts per hundred' is the LANGUAGE node content
edges.chineseReason: 百分号表示按每百份来描述数量，读写百分数需要理解这一含义。

edges.toName: 数轴上的数 · 选择数轴等工具
edges.fromGoal: Select and use familiar tools (concrete objects, fingers, ten frames) to help solve a mathematical problem
edges.toGoal: Select and use appropriate tools and representations (number lines, hundred squares, rulers, part-whole models) to support problem-solving
edges.sourceReason: Age 6-7 strategic tool selection builds on age 5-6 familiarity with basic tools
edges.chineseReason: 尝试用物品或图形解决问题后，可以比较数轴等工具适合说明什么。

edges.fromName: 测量长度 · 用相同单位首尾相接
edges.toName: 数轴上的数 · 选择数轴等工具
edges.fromGoal: Measure the length of an object using same-size length units laid end to end with no gaps or overlaps
edges.toGoal: Select and use appropriate tools and representations (number lines, hundred squares, rulers, part-whole models) to support problem-solving
edges.sourceReason: Measuring length with units requires selecting appropriate measurement tools
edges.chineseReason: 测量长度时，需要选择合适的单位和工具。

edges.toName: 数轴上的数 · 选择数轴等工具
edges.fromGoal: Add within 100 using strategies based on place value, including adding a two-digit and one-digit number, and a two-digit and a multiple of 10
edges.toGoal: Select and use appropriate tools and representations (number lines, hundred squares, rulers, part-whole models) to support problem-solving
edges.sourceReason: Adding within 100 requires choosing number line vs hundred square strategically
edges.chineseReason: 计算100以内加法时，可以根据问题选择数轴、百数表或其他方法。

edges.fromName: 求一个数量的几分之几：进阶
edges.toName: 理解分数 · 分数倍与简单速率
edges.fromGoal: Solve problems involving increasingly harder fractions to calculate quantities, including non-unit fractions where the answer is a whole number
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving scaling by simple fractions and problems involving simple rates
edges.sourceReason: Fraction-of-quantity skills support scaling by simple fractions
edges.chineseReason: 求一个数量的几分之几，可以用来描述把数量缩放为原来的某个分数倍。

edges.fromName: 用倍数比较 · 倍数比较的情境问题
edges.toName: 理解分数 · 分数倍与简单速率
edges.fromGoal: Solve word problems involving multiplicative comparison using drawings and equations with a symbol for the unknown number
edges.toGoal: Solve problems involving scaling by simple fractions and problems involving simple rates
edges.sourceReason: Multiplicative comparison supports scaling problems
edges.chineseReason: 倍数比较描述两个数量之间的乘法关系，可用于分析缩放情境。

edges.fromGoal: Read, write, and interpret the symbols +, −, and = in number sentences
edges.toGoal: Read, write, and interpret the symbols ×, ÷, and = in multiplication and division number sentences
edges.sourceReason: Reading × and ÷ symbols parallels reading + and − symbols
edges.chineseReason: 乘号和除号是运算符号，与加号、减号一样需要结合数量关系理解。

edges.fromGoal: Understand division as sharing equally into groups or as grouping (how many groups of a given size can be made)
edges.toGoal: Read, write, and interpret the symbols ×, ÷, and = in multiplication and division number sentences
edges.sourceReason: Writing ÷ sentences requires understanding division
edges.chineseReason: 读写除号时，可以结合平均分享或分组情境理解它表示的运算。

edges.fromName: 乘法是相同加数的和 · 相同加数与成组
edges.fromGoal: Understand multiplication as repeated addition and grouping equal sets
edges.toGoal: Read, write, and interpret the symbols ×, ÷, and = in multiplication and division number sentences
edges.sourceReason: Writing × sentences requires understanding multiplication
edges.chineseReason: 读写乘号时，可以结合相同组或重复加法理解它表示的运算。

edges.fromGoal: Recognise, describe and create additive patterns that increase or decrease by a constant amount using numbers, shapes and objects, state the rule, and find missing elements
edges.toGoal: Follow and create algorithms (flowcharts or written step lists) with a sequence of steps, decisions using comparisons (e.g. 'Is the number greater than 20?', 'Is it even?') and repetition until a stop condition, to investigate numbers and describe the patterns that emerge
edges.sourceReason: Describing pattern rules supports describing the number patterns an algorithm produces
edges.chineseReason: 先描述数列每一步的变化，可以帮助写出生成它的运算步骤。

edges.fromGoal: Identify arithmetic patterns (including patterns in the addition table or multiplication table) and explain them using properties of operations
edges.toGoal: Follow and create algorithms (flowcharts or written step lists) with a sequence of steps, decisions using comparisons (e.g. 'Is the number greater than 20?', 'Is it even?') and repetition until a stop condition, to investigate numbers and describe the patterns that emerge
edges.sourceReason: Recognising number patterns supports describing what an algorithm produces
edges.chineseReason: 观察乘法表中的规律，可以帮助描述按规则计算得到的数列。

edges.fromGoal: Draw and measure line segments and angles accurately, and construct triangles from given conditions using the drawing approaches the standard calls for: ruler and protractor for two sides and the included angle (SAS) or two angles and the included side (ASA); ruler and compasses for three sides (SSS), using intersecting arcs; and dynamic geometry software; check each construction by measuring the remaining sides and angles (to within about 1 mm and 1°). Interpreting scale drawings is covered in Scale drawings and maps; deciding whether conditions give one, many or no triangles is covered in Which triangles are possible
edges.toGoal: Use ruler and compasses to perform standard constructions: perpendicular bisector of a line segment, perpendicular to a line from or at a given point, and bisecting an angle
edges.sourceReason: Compass constructions require confident drawing and measuring skills first
edges.chineseReason: 理解边长和角度的条件，有助于看懂尺规作图怎样确定三角形。

edges.fromGoal: Understand probability as a measure expressed as a number between 0 (impossible) and 1 (certain); place events on the probability scale; express probabilities as fractions, decimals, and percentages
edges.toGoal: Calculate the probability of a simple event with equally likely outcomes using the formula: probability = number of favourable outcomes ÷ total number of possible outcomes; express the result as a fraction in its simplest form; apply to rolling dice, drawing from bags, and other simple chance situations
edges.sourceReason: Calculating probability using favourable/total outcomes requires understanding probability as a number on a 0-1 scale
edges.chineseReason: 概率位于0和1之间；各结果等可能时，可以用有利结果数与总数的比计算。

edges.fromGoal: Understand that 'equally likely' means every outcome has exactly the same chance of occurring; identify whether a given situation has equally likely outcomes (a fair coin, a fair die, a spinner with equal sections) or unequally likely outcomes (a bag with more of one colour, a spinner with unequal sections)
edges.toGoal: Calculate the probability of a simple event with equally likely outcomes using the formula: probability = number of favourable outcomes ÷ total number of possible outcomes; express the result as a fraction in its simplest form; apply to rolling dice, drawing from bags, and other simple chance situations
edges.sourceReason: The probability formula only applies to situations with equally likely outcomes — this concept must be secure first
edges.chineseReason: 各结果等可能时，可以用有利结果数除以全部结果数；不等可能时不能只靠结果数量判断概率。

edges.toName: 拿走与分开：减法的意义
edges.fromGoal: Cardinality principle: the last number said when counting a set tells how many objects are in the set, regardless of arrangement or order counted
edges.toGoal: Understand subtraction as taking away or separating from a group to find how many remain
edges.sourceReason: Understanding subtraction as taking away requires knowing numbers represent quantities (cardinality)
edges.chineseReason: 知道数字表示原有的数量后，可以用减法描述拿走后的数量。

edges.toName: 按特征辨认和绘制图形
edges.fromGoal: Distinguish defining attributes of shapes (e.g. triangles are closed and three-sided) from non-defining attributes (e.g. colour, orientation, overall size)
edges.toGoal: Recognise and draw shapes having specified attributes (e.g. a given number of angles or equal faces); identify triangles, quadrilaterals, pentagons, hexagons, and cubes
edges.sourceReason: Drawing shapes by attributes extends understanding defining vs non-defining attributes
edges.chineseReason: 辨认决定图形类别的特征，可以帮助按要求绘制图形。

edges.fromName: 平面图形 · 边与对称
edges.toName: 按特征辨认和绘制图形
edges.fromGoal: Identify and describe properties of 2-D shapes including the number of sides and line symmetry in a vertical line
edges.toGoal: Recognise and draw shapes having specified attributes (e.g. a given number of angles or equal faces); identify triangles, quadrilaterals, pentagons, hexagons, and cubes
edges.sourceReason: Identifying pentagons, hexagons, quadrilaterals extends knowing 2-D shape properties
edges.chineseReason: 根据平面图形的边数等特征，可以辨认和绘制不同的多边形。

edges.fromGoal: Find the number that makes 10 when added to a given number from 1 to 9 (number bonds to 10)
edges.toGoal: Add three one-digit numbers using strategies including looking for pairs that make 10
edges.sourceReason: Looking for pairs that make 10 benefits from knowing number bonds to 10
edges.chineseReason: 知道哪些两个数合起来是10，可以帮助选择先凑十的两个加数。

edges.fromGoal: Understand and apply the commutative property of addition: addends can be added in any order
edges.toGoal: Add three one-digit numbers using strategies including looking for pairs that make 10
edges.sourceReason: Spotting a pair that makes 10 and adding it first means reordering addends, which relies on knowing that addition can be done in any order
edges.chineseReason: 交换加数顺序，可以先把合成10的两个数相加。

edges.fromGoal: Understand and apply the associative property of addition: when adding three numbers, any two can be added first
edges.toGoal: Add three one-digit numbers using strategies including looking for pairs that make 10
edges.sourceReason: US route: the associative property formalises grouping any two of the three addends first; soft because this node is US-only and England teaches the grouping within adding three one-digit numbers
